papers.title: TinyCardioUNet: IMU-to-ECG Translation with Graph-Encoded Inter-Axis Dependencies and Tensor Decomposition-Based Parameter Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Estimating electrocardiography (ECG) from a chest-worn inertial measurement unit (IMU) enables continuous heart rate (HR) monitoring without the discomfort of electrodes. We propose TinyCardioUNet, a lightweight UNet that uses all six IMU axes without prior channel selection, refines its bottleneck with a graph neural network that encodes inter-axis dependencies, and employs tensor decomposition with automatic variational Bayesian rank selection for parameter reduction. On a public dataset, TinyCardioUNet achieves an RMSE of $0.098$ and a Pearson correlation coefficient of $0.677$ with only $36.0$k parameters and remains comparatively robust to additive noise, demonstrating accurate ECG reconstruction with a compact model.
papers.comment: The source code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/ttlabtuat/TinyCardioUNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TinyCardioUNet 用轻量 UNet 直接从胸戴 IMU 六轴信号重建 ECG：瓶颈处用图神经网络编码轴间依赖，再用张量分解加自动变分贝叶斯秩选择压缩参数。在公开数据集上 RMSE 0.098、Pearson 相关 0.677，参数仅 36.0k，且对加性噪声保持相对稳健。
Motivation: 用 ECG 电极长期监测心率体验不适，IMU 可无电极连续测心率，但六轴信号到 ECG 的映射需要在小模型容量下保住重建精度。
Method: 轻量 UNet 不做通道筛选、直接吃全部六个 IMU 轴；瓶颈用图神经网络 (GNN) 编码轴间依赖；参数削减用张量分解配合自动变分贝叶斯秩选择。
Result: 在公开数据集上 RMSE 0.098，Pearson 相关系数 0.677，参数量 36.0k，并对加性噪声表现出相对稳健性。
Conclusion: 轴间依赖建模加张量分解可以在 36.0k 参数量级上实现准确的 IMU 到 ECG 重建，支撑无电极的连续心率监测。

papers.title: Neuralized Multi-Wavelet Decomposition for Time Series Classification and Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series analysis is fundamental in domains such as finance, healthcare, and meteorology. Real-world time series often exhibit multiscale characteristics shaped by diverse latent factors, resulting in intricate temporal patterns and rich frequency structures. However, existing approaches typically focus on either frequency-domain decomposition or time-domain pattern extraction in isolation, neglecting their joint structure. This decoupled modeling limits representation expressiveness and undermines performance in tasks requiring simultaneous temporal and spectral reasoning. To address this gap, we propose m-WCN, a novel end-to-end deep learning framework that neuralizes multi-wavelet decomposition for joint extraction of temporal patterns and frequency components. By approximating the classical GHM multi-wavelet transform with trainable convolutional operators and enforcing orthogonality constraints, m-WCN produces interpretable multi-resolution representations. Built on this foundation, we introduce two task-specific architectures: TFBC for time series classification, which boosts discriminative features across frequency scales, and FTB for forecasting, which ensembles frequency-aware predictors. Extensive experiments on 64 UCR datasets and seven public forecasting benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Built on the neuralized m-WCN, our TFBC and FTB outperform various baseline models across diverse datasets, achieving average improvements of 19.97% in classification and 19.92% in forecasting tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 m-WCN，用可训练卷积算子近似经典 GHM 多小波变换并施加正交约束，把时域模式与频域分量放进一个端到端框架；在其上构建分类架构 TFBC 与预测架构 FTB。在 64 个 UCR 数据集与七个公开预测基准上，相对多种基线平均提升 19.97%（分类）与 19.92%（预测）。
Motivation: 现有时间序列方法要么只做频域分解、要么只做时域模式提取，二者解耦限制了表示表达力，难以支撑需要同时做时序与频谱推理的任务。
Method: m-WCN 用可训练卷积算子近似 GHM multi-wavelet transform，并以正交约束保证可解释的多分辨率表示；TFBC 在各频尺度上增强判别特征用于分类，FTB 集成频域感知的预测器用于 forecasting，整体端到端训练。
Result: 在 64 个 UCR 分类数据集与七个公开 forecasting 基准上，TFBC 与 FTB 相对多种基线模型平均提升分别为 19.97%（分类）与 19.92%（预测）。
Conclusion: 把经典多小波分解神经化并保持正交性，可在分类与预测两类任务上同时带来两位数的平均性能提升，说明时频联合建模优于时域或频域单独建模。

papers.title: When No One Owns the Judgment: Accountability Under Contribution Dissolution in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Communities often respond to potentially AI-assisted work by asking three questions: Was AI used? Was that use disclosed? Can hidden use be detected? These questions place AI use itself at the center of accountability while overlooking a deeper problem: unowned judgment. Evaluations, claims, decisions, and creative directions can be shaped by AI with no accountable human or institution prepared to stand behind them. We develop this argument through two illustrative cases: AI-assisted peer review and concealed AI use in creative work. The first shows how contribution dissolution can weaken responsibility while the second shows how the fear of losing credit can discourage honest disclosure. The cases expose the limits of disclosure rules and provenance records as responses to AI-mediated collaboration. We offer three directions for discussion: distinguishing the roles AI plays, identifying judgments that require clear human ownership, and creating conditions in which AI involvement can be disclosed without default penalty. The broader aim is to make AI-shaped contributions discussable, creditable, contestable, and repairable.
papers.comment: In CSCW'26 workshop on contribution, originality, and accountability in agent-mediated collaboration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出社区对 AI 辅助工作的问责只盯「是否用了 AI、是否披露、能否检测」，却漏掉了更根本的问题：AI 塑造的评价、主张与创作方向背后没有可问责的人或机构（unowned judgment）。以 AI 辅助同行评审和隐瞒 AI 使用的创作为两个案例，论证贡献溶解 (contribution dissolution) 会削弱责任、而怕失去署名又会抑制诚实披露，因此披露规则与来源记录 (provenance) 都不足以应对。
Motivation: 现有问责框架把 AI 使用本身置于中心，但真正断裂的是判断的所有权：AI 参与形成的评价与决策无人愿为其负责，披露规则和 provenance 记录对此失效。
Method: 通过两个说明性案例展开论证——AI 辅助同行评审（展示贡献溶解如何削弱责任）与创作中隐瞒 AI 使用（展示失去署名的恐惧如何抑制披露），并据此检讨披露规则与来源记录的局限。
Result: 提出三个讨论方向：区分 AI 扮当的角色、识别必须由人明确拥有的判断、以及创造让 AI 参与可被披露而不默认受罚的条件；目标是让 AI 塑造的贡献可讨论、可计功、可争议、可修复。
Conclusion: 问责的重心应从「AI 是否被使用」转向「判断由谁拥有并承担」，否则披露制度无法解决贡献溶解带来的责任真空。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoSpeedUp 把人类操作的节奏当作机器人模仿学习的时间监督：对齐人与机器人演示的对应操作阶段，从多段人类演示估计各阶段相对速度，再对机器人演示做 retiming 后送入标准 behavior cloning。在两个真实操作任务上，任务成功率平均提高 25 个百分点，成功执行时间缩短 36.5%。
Motivation: 模仿学习得到的机器人策略继承了演示中保守的执行节奏；现有加速方法主要依赖机器人侧信息或预设 tempo 因子来决定加速幅度，缺少与任务匹配的“每个阶段该多快”的参考。

papers.title: DocuTeam: Mixed-Initiative Multi-Agent Discussions around Evolving Documents
papers.abstract_en: In open-ended problem solving, collaborators often rely on discussion to surface concerns, challenge perspectives, and refine shared work as it evolves. While AI agents are increasingly used as discussion partners, existing multi-agent systems place a heavy burden on users to initiate and carefully orchestrate the discussions. We present DocuTeam, a mixed-initiative multi-agent discussion system in which both users and agents can initiate and steer conversations. Agents monitor document changes to proactively start and redirect discussions as the work evolves, while users can flexibly shape the conversation or adopt agent ideas. In a within-subjects study (N=20), participants using DocuTeam produced outcomes rated significantly more novel, relevant, and specific than with a baseline without any increase in cognitive load. Rather than using agents for one-off idea sourcing, participants engaged in an iterative refinement loop in which document changes prompted agent reactions, which led users to revisit and further develop their work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DocuTeam 是一个混合主动 (mixed-initiative) 的多智能体讨论系统：agent 监控文档变化并主动发起或转向讨论，用户也能随时介入、采纳 agent 的想法。在 N=20 的被试内实验中，产出在新颖性、相关性、具体性上显著优于无 agent 的基线，且认知负荷没有上升。
Motivation: 现有讨论型多智能体系统把发起和编排讨论的负担全压在用户身上，难以跟上文档持续演化的协作节奏。
Method: 系统让 agent 监控文档变更以主动发起和重定向讨论，用户可随时塑造对话或采纳 agent 想法；采用被试内设计 (within-subjects)，与不含 agent 的基线对照，测量产出评价与认知负荷。
Result: N=20 的被试内研究中，使用 DocuTeam 的产出在新颖性、相关性和具体性上被显著评为更高，同时认知负荷没有增加；参与者形成了文档变更触发 agent 反应、再回到文档继续迭代的循环。
Conclusion: agent 不应只做一次性点子来源，而应围绕持续演化的文档做多轮迭代精炼，且这种主动介入可以在不加重用户认知负荷的前提下提升产出质量。

papers.title: Beyond Feature Reliability: Repeat-Informed Multifractal Curve Regression for Brain-Age Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Brain-age prediction from resting-state fMRI provides a quantitative framework for characterizing age-related changes in spontaneous brain dynamics and for identifying functional signatures. Existing studies have linked fractal and multifractal scaling to age and examined the reliability of individual features. However, prediction repeatability depends on how features fluctuate jointly and how a predictor combines them, which feature-wise reliability assessments do not capture. To address this problem, we propose Repeat-informed Multifractal Curve Regression (RMCR), a structured framework for learning stable age-predictive patterns from multifractal curves. By jointly modeling curve structure and repeat-scan variability, RMCR learns predictive combinations of fluctuation orders that target both accuracy and within-subject consistency. Relative to a matched run-level ridge baseline, RMCR reduces single-run MAE by 6.1% on HCP-A and 7.9% on an external Cam-CAN cohort, and within-visit repeat absolute difference by 18.5% on HCP-A, using a single scan at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Repeat-informed Multifractal Curve Regression (RMCR)，把多重分形曲线结构与重复扫描变异性一起建模，学习兼顾精度与被试内一致性的年龄预测组合。相对匹配的 run-level ridge 基线，单次运行 MAE 在 HCP-A 降 6.1%、在外部 Cam-CAN 队列降 7.9%，同次访问重复扫描绝对差在 HCP-A 降 18.5%，推理只需一次扫描。
Motivation: 现有脑龄预测只评估单个分形/多重分形特征的可靠性，但预测可重复性取决于特征的联合波动与预测器的组合方式，逐特征可靠性评估捕捉不到这一点。
Method: RMCR 是一个结构化回归框架，输入为静息态 fMRI 导出的多重分形曲线，联合建模曲线结构与 repeat-scan 变异性，按波动阶数 (fluctuation orders) 学习预测性组合，同时优化精度与被试内一致性；对照为匹配的 run-level ridge 基线，推理阶段只用单次扫描。
Result: 相对匹配的 run-level ridge 基线：单次运行 MAE 在 HCP-A 降低 6.1%，在外部 Cam-CAN 队列降低 7.9%；同次访问重复扫描的绝对差在 HCP-A 降低 18.5%；推理仅用一次扫描。
Conclusion: 脑龄预测的可重复性要靠联合建模曲线结构与重复扫描变异性来提升，逐特征可靠性评估不足以保证被试内一致；该收益在外部 Cam-CAN 队列上仍成立。

papers.title: PHOSA: Photorealistic 3D Sign Avatar Modeling and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we focus on photorealistic sign avatar modeling, which is crucial for effective communication with the Deaf community and is characterized by complex hand gestures and nuanced facial expressions. To this end, we introduce MVSign, the first multi-view Chinese sign language dataset co-designed with Deaf experts, featuring diverse gestures and rich annotations. For precise SMPL-X annotation, we develop a hybrid fitting pipeline that produces accurate body, hand, and facial parameters and can also be applied to the monocular setting. Building on MVSign, we propose a decoupled sign avatar representation that isolates body, head, and hand components to capture complex articulations, together with a motion-aware sampling strategy to handle motion blur and balance gesture diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity visual results on MVSign, particularly in detailed hand and facial regions, and generalizes well to in-the-wild monocular sign language videos. Project page: https://naaapi.github.io/PHOSA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHOSA 提出多视角中国手语数据集 MVSign 与解耦式手语数字人表示，把身体、头部、手部分开建模并用运动感知采样应对运动模糊，在 MVSign 上得到高保真视觉结果，尤其在手部与面部细节上，并能泛化到野外单目手语视频。
Motivation: 手语数字人建模需要同时刻画复杂手势与细腻面部表情，而现有数据与表示难以同时提供精确 SMPL-X 标注和高保真细节还原。
Method: 构建与聋人专家共同设计的多视角中国手语数据集 MVSign；开发混合拟合管线产出准确的 SMPL-X 身体、手部与面部参数（亦可用于单目场景）；提出解耦身体/头/手的手语数字人表示，配合运动感知采样 (motion-aware sampling) 处理运动模糊并平衡手势多样性。
Result: 实验显示该方法在 MVSign 上取得高保真视觉结果，尤其在手部与面部细节区域，并能良好泛化到野外单目手语视频。
Conclusion: 解耦身体、头、手的表示加上运动感知采样，可在多视角数据上还原手语的精细动作并迁移到单目野外视频。

papers.title: Sufficiently Reduced Distributional Regression
papers.abstract_en: We propose Sufficiently Reduced Distributional Regression (SRDR), a generative method that combines conditional distribution estimation with nonlinear sufficient dimension reduction (SDR). It builds on a characterization of sufficiency through strictly proper scoring rules: a dimension reduction is sufficient if and only if predicting the response from the reduced covariates incurs no loss in expected score relative to the full covariates. Sufficient dimension reduction thus becomes a risk minimization problem. SRDR jointly trains a dimension reduction map and a generative prediction model by minimizing the energy score, which can be estimated by sampling without density evaluation or adversarial training. The framework extends to multi-environment data and to classification. We prove that the estimated conditional distributions converge in energy distance to the true ones, which implies that the learned representation is asymptotically sufficient. In simulations and applications to CT slice localization, superconductivity, and digit classification, SRDR recovers low-dimensional sufficient structure and matches or outperforms state-of-the-art nonlinear SDR methods in representation quality and predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sufficiently Reduced Distributional Regression (SRDR)，把充分降维 (SDR) 改写成用严格 proper scoring rule 定义的风险最小化问题：联合训练降维映射与生成式预测模型，最小化 energy score。证明估计的条件分布按 energy distance 收敛到真值，因而学到的表示渐近充分；在 CT slice 定位、超导体与数字分类上恢复低维充分结构，表示质量与预测性能匹配或超过现有非线性 SDR 方法。
Motivation: 非线性充分降维缺少一个可直接优化的目标：判断降维是否充分通常依赖难以估计的条件分布，生成式预测与降维表示也往往分开训练。
Method: SRDR 用严格 proper scoring rule 刻画充分性——从降维协变量预测响应不损失期望得分当且仅当降维充分——从而把 SDR 变成风险最小化；联合训练降维映射与生成预测模型，最小化 energy score，该得分可由采样估计，无需密度评估或对抗训练。框架可扩展到 multi-environment 数据与分类，并给出条件分布按 energy distance 收敛的证明。
Result: 在模拟以及 CT slice localization、superconductivity、digit classification 三个应用上，SRDR 恢复低维充分结构，表示质量与预测性能匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 非线性 SDR 方法；理论结果为估计条件分布的 energy distance 收敛，蕴含表示渐近充分。
Conclusion: 充分性可以由 proper scoring rule 转成可优化的风险目标，联合优化降维与生成预测即可在不评估密度的前提下得到渐近充分的表示。

papers.title: From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
papers.abstract_en: Visual software often needs a decision over supplied alternatives rather than a generated explanation. We present PixelJev, a native-image decision interface that maps an image, a task instruction, and a runtime candidate set to a structured choice and candidate-conditioned probabilities using small open multimodal models. Its initial realization unifies recognition and multiplechoice visual question answering through an existing language-model readout, with separately evaluated options for frozen inference, language-side adaptation, and held-out calibration. Across seven benchmark evaluations, 64-shot source adaptation raises Pets accuracy from 60.13% to 92.40% across optimization seeds and transfers to natural resampling, new texture labels, and A-OKVQA without target fitting, while frozen inference already supports both VQA tasks. A matched prompt-only follow-up on Pets and ScienceQA attributes the large Pets gain to adaptation and identifies a narrower output validity benefit of candidate readout in adapted VQA. Specialist DINOv2 probes remain stronger on source recognition, frozen 4B is stronger than adapted 2B on DTD and ScienceQA, and accuracy gains do not ensure calibrated target probabilities. These findings establish a working starting point for general-purpose visual decision models and identify the remaining requirements: schema robustness, cross-family transfer, and reliable use of visual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixelJev 把图像、任务指令与运行时候选集映射为结构化选择与候选条件概率，用小型开放多模态模型统一识别与多选 VQA。在七项基准评测中，Pets 上 64-shot 源适配把准确率从 60.13% 提到 92.40%，并零目标拟合迁移到自然重采样、新纹理标签与 A-OKVQA；但准确率提升不保证概率校准。
Motivation: 视觉软件常需在给定候选间做决策而非生成解释，缺少把识别与多选 VQA 统一到候选条件概率输出的通用接口。
Method: PixelJev 为原生图像决策接口，用小型开放多模态模型经既有语言模型读出 (readout) 输出结构化选择与候选条件概率；分别评测冻结推理、语言侧适配与留出校准三条路径，并做匹配 prompt-only 对照以归因增益来源。

papers.title: Online Task Adaptation via Self-Organisation
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are typically adapted by computing gradients and updating model parameters. We investigate whether task-specific adaptation can instead emerge from a meta-learned self-organising process that requires no gradients at adaptation time. We instantiate this idea with a Neural Cellular Automaton in which locally interacting recurrent cells maintain both a recurrent state and a fast associative memory. During meta-training, backpropagation is used to learn the recurrent dynamics together with how the memory is read and written. Once training is complete, the slow model parameters remain fixed, and online adaptation occurs only through cellwise memory updates driven by local prediction errors and a delta rule. We evaluate whether the learned mechanism can adapt to semantically distinct held-out classification tasks. A single pass over the support data produces substantial improvements in held-out performance without gradient computation or parameter updates during adaptation, and the mechanism remains effective across large changes in the number of examples processed jointly. These results show that task-specific adaptation can be achieved through explicit fast-memory updates while keeping the slow model parameters fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Neural Cellular Automaton 把任务适配从梯度更新改成自组织的记忆读写：元训练时用反传学出循环动力学与记忆读写规则，适配阶段慢参数冻结，仅靠局部预测误差驱动的 delta rule 逐格更新联想记忆。在语义不同的 held-out 分类任务上，单次遍历 support 数据即带来 held-out 性能的显著提升，且在联合处理样本数大幅变化时仍有效。
Motivation: 常规神经网络适配必须在适配时计算梯度并改参数，成本高且要求可微；本文追问任务特化能否由元学习出的自组织过程在无梯度条件下涌现。
Method: 以 Neural Cellular Automaton 实例化：局部交互的循环 cell 同时持有循环状态与快速联想记忆 (associative memory)；元训练阶段用 backpropagation 学习循环动力学以及记忆的读写方式，训练完成后慢参数固定，在线适配只做由局部预测误差与 delta rule 驱动的逐格记忆更新。
Result: 在语义不同的 held-out 分类任务上，单次遍历 support 数据即带来 held-out 性能的显著提升，适配过程不计算梯度、不更新参数；该机制在联合处理样本数发生大幅变化时仍保持有效。
Conclusion: 任务特化适配可以通过显式的快速记忆更新实现，慢模型参数全程保持固定，无需在适配时做梯度计算或参数更新。

papers.title: Reasoning Instructions Can Break Answer Decoding in Vision--Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) instructions can distort multiple-choice VLM evaluation when a scorer appends a reasoning cue but reads answer-label logits before the model generates any rationale. We call this CoT-prefix scoring. On ScienceQA, Qwen2.5-VL-7B drops from 80.76% to 45.48%, and across five option-content permutations 93.54% of CoT-prefix predictions select the first slot. Condition-matched linear probes recover 78.94% from the same hidden states, while free generation restores 75.24%, showing that the answer often survives the prefix and the immediate readout fails. Vocabulary and layer diagnostics explain the mismatch: probability mass moves toward continuation tokens, while answer information remains linearly accessible in late layers. The effect recurs with varying severity across datasets and models, though not universally. These results show that CoT-prefix scoring can confound model knowledge with an evaluation-interface mismatch and should be avoided unless the requested and scored output events are aligned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 CoT-prefix scoring 这种评测接口错位：给 VLM 加了 CoT 提示却在生成推理前就读答案标签 logits，导致答案解码被破坏。ScienceQA 上 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 从 80.76% 掉到 45.48%，93.54% 的预测选第一槽位，但线性探针仍能从同一隐状态恢复 78.94%，说明知识还在、读出方式错了；建议让被请求的输出事件与被打分的输出事件对齐。
Motivation: 多选题 VLM 评测中，评分器在模型生成任何推理之前就读答案标签 logits，会把模型知识与评测接口错位混为一谈。
Method: 定义 CoT-prefix scoring（加 CoT 提示但读生成前的答案标签 logits），在 ScienceQA 上测 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，做五种选项内容置换，并用条件匹配的线性探针 (condition-matched linear probes) 读同一隐状态、对照自由生成 (free generation)，再做词表与层级诊断。
Result: ScienceQA 上 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 从 80.76% 降至 45.48%；五种选项内容置换中 93.54% 的 CoT-prefix 预测选第一槽位；线性探针从同一隐状态恢复 78.94%，自由生成恢复 75.24%。诊断显示概率质量移向续写 token，而答案信息在后层仍线性可读；该效应在不同数据集与模型上以不同严重程度复现，但并非普遍存在。
Conclusion: CoT-prefix scoring 会把模型知识与评测接口错位混淆，除非请求的输出事件与打分的输出事件对齐，否则应避免这种评分方式。

papers.title: Learnable Time-Frequency Masks for Explaining Time-Series Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Time-series explainability remains challenging because discriminative information is often encoded in latent frequency or time-frequency features rather than in the raw signal itself. Existing attribution methods typically operate either in the time domain or in a fixed transform domain, limiting their ability to capture salient information across different representations. We propose XACT, a general framework that learns sparse attribution masks over coefficients from arbitrary invertible time-frequency transforms. We evaluate the framework on the STFT, the continuous wavelet transform, and the discrete wavelet transform. In addition, we extend the virtual inspection layer approach from the STFT to both wavelet transforms, enabling LRP to generate explanations in these representations. On a synthetic dataset, XACT produces precise explanations and is less prone to highlighting spurious features than the tested baselines. Across two real-world datasets, XACT produces sparse and structured explanations, although no method performs best across all quantitative evaluation criteria. These results demonstrate that learning explanations directly in time-frequency representations offers a flexible approach to interpreting deep-learning models for time series data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 XACT：在任意可逆时频变换的系数上学稀疏归因掩码，并把 virtual inspection layer 从 STFT 推广到连续与离散小波变换，使 LRP 能在这些表示中生成解释。合成数据上 XACT 解释更精确、更少指向虚假特征；两个真实数据集上解释稀疏且有结构，但没有方法在全部定量指标上同时最优。
Motivation: 时间序列判别信息常编码在隐含的频率或时频特征而非原始信号里，现有归因方法要么只在时域、要么固定在某个变换域，无法跨表示捕捉显著信息。
Method: XACT 在任意可逆时频变换（STFT、连续小波变换 CWT、离散小波变换 DWT）的系数上学习稀疏归因掩码；并把原本用于 STFT 的 virtual inspection layer 扩展到两种小波变换，让 LRP 在这些表示中直接产出解释。
Result: 在合成数据集上，XACT 给出精确解释，且比所测基线更少高亮虚假特征；在两个真实数据集上产生稀疏且有结构的解释，但在全部定量评估准则上没有哪个方法始终最佳。
Conclusion: 直接在时频表示中学习解释，是解读深度时序模型的一种灵活途径；跨准则的最优性并不集中在单一方法上。

papers.title: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the edited model. We propose ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing), which learns semantic addresses from paraphrases and hard same-subject negatives, aligns them with autoregressive hidden states through rollout refinement and gate calibration, and embeds the resulting gated low-rank operator within one MLP layer, so that the deployed model runs in a single forward pass with no external retriever or auxiliary router. Evaluated on CounterFact, ZSRE, and KnowEdit across three 7--8B model families, ALOE achieves efficacy between 0.955 and 0.999 and locality between 0.981 and 1.000; mechanistic analyses confirm that the learned geometry separates competing edits and that calibration suppresses out-of-scope activation. The remaining errors concentrate in paraphrase coverage and write fitting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALOE 把知识编辑从写入问题扩展为寻址问题：从 paraphrase 与同主体 hard negative 学出语义地址，经 rollout refinement 与 gate calibration 对齐自回归隐状态，再把带门控的低秩算子嵌进单个 MLP 层，部署时单次前向、无需外部检索器或辅助路由器。在 CounterFact、ZSRE、KnowEdit 上跨三个 7–8B 模型家族，efficacy 达 0.955–0.999、locality 达 0.981–1.000。
Motivation: 知识编辑通常只被当作写入问题，忽略寻址：激活过窄会记住单个 prompt，过宽会破坏邻近知识；参数化编辑器隐式编码作用范围，基于记忆的编辑器虽显式选择却把选择放在被编辑模型之外。
Method: ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing) 从 paraphrase 与 hard same-subject negatives 学习语义地址，用 rollout refinement 与 gate calibration 将其与自回归隐状态对齐，并把得到的门控低秩算子嵌入单个 MLP 层，使部署模型单次前向运行、不依赖外部 retriever 或辅助 router。
Result: 在 CounterFact、ZSRE、KnowEdit 三个数据集、三个 7–8B 模型家族上，efficacy 落在 0.955–0.999，locality 落在 0.981–1.000；机理分析显示学到的几何结构能区分相互竞争的编辑，calibration 抑制了 out-of-scope 激活，剩余错误集中在 paraphrase 覆盖与 write fitting。
Conclusion: 把寻址显式化并嵌入被编辑模型内部，可以在单次前向的约束下同时拿到接近满值的 efficacy 与 locality；当前瓶颈是 paraphrase 覆盖和 write fitting。

papers.title: BridgeMem: Causal Dyadic Transition Residuals for Temporal Knowledge Graph Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graph forecasting aims to infer future relational facts from the temporal structure of observed events. Existing forecasters mainly summarize history through entity states, relation states, paths, or exact recurrence. These views often miss pair-specific transition evidence, that is, the way prior relations between the query actor and a candidate change the odds of the target relation. We introduce BridgeMem, which estimates this quantity as a residual added to the log scores of a frozen full-vocabulary forecaster. For each candidate, BridgeMem retrieves the pair's events that strictly precede t, encodes their relations, directions, and lags, and converts them into a likelihood-ratio correction. A support-adaptive empirical-Bayes reader trusts exact transition counts where they are abundant and backs off to a learned attention estimator where they are sparse. The backbone's own uncertainty gates the correction, so confident queries and candidates without dyadic history are left unchanged. On five benchmarks, BridgeMem improves on the strongest of nine baselines from 2021--2026 in all 20 filtered MRR and Hits@{1,3,10} comparisons, with MRR gains of 0.0213, 0.0164, 0.0216, 0.0112, and 0.0028 over the best prior result. These results show the value of explicit dyadic transition modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BridgeMem 为时序知识图谱预测加一个成对转移残差：检索查询实体与候选之间严格早于 t 的历史事件，把关系、方向、时延编码成似然比修正，加到冻结全词表预测器的 log score 上。在五个基准上，对 2021–2026 年九个基线中最强者，全部 20 项 filtered MRR 与 Hits@{1,3,10} 比较均提升，MRR 增益依次为 0.0213、0.0164、0.0216、0.0112、0.0028。
Motivation: 现有预测器用实体状态、关系状态、路径或精确复现来概括历史，都漏掉了成对转移证据，即查询实体与候选之间的既往关系如何改变目标关系的几率。
Method: 对每个候选检索严格早于 t 的成对事件，编码其关系、方向与 lag，转成似然比修正；support-adaptive empirical-Bayes reader 在转移计数充足时信任精确计数、稀疏时回退到学习的 attention 估计器；用骨干自身的不确定性做门控，置信查询与无成对历史的候选保持不变。
Result: 在五个基准上，对九个 2021–2026 年基线中最强者，全部 20 项 filtered MRR 与 Hits@{1,3,10} 比较均提升；MRR 增益分别为 0.0213、0.0164、0.0216、0.0112、0.0028。
Conclusion: 显式建模成对转移 (dyadic transition) 能稳定提升时序知识图谱预测，且不确定性门控可让修正只作用于有成对历史支撑的候选。

papers.title: Baszta: Data-Centric Fine-Tuning of a Polish Multi-Label Safety Classifier
papers.abstract_en: We develop a multi-label Polish content-safety classifier by fine-tuning allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M) across five categories (hate, vulgarity, sexual content, crime, self-harm) using a Focal + R-Drop objective, and evaluate the resulting model against Bielik Guard (Sójka) on the shared out-of-distribution Gadzi Język benchmark. Both systems are given per-category threshold tuning on the same calibration split. Under that matched protocol our model holds a small but statistically significant lead in micro F1, while an apparent macro-F1 lead does not survive: it was an artifact of comparing a tuned model against an untuned one. We also report what that micro figure is worth. Because Gadzi Język is 97% crime-positive, a classifier that flags crime on every input and nothing else already scores 0.910 micro F1 on the same test split, so micro separates neither system from a degenerate strategy and macro is the column that does. Per-category and per-protocol figures are reported in Section 4. The residual out-of-distribution gap is one of calibration rather than discrimination. Ranking quality stays high while positive probabilities collapse, and per-category temperature scaling recovers the loss where Platt scaling and isotonic regression do not. That recovery turns out to be conditional on the calibration set containing safe text. Gadzi Język contains almost none, so thresholds fitted on it flag crime on every safe input, and a balanced refit buys a deployable operating point at the cost of adversarial recall. We report both operating points rather than only the flattering one. Two changes that are standard practice, per-class cost-sensitive weighting and mean pooling, each raise in-distribution macro F1 while lowering the out-of-distribution figure, which indicates that robustness has to be selected for directly rather than inherited from in-distribution accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Baszta 用 allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M) 微调出波兰语多标签内容安全分类器（Focal + R-Drop，五类别），在 Gadzi Język 上与 Bielik Guard (Sójka) 同协议比较：micro F1 有小幅但统计显著的领先，macro-F1 领先在双方都做阈值调优后消失。由于该基准 97% 为 crime 阳性，全报 crime 的退化策略已得 0.910 micro F1，故 OOD 差距本质是校准而非判别，per-category temperature scaling 可恢复而 Platt/isotonic 不行。
Motivation: 波兰语内容安全模型在分布外 (OOD) 文本上排名质量尚可但正类概率塌缩，且常用评测指标被类别极不平衡（Gadzi Język 97% crime 阳性）与调参协议不对称掩盖，无法区分真实能力与退化策略。
Method: 微调 allegro/herbert-base-cased (124M)，损失为 Focal + R-Drop，覆盖 hate、vulgarity、sexual content、crime、self-harm 五类；与 Bielik Guard (Sójka) 在共享 OOD 基准 Gadzi Język 上按同一 calibration split 做 per-category 阈值调优后比较，并测试 per-category temperature scaling、Platt scaling、isotonic regression 三种校准，以及 per-class cost-sensitive weighting 与 mean pooling 两项常规改动。
Result: 匹配协议下 micro F1 小幅但统计显著领先 Bielik Guard；macro-F1 领先不成立，系调优模型对比未调优模型的假象。Gadzi Język 97% crime 阳性，恒报 crime 的退化分类器在同一测试集得 0.910 micro F1。temperature scaling 恢复 OOD 校准损失，Platt scaling 与 isotonic regression 不能；该恢复依赖校准集含 safe 文本，而基准几乎不含，按其拟合的阈值会把所有 safe 输入标为 crime，balanced refit 换来可部署工作点但牺牲 adversarial recall。cost-sensitive weighting 与 mean pooling 各自提升分布内 macro F1 却降低 OOD 数值。
Conclusion: OOD 鲁棒性必须被直接选择，不能从分布内精度继承；评测上 macro F1 才能区分该系统与退化策略，且应同时报告 balanced refit 与原始两个工作点。

papers.title: TP-CRIV: A Framework for Third-Party Challenge-Response Identity Verification of AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) models are increasingly deployed through remote services, making model misappropriation a growing concern. Existing approaches, including watermarking, fingerprinting, and model similarity analysis, primarily rely on predefined evidence or direct behavioral comparison and do not explicitly evaluate whether the claimant currently possesses and can utilize model-dependent information relevant to the claimed model identity. In this paper, we propose Third-Party Challenge-Response Identity Verification (TP-CRIV) for AI models. TP-CRIV targets a third-party verification setting in which the verifier has neither white-box nor API access to the claimant's model, can interact with the suspicious deployed service only through its ordinary black-box inference interface, and does not require protocol-specific cooperation from the service provider. Under these constraints, the framework enables the verifier to obtain empirical evidence as to whether the claimant locally possesses a model satisfying a predeclared identity relative to the deployed model. Verification is conducted under fresh, previously undisclosed requirements and network isolation, so that the demonstrated capability cannot rely on online external assistance after challenge disclosure. The resulting evidence is interpreted relative to independently specified and calibrated matching and non-matching operating situations and is statistical rather than cryptographic. We instantiate TP-CRIV for CNN image classifiers using probability-control-based witness generation. Experiments on ten ImageNet-pretrained TorchVision models demonstrate clear same/cross-model separation and finite-challenge verification using independently calibrated thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出第三方挑战-响应身份验证框架 TP-CRIV：验证者无白盒也无 API 访问，仅通过普通黑盒推理接口与可疑服务交互，在全新未公开要求与网络隔离下取证，判定声称方是否本地持有满足预声明身份的模型。在十个 ImageNet 预训练 TorchVision CNN 上用基于概率控制的 witness 生成，同模型/跨模型分离清晰，并以独立校准阈值完成有限挑战验证。
Motivation: 远程服务部署使模型盗用成为问题，而水印、指纹与模型相似性分析依赖预设证据或直接行为比对，不评估声称方当前是否真正持有并能使用与所声称身份相关的模型信息。
Method: TP-CRIV 面向验证者既无白盒也无 API、只能走普通黑盒推理接口且无需服务方配合的第三方场景；在新鲜未披露要求与网络隔离下发起挑战，使作证能力无法依赖事后在线外部协助；证据相对于独立指定并校准的匹配/非匹配情形解读，属统计性而非密码学证据。针对 CNN 图像分类器用 probability-control-based witness generation 实例化。
Result: 在十个 ImageNet 预训练 TorchVision 模型上的实验显示同模型与跨模型清晰分离，并用独立校准的阈值完成有限挑战 (finite-challenge) 验证。
Conclusion: 在黑盒、无服务方配合的约束下，统计性挑战-响应证据足以支持对所部署模型身份的第三方经验性验证，其证据强度是统计的而非密码学的。

papers.title: Deep learning of longitudinal visual fields predicts glaucoma progression rate and identifies fast progressors
papers.abstract_en: Glaucoma is the leading cause of irreversible blindness, and timely identification of fast progressors is essential to prevent disability. Current practice estimates progression by ordinary least-squares regression of mean deviation (MD) on time, requiring 6--10 visual field (VF) tests over several years to obtain a reliable slope. We present GLAM (Glaucoma Longitudinal Analysis Model), a deep learning framework that ingests longitudinal Humphrey 24-2 total deviation sequences with five clinical features and predicts MD and visual field index progression rates using attention-based fusion and aleatoric uncertainty. On the open-access University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field dataset (4,276 patient-eyes), GLAM achieved an MD-rate mean absolute error of 0.139 dB yr$^{-1}$ ($R^2 = 0.927$; 73.5% reduction over a ridge baseline) and an AUC of 0.990 for fast-progressor detection. VF-only deep learning can match multimodal pipelines for progression prognostication using routinely collected perimetry alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLAM 用注意力融合直接从 Humphrey 24-2 总偏差序列加五项临床特征预测青光眼 MD 与 VFI 进展速率，并用 aleatoric 不确定性做快速进展者判别。在 University Washington 公开数据集 4,276 只眼上，MD 速率 MAE 0.139 dB/yr（R²=0.927，较 ridge 基线降 73.5%），快速进展者 AUC 0.990；结论是仅用常规视野检查的纯 VF 深度学习即可匹配多模态进展预后流程。
Motivation: 现行做法用 OLS 对 MD 对时间回归，需要数年内 6–10 次视野检查才能得到可靠斜率，识别快速进展者过慢。
Method: GLAM（Glaucoma Longitudinal Analysis Model）以纵向 Humphrey 24-2 总偏差序列加五项临床特征为输入，用 attention-based fusion 预测 MD 与 visual field index 进展速率，并建模 aleatoric uncertainty；对照为 ridge 回归基线。
Result: 在 University of Washington Humphrey Visual Field 数据集（4,276 patient-eyes）上：MD 速率 MAE 0.139 dB yr⁻¹，R²=0.927，较 ridge 基线降低 73.5%；快速进展者检测 AUC 0.990。
Conclusion: 仅依赖常规视野检查的 VF-only 深度学习即可达到多模态进展预后水平，无需多年多次检查的 OLS 斜率。

papers.title: IronViT: Toward Efficient Generalist Visual Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: A generalist vision encoder must capture semantic, spatial, language-aligned, and action-relevant cues within a unified representation, yet softmax attention underlying today's most capable visual backbones becomes prohibitively expensive at high resolution. A natural attempt to address both challenges is to distill multiple specialist teachers directly into an efficient architecture. We find that directly coupling these objectives degrades representation quality, as the student must simultaneously reconcile heterogeneous capabilities and adapt them to a different token-mixing architecture. We introduce IronViT, built on a simple principle: consolidate capabilities before constraining computation. IronViT first distills complementary specialists into a softmax attention capability bridge, then progressively transfers the consolidated representation to a hybrid softmax-linear attention encoder. A purpose-built data pipeline further curates the distillation corpus for higher information density and broader domain coverage. Across recognition, retrieval, dense prediction, multimodal understanding, and robotic learning, IronViT is competitive with leading specialist and generalist vision encoders. The softmax bridge achieves the strongest aggregate performance in multimodal understanding and robotic learning among the evaluated backbones, while the hybrid encoder retains broad transfer performance with an efficiency advantage that grows with input resolution. Together, these results show that consolidating capabilities before architectural conversion can yield a generalist visual encoder without inheriting the prohibitive high-resolution cost of conventional softmax attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IronViT 先把多个 specialist 教师蒸馏进一个 softmax attention 能力桥，再把合并后的表征逐步迁移到 hybrid softmax-linear attention 编码器，避免直接把异构能力灌进不同 token-mixing 架构导致的表征退化。在识别、检索、密集预测、多模态理解与机器人学习上与领先的 specialist/generalist 视觉编码器相当，softmax 桥在多模态理解和机器人学习上取得被评估骨干中最强的综合表现，且效率优势随输入分辨率增大而扩大。
Motivation: 通用视觉编码器需同时承载语义、空间、语言对齐与动作相关线索，而主流骨干的 softmax attention 在高分辨率下开销过高；直接把多个 specialist 教师蒸馏进高效架构会让学生同时调和异构能力并适配不同 token-mixing 结构，反而损害表征质量。
Method: 两阶段蒸馏：先将互补 specialist 教师蒸馏进 softmax attention 能力桥 (capability bridge)，再把合并后的表征渐进迁移到 hybrid softmax-linear attention 编码器；另配专用数据管线为蒸馏语料做信息密度与领域覆盖的筛选。
Result: 在识别、检索、密集预测、多模态理解和机器人学习五类任务上，IronViT 与领先的 specialist 及 generalist 视觉编码器相当；softmax 桥在被评估骨干中于多模态理解和机器人学习取得最强综合表现；hybrid 编码器保持广泛迁移性能，且效率优势随输入分辨率增长而扩大。
Conclusion: 先合并能力再做架构转换，可以在不继承传统 softmax attention 高分辨率开销的前提下得到通用视觉编码器；直接耦合蒸馏目标与架构替换是次优路径。

summary_sections.method: 两阶段蒸馏：先将互补 specialist 教师蒸馏进 softmax attention 能力桥 (capability bridge)，再把合并后的表征渐进迁移到 hybrid softmax-linear attention 编码器；另配专用数据管线为蒸馏语料做信息密度与领域覆盖的筛选。
summary_sections.result: 在识别、检索、密集预测、多模态理解和机器人学习五类任务上，IronViT 与领先的 specialist 及 generalist 视觉编码器相当；softmax 桥在被评估骨干中于多模态理解和机器人学习取得最强综合表现；hybrid 编码器保持广泛迁移性能，且效率优势随输入分辨率增长而扩大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 先合并能力再做架构转换，可以在不继承传统 softmax attention 高分辨率开销的前提下得到通用视觉编码器；直接耦合蒸馏目标与架构替换是次优路径。

papers.title: Policy as Code: A Coroutine-Bridge Harness for Fast-Reasoning Reliability on CAR-bench
papers.abstract_en: CAR-bench evaluates whether tool-using agents stay reliable under real-world uncertainty, executing every tool inside the evaluator so that each tool-result exchange is a separate agent round-trip. A conventional next-action agent can batch parallel tool calls, but a chain of dependent calls costs it one model call per round of results. We present a coroutine-bridge harness in which the model's only action is to emit a Python program that blocks and resumes in place across evaluator tool exchanges. This decouples model invocation from tool round-trips: on the public test split the agent uses a median of two model calls against seven agent turns per task, resolving a full multi-turn task in a median of 1.8 s of model latency on Cerebras gpt-oss-120b. Because the action surface is executable code, deterministic CAR-bench policies are encoded directly as logic in the tool layer rather than as prompt rules, enforcing compliance at zero reasoning cost. On the official hidden evaluation the harness won Track 2 with 60.0% Pass^3, 4.5x the organizer baseline, at the lowest estimated cost and the fastest median task latency (3.14 s) of any entry scoring above that baseline; the same unchanged harness reproduced an identical 60.0% Pass^3 on GPT-5.5 in the Open track, matching frontier-model agents. A single static prompt, appended with per-task state at the tail, stays byte-identical across calls and across tasks: the frozen submission prompt served 78% of input tokens from cache (86.6% across its warm tail), against 73% over a three-week development corpus in which prompt edits repeatedly reset the cache. This compounds the few-call design into a small fraction of nominal input compute.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Technical report for the winning entry in Track 2 (Cerebras Fast-Reasoning) of the CAR-bench Challenge at IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAR-bench 上的 coroutine-bridge harness 让模型只输出一段可阻塞、可原地恢复的 Python 程序，把模型调用与工具往返解耦，并把评测器的确定性策略直接写成工具层代码而非 prompt 规则。公开测试集上每任务中位数只需 2 次模型调用（对照 7 个 agent 轮次）、模型延迟中位数 1.8 s（Cerebras gpt-oss-120b）；官方隐藏评测以 60.0% Pass^3 赢得 Track 2，为组织者基线的 4.5 倍，同一未改动 harness 在 Open track 的 GPT-5.5 上复现同样的 60.0%。
Motivation: 工具在评测器内执行、每次工具结果交换都是一次 agent 往返，链式依赖调用使常规 next-action agent 每轮结果都要付一次模型调用，延迟与 token 成本随轮次线性膨胀。
Method: 模型唯一动作是发出一段在评测器工具交换间阻塞并原地恢复的 Python 程序（coroutine-bridge harness），从而解耦模型调用与工具往返；CAR-bench 的确定性策略以逻辑形式编码进工具层而非 prompt 规则；提交 prompt 单一静态、仅在尾部追加每任务状态，跨调用跨任务逐字节不变。
Result: 公开测试集：每任务中位数 2 次模型调用对 7 个 agent 轮次，Cerebras gpt-oss-120b 上完整多轮任务模型延迟中位数 1.8 s。官方隐藏评测：Track 2 冠军，60.0% Pass^3，为组织者基线的 4.5 倍，且在所有超过该基线的参赛中估计成本最低、任务延迟中位数最快（3.14 s）。同一未改动 harness 在 Open track 的 GPT-5.5 上复现完全相同的 60.0% Pass^3。冻结 prompt 使 78% 输入 token 命中缓存（其 warm tail 达 86.6%），对照三周开发语料的 73%（其间反复改 prompt 不断重置缓存）。
Conclusion: 把动作面换成可执行代码、把策略下沉到工具层并保持 prompt 冻结，能在不改模型的前提下同时压低调用次数、延迟与输入算力，且跨模型复现同一成绩。

papers.title: No More Free Lunch: Corpus Task Complexity Matters as Corpora Grow
papers.abstract_en: Given a large corpus, the questions one might ask can vary -- from "When was the first human heart transplant?" to "What are all the contradictory claims in this literature?" -- but what makes some questions more challenging than others? In this work, we define a notion of Corpus Task Complexity (CTC) that characterizes tasks by how their difficulty grows with corpus size; for instance, a retrieval query only requires a single linear pass over a corpus, while finding contradictions requires checking a quadratically growing set of claim pairs. Observing that prior work has largely only studied tasks whose difficulty grows linearly with corpus size, which we call low CTC tasks, we introduce 10 new tasks belonging to a class of high CTC whose difficulty grows quadratically or more in corpus size. We find that high-CTC tasks not only grow much more challenging on average at longer contexts for LCLMs, they reverse many modeling conclusions drawn solely from low-CTC evaluations. For instance, efficient block-sparse and hybrid attention approaches consistently match full attention performance on low-CTC tasks, but degrade much more on high-CTC tasks. Large-corpus high-CTC reasoning thus remains an open challenge as full attention is too costly to scale, motivating future research on these tasks. We release our code, data, and 22-task suite (CTC-Bench), to facilitate future research in this area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出语料任务复杂度 (Corpus Task Complexity, CTC)，按难度随语料规模的增长速率刻画任务：检索只需一次线性扫描，找矛盾则要检查二次增长的 claim 对。新增 10 个高 CTC 任务并组成 22 任务的 CTC-Bench，发现高 CTC 任务在长上下文上对 LCLM 更难，且推翻仅由低 CTC 评测得出的结论——block-sparse 与 hybrid attention 在低 CTC 上稳定匹配 full attention，但在高 CTC 上明显退化。
Motivation: 既有长上下文评测几乎只覆盖难度随语料线性增长的低 CTC 任务，无法代表随语料变大而二次增长的推理需求，据此得出的建模结论会误导。
Method: 定义 CTC 度量任务难度随语料规模的增长速率；引入 10 个二次或更高增长的高 CTC 任务，与既有任务合成 22 任务套件 CTC-Bench，并开源代码与数据；在 LCLM 上比较 full attention 与 block-sparse、hybrid attention 等高效注意力方案。
Result: 高 CTC 任务在长上下文上平均难度增长快得多，并反转多项仅基于低 CTC 的建模结论：block-sparse 与 hybrid attention 在低 CTC 任务上持续匹配 full attention，却在高 CTC 任务上退化明显；新增 10 个高 CTC 任务，发布 22 任务的 CTC-Bench。
Conclusion: 大语料高 CTC 推理仍是开放难题，因为 full attention 成本无法扩展；高效注意力必须在高 CTC 任务上重新检验，而不能只看低 CTC 评测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AFT Neural Function Approximators for 1D Nonlinear Force Laws
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear contacts and friction strongly influence the vibration response of assembled structures, but their accurate numerical treatment is computationally demanding. The harmonic balance method is widely used to compute periodic steady-state responses, yet the required alternating frequency-time scheme becomes costly for nonsmooth and hysteretic nonlinearities and must be repeated throughout the nonlinear solution process. Here we show that this procedure can be replaced by neural networks that directly map displacement Fourier coefficients to nonlinear force coefficients and provide the corresponding Jacobian through automatic differentiation. The surrounding solver and continuation algorithms remain unchanged for the computation of frequency response curves. The neural networks exclusively learn individual nonlinear elements rather than complete system responses. Physics-based nondimensionalization and phase normalization facilitate the learning process and enable a single trained network to cover a wide range of parameter combinations. Building on the cubic spring, unilateral spring, and Jenkins elements considered here, the approach points toward a reusable library of nonlinear-element surrogates that can be combined in arbitrary number and location within a mechanical system. By bypassing the iterative force evaluation in time domain, the method offers favorable computational scaling for high-resolution analyses and systems with many nonlinear elements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用神经网络直接把位移 Fourier 系数映射为非线性力系数，并经自动微分给出 Jacobian，从而替代 harmonic balance 中代价高昂的 alternating frequency-time (AFT) 时域迭代求力。求解器与 continuation 算法保持不变，物理无量纲化与相位归一化使单个训练好的网络覆盖宽参数范围，可拼成非线性单元 surrogate 库。
Motivation: 装配结构中接触与摩擦等非光滑、迟滞非线性使 AFT 每次求力都要在时域反复迭代，在非线性解过程与频率响应曲线计算中代价高，且随分辨率与非线性单元数量增长。
Method: 训练神经网络学习单个非线性单元（cubic spring、unilateral spring、Jenkins element），输入位移 Fourier 系数、输出非线性力系数，Jacobian 由 automatic differentiation 直接给出；用 physics-based nondimensionalization 与 phase normalization 使单一网络覆盖宽参数组合，外层 solver 与 continuation 算法不变。
Result: 在 cubic spring、unilateral spring 与 Jenkins 单元上展示该替代方案，用于计算频率响应曲线；摘要给出定性结论：绕过时域迭代求力后，对高分辨率分析与含大量非线性单元的系统具有有利的计算标度。
Conclusion: 非线性单元可以被逐个学习成可复用 surrogate，并按任意数量与位置组合进机械系统，AFT 的时域求力环节可整体替换而不改动外层求解流程。

papers.title: TOLA: Text-aware One-Step Latent Adaptation for Diffusion-based Text Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Text image super-resolution (TSR) aims to recover visually faithful and readable text under unknown degradations. Existing diffusion-based methods typically rely on multi-step prediction of either the high-resolution image or its text prior, resulting in prohibitive computational cost and inference latency. More critically, an erroneous text prior may be repeatedly injected into the denoising process, causing image and text predictions to reinforce each other and progressively amplify an early recognition error into a sharp yet semantically incorrect character. To address these limitations, we propose TOLA, a Text-aware One-step Latent Adaptation framework without iterative image-text diffusion. TOLA consists of two key modules. First, a confidence-weighted text conditioning module constructs the semantic condition only once and suppresses unreliable OCR predictions before they contaminate image reconstruction. Second, a lightweight latent residual correction module explicitly estimates and corrects the structured residual errors to recover missing or distorted stroke details. Extensive experiments demonstrate our state-of-the-art performance across all evaluation metrics on both CTR-TSR-Test ($\times 4$) and RealCE-200 benchmarks. It is worth noting that our TOLA consistently surpasses existing diffusion-based TSR methods by at least 2.72 dB in PSNR on CTR-TSR-Test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TOLA 把基于扩散的文本图像超分辨率 (TSR) 改成单步隐空间自适应：语义条件只构建一次，并在污染重建前抑制不可靠的 OCR 预测，再用轻量隐空间残差修正补回丢失或变形的笔画。在 CTR-TSR-Test (×4) 与 RealCE-200 上取得全部指标的最先进表现，PSNR 至少高出既有扩散式 TSR 方法 2.72 dB。
Motivation: 扩散式 TSR 依赖多步预测高分辨率图像或其文本先验，计算开销与推理延迟高；错误文本先验被反复注入去噪过程，图像与文本预测互相强化，把早期识别错误放大成清晰但语义错误的字符。
Method: TOLA 框架不含迭代式图像-文本扩散，含两个模块：置信度加权文本条件模块只构建一次语义条件并在 OCR 预测不可靠时加以抑制；轻量隐空间残差修正模块 (latent residual correction) 显式估计并校正结构化残差误差以恢复笔画细节。
Result: 在 CTR-TSR-Test (×4) 与 RealCE-200 两个基准上，全部评估指标达到 state-of-the-art；在 CTR-TSR-Test 上 PSNR 至少比现有扩散式 TSR 方法高 2.72 dB。
Conclusion: 去掉迭代式图像-文本扩散、改为一次性条件构建加隐空间残差修正，即可同时降低扩散式 TSR 的推理开销并避免早期识别错误被逐轮放大。

papers.title: SARFusion: Scene-Aware Routing Fusion for Robust Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camera-LiDAR fusion has become a prevailing paradigm for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. However, existing fusion detectors often establish strong inter-modality dependencies by decoding object queries from tightly coupled multimodal representations. Under corrupted driving conditions, such dependencies make the detector vulnerable to unreliable modalities, where degraded observations may interfere with reliable modality-specific evidence and lead to suboptimal predictions. Moreover, modality reliability can vary across both global driving scenes and individual object queries, requiring adaptive fusion decisions at a finer granularity. To bridge this gap, we reformulate robust camera-LiDAR fusion as a scene-aware branch routing problem and propose SARFusion, a robust 3D object detector. Instead of producing detections from a single fused representation, SARFusion decouples object-query decoding into three parallel reasoning branches: a camera branch, a LiDAR branch, and a camera-LiDAR fusion branch. Guided by a Scene Reliability Prior estimated from the global driving context, SARFusion further incorporates object-level evidence to route each query to the most suitable branch. This query-wise routing strategy alleviates harmful cross-modal interference while preserving the benefits of multimodal fusion when complementary cues are trustworthy. On the nuScenes test set, SARFusion achieves strong performance with 72.5 mAP and 74.4 NDS. Extensive analyses demonstrate its robustness under challenging conditions, including sensor corruptions and environmental changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SARFusion 把相机-LiDAR 3D 检测重构为场景感知分支路由问题：解耦出相机、LiDAR、融合三条并行 query 解码分支，用全局场景可靠性先验 (Scene Reliability Prior) 加物体级证据把每个 query 路由到最合适的分支，从而在传感器退化时抑制有害跨模态干扰。在 nuScenes test 上取得 72.5 mAP 与 74.4 NDS。
Motivation: 现有融合检测器从紧耦合的多模态表征解码 query，一旦某个模态在恶劣驾驶条件下退化，退化的观测会污染另一模态的可靠证据，导致预测次优；而模态可靠性既随全局场景变化也随单个 query 变化，需要更细粒度的自适应融合决策。
Method: SARFusion 将 object-query 解码解耦为三条并行推理分支（camera、LiDAR、camera-LiDAR fusion），先由全局驾驶上下文估计 Scene Reliability Prior，再结合 object-level evidence 对每个 query 做逐 query 路由，使 query 落到最合适的分支。
Result: 在 nuScenes test set 上达到 72.5 mAP 与 74.4 NDS；作者称在传感器损坏 (sensor corruptions) 与环境变化等挑战条件下表现出稳健性。
Conclusion: 逐 query 的场景感知分支路由能在保留多模态融合收益的同时减轻有害跨模态干扰，是提升损坏条件下 3D 检测稳健性的可行路径。

papers.title: Post-Training Leaves Behavioral Shadows on Unrelated Decisions
papers.abstract_en: We find that language models can transfer capabilities through task-unrelated text. Post-training typically improves language models using task-specific data. Prior work on subliminal learning shows that information about these updates can pass through unrelated generations, but has largely focused on traits or preferences using extensive teacher outputs. We introduce Active Taskless Distillation (ATD), which achieves capability transfer using only a single word from the teacher per prompt. ATD probes the behavioral shadow of post-training by selecting prompts where the teacher and student's shared public ancestor is nearly indifferent between two ordinary words. A student initialized from this ancestor learns solely from the resulting prompt-word pairs, without target-task examples, teacher logits, or teacher parameters. In the primary coding experiment with Qwen2.5-1.5B, 5,664nses yield a 5.34 pp gain on HumanEval+ over an exact nuisance-matched control thadisrupts prompt-resperiments showtransfer in scientific knowledge, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehensins across additional model generations, sizes, and families. Functional analyses show that the learned sid composable, andthat its strength tracks the teacher's update strength.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Active Taskless Distillation (ATD)：教师在每个 prompt 上只输出一个普通词，学生从共享的公开祖先模型初始化，仅用这些 prompt-词对做后训练即可把教师的能力迁移过来。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 的主编码实验中，5,664 个样本使 HumanEval+ 相对精确匹配干扰项的对照提升 5.34 pp，且该能力在科学知识、常识推理与阅读理解上跨模型代际、规模与家族迁移。
Motivation: 后训练通常依赖任务专属数据，既往 subliminal learning 只能靠教师大量输出传递特质或偏好，能力级迁移的成本与机制都不清楚。
Method: ATD 挑选共享公开祖先在两个普通词之间近乎无差别的 prompt，教师只给一个词；学生从该祖先初始化，仅用 prompt-词对训练，不用目标任务样例、教师 logits 或教师参数；另设精确匹配的干扰项 (nuisance-matched) 对照，并做功能分析。
Result: 主编码实验用 Qwen2.5-1.5B，5,664 个样本使 HumanEval+ 提升 5.34 pp（相对精确匹配干扰对照）；实验显示迁移覆盖科学知识、常识推理与阅读理解，跨更多模型代际、规模与家族；功能分析表明学到的信号可组合，其强度随教师更新强度变化。
Conclusion: 后训练会在与任务无关的文本上留下可被下游学生读取的行为阴影，单个词的信号足以传递能力，且信号强度与教师更新强度挂钩。

papers.title: Towards An LLM-Driven Unified Conversion Framework for BT and FSM in Autonomous Intelligent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Finite state machine (FSM) and behavior trees (BT) are widely adopted behavioral modeling paradigms for autonomous intelligent systems. While functionally equivalent and inter-convertible in principle, existing transformation methods between FSM and BT face major challenges in preserving behavioral completeness and avoiding model complexity explosion. To overcome these issues, we propose an LLM-driven unified conversion framework that enables automatic, efficient, and semantically consistent transformation between FSM and BT. Specifically, a novel loop execution BT structure is designed for LLM to accurately capture the loop structure in FSM, thereby preserving behavioral completeness. To mitigate the state explosion problem in BT-to-FSM conversion, a depth compression strategy is introduced with LLM prompt to eliminate redundant control nodes, complemented by differentiated hierarchical conversion rules that collectively reduce the number of required sub-FSM. Simulation experiments in multiple autonomous decision-making scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework enables an accurate and automated bidirectional conversion between FSM and BT. Furthermore, it significantly enhances the scalability and maintainability of generated models compared to traditional approaches, providing a practical solution for behavior model conversion in consumer-grade autonomous intelligent systems such as service robots, game agents, and smart home devices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由 LLM 驱动的 FSM 与行为树 (BT) 统一互转框架：用专门设计的 loop execution BT 结构忠实还原 FSM 循环以保住行为完备性，用深度压缩策略配合分层转换规则消除冗余控制节点、抑制 BT 转 FSM 的状态爆炸。在多个自主决策场景的仿真实验中实现准确的双向自动转换，并显著提升生成模型的可扩展性与可维护性。
Motivation: FSM 与 BT 在原理上功能等价且可互转，但现有转换方法难以同时保住行为完备性并避免模型复杂度爆炸。
Method: 框架包含三部分：为 LLM 设计的 loop execution BT 结构以捕获 FSM 中的循环；BT 转 FSM 时用 LLM prompt 驱动的深度压缩策略消除冗余控制节点；配合差异化分层转换规则减少所需 sub-FSM 数量。
Result: 在多个自主决策场景的仿真中，框架实现 FSM 与 BT 之间准确、自动的双向转换；相比传统方法显著提升生成模型的可扩展性与可维护性。
Conclusion: LLM 加上针对性的结构设计（循环结构、深度压缩、分层规则）可以让 FSM 与 BT 的互转既保行为完备又不爆炸，适用于服务机器人、游戏 agent、智能家居设备等消费级自主系统。

papers.title: ComplexSync: High-Fidelity and Real-Time Lip Sync in Complex Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Lip synchronization aims to generate visual lip dynamics that align precisely with speech audio. Despite the high generation quality of diffusion models, they often struggle in complex scenarios and suffer from prohibitive inference latency, limiting real-world deployment. We present ComplexSync, a unified diffusion-based framework that enables real-time, high-fidelity lip sync under complex conditions. First, we introduce a dual-stream joint training strategy to mitigate information leakage from reference frames while preserving natural dynamics. Second, we develop a distillation-based acceleration scheme for single-step denoising, achieving a throughput of over 70 FPS. Third, we propose a relational alignment loss that leverages structural priors from Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to enhance robustness against complex scene factors. Furthermore, we present the first benchmark specifically designed for complex lip synchronization, comprising over 200 challenging video sequences and specialized metrics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ComplexSync achieves state-of-the-art performance across both standard and complex scenarios while enabling real-time inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ComplexSync 是一个基于扩散的唇同步框架，用双流联合训练防止参考帧信息泄漏、蒸馏实现单步去噪、关系对齐损失借用视觉基础模型 (VFM) 结构先验来抵抗复杂场景干扰。单步去噪吞吐超过 70 FPS，实现实时推理，并在标准与复杂场景上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 扩散模型生成质量高，但在复杂场景下表现不稳且推理延迟过高，难以实际部署；同时缺少专门针对复杂条件的唇同步评测基准。
Method: 统一扩散框架含三个组件：双流联合训练策略在保留自然口型动态的同时抑制参考帧信息泄漏；基于蒸馏的加速方案把去噪压缩到单步；关系对齐损失利用 Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) 的结构先验增强对复杂场景因素的鲁棒性。另发布首个面向复杂唇同步的 benchmark，含 200 多个高难视频序列与专用指标。
Result: 单步去码吞吐超过 70 FPS，实现推理实时化；在标准与复杂场景两类评测上均达到 state-of-the-art；benchmark 包含超过 200 个挑战性视频序列。
Conclusion: 扩散式唇同步可以通过蒸馏单步去噪达到实时吞吐，同时用 VFM 结构先验的对齐损失在复杂场景下保持高保真，且需要专门的复杂场景基准来度量。

papers.title: FounRef: Robust, Structure-Preserving, and Fast Metric Refinement of Frozen Monocular Foundation Priors with Sparse Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Dense metric depth from cameras is essential to real-world 3D applications, yet achieving accuracy, faithful surface geometry, and fast inference simultaneously remains challenging. Monocular foundation models provide rich, transferable geometric priors but lack reliable metric scale, while depth-completion networks recover metric depth at the cost of geometric fidelity, cross-domain robustness, or speed. We present FounRef, a training-free method that aligns a frozen monocular foundation prior with sparse metric anchors to produce dense metric depth. FounRef is modular by design: its depth prior, anchor source, and refinement solver can each be replaced independently. We instantiate FounRef with MoGe-2 and LiDAR anchors. FounRef validates each anchor against the prior's dense depth prediction, rejecting inconsistencies caused by cross-sensor misalignment that geometry-only filters cannot detect. It then applies global and local metric corrections through a structure-preserving solver, retaining the prior's fine-grained geometry. FounRef requires no task-specific training and operates out of the box across unfamiliar cameras and scenes. On out-of-domain data, it delivers up to 24% lower depth error, 92% lower surface-normal noise, and almost 15x faster inference than DMD3C, a state-of-the-art depth-completion network. By decoupling metric alignment from geometry prediction, FounRef provides an accurate, geometrically faithful, and efficient approach to dense metric depth that can directly benefit from future advances in foundation models and metric sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FounRef 是一种免训练的稠密度量深度方法：把冻结的单目基础模型先验与稀疏 LiDAR 锚点对齐，先用先验的稠密深度逐个校验锚点、剔除跨传感器错位导致的不一致，再用保结构求解器做全局与局部度量校正。在域外数据上相对深度补全网络 DMD3C 深度误差最多降 24%、表面法线噪声降 92%、推理快近 15 倍。
Motivation: 单目基础模型有可迁移的几何先验却没有可靠度量尺度，深度补全网络能恢复度量深度却牺牲几何保真、跨域鲁棒性或速度，三者难以同时满足。
Method: 训练无关 (training-free) 的模块化管线：深度先验、锚点来源、精化求解器可各自替换；实例化采用 MoGe-2 先验加 LiDAR 锚点，先对照先验稠密深度预测校验每个锚点并拒绝几何滤波检不出的跨传感器错位，再由保结构求解器施加全局与局部度量校正，保留先验的细粒度几何。
Result: 在域外 (out-of-domain) 数据上，相对 SOTA 深度补全网络 DMD3C：深度误差最多降低 24%，表面法线噪声降低 92%，推理速度提升近 15 倍；无需任务特定训练，可直接用于陌生相机与场景。
Conclusion: 把度量对齐与几何预测解耦，用冻结先验加稀疏锚点即可同时拿到准确、几何保真且高效的稠密度量深度，并能直接继承基础模型与度量传感器的后续进步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FB-GDM: Fully-Bayesian Guided Diffusion Models for High-Dimensional Linear Inverse Problems via Unsupervised Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are powerful priors for linear inverse problems, but the reference guidance methods, Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) and Pseudoinverse-Guided Diffusion Models ($Π$GDM), rely on scalar hyperparameters tuned per task, usually against the ground truth. We introduce FB-GDM, a fully-Bayesian guided diffusion method that removes this calibration step. Starting from the Gaussian approximation of $Π$GDM, we derive a closed-form conditional score that depends on two precision parameters (inverse variances), one associated with the denoising approximation and one with the observation likelihood, and treat them as latent variables inferred by variational inference at each reverse step. A separable factorization makes each update scale linearly with the number of pixels, so the inference stays tractable at full image resolution, at a cost comparable to one $Π$GDM run. FB-GDM requires neither the noise level nor the ground truth: its only inputs are the observation and the forward operator. Experiments on CelebA-HQ inverse problems establish two results. (i) The precision parameters, inferred from the observation alone, allow FB-GDM to outperform $Π$GDM at its nominal setting, even when the latter is given the true noise level, by up to 14 dB depending on the operator, and to match the ground-truth-calibrated $Π$GDM oracle within 0.1 dB. (ii) FB-GDM is robust when the forward operator, the noise level, or the image distribution changes: it stays close to a per-problem $Π$GDM oracle throughout and does not exhibit the hallucinations observed with DPS, whereas DPS substantially degrades at a fixed scale and $Π$GDM stays competitive only if it is re-tuned against the ground truth for each new problem. When the prior is applied to images outside its training set, this re-balancing between data and prior keeps FB-GDM faithful where a fixed face-prior guidance can otherwise hallucinate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FB-GDM 把 ΠGDM 的两个标量引导超参数（去噪近似精度与观测似然精度）当作每步反向过程中由变分推断在线推断的潜变量，从而去掉逐任务对照真值调参。在 CelebA-HQ 线性反问题上，仅凭观测推断精度即可比 ΠGDM 名义设置最高高出 14 dB，并在 0.1 dB 内追平用真值调参的 ΠGDM oracle；当前算子、噪声水平或图像分布变化时仍贴近 oracle，且不出现 DPS 的幻觉。
Motivation: DPS 与 ΠGDM 这类扩散引导方法依赖逐任务标量超参数，通常要对照真值调参，换算子或换噪声水平就得重调，且 DPS 在固定尺度下会明显退化甚至产生幻觉。
Method: 从 ΠGDM 的高斯近似出发推导闭式条件 score，其中含两个精度参数（逆方差）：一个对应去噪近似、一个对应观测似然；二者作为潜变量在每个反向步用变分推断 (variational inference) 推断。可分离分解使每次更新随像素数线性扩展，全分辨率推断开销与一次 ΠGDM 运行相当；输入只有观测与前向算子，不需要噪声水平或真值。
Result: 在 CelebA-HQ 线性反问题上：仅由观测推断的精度参数使 FB-GDM 超过 ΠGDM 名义设置，视算子不同最高高出 14 dB，并在 0.1 dB 内匹配用真值校准的 ΠGDM oracle；当前向算子、噪声水平或图像分布改变时，FB-GDM 全程贴近逐问题 ΠGDM oracle，且不出现 DPS 观察到的幻觉，而 DPS 在固定尺度下大幅退化、ΠGDM 只有逐问题对照真值重调才保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 把引导超参数升级为逐步在线推断的潜变量，可以在不接触真值与噪声水平的前提下达到真值校准 oracle 的水平，并在算子与分布变化时保持对数据与先验的再平衡，避免固定人脸先验引导的幻觉。

papers.title: Continuous Online Fault Detection for Mobile Robots via Adaptive Edge Models
papers.abstract_en: Mobile robots require robust, real-time fault detection capable of continuous adaptation on constrained edge hardware. While deep time-series models excel at unsupervised anomaly detection, their computational cost prohibits high-frequency onboard execution. This paper bridges this gap via a Teacher-Student distillation framework. An offline foundation model (TSPulse) generates pseudo-labels from unlabeled time series augmented with fault injections. A lightweight MiniRocket Student, adapted with a Recursive Least Squares estimator, approximates this complex decision boundary to execute real-time inference onboard. Evaluations on the TSB-AD benchmark and a physical mobile robot demonstrate the Student achieves a 4.30 ms CPU inference latency. During real-world domain shifts, online adaptation enables the Student to recover from unseen mechanical degradation, improving VUS-PR scores from 0.26 to 0.75 without catastrophic forgetting. Crucially, an uncertainty-guided active learning strategy minimizes operator cognitive load, requesting sparse interventions only when encountering novel fault distributions. These results validate the deployment of state-of-the-art anomaly detection on resource-constrained robotics through offline-to-online distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向移动机器人的边缘实时故障检测：用离线基础模型 TSPulse 对含故障注入的无标签时序打伪标签，蒸馏给带递归最小二乘 (RLS) 的轻量 MiniRocket Student 在板端实时推理。真实域偏移下在线适应使 VUS-PR 从 0.26 升到 0.75 且无灾难性遗忘，CPU 推理延迟 4.30 ms。
Motivation: 深度时序模型做无监督异常检测效果好但算力开销大，无法在资源受限的移动机器人边缘硬件上高频运行；同时真实机械退化造成的域偏移需要持续在线适应。
Method: Teacher-Student 蒸馏：离线基础模型 TSPulse 对加入故障注入增强的无标签时序生成伪标签，轻量 MiniRocket Student 用递归最小二乘 (Recursive Least Squares) 估计器逼近其决策边界以做板端实时推理；再用不确定性引导的主动学习策略，仅在遇到新故障分布时向操作者请求稀疏干预。
Result: 在 TSB-AD 基准与实体移动机器人上评测：Student 达到 4.30 ms CPU 推理延迟；真实域偏移下在线适应使 VUS-PR 从 0.26 提升到 0.75，且无灾难性遗忘；主动学习仅在新故障分布时请求稀疏人工干预。
Conclusion: 离线到在线的蒸馏路径能把 SOTA 级异常检测部署到资源受限的机器人上，并靠在线适应与不确定性引导干预同时应对域偏移和操作者认知负荷。

papers.title: ImCorr: Sub-pixel Semantic Correspondence via Implicit Feature Decoding
papers.abstract_en: The strong performance that modern semantic correspondence methods achieve at standard thresholds plateaus sharply at fine-grained thresholds. We argue that this plateau stems not from the representational capacity of backbone features, but from a grid-tied readout. Patch-based vision transformers tokenize images onto discrete grids, introducing two forms of quantization error: querying nearest patch features instead of exact keypoints on the source side, and the absence of grid features representing precise ground-truth locations on the target side. We quantify this quantization ceiling across all 499,188 keypoints in SPair-71k: under the standard 448x448, patch-14 setting, 84.9% of ground-truth keypoints have no grid feature representing their precise location at PCK@0.01. This is a structural limitation at the representation level, independent of the matching strategy. We address this with ImCorr: Sub-pixel Semantic Correspondence via Implicit Feature Decoding, which formulates correspondence estimation over a continuous feature field queryable at arbitrary continuous coordinates. A FiLM-conditioned decoder is trained to embed sub-pixel positional information into the feature field. Querying the field directly at exact keypoint coordinates theoretically eliminates representation-level quantization error on the source side, while decoding onto a grid denser than the backbone grid substantially reduces quantization error on the target side. On SPair-71k and AP-10K (intra-species, cross-species, and cross-family), ImCorr improves performance at fine-grained thresholds (PCK@0.01-0.05), achieving a 6.2 percentage point gain over the prior state of the art at PCK@0.01 on SPair-71k. These results demonstrate that representational continuity is an effective solution for precise semantic correspondence. Code is available at https://github.com/YusungChoi/ImCorr.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImCorr 把语义对应从离散 patch 网格搬到可任意连续坐标查询的隐式特征场，用 FiLM 条件解码器把亚像素位置信息编码进场中。在 SPair-71k 全部 499,188 个关键点上，448×448、patch-14 设置下 84.9% 的真值关键点在 PCK@0.01 处没有对应网格特征，说明瓶颈是网格绑定读出而非 backbone 表征能力；ImCorr 在 SPair-71k 的 PCK@0.01 上比先前 SOTA 高 6.2 个百分点。
Motivation: 语义对应方法在标准阈值下表现强，但在细粒度阈值上急剧停滞；作者认为这不是 backbone 特征表征能力不足，而是 patch 化 ViT 的网格绑定读出带来的量化误差——源侧只能查最近 patch 特征，目标侧缺少代表精确真值位置的网格特征。
Method: ImCorr 将对应估计表述为在连续特征场上、可在任意连续坐标查询的形式：用 FiLM 条件化的解码器把亚像素位置信息嵌入特征场，源侧直接在精确关键点坐标查询以消除源侧表征量化误差，目标侧解码到比 backbone 网格更密的网格上以大幅降低目标侧量化误差。
Result: 在 SPair-71k 全部 499,188 个关键点上量化了量化上限：448×448、patch-14 设置下 84.9% 的真值关键点在 PCK@0.01 处没有代表其精确位置的网格特征。在 SPair-71k 与 AP-10K（intra-species、cross-species、cross-family）上，ImCorr 在细粒度阈值 PCK@0.01–0.05 提升性能，在 SPair-71k 的 PCK@0.01 上比先前 SOTA 高 6.2 个百分点。
Conclusion: 细粒度阈值下的对应瓶颈是表征层面的网格量化这一结构性限制，与匹配策略无关；表征连续性（representational continuity）是实现精确语义对应的有效途径。

papers.title: ASIRF: An Agentic Framework for Context-Dependent Sensitive Information Redaction
papers.abstract_en: Sensitive information is defined by domain and intent, not a universal category, yet redaction systems such as privacy filters and named-entity recognizers fix a taxonomy at training time, requiring retraining for each new domain. We introduce ASIRF (Agentic Sensitive Information Redaction Framework), which retrieves domain-specific definitions based on the input's domain from a flexible knowledge base at inference time, needing no retraining to adapt. Two architectures, a three-call multi-agent pipeline and a single-agent variant, are evaluated across ten small open-weight models and eight datasets, including out-of-distribution fictional domains, against the OpenAI Privacy Filter (OPF) as a trained-classifier baseline. With only a few dozen expert-authored definitions per domain and no training data, ASIRF's recall exceeds OPF's in 68 of 80 model-domain combinations (85 percent), by at least one of the two architectures, with shortfalls confined mostly to OPF's training-distribution domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ASIRF 在推理时按输入所属领域从可扩展知识库检索领域专属的敏感信息定义，无需重训即可适配新领域；在 10 个小参数开源模型 × 8 个数据集（含分布外虚构领域）共 80 个模型-领域组合上，两种架构（三轮调用多智能体流水线与单智能体变体）中至少一种的 recall 超过训练式基线 OpenAI Privacy Filter 的组合达 68/80（85%），且落后主要集中在 OPF 的训练分布领域内。
Motivation: 敏感信息由领域与意图决定而非固定类别，但隐私过滤器与 NER 在训练时固化分类体系，每换一个领域都要重新训练。
Method: ASIRF（Agentic Sensitive Information Redaction Framework）在推理时依据输入领域从灵活知识库检索领域定义，比较三轮调用多智能体流水线与单智能体两种架构，在 10 个小参数开源模型和 8 个数据集（含分布外虚构领域）上评测，以 OpenAI Privacy Filter (OPF) 为训练式分类器基线；每个领域只需几十条专家撰写的定义、零训练数据。
Result: 80 个模型-领域组合中 68 个（85%）上 ASIRF 的 recall 至少被其中一种架构超过 OPF；短处主要限于 OPF 训练分布内的领域。
Conclusion: 以推理时检索领域定义替代训练期固定分类体系，可在不重训、无训练数据的条件下跨领域达到不低于训练式隐私过滤器的召回，代价是 OPF 熟悉的分布内领域仍可能落后。

papers.title: When Honesty is Not Enough in AI Debate
papers.abstract_en: Scalable oversight aims to verify the behaviour of agents whose capabilities exceed those of their overseers. AI debate has been proposed as an oversight solution in which competing agents help a resource-limited verifier assess claims that it cannot reliably evaluate unaided. Much of its promise rests on incentivizing honest arguments that lead to correct verdicts. Yet a correct verdict need not uniquely determine the arguments used to support it. Agents may retain discretion over which correct claims to present, how to frame them, and in what order to disclose them. This residual freedom can allow agents to shape what the verifier learns beyond the task-relevant conclusion, pursuing latent objectives without compromising verdict correctness. To study this phenomenon, we introduce the framework strategic interactive oversight (SIO), which treats oversight jointly as a verification mechanism and a strategic communication channel. Within this framework, we formalise the notion of task-admissible latent optimisation, which entails the pursuit of latent objectives while maintaining a prescribed task performance. As proof-of-concept, we instantiate SIO in the establish protocol debate with cross-examination and quantify a tradeoff between task success and information disclosure about a hidden variable. The trade-off identifies a strategic window in which substantial disclosure remains compatible with task admissibility. Towards mitigation, we reduce admissible bias by expanding the cross-examiner's role to mitigate persistent disclosure over finite interaction horizons. Our results highlight the need to evaluate oversight not only by the correctness of its verdicts, but also by the information conveyed through its transcripts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI debate 中诚实不足以约束代理：即使裁决正确，代理仍可选择呈现哪些正确论点、如何措辞与排序，在不损害裁决正确性的前提下追求潜在目标。作者提出 strategic interactive oversight (SIO) 框架，把监督同时视为验证机制与策略性通信通道，并在带交叉询问的 establish protocol debate 中量化任务成功与隐藏变量信息披露的权衡，发现存在一个大量披露仍与任务可容性兼容的策略窗口；扩大 cross-examiner 角色可在有限交互轮次内降低可容偏差。
Motivation: 可扩展监督 (scalable oversight) 依赖诚实论证导向正确裁决，但正确裁决并不唯一决定论证内容，代理可在裁决正确之外塑造验证者学到的信息，从而在不违反任务表现的情况下追求潜在目标。
Method: 提出 strategic interactive oversight (SIO)，把监督形式化为验证机制加策略性通信通道；在其中定义 task-admissible latent optimisation（保持规定任务表现的同时追求潜在目标），并以带 cross-examination 的 establish protocol debate 作为概念验证实例化，量化任务成功与隐藏变量信息披露的权衡。
Result: 在 establish protocol debate 中量化出任务成功与隐藏变量信息披露之间的权衡曲线，识别出 substantial disclosure 仍与 task admissibility 兼容的策略窗口；通过扩展 cross-examiner 的角色，在有限交互轮次 (finite interaction horizons) 内降低了可容偏差 (admissible bias)。

papers.title: The Entropy Triangle Method (ETM): A novel framework for the prevention of cardiac arrhythmia with a review of more than 10,000 patients
papers.abstract_en: One of the most important problems in medicine is to facilitate prediction. In this study, we propose entropy triangle method, a novel framework for predicting heart rhythms using a novel machine learning technique. This framework includes three steps: feature engineering, entropy triangle oversampling, and disease prediction. The dataset used in this study is a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia research database with 10,646 patients. This dataset contains 11 different heart rhythms (5 sinus rhythms and 6 non-sinus rhythms). In this article, we introduce two firsts in machine learning and medicine that can predict non-sinus rhythm with over 85% accuracy. Our experimental results show, among others, that the most accurate classifier based on entropy triangles and the most useful oversampling are the supported vector classifiers and oversampling techniques for shark scent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出心律失常预测框架 Entropy Triangle Method (ETM)，把特征工程、entropy triangle 过采样与分类三步串联，在 10,646 例 12 导联 ECG 心律失常数据库上预测非窦性心律，准确率超过 85%。作者称其为机器学习与医学中的两个首次，并指出基于 entropy triangle 的最优分类器是支持向量机 (SVC)，配合 shark scent 过采样最有效。
Motivation: 医学预测的核心难题之一是心律失常的早期识别，而 ECG 数据中心律类别高度不平衡，使非窦性心律的预测困难。
Method: ETM 分三步：特征工程、entropy triangle 过采样 (entropy triangle oversampling)、疾病预测；数据为含 10,646 名患者的 12 导联 ECG 心律失常研究数据库，覆盖 11 种心律（5 种窦性、6 种非窦性）。
Result: 非窦性心律预测准确率超过 85%；在所比较的分类器与过采样技术中，基于 entropy triangle 的最准确分类器为支持向量分类器 (supported vector classifiers)，最有用的过采样为 shark scent 过采样。
Conclusion: ETM 用 entropy triangle 过采样配合 SVC 即可在不平衡 ECG 数据上把非窦性心律预测准确率推到 85% 以上。

papers.title: An Automated Georeferencing Technique for Multi-Temporal Stope Point Clouds for Downstream Geotechnical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of UAV laser scanning in underground mines has enabled frequent acquisition of 3D point clouds from challenging environments such as stopes, generating large volumes of multi-temporal spatial data throughout successive excavation stages. However, in GNSS-denied underground environments, independently acquired stope point clouds are generated within local scanner reference frames and require registration and georeferencing before integration with mine reference data for downstream geotechnical analysis, monitoring, and mine planning. This process is commonly performed manually by aligning individual stope scans with mine reference drives, making repeated georeferencing time-consuming and potentially limiting the utilisation of routinely acquired data. This study proposes the 3D Tag-based Automated Registration and Georeferencing Technique (3D-TARGeT), an automated framework using low-cost, generic, non-unique rectangular tags to establish spatial correspondence between stope point clouds and the mine reference coordinate system. The framework combines automated tag identification, geometric tag matching, and rigid transformation estimation. It was evaluated as a proof of concept using four multi-temporal point-cloud scans of an underground mine stope, with the proposed tags simulated under representative scanning conditions. 3D-TARGeT achieved consistent centimetre-level georeferencing accuracy, with median cloud-to-cloud distance and root mean square error below 0.03 m across all scans, while substantially outperforming widely used automatic point-cloud registration techniques. Overall, 3D-TARGeT provides an accurate and robust approach for automating stope point-cloud georeferencing, reducing reliance on manual alignment and facilitating multi-temporal datasets for downstream geological and geotechnical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D-TARGeT 用低成本、非唯一的矩形标签在无 GNSS 的地下矿中自动把采场 (stope) 多期点云配准并地理参考到矿山坐标系，流程为自动标签识别、几何标签匹配与刚体变换估计。在 4 期采场扫描（标签按代表性扫描条件模拟）的概念验证中，中位云到云距离与 RMSE 全部低于 0.03 m，且明显优于常用自动点云配准方法。
Motivation: UAV 激光扫描在地下矿高频采集多期采场点云，但无 GNSS 环境下各期点云只在局部扫描仪坐标系里，需人工与矿山参考巷道对齐，重复地理参考耗时，限制常规数据的使用。
Method: 提出 3D-TARGeT：用低成本、通用、非唯一的矩形标签建立采场点云与矿山参考坐标系的空间对应，组合自动标签识别、几何标签匹配与刚体变换估计三步，替代人工对齐。
Result: 在 4 期地下矿采场多期点云扫描的概念验证中（标签按代表性扫描条件模拟），中位云到云距离与 RMSE 在所有扫描上均低于 0.03 m，达到厘米级精度，并大幅优于广泛使用的自动点云配准技术。
Conclusion: 标签驱动的自动地理参考能以厘米级精度替代人工对齐，使多期采场数据可用于地质与岩土下游分析、监测与采矿规划；证据来自 4 期扫描加模拟标签的概念验证。

papers.title: Right Choice of Classification Algorithms Based on Reinforcement Learning for Prediction of Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver
papers.abstract_en: There are many complex issues in the world of artificial intelligence. Some of these problems are solved using other artificial intelligence methods, which are called artificial intelligence for artificial intelligence. Finding an appropriate classifier algorithm is a time-consuming task. For this reason, an algorithm that can automatically learn the choice of classification algorithms is very important. Classification algorithms are useful in predicting various diseases. Also, Primary Biliary Cirrhosis is one of the most well-known diseases that have been predicted by classification algorithms. This research's most significant achievement and novelty is the automatic increase in learning through a scoring method of reinforcement learning is called square learning (SL). In this research, an algorithm is presented that learns to automatically select the appropriate classification algorithm to predict Primary Biliary Cirrhosis. In this article, with inspiration from four evaluation metrics in classification algorithms, a new reinforcement learning method by the name of Fourth Degree Learning has been presented. In this research, we increased the performance of the classification algorithms used in this method from 63% of accuracy and achieved 98% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习自动选择分类算法的框架，用于原发性胆汁性肝硬化 (Primary Biliary Cirrhosis) 预测：先给出评分式强化学习方法 square learning (SL)，再提出受四个分类评估指标启发的 Fourth Degree Learning。分类算法性能从 63% 准确率提升到 98% 准确率。
Motivation: 为具体疾病任务手工挑选分类算法耗时且依赖经验，需要让算法自动学会选择合适的分类器。
Method: 用强化学习驱动分类器选择：以 square learning (SL) 评分方法自动增加学习，并提出受分类算法四个评估指标启发的 Fourth Degree Learning 强化学习方法，作用于 Primary Biliary Cirrhosis 的分类预测。
Result: 所用分类算法的准确率从 63% 提升到 98%。
Conclusion: 让强化学习自动选择分类算法可显著提高疾病预测分类性能，作者以此作为该研究最主要成果与创新。

papers.title: Towards Deployable Underwater Vessel Classification
papers.abstract_en: We propose a compact underwater acoustic classification framework combining multi-representation feature engineering, temporal statistical pooling, and compact convolutional architectures designed for acoustic time-frequency and cochlear representations. We investigate multiple conventional and auditory-inspired representations and first evaluate lightweight classifiers and Conventional Neural Networks (CNNs) on ShipsEar dataset. On the provided split, a two-layer CNN achieves a macro F1 of 0.9918, while a Radial Basis Function Support Vector Machine (RBF-SVM) reaches 0.9883. However, source-recording provenance cannot be reconstructed, preventing verification of recording-independent generalisation. We therefore evaluate on DeepShip dataset using recording-level partitioning before segmentation. Under this protocol, a 157K-parameter compact CNN achieves a test macro F1 of 0.7226, while an 11.17M-parameter ResNet18 provides no improvement in validation performance under the matched setting. These results demonstrate the importance of representation-aware feature and model design, together with rigorous recording-level evaluation, for classification performance and deployability in compact underwater acoustic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出紧凑水下声学分类框架：多表示特征工程 + 时间统计池化 + 紧凑卷积网络，面向声学时频与耳蜗 (cochlear) 表示。在 ShipsEar 提供划分上两层 CNN macro F1 达 0.9918，但来源不可追溯；改用 DeepShip 录音级划分后，157K 参数紧凑 CNN macro F1 为 0.7226，而 11.17M 参数 ResNet18 在匹配设置下验证性能无提升。
Motivation: ShipsEar 上的高分无法验证录音独立泛化，因为来源录制信息不可重建；水下声学部署需要在严格录音级划分下仍可用的紧凑模型。
Method: 组合多表示特征工程（含时频与耳蜗表示）、时间统计池化与紧凑卷积架构；先在 ShipsEar 上评估轻量分类器与 CNN，再在 DeepShip 上采用分割前的录音级划分 (recording-level partitioning) 重新评估。
Result: ShipsEar 提供划分：两层 CNN macro F1 0.9918，RBF-SVM 0.9883。DeepShip 录音级划分：157K 参数紧凑 CNN 测试 macro F1 0.7226；11.17M 参数 ResNet18 在匹配设置下验证性能无改善。
Conclusion: 表示感知的特征与模型设计配合严格的录音级评估，才是紧凑水下声学系统分类性能与可部署性的关键；ShipsEar 高分不足以证明录音独立泛化。
