papers.title: CRISS: A Retrieval-Augmented AI Chatbot for Assisting Cancer Registrars
papers.abstract_en: Cancer registrars, including Oncology Data Specialists (ODSs), must interpret complex and frequently updated coding and staging standards. We developed CRISS (Cancer Registry Intelligent Support System), a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational assistant that provides rapid, citation-supported access to registry guidance. This study evaluated whether CRISS could (1) support accurate and citation-supported responses, (2) improve access to and interpretation of relevant guidance, and (3) support training/helpdesk use while preserving human oversight of final abstraction decisions. We built a domain-specific knowledge base from national cancer registry standards, segmented into metadata-tagged passages and indexed as dense embeddings. Retrieved passages were used to generate citation-grounded responses through a large language model (LLM). Open-weight, proprietary, and non-RAG baseline models across Gemini and GPT families were evaluated on easy, medium, and hard registry questions using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocols. RAG configurations consistently outperformed non-RAG approaches, especially as question difficulty increased. Mean grounding scores for RAG were 0.62/0.56/0.59 across easy/medium/hard tiers versus 0.29/0.26/0.29 for non-RAG. RAG models also achieved higher semantic-similarity scores overall. Proprietary RAG models performed strongest on easy and medium questions, while local RAG models ranked highest on hard questions and proprietary models were generally more cautious. Domain-specific RAG improved evidence grounding and response quality for cancer registry questions while enabling citation-supported assistance across complexity levels. CRISS demonstrates the potential of human-centered, citation-grounded AI to support cancer registrars while preserving human oversight for final coding decisions.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 13 figures, 7 tables. Keywords: cancer registry, retrieval-augmented generation, large language models, conversational AI, clinical informatics, oncology data specialists, medical question answering, AI safety, clinical decision support
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRISS 是面向癌症登记员 (cancer registrar) 的 RAG 对话助手，把国家癌症登记标准切成带元数据标签的段落并建稠密向量索引，用 LLM 生成带引用的回答。在 easy/medium/hard 三档登记问题上，RAG 的平均 grounding 分数为 0.62/0.56/0.59，非 RAG 基线仅 0.29/0.26/0.29，且题目越难差距越大。
Motivation: 癌症登记员需频繁解读不断更新的编码与分期标准，人工查证慢且易错，需要快速、可引用的指南获取方式，同时保留人工对最终抽象决策的监督。
Method: 以国家癌症登记标准构建领域知识库，切分为带元数据标签的段落并索引为稠密 embeddings，检索到的段落送入 LLM 生成 citation-grounded 回答；用 LLM-as-a-Judge 协议在 Gemini 与 GPT 系列的开源权重、专有及非 RAG 基线上评测 easy/medium/hard 三档问题。
Result: RAG 平均 grounding 分数 easy/medium/hard 为 0.62/0.56/0.59，非 RAG 为 0.29/0.26/0.29；RAG 整体语义相似度分数也更高。专有 RAG 模型在 easy 与 medium 题上最强，本地 RAG 模型在 hard 题上排名最高，专有模型整体更保守。
Conclusion: 领域特定 RAG 能提升癌症登记问题的证据 grounding 与回答质量，跨难度档位提供带引用的辅助，同时把最终编码决策留给人类监督。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Measuring: Tool-Augmented Metric Spatial Reasoning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe scenes well but reason poorly about metric 3D structure such as absolute distances, physical sizes, or egocentric directions. We present a modular, predictor agnostic, tool-augmented framework that equips a small VLM (Qwen3.5-4B) with geometric tools: 3D object detection, metric depth estimation, and deterministic solvers for distance, size and bearing. Each object is detected in the camera frame of its own best view, and the tools use that frame's pose to lift every detection into one shared world frame. Moving metric computation out of the model's weights and into explicit solvers yields large gains on three of four ReVSI-Bench tasks: with a strong monocular detector (WildDet3D), absolute distance rises from 0.46 to 0.74 Mean Relative Accuracy (MRA), relative distance from 39.1% to 67.4%, and relative direction from a below-chance 25.9% to 73.4%. Because any detector can be swapped in behind the tool interface, comparing real detectors against ground-truth boxes separates perception error from reasoning error: orchestration costs only 0.03 MRA. Object size is bounded by the detector: the tools are near-exact on groundtruth boxes (0.97) yet the best real detector barely beats the no-tool baseline (0.61 vs. 0.58), because size reads straight off a box extent monocular detectors get wrong. Without a predefined recipe, the model already sequences the tools correctly on its own, matching a scripted pipeline on three of four tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模块化、预测器无关的工具增强框架，把度量 3D 推理从 VLM 权重里搬到显式几何求解器：3D 检测、单目深度估计与确定性距离/尺寸/方位求解器协同，各物体在最佳视角相机系检测后统一提升到世界系。在 ReVSI-Bench 四项任务中的三项上大幅提分，绝对距离 MRA 0.46→0.74，相对距离 39.1%→67.4%，相对方向 25.9%→73.4%；物体尺寸则被检测器卡住。
Motivation: VLM 能描述场景，却难以正确推理绝对距离、物理尺寸和自我中心方向这类度量 3D 结构，因为这些量本不该由模型权重隐式承担。
Method: 为小模型 Qwen3.5-4B 外挂几何工具：WildDet3D 等 3D 目标检测器、单目度量深度估计，以及距离、尺寸、方位的确定性求解器；每个物体在自身最佳视角的相机系中检测，用该系位姿统一提升到共享世界系。检测器可在工具接口后替换，用真值框对比以分离感知误差与推理误差。
Result: 在 ReVSI-Bench 上，配 WildDet3D 时绝对距离 MRA 从 0.46 升到 0.74，相对距离从 39.1% 升到 67.4%，相对方向从低于随机的 25.9% 升到 73.4%；编排本身只损失 0.03 MRA。物体尺寸受限于检测器：真值框下工具近乎精确（0.97），最佳真实检测器仅 0.61，勉强胜过无工具基线 0.58。无需预定义流程，模型已能自行正确排序工具，在四项任务中的三项上与脚本化流水线持平。
Conclusion: 把度量计算移出模型权重、交给显式求解器可大幅提升 VLM 的距离与方向推理，而尺寸这类直接读自框范围的量仍被单目检测器的感知误差封顶。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: BranchShine-CR: Compact Multilingual IPA Transcription with Self-Conditioned CTC and Consistency Regularization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce BranchShine-CR, a 25M-parameter model for multilingual transcription into the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). It combines log-mel features, a rotary-position E-Branchformer encoder, intermediate self-conditioned connectionist temporal classification (CTC), and consistency regularization across augmented views. On 16,646 shared IPApack++ test utterances, it achieves 4.47% IPA character error rate, a 22.3% relative reduction from ZIPA-CTC-NS, with approximately one-twelfth as many parameters while being trained from scratch. BranchShine-CR also outperforms a similarly sized NeMo Conformer baseline across all 41 dataset language labels. Ablation studies indicate the individual components synergetically acting in model performance contribution. These findings support compact IPA recognition capabilities under limited compute budget, for applications in low-resource on-device pronunciation assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BranchShine-CR 是一个 25M 参数的多语言 IPA 转写模型，用 log-mel 特征加 rotary-position E-Branchformer 编码器、中间层自条件 CTC (self-conditioned CTC) 与增强视图间一致性正则 (consistency regularization) 从零训练。在 16,646 条共享 IPApack++ 测试语句上 IPA 字符错误率 4.47%，相对 ZIPA-CTC-NS 降低 22.3%，参数量约为其十二分之一。
Motivation: 多语言 IPA 转写与发音评估需要在受限算力预算下做到端侧部署，而现有系统参数量大、依赖预训练，低资源场景难以负担。
Method: 25M 参数模型：log-mel 特征输入，rotary-position E-Branchformer 编码器，中间层自条件 CTC 输出，训练时对增强视图施加一致性正则；从零训练，不依赖预训练，并做组件消融。
Result: 在 16,646 条共享 IPApack++ 测试语句上 IPA 字符错误率 (CER) 4.47%，相对 ZIPA-CTC-NS 降低 22.3%，参数量约为其 1/12；在全部 41 个数据集语言标签上均优于规模相近的 NeMo Conformer 基线；消融显示各组件对性能有协同贡献。
Conclusion: 在有限算力下，自条件 CTC 与一致性正则的紧凑模型即可实现可用的多语言 IPA 识别，支撑端侧发音评估应用。

papers.title: EIB-Net: Entropy-Guided Information Bottleneck for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of photorealistic AI-generated images demands robust detection methods that generalize across diverse generative models. While existing approaches target manipulation-based forgeries with local artifacts, generation-based images (e.g., from diffusion models) lack such traces, posing a fundamental challenge. We observe that generative models prioritize global semantics at the expense of local texture fidelity, making low-texture regions key indicators of synthetic origin. To exploit this, we propose EIB-Net, an Entropy-guided Information Bottleneck Network. EIB-Net introduces a novel Image Entropy (IE) metric to automatically select the most informative (lowest-entropy) patch, then processes it with a Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) to learn compact, generalizable features. Extensive experiments on DIFF, DiffusionForensics, and GenImage benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: EIB-Net achieves 85.7\% accuracy using only 2\% of training data, outperforming full-image baselines by over 15\%, and maintains robust cross-generator generalization (83.5\% average accuracy on GenImage). Furthermore, our entropy-guided patch selection (EGPL) consistently enhances diverse backbones (CNNs and Transformers), proving its practical value for data-efficient detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EIB-Net 用图像熵 (Image Entropy) 自动选出信息量最高的最低纹理 patch，再经变分信息瓶颈 (VIB) 学紧凑可泛化特征，专攻扩散模型生成图像的检测。在 DIFF、DiffusionForensics、GenImage 上以 2% 训练数据达到 85.7% 准确率，比全图基线高出 15% 以上，GenImage 跨生成器平均准确率 83.5%。
Motivation: 生成式伪造（如扩散模型）缺少局部篡改痕迹，现有面向 manipulation-based forgery 的检测方法难以泛化到不同生成模型；同时全图训练数据成本高。
Method: 提出 EIB-Net：先用新提出的 Image Entropy (IE) 指标自动挑选最低熵（纹理最少）的 patch，再送入 Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) 学习紧凑特征；另给出熵引导 patch 选择模块 EGPL，可插到 CNN 与 Transformer 骨干上。
Result: 在 DIFF、DiffusionForensics、GenImage 上达到 SOTA：仅用 2% 训练数据取得 85.7% 准确率，比全图基线高出 15% 以上；GenImage 上跨生成器平均准确率 83.5%；EGPL 一致提升 CNN 与 Transformer 多种骨干。

papers.title: Transformers as Cross-Task Learners: Shared Structure Drives Sample Efficiency in In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Transformers achieve remarkable performance by jointly learning broad families of tasks during pretraining and adapting to unseen tasks from only a short prompt. Yet a rigorous mathematical and statistical understanding of this phenomenon remains limited. This paper aims to study how Transformers exploit shared cross-task structure and how this structure affects the sample complexity of in-context learning (ICL). Specifically, we characterize task-space complexity through covering numbers under a prescribed metric, thereby quantifying the low-dimensional cross-task structure without requiring an explicit parametric representation. The resulting cover provides a set of anchor functions, which we use to introduce a task-identification-and-evaluation procedure: context observations localize an unseen task among the anchor functions, and the response at a query is predicted by aggregating the corresponding anchor function query evaluations. For approximation, we explicitly construct a Transformer with Softmax attention to approximate this procedure. For generalization, we derive an error bound that separates the effects of the number of pretraining tasks and the prompt length. The scaling with respect to the number of pretraining tasks is governed by the intrinsic dimensions of the task space and input domain; once sufficiently many tasks are available, the dependence on the prompt context length becomes dimension-free. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to quantify cross-task complexity for general nonlinear task families and explicitly construct a Transformer that exploits their low-dimensional structure to perform ICL. Our theory provides a quantitative explanation of how joint pretraining across related tasks improves in-context generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用覆盖数 (covering numbers) 刻画任务空间的跨任务复杂度，给出锚函数 (anchor functions) 上的任务识别-评估 ICL 程序，并显式构造带 Softmax attention 的 Transformer 去逼近它。误差界把预训练任务数与 prompt 长度的贡献分开：任务数的标度由任务空间与输入域的内在维度决定，任务足够多后对 prompt 长度的依赖变成 dimension-free。
Motivation: Transformer 联合预训练多任务并靠短 prompt 适应新任务的现象缺少严格的数理统计解释，尤其缺少对一般非线性任务族跨任务复杂度的量化。
Method: 在给定度量下用覆盖数刻画任务空间复杂度，得到锚函数集合；据此提出任务识别-评估程序，用 context 观测在锚函数中定位未见任务，再聚合各锚函数在 query 处的取值作预测；随后显式构造一个 Softmax attention 的 Transformer 逼近该程序，并推导泛化误差界。
Result: 得到分离预训练任务数与 prompt 长度效应的误差界：任务数一侧的标度由任务空间内在维度与输入域内在维度控制，任务数足够多后对 prompt 长度的依赖为 dimension-free；作者称这是首个量化一般非线性任务族跨任务复杂度并显式构造利用该低维结构做 ICL 的 Transformer 的工作。
Conclusion: 跨任务共享的低维结构是联合预训练提升 in-context 泛化的机制：任务族内在维度越低，所需预训练任务数越少，且一旦任务充足，样本效率不再受 prompt 长度制约。

papers.title: Empath: Tracing Multi-Level Emotion Dynamics in Crisis Counseling Dialogues
papers.abstract_en: Emotion dynamics are critical for understanding crisis-support conversations, yet most computational work treats emotion as static utterance-level labels. We introduce EMPATH, a framework for understanding affective dynamics in mental health dialogues across three granularities: turn-level labels, transition probabilities, and global conversation archetypes. Applying EMPATH to text-based crisis conversations with self-identified Black texters discussing grief, we find persistent negative affect, gradual hope-ward transitions, distinct texter-volunteer emotional roles, and heterogeneous recovery trajectories. These results highlight the informative patterns that emerge from computationally understanding crisis support and expressions of grief as dynamic processes within conversations, as well as the overall value of emotion-dynamic analysis for analyzing and comparing affect in dialogues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMPATH 把危机咨询对话中的情绪从静态逐轮标签扩展为三层动态刻画：逐轮标签、情绪转移概率、全局对话原型。应用于自述为 Black 的文本求助者谈悲伤的危机对话后，发现负面情绪持续存在、情绪逐步向希望方向转移、求助者与志愿者角色分明，且恢复轨迹存在异质性。
Motivation: 既有计算工作把情绪当作静态的逐轮标签，无法刻画危机支持对话中情绪随时间演变的过程与对话级别的模式。
Method: EMPATH 框架在三个粒度上建模情绪动态：turn-level 标签、transition probabilities（情绪转移概率）、global conversation archetypes（全局对话原型），应用于文本型危机对话数据。
Result: 在自述为 Black、讨论悲伤的文本求助者对话中，识别出持续的负面情绪、逐步向希望（hope-ward）的转移、求助者与志愿者之间分明的情绪角色，以及异质的恢复轨迹。
Conclusion: 把危机支持与悲伤表达当作对话内的动态过程来计算分析，能浮现出静态标签看不到的模式，情绪动态分析可用于比较对话中的情感。

papers.title: From Self-Distillation to Self-Practice: Privileged Information for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has become a popular recipe for post-training LLM agents. It supervises the agent model at the token level with a stronger teacher view of the same model, obtained by conditioning on privileged information (PI). In this work, we show that in multi-turn agents, this paradigm teaches the student to act with confidence but without the information behind it. The trained agent behaves as if it had privileged information it never observed, and its performance falls well short of plain RL, in the worst case below the untrained base model. Therefore, we propose Privileged Self-Practice (PSP), which keeps the PI and moves it from the loss to the sampler. When the student's rollouts on a task mostly fail, we inject a short per-task instruction written by an analyzer model, sample the task again with the instruction in context, and train on the result with an unchanged GRPO objective. The privileged information stays in the prompt and never enters the loss. Across AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, with three different student models, PSP obtains the best average score in every setting and is the only method that consistently outperforms plain GRPO, improving task-goal completion by up to 65% on AppWorld and the resolved rate by up to 61% on SWE-bench Verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多轮 LLM agent 上，on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 把特权信息 (privileged information, PI) 放进 token 级损失，训练出的 agent 表现得像自己观察到了其实从未见过的信息，最差时低于未训练 base model。作者提出 Privileged Self-Practice (PSP)：把 PI 从损失移到采样器——当某任务的 rollout 大多失败时，注入 analyzer model 写的简短任务指令，带指令重新采样，再用不变的 GRPO 目标训练。
Motivation: OPSD 是 LLM agent 后训练的流行配方，但在多轮设定下它教学生自信地行动却拿不到支撑这种自信的信息，性能甚至不如普通 RL，最差低于未训练 base model。
Method: PSP 保留 PI 但只把它放进 prompt：rollout 大量失败的任务上，由 analyzer model 生成 per-task 指令注入上下文，重新采样该任务，再以完全不变的 GRPO 目标训练；PI 不进入损失。
Result: 在 AppWorld 与 SWE-bench Verified 上、用三个不同 student model，PSP 在每个设定中取得最佳平均分，也是唯一稳定优于 plain GRPO 的方法：AppWorld 上任务目标完成度提升最高 65%，SWE-bench Verified 上 resolved rate 提升最高 61%。
Conclusion: 特权信息应当通过采样时的上下文注入而非 token 级蒸馏损失传递给多轮 agent，否则会学到没有信息支撑的自信；放进 prompt 并保持 GRPO 目标不变即可稳定超过 plain GRPO。

papers.title: SLCA-GRPO: Resolving Cross-Segment Credit Misattribution in Tool-Calling RL
papers.abstract_en: Tool-calling agents produce heterogeneous outputs, interleaving structured tool invocations with user-facing natural language summaries. This output heterogeneity presents a structural failure mode in standard on-policy Reinforcement Learning (RL): algorithms like GRPO indiscriminately broadcast a homogeneous trajectory-level scalar advantage to all tokens. Consequently, gradient noise from summary generation leaks into tool-decision tokens, causing cross-segment credit misattribution and brittle optimization. In this work, we propose SLCA-GRPO, a framework incorporating Segment-Locked Credit Assignment (SLCA). To enable scalable exploration without costly real APIs and stable training, we first construct the Schema-Guided LLM Simulator (SGLS) as foundational training infrastructure. Building on this, SLCA decouples advantage estimation at the structural segment level within a single group of rollouts, without requiring additional rollouts from intermediate states. Supported by Hierarchical Rewards (HierR), SLCA routes execution advantages to tool tokens and preference advantages to summary tokens, eliminating advantage contamination (the dominant cross-segment credit misattribution channel) within each policy update. On a 7B backbone, SLCA-GRPO accelerates convergence and outperforms standard GRPO, ToolPO, and RLTR by +2.53 pp on in-domain evaluation, +1.36 pp on the Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL), and +9.15 pp on $τ^2$-Bench under the same training budgets, achieving higher accuracy with reduced tool redundancy and costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具调用 agent 的输出混合结构化调用与自然语言摘要，标准 GRPO 把轨迹级标量优势广播给所有 token，摘要生成的梯度噪声会泄漏到工具决策 token，造成跨段 credit 错配。SLCA-GRPO 在同一组 rollout 内按结构段解耦优势估计，用分层奖励 (HierR) 把执行优势路由到工具 token、偏好优势路由到摘要 token，无需从中间状态额外采样。7B backbone 上同训练预算下比 GRPO、ToolPO、RLTR 分别在域内评测 +2.53 pp、BFCL +1.36 pp、τ²-Bench +9.15 pp。
Motivation: 工具调用输出天然分段异质，而 GRPO 对整条轨迹广播同质标量优势，摘要段的梯度噪声污染工具决策 token，导致 credit 错配与训练不稳。
Method: 先构建 Schema-Guided LLM Simulator (SGLS) 提供免真实 API 的可扩展探索与稳定训练环境；SLCA 在单组 rollout 内按结构段解耦优势估计，不需从中间状态追加 rollout；Hierarchical Rewards (HierR) 将执行优势分配给工具 token、偏好优势分配给摘要 token，消除 advantage contamination。
Result: 在 7B backbone、相同训练预算下，域内评测比标准 GRPO、ToolPO、RLTR 高 +2.53 pp，Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) 高 +1.36 pp，τ²-Bench 高 +9.15 pp，同时收敛更快、工具冗余与成本更低。
Conclusion: 按结构段锁定 credit assignment 并配合分层奖励，可在同一组 rollout 内消除跨段优势污染，从而在工具调用 RL 中以更低成本取得更高准确率。

papers.title: Where Hallucinations Live: A Cross-Architecture Circuit in VQ-Tokenized Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) that tokenize images through a vector-quantized (VQ) codebook routinely hallucinate objects on grounded yes/no benchmarks, yet existing decoding-time fixes treat this as generic miscalibration without an architectural account. Using activation patching across twenty-five models spanning eight LLM families, we identify an early-layer ($L_0$) attention routing circuit shared across VQ-tokenized VLMs and propose a three-gate diagnostic that distinguishes the models carrying it from those that do not. The diagnostic isolates ten positive models (five natural unified-VQ VLMs across three LLM families and five induced variants) and rejects the remaining fifteen. A single-variable architectural swap (LLaVA-1.6 CLIP+MLP $\rightarrow$ VQ+Linear) installs the circuit, while a matched-compute MLP control on identical data does not, isolating vector quantization as the source of the pathological signal; the routing pathway that carries it is one that the backbone already provides. Against tuned VCD and DoLA baselines, tuned DoLA wins on binary calibration, but \textbf{only $L_0$ ablation reduces object hallucination in open-ended generation} (CHAIR$_i$ reduces by $31\,\%$ relatively, whereas tuned DoLA and VCD leave it unchanged or worsen it). These results recast object hallucination in unified VQ VLMs as a property of architecture and pretraining, and yield a targeted intervention that mechanism-agnostic decoding cannot replicate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VQ 码本分词的统一 VLM 在 grounded yes/no 基准上系统性幻觉物体，跨 25 个模型的 activation patching 定位到一个共享的早期层 (L0) 注意力路由电路。三门诊断筛出 10 个携带该电路的正例模型；把 LLaVA-1.6 的 CLIP+MLP 换成 VQ+Linear 即可装上电路，而等算力 MLP 对照不能，说明病态信号源是 vector quantization。仅对 L0 做 ablation 能降低开放式生成的物体幻觉，CHAIR_i 相对下降 31%，调优后的 DoLA 与 VCD 则不变或变差。
Motivation: VQ 分词的统一 VLM 在 grounded yes/no 基准上例行出现物体幻觉，而现有解码期修复把它当作通用失准，缺少架构层面的解释，因而无法定位病态信号的来源。
Method: 在横跨 8 个 LLM 家族的 25 个模型上做 activation patching，定位跨 VQ-tokenized VLM 共享的早期层 L0 注意力路由电路，并提出三门诊断区分携带与不携带该电路的模型；再用单变量架构替换（LLaVA-1.6 CLIP+MLP → VQ+Linear）与同数据等算力 MLP 对照做因果隔离，最后与调优的 VCD、DoLA 基线对比 L0 ablation。
Result: 三门诊断从 25 个模型中筛出 10 个正例（3 个 LLM 家族的 5 个自然 unified-VQ VLM 加 5 个 induced 变体），拒绝其余 15 个；VQ+Linear 替换装上电路而等算力 MLP 对照不能。开放式生成中仅 L0 ablation 降低物体幻觉，CHAIR_i 相对下降 31%，调优 DoLA 与 VCD 不变或恶化；调优 DoLA 在二元校准上最好。
Conclusion: 统一 VQ VLM 的物体幻觉是架构与预训练的属性，病态信号来自 vector quantization、由 backbone 已有的路由通路承载，因此针对 L0 的定向干预是机制无关解码方法复制不了的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Tokens Remember: When Tokenization Bypasses Knowledge Editing and Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight LLMs give downstream users control over the inference stack, but this flexibility can undermine post-release guarantees that sensitive knowledge has been modified or removed. Model editing and machine unlearning are used to modify or remove targeted knowledge without retraining models from scratch. However, existing security evaluations of these techniques face two critical limitations. First, they typically require access to either the original pre-edit/unlearning model or auxiliary classifiers to detect modifications or reconstruct pre-edit behavior. Second, they evaluate modifications under the canonical tokenization of an input, implicitly treating tokenization as a benign preprocessing step. We show that this assumption creates a security gap: the same input string can be represented by alternative valid tokenizations that induce different computational trajectories, allowing an adversary to bypass localized modifications and recover information intended to be suppressed. We introduce Toketive, a simple yet powerful reference-free attack that exploits the tokenization-based side channel to (i) detect modified knowledge and (ii) reconstruct the corresponding pre-edit response. It operates solely on the released model and requires neither the pre-edit model, training data, shadow models, nor auxiliary classifiers. Across five LLMs, six datasets, and six editing and unlearning techniques, we find that 38.6% of alternative tokenizations bypass the modification and recover the pre-edit response. Toketive detects modified facts with an F1 score of 84.2%, a 26.2% relative gain over the strongest baseline, and reconstructs pre-edit responses with 74.5% top-5 accuracy, 21.7% higher than the best baseline. Our results show that localized modifications should not be treated as robust knowledge-control boundaries without adversarial evaluation over alternative representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Toketive：利用同一输入字符串的替代 tokenization 会走不同计算轨迹这一侧信道，仅凭发布后的模型即可检测被编辑/遗忘的知识并重建编辑前回答，无需原模型、训练数据、影子模型或辅助分类器。在 5 个 LLM、6 个数据集、6 种编辑与遗忘技术上，38.6% 的替代 tokenization 绕过修改恢复出编辑前回答；检测 F1 84.2%（比最强基线相对高 26.2%），重建 top-5 准确率 74.5%（比最佳基线高 21.7%）。
Motivation: 开放权重 LLM 的编辑与机器遗忘被当作发布后的知识控制保证，但现有安全评估要么需要编辑前模型或辅助分类器，要么只在规范 tokenization 下评测，把 tokenization 当作良性预处理，从而留下安全缺口。
Method: Toketive 是一种 reference-free 攻击：对输入构造替代但合法的 tokenization，观察其诱导的不同计算轨迹，用以（i）检测被修改的知识、（ii）重建编辑前回答；仅依赖发布模型，在 5 个 LLM、6 个数据集、6 种编辑与遗忘技术上评测。
Result: 38.6% 的替代 tokenization 绕过修改并恢复编辑前回答；被修改事实检测 F1 84.2%，相对最强基线提升 26.2%；编辑前回答重建 top-5 准确率 74.5%，比最佳基线高 21.7%。
Conclusion: tokenization 是可被利用的知识控制旁路：局部编辑与遗忘在替代表示下不构成稳健的知识控制边界，必须先做跨替代表示的对抗评测再当作保证。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration of 3GPP Channel Estimators
papers.abstract_en: Pilot-aided channel estimation is a decisive block in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) receivers for both 5G New Radio (5G-NR) and Long-Term Evolution (LTE). A large body of estimators exists, from simple least-squares (LS) interpolation to statistically optimal linear minimum-mean-square-error (LMMSE) variants and, more recently, deep convolutional denoisers, yet no single estimator is uniformly best: the winner depends on the propagation scenario, the numerology, the operating signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the mobility (Doppler), and the antenna configuration. In this paper, we quantify this fact through a unified study of eight literature estimators evaluated over the 3GPP TR~38.901 Urban-Macro (UMa), Urban-Micro (UMi), and Rural-Macro (RMa) channels generated with NVIDIA Sionna, for both 5G-NR and LTE numerologies, in single-input single-output (SISO) and $8\times2$ multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) settings. We then propose a \emph{condition-adaptive multi-agent orchestrator} that treats each estimator as an independent agent and dispatches, per operating condition, to the agent that is best on a validation split without any genie knowledge. The orchestrator tracks the per-realization oracle to within $1.07$~dB and improves the normalized mean-square error (NMSE) over the best \emph{fixed} strategy by up to $3.6$~dB at high SNR, where the low-SNR champion is no longer optimal. Because the agents are independent, running them concurrently delivers this best-of-eight accuracy at essentially single-estimator latency: a data-parallel partition scales the wall-clock nearly as $1/K$ with $K$ workers (up to $6.9\times$), whereas naive by-algorithm partitioning is Amdahl-limited by the heaviest agent. The results substantiate multi-agent orchestration as a practical route to robust channel estimation across heterogeneous 5G-NR/LTE deployments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把八个文献信道估计器各当一个独立 agent，按传播场景、numerology、SNR、多普勒与天线配置逐次派发到验证集上最优者，无需 genie 信息。在 NVIDIA Sionna 生成的 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa/UMi/RMa 信道上，编排器 NMSE 贴近逐次 oracle 1.07 dB 以内，高 SNR 下比最优固定策略改善最多 3.6 dB；数据并行下墙钟时间随 worker 数近似 1/K 缩放，最高 6.9×。
Motivation: OFDM 接收机里没有单一估计器在所有条件下都最优：赢家随传播场景、numerology、SNR、多普勒与天线配置变化，固定选一个策略在高 SNR 会失效。
Method: 统一评测八个文献估计器（LS 插值到 LMMSE 变体与深度卷积去噪器），覆盖 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa/UMi/Rma 信道、5G-NR 与 LTE numerology、SISO 与 8×2 MIMO，信道由 NVIDIA Sionna 生成；再提出 condition-adaptive multi-agent orchestrator，把每个估计器当独立 agent，按操作条件派发给验证集上最优者，不使用 genie 知识。
Result: 编排器跟踪逐次 oracle 到 1.07 dB 以内；高 SNR 下 NMSE 相对最优固定策略改善最多 3.6 dB（此时低 SNR 冠军已非最优）；数据并行分区使墙钟时间随 K 个 worker 近似 1/K 缩放，最高 6.9×，而按算法分区受最重 agent 的 Amdahl 限制。
Conclusion: 多 agent 编排以接近单估计器的延迟拿到八者中最好的精度，是跨异构 5G-NR/LTE 部署做稳健信道估计的实用路线。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
papers.abstract_en: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE GCCE 2026. 5 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 RoboCup@Home 的通用服务机器人 (GPSR) 任务规划，提出两阶段 LLM chaining：把指令分类与动作生成拆开，使单次推理 prompt 长度缩短约 45%。在 100 条随机生成的 GPSR 指令、三个本地与云端模型上，规划一致性一致优于 Single Prompt，本地模型最高提升 37 个百分点；Toyota HSR 实机 10 个任务完成 6 个，执行层失败成为主要瓶颈。
Motivation: Single Prompt 方式在多步家庭任务规划中出现上下文膨胀与 Lost in the Middle 现象，导致规划不可靠，且规划成功不等于任务真正完成。
Method: 两阶段 LLM chaining 架构：第一阶段做指令分类，第二阶段做动作生成，缩短每次推理的 prompt；在 100 条随机生成的 GPSR 指令上评测，覆盖本地开源与前沿云端三类语言模型，并在 Toyota HSR 上做实机执行实验。
Result: 单次推理 prompt 长度缩短约 45%；相对 Single Prompt 在全部三个模型上规划一致性均提升，本地模型最高 +37 个百分点；HSR 实机 10 个任务完成 6 个，执行层失败是主要剩余瓶颈。
Conclusion: 两阶段 chaining 能稳定改善 LLM 任务规划一致性，但规划成功不保证任务完成，下一步瓶颈在执行层而非规划层。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Personalised federated learning for Riemannian and Euclidean EEG decoding
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) lets EEG decoders learn from recordings of several subjects without pooling them. We consider two light EEG decoders, the Riemannian SPDNet and the Euclidean EEGNet. Both split into a trunk, which builds a latent representation, and a head, which classifies it. Inter-subject variability, however, makes a single shared FL model a poor fit for each subject. Personalised FL addresses this: all subjects learn a common trunk, and each subject keeps its own head. We adapt it for SPDNet and study its effects against standard FL and centralised training, with EEGNet as a Euclidean baseline. Experiments cover three motor-imagery datasets that span diverse regimes in channels, subjects and classes. We observe that personalised SPDNet reaches higher accuracy than both standard FL and centralised training, while converging in fewer rounds and communicating fewer parameters than standard FL. It also outperforms every EEGNet configuration on two of the three datasets, although centralised EEGNet outperforms centralised SPDNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 EEG 联邦学习中把 SPDNet 拆成共享 trunk 与各被试私有 head，个性化联邦训练的 Riemannian 解码器在三个运动想象数据集中的两个上同时高于标准联邦与集中式训练，并且比标准联邦更少通信轮次、更少通信参数。
Motivation: 被试间差异使单一共享的联邦 EEG 解码模型对每个被试都不适配，集中式训练又要求汇集各被试数据。
Method: 将轻量 Riemannian 解码器 SPDNet 与 Euclidean 解码器 EEGNet 各自拆为 trunk（潜表征）与 head（分类）；个性化联邦学习中所有被试共享 trunk、各自保留 head，并与标准联邦和集中式训练对比，EEGNet 作为 Euclidean 基线，覆盖通道数、被试数与类别数不同的三个运动想象数据集。
Result: 个性化 SPDNet 准确率高于标准联邦与集中式训练，且收敛轮次更少、通信参数量少于标准联邦；在三个数据集中的两个上超过所有 EEGNet 配置，但集中式 EEGNet 仍优于集中式 SPDNet。
Conclusion: 共享 trunk 加私有 head 的个性化联邦方案能缓解被试间差异，使 Riemannian 解码器在不汇集数据的前提下胜过标准联邦与集中式训练，但 Euclidean 的 EEGNet 在集中式设定下仍占优。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Paging the Experts: A Reproducible Characterization of Flash-Backed MoE Inference on iPhone
papers.abstract_en: Sparse activation reduces mixture-of-experts computation without eliminating the need to store all experts. We present Routide, a Swift/MLX runtime that executes the text path of a pinned public Qwen3.6-35B-A3B quantized checkpoint while keeping expert weights in iPhone storage and a byte-budgeted subset in memory. We characterize cache-policy sensitivity, numerical comparison boundaries, and measurement limits. Across five recorded 128-token workloads, fixed-route replay gives 0.00% demand hits with a 512 MiB LRU cache, 18.80% with seeded random eviction at the same budget, and 38.58% with 576 MiB LRU. The apparent capacity cliff is therefore a policy/workload interaction, not a universal memory requirement. Same-runtime Mac controls preserve generated sequences across eviction and asynchronous prefetch, including 2,560 exact token comparisons and 10,334 speculative loads. In contrast, complete resident-Python versus recorded-phone sequences disagree on all five tested cases, precluding a general numerical equivalence claim. Two separately scoped iOS 27 memory protocols observe sampled process-footprint peaks of 1.87-2.32 GiB on short prompts and 2.39-2.73 GiB on one longer prompt. We retain a thermal stopping event, negative timing comparisons, and a single qualified whole-device power estimate. These results establish bounded feasibility and identify limitations that a deployment claim must not hide.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Routide 是一个 Swift/MLX 运行时，把 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 量化检查点的专家权重留在 iPhone 存储、内存只驻留字节预算内的子集，用缓存策略换命中率。五组 128-token 负载下，512 MiB LRU 固定路由重放命中率 0.00%，同预算随机逐出为 18.80%，576 MiB LRU 达 38.58%，说明所谓容量悬崖是策略与负载的交互而非普适内存需求。
Motivation: 稀疏激活省了专家计算但不省存储，端侧跑大 MoE 时专家权重必须在存储与内存间搬运；此前对缓存策略敏感性、数值可比边界与测量极限缺少可复现刻画。
Method: 在 iPhone 上用 Swift/MLX 运行时执行固定公开 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 量化检查点的文本路径，专家权重驻留存储、内存只保留字节预算子集；刻画缓存策略敏感性、数值比较边界与测量极限，并用同运行时 Mac 对照保序、另测两套 iOS 27 内存协议的进程占用峰值。
Result: 五组 128-token 负载：512 MiB LRU 固定路由重放 0.00% demand hit，同预算 seeded random eviction 18.80%，576 MiB LRU 38.58%。同运行时 Mac 对照在逐出与异步预取下保持生成序列一致，含 2,560 次精确 token 比较与 10,334 次 speculative loads；而完整驻留 Python 与录制手机序列在全部五例上均不一致。两套 iOS 27 内存协议采样到进程占用峰值：短提示 1.87–2.32 GiB，一条较长提示 2.39–2.73 GiB；另保留一次热停止事件、负的时间比较与一个带限定的整机功耗估计。
Conclusion: 端侧 flash-backed MoE 推理在给定缓存策略与负载下是有限可行的，容量悬崖由策略/负载交互决定；跨运行时数值等价不成立，部署声明必须带上这些测量边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploiting answer-invariant redundancies in satellite imagery for efficient VLM inference on edge
papers.abstract_en: Onboard vision-language models could enable satellites to answer queries directly, but exhaustive tiled inference over high-resolution imagery is slow and energy-intensive. We identify answer-invariant token redundancy (AITR): image tiles and vision tokens that can be removed without changing the final answer. We present Rift, a two-stage system that performs query-conditioned tile pruning followed by elastic prefill to reduce token budget. We evaluate it on LLaVA-1.5 7B running on Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with exhaustive tiled inference, Rift reduces energy by 78% and latency by 69%, while increasing accuracy from 45% to 73%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 卫星星上视觉语言模型对高分辨率影像做穷举分块推理既慢又耗电，作者识别出可删除而不改变最终答案的答案不变 token 冗余 (AITR)，并提出两阶段系统 Rift：先按查询裁剪图块，再做弹性 prefill 压缩 token 预算。在 Jetson AGX Orin 上跑 LLaVA-1.5 7B，相比穷举分块推理能耗降 78%、延迟降 69%，准确率反而从 45% 升到 73%。
Motivation: 星上 VLM 要直接回答查询，但对高分辨率卫星影像做穷举分块推理速度慢、能耗高，边缘设备难以承受。
Method: Rift 两阶段系统：查询条件化的图块裁剪 (query-conditioned tile pruning) 去掉无关图块，随后 elastic prefill 进一步削减 vision token 预算；评测对象为 Jetson AGX Orin 上的 LLaVA-1.5 7B，对照穷举分块推理。
Result: 相比穷举分块推理，Rift 能耗降低 78%，延迟降低 69%，同时准确率从 45% 提高到 73%。
Conclusion: 卫星影像问答中大量 vision token 对最终答案无贡献，按答案不变性裁剪 token 可以同时大幅省电提速并抬高准确率，而不是在精度与开销之间做取舍。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: RGBD20K: A Large-Scale Benchmark for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose RGBD20K, a novel dataset for facilitating the development of more robust and general RGB-D semantic segmentation by encompassing abundant categories and high-quality annotations. RGBD20K possesses several attractive properties: (1) Expanded Semantic Space. In particular, it covers 160 fine-grained categories, largely surpassing the category diversity of existing popular RGB-D benchmarks (e.g., NYUv2 with 40 classes and SUN RGB-D with 37 classes). With such enriched semantic coverage, we expect to promote the learning of more generalizable segmentation models. (2) Larger Scale. Compared with current benchmarks, RGBD20K offers 20,000 RGB-D image pairs, providing a substantially larger training resource that benefits the development of more powerful deep models. (3) High-Fidelity Annotation. We perform rigorous re-evaluation and correction of existing labels to resolve long-standing annotation noise, resulting in a clean and reliable ground-truth foundation. Furthermore, we propose a novel score-purified fusion (SPF) method, which achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach in leveraging high-quality multimodal information for RGB-D semantic segmentation. The dataset is here: https://github.com/ShaohuaDong2021/RGBD20K/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RGBD20K：20,000 对 RGB-D 图像、160 个细粒度类别的语义分割基准，并配套提出 score-purified fusion (SPF) 方法，在全部被评测基准上取得 state-of-the-art 表现。类别覆盖远超 NYUv2（40 类）与 SUN RGB-D（37 类），标注经重新评估与纠错以清除长期存在的标注噪声。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-D 语义分割基准类别覆盖窄（NYUv2 40 类、SUN RGB-D 37 类）、规模有限且带标注噪声，限制了分割模型的泛化能力与训练资源。
Method: 构建含 20,000 对 RGB-D 图像与 160 个细粒度类别的数据集，对既有标签做重新评估与纠错以获得干净的 ground truth；同时提出 score-purified fusion (SPF) 方法，利用高质量多模态信息做 RGB-D 语义分割。
Result: RGBD20K 覆盖 160 个细粒度类别，对比 NYUv2 的 40 类与 SUN RGB-D 的 37 类；提供 20,000 对 RGB-D 图像；SPF 方法在全部被评测基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 更广的语义覆盖、更大规模与更干净的标注是提升 RGB-D 语义分割泛化的有效路径，SPF 融合高质多模态信息可同步带来分割精度提升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Generative Atmospheric Super-Resolution from Heterogeneous In Situ Observations through Composable Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Atmospheric observations are sparse, heterogeneous, and unevenly distributed, whereas many generative atmospheric models learn distributions over regularly gridded multivariate states. Once pretrained, diffusion models can supply atmospheric priors that can be combined with observation-derived likelihood factors in a Bayesian formulation. However, these observation sources differ substantially in geometry and sampling density, complicating the consistent use of their observations within a common inference framework. Here, we formulate this reconstruction problem as generative atmospheric super-resolution and introduce composable observation interfaces for conditioning a single pretrained 13-variable atmospheric diffusion model. The interfaces convert sparse radiosonde (R), clustered aircraft (A), and dense irregular surface-station (S) observations into source-specific likelihood factors that specify where observations constrain the gridded state, how residuals are counted under uneven sampling, and how strongly each source guides posterior sampling. We developed the aircraft and surface observation interfaces using 2019 observations and evaluated the selected interfaces throughout 2020 without further tuning. Compared with reconstructions conditioned only on radiosonde observations, the composed R+A+S interface reduces RMSE evaluated against ERA5 by $9.24\%$ across all 13 state variables over the CONUS domain. The aircraft and surface factors provide complementary improvements in upper-air and surface variables. The R+A+S combination also lowers the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS), while evaluations at held-out aircraft and surface-station observations show reduced prediction errors. Together, these results demonstrate a modular route for conditioning a pretrained atmospheric generative prior on heterogeneous in situ observations without retraining the underlying model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把稀疏异质的原位观测重组为可组合的观测接口 (composable observation interfaces)，在不重训的前提下条件化一个预训练的 13 变量大气扩散模型，将重建问题表述为生成式大气超分辨率。用 2019 年资料开发飞机与地面接口、2020 年全年无再调参检验，R+A+S 组合相对仅用探空的重建在 CONUS 上对 ERA5 的 RMSE 全变量平均降低 9.24%，CRPS 同步下降。
Motivation: 大气原位观测稀疏、几何与采样密度各异，而生成式大气模型学的是规则网格多变量状态分布，异质观测难以在同一推断框架里一致使用。
Method: 预训练 13 变量大气扩散模型作为先验，与观测导出的似然因子做贝叶斯组合；三类接口把探空 (R)、聚簇飞机 (A)、密集不规则地面站 (S) 转成各自似然因子，规定观测在何处约束网格态、不均匀采样下残差如何计权、各源对后验采样的引导强度。飞机与地面接口用 2019 年观测开发，选定后在 2020 年全年评估且不再调参。
Result: 相对仅以探空为条件的重建，R+A+S 组合在 CONUS 上对 ERA5 的 RMSE 在全部 13 个状态变量上平均降低 9.24%；飞机与地面因子分别在上层大气变量与地面变量上带来互补改进；R+A+S 同时降低 CRPS，在留出的飞机与地面站观测上预测误差也减小。
Conclusion: 模块化的观测接口可以在不重训练底层生成先验的情况下接入异质原位观测，且各观测源的贡献在上层与地面变量上互补。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: Growth-Inspired Graph Generation and Inverse Design of Mechanical Lattices via Dot Matrices Database Augmentation and GCNN
papers.abstract_en: Natural load-bearing and transport networks are not assembled in a single step; they emerge through a temporally ordered process of growth, branching, reinforcement, and loop formation. Inspired by this developmental logic, this work introduces a morphogenetic graph-generation framework for mechanical lattices in which a discrete dot matrix provides potential nodes and the final architecture is created by sequential cross-layer and intra-layer growth. The same rule is visualized in two dimensions as a leaf-vein-like developmental sequence and implemented in three dimensions on a 3x3x3 nodal matrix containing 27 candidate nodes. A dataset of distinct three-dimensional lattices was evaluated by beam-based finite element analysis and represented directly as graphs. A graph convolutional neural network (GCNN) with three graph-convolution layers and dual global pooling learns the topology-property mapping and predicts effective compressive stiffness. Coupling the GCNN surrogate with rapid structural sampling enables inverse design: for a target stiffness of 1000 MPa, the selected design was predicted at 1042.43 MPa and validated by finite element analysis at 1027.49 MPa. Beyond straight members, the framework has also been extended to parameterized horseshoe-shaped curved beams made of nonlinear materials, enabling topology-geometry design toward prescribed deformation shapes. Our work provides a paradigm for augmenting the database of mechanical metamaterials, and the resulting perspective links biological morphogenesis, graph learning, and nonlinear shape programming in a unified generative design framework for architected materials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出受形态发生启发的图生成框架：在 3x3x3 离散点阵上按跨层与层内顺序生长生成机械点阵拓扑，用 beam-based 有限元建库，再以三层 GCNN 代理做逆设计。目标刚度 1000 MPa 时选中设计预测 1042.43 MPa、有限元验证 1027.49 MPa，并扩展到非线性材料的马蹄形曲梁以逼近指定变形形状。
Motivation: 自然承载与传输网络是逐步生长、分枝、加固、成环形成的，而机械超材料点阵数据库的构建缺少能按此逻辑批量生成多样拓扑并支持逆设计的手段。
Method: 离散点阵提供候选节点，最终结构由跨层与层内顺序生长得到，同一规则二维可视化为叶脉状序列、三维实现在 3x3x3 共 27 个候选节点上；生成的三维点阵用 beam-based 有限元分析评估并直接表示为图，训练含三个 graph-convolution 层与双全局池化的 GCNN 学习拓扑-性能映射、预测有效压缩刚度，再将 GCNN 代理与快速结构采样耦合做逆设计。
Result: 针对目标刚度 1000 MPa，选中设计的 GCNN 预测值为 1042.43 MPa，有限元验证值为 1027.49 MPa；框架进一步扩展到由非线性材料制成的参数化马蹄形曲梁，实现面向指定变形形状的拓扑-几何设计。
Conclusion: 顺序生长规则加 GCNN 代理可以扩充机械超材料数据库并把逆设计推向指定刚度与指定变形形状，把生物形态发生、图学习与非线性形状编程统一进一个生成式设计框架。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 离散点阵提供候选节点，最终结构由跨层与层内顺序生长得到，同一规则二维可视化为叶脉状序列、三维实现在 3x3x3 共 27 个候选节点上；生成的三维点阵用 beam-based 有限元分析评估并直接表示为图，训练含三个 graph-convolution 层与双全局池化的 GCNN 学习拓扑-性能映射、预测有效压缩刚度，再将 GCNN 代理与快速结构采样耦合做逆设计。
summary_sections.result: 针对目标刚度 1000 MPa，选中设计的 GCNN 预测值为 1042.43 MPa，有限元验证值为 1027.49 MPa；框架进一步扩展到由非线性材料制成的参数化马蹄形曲梁，实现面向指定变形形状的拓扑-几何设计。
summary_sections.conclusion: 顺序生长规则加 GCNN 代理可以扩充机械超材料数据库并把逆设计推向指定刚度与指定变形形状，把生物形态发生、图学习与非线性形状编程统一进一个生成式设计框架。

papers.title: EvoTreeNAD: Genealogy-Guided Evolution for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Discovery
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven scientific discovery accelerates research by autonomously developing solutions and designs. Large language model (LLM) agents support this process through iterative generation and evaluation. Yet these iterations alone do not ensure cumulative progress or establish which directions to pursue next. Costly evaluation further constrains the scope of exploration. Neural architecture discovery brings these challenges together, coupling open-ended design with resource-intensive experimentation. We introduce EvoTreeNAD, a genealogy-guided evolutionary algorithm that constructs trainable architectures without a supplied seed or a hand-specified search space. Starting from an empty root, it grows a persistent genealogy in which each new node represents a complete architecture. Top-percentile values computed from each node and its descendants guide lineage selection. Using the selected design history, an Idea Agent proposes a variant and a Code Agent implements it. Each evaluated variant becomes a child node, expanding the genealogy while providing evidence for subsequent lineage selection. Our theoretical analysis establishes the existence of stationary variation regimes as the genealogy grows. Under specified variation assumptions, sustained top-percentile family values quantify the probability of generating high-reward architectures in these regimes. EvoTreeNAD discovers architectures that outperform the compared NAS and NAD baselines, achieving CIFAR-10/100 test errors of $2.05{\pm}0.06\%$ and $15.09{\pm}0.22\%$. On all six MedMNIST-v2 tasks, the discovered architectures surpass the strongest listed baselines. A controlled CIFAR-10 study further shows that EvoTreeNAD outperforms direct generation, best-of-$N$ greedy continuation, and full-family-mean routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoTreeNAD 用谱系引导的进化算法从空根节点出发、不预设种子架构或搜索空间地构造可训练网络：每个节点是一个完整架构，节点及其后代的 top-percentile 值决定谱系选择，再由 Idea Agent 提出变体、Code Agent 实现。在 CIFAR-10/100 上取得 2.05±0.06% 与 15.09±0.22% 测试错误，超过所比较的 NAS/NAD 基线，并在全部六个 MedMNIST-v2 任务上超过最强列出基线。
Motivation: LLM agent 的迭代生成与评估本身不保证累积进展，也不指明下一步方向；神经架构发现同时面临开放式设计与昂贵评估，探索范围因此受限。
Method: 从空根节点增长持久 genealogy，每个新节点代表一个完整架构；用每个节点及其后代的 top-percentile 值做谱系选择，选中的设计历史交给 Idea Agent 提出变体、Code Agent 实现，每个被评估的变体成为新子节点。理论分析给出谱系增长下平稳变异机制 (stationary variation regimes) 的存在性，并在给定变异假设下用持续的 top-percentile family 值量化生成高奖励架构的概率。
Result: CIFAR-10 测试错误 2.05±0.06%，CIFAR-100 为 15.09±0.22%，均优于所比较的 NAS 与 NAD 基线；六个 MedMNIST-v2 任务全部超过最强列出基线；受控 CIFAR-10 研究中优于直接生成、best-of-N 贪心续写与全家族均值路由三种策略。
Conclusion: 以谱系证据（而非单轮迭代）驱动 LLM 的架构变体选择，可以在无种子、无手工搜索空间的条件下持续产出高奖励架构，并在图像分类基准上超过既有 NAS/NAD 方法。

papers.title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin. We introduce MeshHeal, a fully decentralized self-healing framework that couples ability-matched peer review across two timescales. At the fast timescale, an adaptive hierarchy escalates uncertain or low-scoring outputs from repeated single-reviewer evaluation to committee deliberation and, when needed, correction before use. At the slow timescale, a task- and ability-conditioned peer-relative detector aggregates scores to distinguish persistent degradation from ordinary output variation, trigger mandatory committee review, and eventually exclude degraded agents from ordinary routing; recovery probes provide fresh evidence for reintegration. To faithfully evaluate routing, we introduce Model-Backed MAS Evaluation, which ties ability assignments to execution models, since prompt-based ability assignments alone can leave routing errors hidden. Across BBH, MATH, and MMLU-Pro, MeshHeal achieves 0.839 degraded-phase accuracy using 51k total model tokens per task, versus the strongest baseline Symphony's 0.807 accuracy using 115k per task. Under staggered degradation and recovery, MeshHeal isolates degraded agents, keeps them excluded from ordinary task execution until recovery, and returns them to normal routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshHeal 针对去中心化 LLM 多智能体系统中的 gray failure（智能体仍响应但任务质量持续下降），用双时间尺度自愈：快时间尺度上把低分或不确定输出从单评审升级到委员会审议乃至纠正，慢时间尺度上用任务与能力条件化的 peer-relative 检测器区分持续退化与正常波动并触发强制复审、最终将退化智能体移出常规路由，恢复探针提供证据使其重新加入。在 BBH、MATH、MMLU-Pro 上，退化阶段以每任务 51k 模型 token 达到 0.839 准确率，而最强基线 Symphony 用 115k token 仅 0.807。
Motivation: 去中心化 LLM 多智能体系统中，智能体可在任务求解质量持续退化时仍保持响应（gray failure）；需要在证据充分到足以改变未来路由之前先保护当前任务，同时让恢复的智能体重新加入。
Method: 提出全去中心化自愈框架 MeshHeal，耦合 ability-matched peer review 的双时间尺度机制：快尺度为自适应层级（单评审 → 委员会审议 → 必要时纠正），慢尺度为任务与能力条件化的 peer-relative 检测器聚合评分并配合恢复探针；同时提出 Model-Backed MAS Evaluation，把能力分配绑定到执行模型以暴露仅用 prompt 分配能力时被掩盖的路由错误。
Result: 在 BBH、MATH、MMLU-Pro 上，MeshHeal 退化阶段准确率 0.839，每任务总模型 token 51k；最强基线 Symphony 准确率 0.807，每任务 115k token。在交错退化与恢复场景下，MeshHeal 隔离退化智能体、在恢复前将其排除于常规任务执行，并在恢复后重新纳入常规路由。
Conclusion: 双时间尺度的自愈路由能在更低 token 成本下维持更高的退化阶段准确率，并在交错退化/恢复过程中正确隔离与重新纳入智能体；Model-Backed 评测使路由错误不再被掩盖。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: AlphaDiverse: Post-Training Local Quantitative Research Agents for Diverse Exploration in Alpha Factor Mining
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems can automate alpha factor mining, but their reliance on external APIs limits control over cost, availability, and confidentiality. Long research loops also tend to revisit a few successful economic mechanisms that lead to research path collapse. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaDiverse, a framework that integrates a multi-agent alpha research system, diverse research path collection, and post-training for local agents. We let the research system generate complementary plan portfolios and vary research environments across loops to collect diverse research paths. Using these diverse traces, we warm-start local Planner and Realizer agents with supervised fine-tuning. Then, we propose a joint GRPO method to optimize both of them using predictive quality and diversity of contributions. Research feedback is confined to inner period data, while a frozen final model is evaluated on a later outer period data, thereby avoiding test-set tuning. Experiments across four Chinese stock universes show that AlphaDiverse can combine competitive prediction with broader exploration.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 7 figures, 26 Tables. Preprint under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlphaDiverse 把依赖外部 API 的 LLM 多智能体 alpha 因子挖掘改成本地部署：研究系统生成互补计划组合并跨循环变换研究环境以收集多样研究路径，用这些轨迹 SFT 热启本地 Planner 与 Realizer，再用联合 GRPO 同时优化预测质量与贡献多样性。在四个中国股票池上，该框架在保持竞争力预测的同时扩大了探索面，且研究反馈只用内期数据、冻结的最终模型在更晚的外期数据上评测以避免测试集调参。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体做 alpha 因子挖掘依赖外部 API，成本、可用性与机密性不可控；长研究循环反复回到少数成功经济机制，导致研究路径坍缩 (research path collapse)。
Method: 三部分：多智能体 alpha 研究系统生成互补计划组合并跨循环变换研究环境，收集多样研究路径；用这些多样轨迹对本地 Planner 与 Realizer 做监督微调 (SFT) 热启；再提出联合 GRPO，同时以预测质量与贡献多样性优化两个 agent。研究反馈限定在内期数据，最终模型冻结后在更晚的外期数据上评测。
Result: 在四个中国股票池 (Chinese stock universes) 上的实验显示 AlphaDiverse 兼具竞争力的预测与更广的探索；论文为 33 页、7 图、26 表的预印本。
Conclusion: 本地化多智能体加多样性驱动的后训练可以在不依赖外部 API 的前提下同时保住 alpha 预测竞争力与研究路径多样性，内/外期分离的评测协议用于避免测试集调参。

papers.title: When Does Action Credit Need Updating?
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents are continually updated with new interaction data. After each policy update, however, previously estimated action credits may become stale. Recomputing them from scratch can require many additional tool calls and environment interactions, making repeated updates increasingly expensive. We ask a simple question: when does historical action credit actually need to be updated? Our key observation is that a change in action value does not necessarily imply a change in the decision. Historical credit can still be useful as long as policy-induced drift is too small to overturn the existing action ranking. Building on this idea, we introduce pairwise branch sensitivity to capture how strongly a policy update affects the downstream regions that distinguish two candidate actions. We then derive a first-order anchored credit-transport estimator that updates historical credit using old interventional trajectories, and propose a Decision-Sufficient Credit Gate (DSC-Gate) that chooses whether to reuse, transport, or resample credit. Experiments show that branch sensitivity explains credit drift substantially better than global policy distance. With sufficient historical data, credit transport reduces estimation error, while its benefit to decision making is concentrated on updates that affect action-distinguishing branches. On a fully independent test set, DSC-Gate changes mean regret by only +0.00004 relative to a gap-based gate while reducing mean new tool steps from 472 to 286, a 39.4% reduction. We observe the same pattern after a real tool-agent parameter update. Overall, our results show that agents do not need to recompute action credit after every policy update: much of the historical evidence can be reused or cheaply corrected, reducing the additional interaction required to keep action decisions up to date.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 工具智能体每次策略更新后都重算 action credit 代价过高，本文提出 DSC-Gate 判定历史 credit 何时可复用、何时用一阶 anchored credit-transport 校正、何时必须重采样。判据是 pairwise branch sensitivity：只要策略漂移不足以翻转既有动作排序，历史 credit 就仍可用。在独立测试集上，DSC-Gate 相对 gap-based gate 的 mean regret 仅 +0.00004，而平均新工具步数从 472 降到 286（降 39.4%）。
Motivation: 工具智能体持续用新交互数据更新，旧的 action credit 随之过期；每次从头重算需要大量额外工具调用与环境交互，反复更新越来越贵。
Method: 提出 pairwise branch sensitivity 度量策略更新对区分两个候选动作的下游区域的影响；据此推导一阶 anchored credit-transport estimator，用旧的 interventional trajectories 更新历史 credit；再用 Decision-Sufficient Credit Gate (DSC-Gate) 在复用、transport、重采样三者间选择。
Result: branch sensitivity 对 credit drift 的解释力显著优于 global policy distance；历史数据充足时 credit transport 降低估计误差，其对决策的收益集中在影响 action-distinguishing branches 的更新上。独立测试集上 DSC-Gate 相对 gap-based gate 的 mean regret 仅 +0.00004，平均新工具步数由 472 降至 286，减少 39.4%；真实 tool-agent 参数更新后观察到同样模式。
Conclusion: 策略更新后不必每次重算 action credit：大部分历史证据可复用或廉价校正，只需在更新触及区分动作的分支时才付出重算代价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FluidRain: Incompressible Rain Flow as an Attention Bias for Loop-in-Loop Video Deraining
papers.abstract_en: Existing video deraining methods typically exploit neighboring frames through either explicit alignment or implicit spatiotemporal aggregation. Explicit alignment relies on accurate motion estimation, which can become unreliable under dense rain, while implicit aggregation avoids alignment but lacks explicit guidance on the directional and temporally coherent structure of rain. This leaves a gap between reliable temporal aggregation and explicit modeling of rain motion. To address these limitations, we propose FluidRain, a lightweight video derainer that uses divergence-free rain flow to guide Loop-in-Loop attention across scales and neighboring frames. Motivated by fluid mechanics, we model rain motion as a divergence-free image-space flow and use it to organize multi-scale and temporal aggregation. Specifically, FluidRain first estimates a rain-flow field for each frame and projects it onto the divergence-free subspace. The resulting flow steers window attention along rain streaks, enabling neighboring frames to be aggregated without explicit alignment. Since rain-flow structure is preserved across scales and nearby frames, Loop-in-Loop reuses the same attention operator across both dimensions, resulting in a three-frame model with only 0.80M parameters. Experiments on four benchmarks show that FluidRain remains competitive with substantially larger restoration models. We further examine how temporal evidence scales with different input views. To evaluate whether the model remains reliable when rain motion changes across frames, we introduce RainSyn-Gust, which injects controlled changes in rain-streak direction into existing benchmarks. We also develop a physics-based no-reference metric that evaluates real-rain removal without requiring clean targets.

Motivation: 显式对齐依赖精确运动估计，在密集降雨下失效；隐式时空聚合虽避开对齐，却缺少对雨的方向性与时间相干结构的显式约束，可靠的时间聚合与雨运动显式建模之间存在缺口。

papers.title: Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies deployed in real environments naturally accumulate mixed-quality experience, including successful executions, partial progress, and failures. Although these rollouts provide valuable information for further learning, directly incorporating them into imitation learning may reinforce undesirable behaviors, while offline reinforcement learning often suffers from unreliable value estimation under sparse rewards and limited data coverage. We consider a practical post-deployment setting where learning relies only on naturally accumulated autonomous rollouts, without additional human corrections or exploratory interaction. To effectively exploit such experience, we propose Predictive Action Chunk Learning (PACL). PACL first learns a predictive chunk-level critic that evaluates temporally extended action sequences and augments temporal difference learning with future latent prediction, providing richer supervision for long-horizon value estimation. The learned critic then converts chunk-level Q-values into discrete quality conditions, which guide a diffusion actor to learn jointly from these mixed-quality experiences without treating all behaviors as equivalent supervision. At inference, the actor generates multiple action chunks and the critic selects the highest valued candidate. Experiments across simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks show that PACL consistently improves the pretrained policy and outperforms strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Predictive Action Chunk Learning (PACL)，用块级预测 critic 给机器人部署后自然积累的混合质量 rollout 打分，再以离散质量条件引导 diffusion actor 分级学习，推理时从多个候选动作块中选 Q 值最高者。在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上，PACL 持续改进预训练策略，并优于强模仿学习与离线强化学习基线。
Motivation: 部署后自主 rollout 混杂成功、部分完成与失败：直接进模仿学习会强化坏行为，离线 RL 在稀疏奖励与有限数据覆盖下价值估计不可靠，且该场景没有人工纠正或额外探索交互。
Method: PACL 分两步：先学块级预测 critic，用未来 latent 预测增强 TD 学习以做长时程价值估计；再把块级 Q 值离散化为质量条件，条件化 diffusion actor 从混合质量经验中差异化学习，推理时生成多个动作块由 critic 择优。
Result: 在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上，PACL 一致改进预训练策略，并在对比中胜过强模仿学习与离线强化学习基线。
Conclusion: 只靠自然积累的自主 rollout、不加人工纠正与探索交互，也能通过块级价值监督与质量条件化把混合质量经验转成对策略的净提升。

papers.title: Automatic Rank Allocation for Low-Rank Adaptation in Large Language Models via lp Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a popular parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models. A key challenge in LoRA is how to determine the rank of each adaptation matrix, as rank directly controls its capacity and efficiency. Existing adaptive-rank methods typically allocate ranks according to manually designed importance scores, which are not directly derived from an optimization objective. In this work, we propose $\ell_p$-LoRA, a principled rank-allocation method based on $\ell_p$ regularization with $0<p<1$, which is a classical sparsity-inducing technique in signal processing and statistics. Specifically, we regularize the energy of each rank-one LoRA component, encouraging redundant components to vanish while preserving important ones. We derive the corresponding proximal subproblem and reduce the matrix optimization to a two-dimensional problem, leading to an implicit thresholding criterion for identifying redundant components. Experiments on natural language understanding and question-answering tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive performance with existing LoRA baselines.
papers.comment: 4 pages of main text and 1 page of reference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ℓp-LoRA：用 0<p<1 的 ℓp 正则约束每个 rank-one LoRA 分量的能量，让冗余分量自动趋于零、重要分量保留，从而由优化目标本身决定各适应矩阵的秩。推导出近端子问题并把矩阵优化降为二维问题，得到判定冗余分量的隐式阈值准则；在自然语言理解与问答任务上性能与现有 LoRA 基线相当。
Motivation: LoRA 的秩直接决定容量与效率，但现有自适应秩方法按人工设计的重要性分数分配秩，该分数并非从优化目标导出，缺少原则性依据。
Method: 对每个 rank-one LoRA 分量的能量施加 ℓp 正则（0<p<1，稀疏诱导技术），推导对应近端子问题 (proximal subproblem)，将矩阵优化化为二维问题，并给出识别冗余分量的隐式阈值准则。
Result: 在自然语言理解 (NLU) 与问答 (QA) 任务上，ℓp-LoRA 取得与现有 LoRA 基线相当 (competitive) 的性能。
Conclusion: 把秩分配写成 ℓp 稀疏优化问题，可让冗余 rank-one 分量在优化过程中自动消失，用一个由目标导出的阈值准则替代人工重要性分数。

papers.title: Only What Was Seen: Observation-Gram Compaction of View-Dependent Appearance in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Most of the memory of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model holds spherical-harmonic colour coefficients, yet each Gaussian is seen only from the narrow cone of directions of the training cameras. We turn this into a distortion metric that other compressors can adopt: a per-Gaussian observation Gram matrix, accumulated from viewing directions and blending weights, is the exact first-order map from coefficient changes to squared image error and needs only the model and the camera poses. Under it, degree reduction becomes a closed-form projection that generalises truncation, degree allocation a Lagrangian rate-distortion problem, and vector quantisation the matrix-weighted Lloyd algorithm, of which Compressed3D's quantiser is the scalar case. Swapped into Compressed3D with everything else unchanged, the metric raises PSNR by +0.49 dB before fine-tuning, with SSIM and LPIPS following, and at matched rate still gains +0.32 dB without a single training image. A training-free stack built on the metric alone is 15% smaller than the image-free GSICO at equal quality on Mip-NeRF 360.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D Gaussian Splatting 的显存大头是球谐颜色系数，但每个 Gaussian 只被训练相机的窄视锥看到；作者把这一事实做成逐 Gaussian 的观测 Gram 矩阵失真度量，它精确给出系数扰动到平方图像误差的一阶映射，且只需模型与相机位姿。在该度量下降阶成为闭式投影、码率分配成为 Lagrangian 率失真问题、向量量化成为矩阵加权 Lloyd；换进 Compressed3D 后 PSNR 在微调前提升 +0.49 dB，同码率下无任何训练图像仍 +0.32 dB，纯免训练堆叠在 Mip-NeRF 360 上比 GSICO 小 15%。
Motivation: 3DGS 压缩普遍用与视角无关的通用失真度量，忽略了每个 Gaussian 实际只被少数训练视角观测这一事实，导致降阶与量化分配偏离真实图像误差。
Method: 从训练相机视线方向与混合权重累积出逐 Gaussian 观测 Gram 矩阵，作为系数变化到平方图像误差的一阶精确映射；在此度量下把降阶写成推广截断的闭式投影，把度数分配写成 Lagrangian 率失真优化，把向量量化写成矩阵加权 Lloyd 算法（Compressed3D 的量化器是其标量特例），并整体替换进 Compressed3D 而其余不变。
Result: 换入该度量后，微调前 PSNR 提升 +0.49 dB，SSIM 与 LPIPS 同向改善；在匹配码率下、完全不用训练图像仍提升 +0.32 dB；仅基于该度量的免训练堆叠在 Mip-NeRF 360 上以同等质量比免图像的 GSICO 小 15%。
Conclusion: 用观测约束的 Gram 失真替代视角无关度量，可以在不引入训练数据的前提下同时改善 3DGS 压缩的保真度与体积，且该度量可被其他压缩器直接采用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beneath the Scores: Rethinking Hallucination Evaluation for Video Understanding Models
papers.abstract_en: Video understanding is increasingly performed by multi-stage LLM agents that separate temporal grounding, visual observation, and reasoning. Yet these stages are typically evaluated on different benchmarks and distributions, making it difficult to determine where hallucinations originate. We first organize existing benchmarks around these stages and show that their scores provide inconsistent diagnostic signals: stronger stage-level performance does not reliably imply lower downstream hallucination, and even benchmarks targeting the same capability can disagree. We therefore introduce a causal stage-intervention protocol that overwrites individual stages while holding the downstream task fixed. Across 60,008 runs on three video-agent architectures, we find that grounding is the dominant source of downstream error, with roughly four times the causal impact of corrupting visual observations. Successful grounding depends primarily on locating the correct region rather than precise temporal overlap, explaining why standard mIoU metrics poorly predict downstream reliability. We further find that incorrect evidence is substantially more harmful than missing evidence. Finally, auditing existing benchmarks against these interventions reveals that their scores do not reliably predict causal cascade sensitivity and can fail under distribution shift. These results motivate intervention-based, stage-aware evaluation for trustworthy video agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多阶段视频理解 LLM agent 的幻觉归因难题，提出因果阶段干预协议：固定下游任务，只覆写单个阶段，用 60,008 次运行在三种视频 agent 架构上测各阶段对下游错误的因果影响。发现 grounding 是下游错误的主导来源，因果影响约为破坏视觉观察的四倍；且错误证据比缺失证据危害大得多，因此 mIoU 这类标准指标难以预测下游可靠性。
Motivation: 多阶段视频 agent 的时序定位、视觉观察、推理分别在不同基准与分布上评测，分数无法定位幻觉来源，且同能力的基准之间也会互相矛盾。
Method: 先把现有基准按三个阶段归类，再提出因果阶段干预协议 (causal stage-intervention)：固定下游任务，单独覆写某一阶段，比较下游幻觉变化；在三种视频 agent 架构上共 60,008 次运行，并用这些干预审计既有基准在分布偏移下的表现。
Result: 60,008 次运行、三种视频 agent 架构上，grounding 的因果影响约为破坏视觉观察的四倍，是下游错误的主导来源；grounding 成败主要取决于定位到正确区域而非精确时间重叠，故 mIoU 对下游可靠性预测很差；错误证据比缺失证据危害显著更大；既有基准分数不能可靠预测因果级联敏感性，在分布偏移下会失效。
Conclusion: 阶段级高分不等于下游低幻觉，视频 agent 的可信评测应改为基于干预、按阶段归因的评测，而不是沿用各阶段独立的 mIoU 式打分。

summary_sections.result: 60,008 次运行、三种视频 agent 架构上，grounding 的因果影响约为破坏视觉观察的四倍，是下游错误的主导来源；grounding 成败主要取决于定位到正确区域而非精确时间重叠，故 mIoU 对下游可靠性预测很差；错误证据比缺失证据危害显著更大；既有基准分数不能可靠预测因果级联敏感性，在分布偏移下会失效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 阶段级高分不等于下游低幻觉，视频 agent 的可信评测应改为基于干预、按阶段归因的评测，而不是沿用各阶段独立的 mIoU 式打分。

papers.title: Personalized Korean Lipreading as Visual Speech Recognition: Transfer, Census and Adaptation on OLKAVS
papers.abstract_en: We present a personalized Korean visual speech recognition (VSR) system and quantify, on the nine-camera OLKAVS corpus, the gap between the population-level benchmark score and an individual user's error. A video-only Conformer initialized from English-trained weights attains 9.95 - 12.19% character error rate (CER) under the corpus protocol against the published 26.64, and 19.00 - 21.52 on unseen wording. Per speaker, CER spans 1.0 to 52.2%, with seen wording lowering CER by 7.0 - 9.0 points and professional delivery and spontaneous speech raising it by 8.5 - 10.5 and 12.7 points. A low-rank adapter with 4.6% of the parameters, trained on 4 to 29 minutes of the user's frontal video, lowers the CER of twelve high-error speakers by 2.13 to 3.58 points, transfers to every camera without loss, and keeps 85% of the full fine-tuning gain at 12% of its cost to other speakers. Cameras above the mouth plane add about six CER points as a constant offset that training on all views keeps small.
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 4 pages plus references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在九摄像头韩语唇读语料 OLKAVS 上，视频 Conformer 用英文权重初始化即把语料协议 CER 压到 9.95–12.19%（已发表基线 26.64），但个体说话人 CER 仍跨 1.0–52.2%。用仅占 4.6% 参数的低秩 adapter、以目标用户 4–29 分钟正面视频训练，可把 12 个高错误说话人 CER 再降 2.13–3.58 点，且跨全部摄像头不掉点。
Motivation: 语料级基准分数掩盖了个体用户的真实错误：同一模型在不同说话人上 CER 从 1.0 到 52.2%，且说话方式（专业朗读 vs 自发语音）与摄像头视角进一步拉大差距，群体基准无法代表单个使用者的可用性。
Method: 在 OLKAVS 九摄像头语料上训练视频-only Conformer，用英文训练权重初始化；按语料协议与 unseen wording 两种设定评测，并按说话人、说话方式、摄像头分解 CER。个性化阶段用低秩 adapter（4.6% 参数），仅以目标用户 4–29 分钟正面视频训练，对照全量微调。
Result: 视频 Conformer 在语料协议下 CER 9.95–12.19%（已发表 26.64），unseen wording 下 19.00–21.52；逐说话人 CER 跨 1.0–52.2%，seen wording 降 7.0–9.0 点，专业朗读与自发语音分别抬高 8.5–10.5 与 12.7 点。低秩 adapter 使 12 个高错误说话人 CER 降 2.13–3.58 点，跨摄像头迁移无损失，保留全量微调 85% 的增益而对其它说话人只花 12% 的代价。位于嘴部平面以上的摄像头带来约 6 个 CER 点的恒定偏移，用全视角训练可将其压小。
Conclusion: 群体基准分数与个体错误之间存在大缺口，而低秩 adapter 用极小参数量和几分钟正面视频即可弥合大部分差距且不损害其它说话人；摄像头高度造成的 CER 偏移应靠多视角训练而非逐视角补偿来处理。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CrossSafe: Towards Cross-Embodiment Latent Safety Filters
papers.abstract_en: Cross-embodiment learning has shown that a single model, such as a vision-language-action (VLA) model, can learn state representations and manipulation skills that can be applied across heterogeneous robots to accomplish various tasks. We hypothesize that the same holds for safety enforcement. The reasoning required to satisfy a safety constraint, such as detecting an obstacle, recognizing that it should be avoided, and selecting a safe abstract action, is largely shared across robots. What differs across embodiments is how the abstract safe action is realized: morphology, kinematics, and dynamics determine which actions are safe and feasible. Consequently, the same action can be safe for one robot and unsafe for another. This is especially important for generalist manipulation policies that operate in a common end-effector action space without explicitly capturing how safety depends on the robot's morphology and kinematics. We propose embodiment-conditioned safety filtering, in which a Hamilton-Jacobi reachability-based value function and its corresponding safety-maximizing policy are shared across robots. Using a morphology-aware latent representation of the robot and its environment, we perform Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis directly in latent space so that the learned safety concepts can generalize across embodiments while remaining explicitly conditioned on each robot's morphology and kinematics. We evaluate our approach across five bimanual robot embodiments and five manipulation tasks with whole-body collision-avoidance constraints. Our results show that a single policy, jointly trained across five manipulation tasks and four embodiments, exhibits zero-shot generalization to a held-out embodiment, reducing the nominal policy's collision rate. They also show that training using more embodiments improves generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrossSafe 提出跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 安全滤波：把 Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析的价值函数与安全策略在机器人间共享，在形态感知的 latent 表示上直接做 HJ 分析，使安全概念随形态与运动学条件化。联合在 5 项操作任务与 4 个具身上训练的单一策略对留出具身零样本泛化，降低名义策略的碰撞率，且训练所用具身越多泛化越好。
Motivation: 通用操作策略在统一末端执行器动作空间中运行，却不显式刻画安全如何依赖机器人形态与运动学，导致同一动作对一个机器人安全、对另一个不安全，跨具身部署时安全约束无法迁移。
Method: 采用 embodiment-conditioned safety filtering：HJ 可达性价值函数与对应的安全最大化策略跨机器人共享；用机器人及其环境的形态感知 latent 表示，在 latent 空间内直接做 Hamilton-Jacobi 可达性分析，使安全概念既跨具身泛化又显式以各机器人的形态、运动学为条件。
Result: 在 5 个双臂机器人具身与 5 项带全身避碰约束的操作任务上评估；单一策略在 5 项任务与 4 个具身上联合训练后，对留出 (held-out) 具身零样本泛化，降低名义策略的碰撞率；训练使用的具身数量越多，泛化越好。
Conclusion: 安全约束所需的推理在机器人间高度共享，可与具体动作实现分离：把 HJ 安全滤波放进形态条件化的 latent 空间，就能跨具身迁移并随训练具身增多而改善泛化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spectral Graph Neural Networks with Hermite Polynomials: A Comprehensive Study
papers.abstract_en: We study spectral graph neural networks built from Hermite polynomials and propose HermNet, a simple model that combines a nodewise predictor with normalized Hermite propagation. Its sparse recurrence requires neither eigendecomposition nor a learned basis. We distinguish the basic model from optional coordinate calibration, response normalization and Gaussian derivative regularization. Hermite and other complete polynomial bases span the same degree-bounded filter space, but their coordinates can produce different optimization behavior under limited training budgets. We analyze this behavior through spectral signal energy, label sampling, changes in learned features and the bias--variance trade-off of regularization. Controlled synthetic experiments identify a regime in which plain HermNet outperforms matched polynomial-basis alternatives, including with a jointly trained nonlinear predictor. Curvature regularization further improves HermNet when the same functional penalty is available to every comparator. Fixed-predictor controls support the advantage under short training budgets, but longer training removes the plain-model lead. Matched real-data comparisons show accuracy deficits, and architectural and numerical studies identify further limits. Together, the analysis and experiments clarify when Hermite propagation is useful and how calibration and regularization affect its performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HermNet：用归一化 Hermite 传播 (normalized Hermite propagation) 替代谱图神经网络中的特征分解与可学习基，稀疏递推只需逐点预测器。受控合成实验找到一个区间，其中 plain HermNet 胜过同阶多项式基对照（含联合训练的非线性预测器），曲率正则再进一步提升；但更长训练会抹平 plain 模型的领先，匹配的真实数据对比则显示精度劣势。
Motivation: 谱图神经网络通常依赖特征分解或可学习多项式基，训练预算受限时不同坐标系的优化行为差异缺乏系统分析。
Method: HermNet 由逐点预测器加归一化 Hermite 传播构成，稀疏递推无需特征分解或学习基；可选组件为坐标校准、响应归一化与高斯导数正则。分析维度包括谱信号能量、标签采样、学习特征变化与正则化的偏差-方差权衡，并做固定预测器对照。
Result: 受控合成实验中 plain HermNet 在特定区间优于匹配的多项式基替代方案（含联合训练的非线性预测器）；在相同函数惩罚下曲率正则进一步改善 HermNet；固定预测器对照支持短训练预算下的优势，但更长训练会消除 plain 模型领先；匹配真实数据对比显示精度不足，架构与数值研究指出更多限制。
Conclusion: Hermite 传播的用处是有条件的：短预算与特定正则设置下占优，长训练或真实数据上优势消失，校准与正则方式决定其表现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Same Bit Width, Different Outcomes: Post-Training Quantization of Text-to-Speech Across Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the cost of on-device text-to-speech (TTS), but published evaluations cover one system or method. We evaluate PTQ across TTS architectures under one protocol with three core models, weight and activation ablations of eight more, and two held-out models quantized blind. Four-bit per-channel weights reduce UTMOS, a predicted mean opinion score, by 2.8 on Supertonic and 0.07 on Kokoro, and per-tensor scaling can cause severe degradation even at 8 bits. The same bit width yields different outcomes, because the sensitive component is model-specific and not reliably predicted from the model class. A staged ablation procedure identifies it, and per-layer GPTQ can restore it to within 0.1 UTMOS. Real int8 and int4 kernels reproduce the simulated ordering at hardware-dependent cost. On a Mac mini, a 4-bit weight kernel runs Supertonic at 0.60x the fp32 latency while int8 is slower, so each configuration requires validation on the target runtime.
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 4 pages plus references. Code and run records: https://github.com/uxfacdev/tts-ptq-map
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一协议下对 13 个 TTS 模型做训练后量化 (PTQ) 评测，发现同一位宽后果因模型而异：4-bit per-channel 权重在 Supertonic 上使 UTMOS 掉 2.8，在 Kokoro 上只掉 0.07，per-tensor 缩放在 8 bit 也可能严重劣化。敏感组件是模型特有的、无法从模型类别预测；用分阶段消融定位它后，per-layer GPTQ 可把 UTMOS 恢复到 0.1 以内。
Motivation: 已发表的 TTS PTQ 评测只覆盖单一系统或单一方法，无法说明同一位宽在不同架构上为何产生截然不同的结果，也无法指导在目标运行时上选配置。
Method: 统一评测协议覆盖三个核心模型，对另外八个模型做权重与激活消融，再加两个盲量化的留出模型；用分阶段消融 (staged ablation) 定位敏感组件，用 per-layer GPTQ 恢复精度，并用真实 int8/int4 kernel 复现模拟排序。
Result: 4-bit per-channel 权重使 Supertonic 的 UTMOS 下降 2.8、Kokoro 仅下降 0.07；per-tensor scaling 在 8 bit 也会造成严重劣化；per-layer GPTQ 可将 UTMOS 恢复到 0.1 以内。Mac mini 上 4-bit 权重 kernel 跑 Supertonic 的延迟为 fp32 的 0.60x，而 int8 反而更慢。
Conclusion: 同一位宽在不同 TTS 架构上结果不同，敏感组件是模型特有的、不能由模型类别推断，因此每个配置都必须在目标运行时上单独验证。

papers.title: Cross-Country Code-Mixing for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-country recommendation on modern e-commerce platforms is typically deployed with disjoint user and item ID spaces across markets, removing the shared anchors that conventional cross-domain methods rely on. Generative recommendation (GR) mitigates this by mapping items into a shared token space and training a unified model, but existing approaches keep behavior sequences strictly country-specific, so knowledge transfer occurs only at the parameter level and remains absent at the data level. Inspired by code-switching corpora in multilingual natural language processing, we propose CMRec, a cross-country GR framework that injects cross-country supervision at the data level via dual-constrained, context-aware code-mixing. CMRec first learns a shared semantic codebook from multi-modal content and behavioral co-occurrence across countries. It then uses this codebook to synthesize mixed-country sequences via token-level substitutions that satisfy both static (content) and dynamic (e.g., price, audience, popularity) constraints. Finally, it introduces a context-aware loss that reweights mixed samples according to their plausibility in the current sequence. Experiments on two real-world multi-country datasets and an online A/B test show that CMRec substantially improves recommendation quality in data-sparse countries while preserving performance in data-rich countries, achieving +1.77% advertising revenue and +2.64% orders on a large-scale e-commerce platform.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Passive LWIR Hyperspectral Ranging via Transmittance Extraction and Distance Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral ranging enables distance estimation in low-light and nighttime scenes by exploiting atmospheric absorption features in thermal radiance received through the atmosphere.Joint estimation of temperature, emissivity, and distance is computationally expensive. Reference-range joint inversion also uses a distance-invariant effective attenuation coefficient, which can bias range estimates.We introduce transmittance extraction and distance alignment (TEDA), which decouples range estimation from temperature--emissivity inversion. In the first stage, a baseline estimator with a data-fidelity term invariant to the known absorption direction yields two closed-form smoothing branches for the slowly varying thermal continuum. An observation-derived gate combines the branches, and subtracting the blended baseline in the log domain recovers atmospheric transmittance. The second stage estimates range by matching the recovered transmittance to sensor-domain transmittance models recomputed for each candidate distance. Monte Carlo simulations show that TEDA effectively reduces the ranging bias caused by the distance-invariant attenuation coefficient approximation. In a measured scene, TEDA's mean range estimates are closer to the LiDAR medians than those of reference-range joint inversion in both evaluated patches. TEDA processes a complete $256\times256$ region of interest in 8.19~s versus 159.47~s for reference-range joint inversion, an approximately 20-fold speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEDA 把被动 LWIR 高光谱测距拆成两步：先用对已知吸收方向不变的数据保真项闭式解出热连续谱基线并在对数域相减恢复大气透过率，再按候选距离重算传感器域透过率模型做匹配定距，从而绕开距离不变有效衰减系数带来的测距偏差。Monte Carlo 仿真显示该偏差被有效压低，实测场景中两个 patch 的平均测距都比参考距离联合反演更接近 LiDAR 中位数，256×256 ROI 处理 8.19 s 对 159.47 s，约 20 倍加速。
Motivation: 被动 LWIR 高光谱定距需同时反演温度、发射率与距离，计算量大；参考距离联合反演用距离不变的有效衰减系数近似，会给距离估计带来偏差。
Method: TEDA 两阶段解耦：第一阶段用对已知吸收方向不变的数据保真项给出热连续谱的两条闭式平滑分支，以观测导出的门控融合，并在对数域减去融合基线恢复大气透过率；第二阶段把恢复的透过率与按每个候选距离重算的传感器域透过率模型匹配来估计距离。
Result: Monte Carlo 仿真表明 TEDA 有效降低距离不变衰减系数近似造成的测距偏差；在实测场景的两个被评估 patch 中，TEDA 的平均距离估计都比参考距离联合反演更接近 LiDAR 中位数；完整 256×256 ROI 处理耗时 8.19 s，对比参考距离联合反演的 159.47 s，约 20 倍加速。
Conclusion: 把定距与温度-发射率反演解耦、并按候选距离重算透过率模型，可在降低被动 LWIR 测距偏差的同时大幅压缩计算时间。

papers.title: Back to the Definition: Estimating Step-Level Advantages via Trajectory Graphs for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods, such as GRPO and its variants, have become a leading paradigm for training reasoning and agentic large language models (LLMs). While their group-normalized advantage estimation is reliable at the response level, it becomes systematically biased at the step level, since coarse-grained trajectory-level advantages are hard to accurately reflect the contribution of individual steps (i.e, failed trajectories may contain valuable steps). Revisiting the foundational RL definition, we notice that GRPO's success on single-turn tasks stems from its advantage estimation strategy, which adheres to the basic definition: the mean reward of multiple actions sampled from the same state constitutes a credible state-value estimate. Extending the faithful estimation to step-level would in principle demand sampling multiple actions from each intermediate state, which is too costly on a per-state basis. To mitigate this issue, we propose a Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment framework (GRAFT) that grafts all rollout trajectories into a trajectory graph, recovering node state-values via Bellman iteration on the graph, and assigning credit to each edge by the node value difference. Theoretically, the estimated step-level advantage faithfully adheres to the basic advantage definition in RL. To further ensure the reliability of step-level advantage estimation, we further propose Graph GAE, which extends GAE to the trajectory graph for reducing the impact of state-value estimation bias. Experiments across a range of multi-turn agentic benchmarks show consistent gains over GRPO and superior performance compared to recent agentic RL algorithms. Code will be available at https://github.com/xcyao00/GRAFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRAFT 把同一组 rollout 的所有轨迹嫁接成一张轨迹图，用图上 Bellman 迭代恢复节点状态值、以节点值差给每条边分配步级 credit，从而让步级优势估计回到 RL 的基本定义。再用 Graph GAE 扩展 GAE 到该图上以抑制状态值估计偏差，在多轮 agentic 基准上稳定超过 GRPO 及近期 agentic RL 算法。
Motivation: GRPO 的组归一化优势在响应级可靠，但把轨迹级粗粒度优势下放到步级时系统性有偏：失败轨迹里也可能含宝贵步骤，单个步骤的贡献被抹平。
Method: 提出 Graph-based Faithful sTep-level credit-assignment (GRAFT)：将全部 rollout 轨迹嫁接为轨迹图，在图上用 Bellman 迭代恢复节点状态值，按节点值差为每条边分配步级优势；再提出 Graph GAE，把 GAE 扩展到轨迹图上以降低状态值估计偏差的影响。
Result: 理论上映射的步级优势忠实符合 RL 中优势的基本定义；在一系列多轮 agentic 基准实验中相对 GRPO 取得一致增益，并优于近期 agentic RL 算法。
Conclusion: 步级 credit 应当从同一状态多次采样的基本定义出发、用轨迹图上的状态值差来估计，而不是直接沿用轨迹级组归一化优势。

papers.title: MoVISA: Multi-Token Reasoning for Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video object segmentation with Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) reasoning have demonstrated the effectiveness of using a single textual token, such as SEG, to predict segmentation masks across images and videos. However, we observe that this single-token strategy lacks the granularity required to precisely localize multiple objects across time in video segmentation tasks. To address this limitation, we develop Multi-Token Reasoning for Video Object Segmentation, or MoVISA. MoVISA uses multiple segmentation tokens, such as SEG0 and SEG1, to represent an object across different frames. This design enables more fine-grained alignment between language prompts and spatio-temporal mask predictions, improving both performance and interpretability. On the challenging MeViS, DAVIS17, ReVOS, and Ref-Youtube-VOS benchmarks, our model achieves a 13.2 percent J and F improvement on MeViS and an 8.4 percent J and F improvement on ReVOS. Code and models will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoVISA 把视频目标分割中单一 SEG 文本 token 换成多个分割 token（SEG0、SEG1），让同一目标在不同帧上有各自的表示，从而把语言提示与时空 mask 预测对齐得更细。在 MeViS 上 J&F 提升 13.2%，在 ReVOS 上提升 8.4%。
Motivation: MLLM 推理驱动的视频目标分割用单个 SEG token 预测跨帧 mask，粒度不足以在时间上精确定位多个目标。
Method: MoVISA 用多个分割 token（如 SEG0、SEG1）分别表示目标在不同帧上的状态，使语言提示与时空 mask 预测做更细粒度对齐；在 MeViS、DAVIS17、ReVOS、Ref-Youtube-VOS 上评测。
Result: 在 MeViS 上 J&F 提升 13.2%，在 ReVOS 上 J&F 提升 8.4%；评测基准为 MeViS、DAVIS17、ReVOS、Ref-Youtube-VOS。
Conclusion: 多 token 表示能提升视频目标分割的性能与可解释性，代码与模型将发布。
