summary_sections.motivation: 已有 DFT 加速方法只预测光滑价电子密度，缺少结构相关的增广占据数与自旋初始化，无法做到完全无参考的电子初始化，遗漏这些分量甚至会抵消或反转加速收益。
summary_sections.method: 先形式化 Complete Neural Electronic Initializer 满足实用端到端 PAW DFT 加速的七条判据，并据此审查既有工作；再引入 AugNet（通用等变模型，预测 PAW 增广占据数）与首个材料自旋密度模型（预测光滑自旋差密度与自旋差 PAW 增广占据数，以预测磁矩约束全局磁态），与既有价电子密度模型组合成完全无参考初始化器，无需任何来自收敛目标计算的电子量。
summary_sections.result: 完美初始化最多可削减 PAW DFT 墙钟时间 40-52%；本方法在未见结构上最多回收该节省的 62%，端到端 DFT 墙钟时间最多降低约 25%，同时保持收敛能量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 只有同时补齐增广占据数与自旋初始化，神经电子初始化才能对材料 DFT 提供完全无参考且真正净正的加速；遗漏这两项会让仅预测光滑价电子密度的方法加速失效甚至变负。

papers.title: How Many Humans Are 32 LLM Judges Worth?
papers.abstract_en: A panel's human-equivalent size is target-specific. Matching a fixed 32-judge panel to empirical human label distributions on three ChaosNLI tasks yields two distinct effective sizes: distributional-error matching gives $ν_{\mathrm{MSE}}=2.304$, $3.750$, and $3.445$, whereas spectral matching gives $ν_H=4.242$, $6.459$, and $6.499$, a gap of $1.72$--$1.89\times$; a binary-error diagnostic credits the same panels with only $1.971$--$2.227$ effective votes. Extrapolating the distributional-error curve at fixed squared mean residual, mean member variance, and normalized mean covariance gives asymptotes of $2.392$, $3.990$, and $3.655$, with 32 judges already reaching $94.0$--$96.3\%$. An exact spectral identity explains the gap: error depends on member energy and on the orientation of residual variation relative to averaging, information that the participation ratio (PR) discards. A realizable hard-label construction confirms that higher spectral diversity can coexist with worse distribution recovery even under equal member energies and nonnegative correlations, and the consensus direction retains $γ_{\mathrm{co}}=43.8\%$, $33.7\%$, and $35.9\%$ of centered residual variance. An external check on CC-1000, a 1,000-item Civil Comments subset with a different panel, gives $ν_H=2.84$. For panel choice, we establish an existence result and one feasible path: exhaustive enumeration at $k\in\{5,7\}$ shows that panels beating the accuracy-top-$k$ baseline on both accuracy and $ν_H$ always exist, and greedily swapping at most two members reaches $24.8$--$56.0\%$ higher $ν_H$ at $0.10$--$1.10$ percentage points higher accuracy. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Chao1208/32judges-votes.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 12 figures, and 13 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Chao1208/chaosnli-judge-votes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ChaosNLI 三个任务上，把 32 个 LLM 评审按不同准则匹配到人类标注分布，得到的有效人数差异巨大：分布误差匹配给出 ν_MSE=2.304/3.750/3.445，谱匹配给出 ν_H=4.242/6.459/6.499（相差 1.72–1.89 倍），二元误差诊断只承认 1.971–2.227 票。作者用精确谱恒等式解释该差距：误差取决于成员能量与残差相对平均方向的取向，而 participation ratio 丢掉了后者。
Motivation: 用 LLM 评审团替代人类标注时，需要回答“多少个模型评审等价于多少人”，但等价人数依赖于所用的匹配准则，此前缺少对这一依赖的定量刻画与解释。
Method: 在 ChaosNLI 三个任务上，将 32-judge 面板分别按分布误差（ν_MSE）、谱准则（ν_H）和二元误差诊断匹配到经验人类标签分布；固定平方均值残差、成员平均方差与归一化平均协方差外推分布误差曲线求渐近值；给出精确谱恒等式并构造可实现的硬标签反例；在 CC-1000（1,000 条 Civil Comments 子集、不同面板）上做外部检验；对 k∈{5,7} 穷举枚举并做贪心成员交换。
Result: 三个任务上 ν_MSE=2.304、3.750、3.445，ν_H=4.242、6.459、6.499，差距 1.72–1.89 倍；二元误差诊断给出 1.971–2.227 有效票。分布误差曲线外推的渐近值为 2.392、3.990、3.655，32 个评审已达 94.0–96.3%。共识方向保留中心化残差方差的 γ_co=43.8%、33.7%、35.9%。CC-1000 上 ν_H=2.84。k∈{5,7} 穷举显示总存在同时在准确率和 ν_H 上超过 accuracy-top-k 基线的面板；贪心至多交换两名成员可使 ν_H 提高 24.8–56.0%，同时准确率提高 0.10–1.10 个百分点。
Conclusion: “一个 LLM 评审等于几个人”没有唯一答案，取决于匹配目标；谱准则因保留残差相对平均方向的取向信息而系统性给出更高有效人数，且面板成员选择可在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著提升 ν_H。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Refinement Is Inherently Editable: Training-Free Prompt-to-Prompt Image Editing with Generative Refinement Network
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing must introduce the requested changes while preserving unrelated source content. In training-free editing, diffusion editors often use spatial controls whose inaccuracies can leave edits incomplete or alter unrelated regions. Causal autoregressive editors face a further constraint: their fixed decoding order limits revision of earlier decisions. As the first to explore training-free image editing with Generative Refinement Networks (GRN), we observe that its refinement process is inherently suitable for editing and offers a promising way to address these limitations. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RefineEdit, a training-free prompt-to-prompt image editing framework built on the GRN. Our key idea is to couple edit localization with content generation through the global refinement of binary image codes, allowing editing evidence to be revised as the image evolves. More specifically, RefineEdit combines bit routing with two stabilization mechanisms: adaptive spatial freezing and finite bit locking. Bit routing starts from an intermediate source state and uses signed probability differences between the two branches to identify editable positions and bits. It directs selected bits toward editing refinement while anchoring the rest to the evolving source trajectory. Adaptive spatial freezing limits unnecessary expansion of the editing region, while finite bit locking maintains recent bit activations to support continued editing. The overall framework requires no additional training, external masks, or attention control. Across nine editing categories of PIE-Bench, RefineEdit achieves the best background-preservation scores in PSNR, LPIPS, MSE, and SSIM, together with the highest whole-image and edited-region CLIP scores among the evaluated methods. Code is available at https://github.com/mura1n/RefineEdit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefineEdit 是首个基于 Generative Refinement Network (GRN) 的免训练 prompt-to-prompt 图像编辑框架，用二值图像码的全局 refinement 把编辑定位与内容生成耦合，使编辑证据可随图像演化被反复修正。在 PIE-Bench 九类编辑上取得最佳背景保持（PSNR、LPIPS、MSE、SSIM）与最高的整图及编辑区域 CLIP 分数，且无需额外训练、外部 mask 或注意力控制。
Motivation: 免训练扩散编辑器依赖空间控制，其不精确会导致编辑不完整或改动无关区域；因果自回归编辑器的固定解码顺序又限制了对早期决策的修订。
Method: 基于 GRN 构建 RefineEdit：bit routing 从中间源状态出发，用两分支的有符号概率差定位可编辑位置与比特，把选中比特导向编辑 refinement、其余锚定到演化中的源轨迹；辅以 adaptive spatial freezing 限制编辑区域外扩、finite bit locking 维持近期比特激活，全程无需训练、外部 mask 或注意力控制。
Result: 在 PIE-Bench 九类编辑任务上，背景保持指标 PSNR、LPIPS、MSE、SSIM 均为所评方法中最佳，整图与编辑区域 CLIP 分数也最高。
Conclusion: GRN 的 refinement 过程天然适配图像编辑，把编辑定位与内容生成耦合可在免训练设定下同时改善背景保持与编辑语义对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TP-DATE，把 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输 (GW-OT) 动态化：用 path action 统一静态与动态的 Quadratic-form OT (QOT) 并证明二者等价，再以 travelling-pair flow matching 让条件路径相互作用并把交互边缘化进单个向量场，实现无模拟的连续轨迹重建。在合成与真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE 更好地保持空间结构并改进连续 3D 动力学重建。
Motivation: 空间转录组的动态重建除匹配表达模式外还需保持组织结构，但现有 GW-OT 多为静态形式，缺少可重建连续轨迹的一般动态表述。
Method: 通过 path action 构造一大类静态与动态 Quadratic-form OT (QOT) 并证明静态-动态等价；提出 travelling-pair flow matching，使条件路径相互作用并将其交互边缘化为单一向量场，以 simulation-free 方式推广 GW-OT。
Result: 在合成与真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE 更好保持空间结构并改进连续 3D 动力学重建；摘要给出的是定性比较结论。
Conclusion: GW-DATE 类的动态推广可在无模拟条件下把结构感知传输用于连续轨迹重建，静态与动态 QOT 在 path action 框架下等价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REARL: A Closed-loop Autonomous Driving Simulation Enhancement Framework with Real Traffic Data and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurate simulation is crucial for autonomous driving development, yet capturing real-world traffic complexity remains challenging. Existing simulators that rely on predefined rules or static data playback struggle with dynamic traffic. CRITICAL uses real traffic data and a large language model (LLM) to adjust the initial simulation configuration, but the simulated distribution still diverges from real traffic as the rollout evolves. We propose REARL, a closed-loop simulation enhancement framework that integrates real traffic data with LLMs. Real traffic data are clustered, and each cluster center is used as a representative scenario that provides typical real-world traffic patterns for the LLM. A timed sliding-window detector then monitors discrepancies in vehicle speed distribution and mean spacing between pairs of vehicles. If a metric exceeds a threshold, the LLM adjusts vehicle decision-making; otherwise the existing controller is kept. The LLM also selects a matching real vehicle from a traffic snapshot and modulates the simulated vehicle with reference to that real action. In a controlled HighD highway setting, compared with the CRITICAL baseline and a PPO-based learning baseline, REARL reduces the Hellinger distance for speed distributions to 0.3067 and the MAPE for mean spacing to 0.8371, while achieving a time headway (THW) of 22.8575 and a lane change rate of 0.0708.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Corresponding author: Yiwen Sun. This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 62503015)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REARL 把真实交通数据与 LLM 接成闭环，用聚类中心提供典型场景、滑窗检测器监控车速分布与车间距偏差，超阈值时由 LLM 调整车辆决策并参考真实车辆动作。在 HighD 高速公路场景下，相对 CRITICAL 基线与 PPO 学习基线，车速分布 Hellinger 距离降到 0.3067，车间距 MAPE 降到 0.8371，THW 为 22.8575、换道率 0.0708。
Motivation: 现有仿真器依赖预设规则或静态数据回放，难以复现动态交通；CRITICAL 虽用真实数据与 LLM 调初始配置，但 rollout 展开后仿真分布仍偏离真实交通。
Method: 先对真实交通数据聚类，把每个聚类中心作为代表场景供 LLM 使用；计时滑动窗口检测器监控车速分布与成对车辆平均间距的偏差，任一指标超阈值即让 LLM 调整车辆决策，否则保留原控制器；LLM 还从交通快照中挑选匹配的真实车辆并以其动作为参考调制仿真车辆。
Result: 在受控的 HighD 高速公路设定中，相对 CRITICAL 基线与 PPO 学习基线，REARL 将车速分布的 Hellinger 距离降至 0.3067，平均间距的 MAPE 降至 0.8371，同时 time headway (THW) 为 22.8575，换道率 0.0708。
Conclusion: 闭环地用真实交通分布偏差触发 LLM 调控，可让自动驾驶仿真在 rollout 过程中持续贴近真实交通，而不只在初始配置阶段对齐。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Long-horizon autoformalization of a core theorem underlying MIP* = RE
papers.abstract_en: Landmark mathematical formalizations have taken specialist teams years to complete. We present FormalFlow, a system that coordinates AI proving agents under human supervision to address statement drift and proof composition in long-horizon formalization. Drawing on software engineering principles and practices, it uses a shared blueprint to guide nested planning, proving and review loops. Agents strengthen verification and review throughout formalization. We completed a machine-checked Lean 4 proof of the quantum soundness of the classical low individual-degree test, a core theorem underlying MIP* = RE. Developing the proof took 63 days; greater parallelism could further reduce this time. The final library contains 126,367 lines of Lean code, all generated by agents. The formalization corrects side conditions and intermediate errors while preserving the published final error bound under corrected assumptions. This work provides a verified foundation for quantum complexity and demonstrates a route to affordable verification of major research proofs by small teams.

papers.title: TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TacSushi 是基于 Cosmos3 的触觉接地世界-动作策略：训练时用动作块条件的解码器预测未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险与触觉摘要，失败试次只提供后果监督、不进模仿，部署时删掉解码器。在 340 成功/50 失败真实机器人试次训练、600 次 rollout 评测中，完整模型分布内成功率 68.3%、分布外 37.5%，去掉未来后果监督降到 36.7%/10.0%，直接触觉拼接替换门控融合为 25.0%/17.5%。
Motivation: 灵巧食物操作要在形变、遮挡与接触不确定下控制，而单纯模仿学不到失败后果，触觉与视觉/语言/手状态的融合方式也缺少设计依据。
Method: 骨干编码当前 RGB、语言与手状态，feature-wise gated fusion 把指尖触觉特征并入动作表示；训练时另设以示范动作块为条件的解码器，预测日志中的未来视觉观测、任务进度、相对接触风险与触觉摘要，失败试次提供后果监督但其动作被排除出模仿，部署时移除该解码器。
Result: 在 340 次成功与 50 次失败真实机器人试次上训练，600 次独立 rollout 覆盖三个分布内任务与两个分布外配料变体，比较六种方法：完整 TacSushi 分布内平均成功率 68.3%、分布外 37.5%；无未来后果监督为 36.7%/10.0%；以直接触觉拼接替代门控融合为 25.0%/17.5%。终端结果用锚定视觉质量协议打分，每次 rollout 等权合并五项人工评分与三项视觉-语言模型评分。
Conclusion: 特征级门控触觉融合与仅训练期的预测式后果监督各自带来互补的增益，二者同时保留时分布内外成功率最高。

papers.title: Seeing Abnormal from Normal: Glomerular Abnormality in Representations of Normal Renal Morphology
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained evaluation of glomerular pathology must distinguish normal glomeruli from abnormalities such as global and segmental glomerulosclerosis, obsolescent, ischemic, solidified, disappearing, and atubular glomeruli. Supervised classification requires labeled examples of every category, which is impractical when subtypes are rare or absent from the training cohort. One-class anomaly detection offers an alternative by modeling normal data and scoring deviations, allowing previously unseen abnormalities to be detected. We use the frozen residual U-Net backbone of Omni-Seg, pretrained to segment structurally normal renal primitives without abnormal-subtype labels. We propose NoRDeC (Normal-Reference Detection and Characterization), a framework combining Mahalanobis normal-reference scoring with layer-wise representation analysis to determine whether and where glomerular pathology is encoded, how spatial aggregation affects detection, and whether abnormalities alter inter-layer relationships differently. Using glomerular images from two institutions, we evaluate backbone layers and aggregation strategies, compare NoRDeC with PaDiM and PatchCore, and analyze representations using centered kernel alignment (CKA). Layer 4 with Center-70 aggregation achieved a pooled AUROC of $0.926\pm0.013$. NoRDeC achieved the highest AUROC in six of seven abnormality categories and in the pooled analysis, while CKA suggested subtype-dependent changes in inter-layer relationships not captured by anomaly scores alone. The normal-reference model is fitted using only normal glomeruli; abnormality labels are used for configuration selection, evaluation, and grouping in the representation analysis. These results show that a frozen renal feature extractor can support both detection and representation-level characterization of glomerular abnormalities without using abnormal examples to fit the detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NoRDeC（Normal-Reference Detection and Characterization）：用冻结的 Omni-Seg 残差 U-Net 骨干提取肾小球特征，仅以正常肾小球拟合 Mahalanobis 正常参考打分，配合逐层表示分析（CKA）定位病理编码位置。在两家机构的肾小球图像上，Layer 4 加 Center-70 聚合的合并 AUROC 达 0.926±0.013，NoRDeC 在七个异常类别中的六个及合并分析中取得最高 AUROC。
Motivation: 肾小球病理细粒度分类需要每个类别的标注样本，而 global/segmental 肾小球硬化、obsolescent、ischemic 等亚型在训练队列中稀有甚至缺失，监督分类不可行。
Method: 以 Omni-Seg 冻结的残差 U-Net 骨干（按正常肾小球结构预训练、无异常亚型标签）提取特征，用 Mahalanobis 正常参考打分做单类异常检测，并结合 layer-wise 表示分析与 centered kernel alignment (CKA) 判断病理编码在哪一层、空间聚合如何影响检测；与 PaDiM、PatchCore 对比，评估不同骨干层与聚合策略。
Result: Layer 4 配 Center-70 聚合的合并 AUROC 为 0.926±0.013；NoRDeC 在七个异常类别中的六个以及合并分析中 AUROC 最高；CKA 显示亚型依赖的层间关系变化，而异常分数本身捕捉不到。正常参考模型仅用正常肾小球拟合，异常标签只用于配置选择、评估与表示分析分组。
Conclusion: 冻结的肾脏特征提取器无需用异常样本拟合检测器，即可同时支持肾小球异常的检测与表示层面的刻画，且层间关系变化提供了异常分数之外的补充信息。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: TERN: A Delta-rule Memory with a Seasonal Reference and Online Adaptation for Epidemic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Weekly influenza surveillance counts guide vaccine distribution and public-health alerts, yet they are hard to forecast. Each region offers only a few seasons, waves shift in timing and height every year, and information that helps while a wave grows misleads after its peak, whereas last season's shape stays informative for a year. Existing epidemic graph models and general forecasters read a short fixed window and treat all past information alike, so they neither exploit earlier seasons nor discard stale associations when the epidemic phase changes. To address these limitations, we propose TERN, a forecaster built around a delta-rule fast-weight memory that decays channel-wise and erases along a learned address under gates driven by local epidemic-phase features, combined with an explicit seasonal reference and online adaptation. On three Cola-GNN influenza benchmarks, TERN outperformed epidemic graph models and general forecasters, matched or exceeded seasonal references, and a controlled comparison confirmed the contribution of the memory itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TERN 用 delta-rule fast-weight 记忆做流感周度发病预测：记忆按通道衰减、在由局部流行相位特征驱动的门控下沿学习地址擦除过期关联，并显式引入上一季作为 seasonal reference 与在线自适应。在三个 Cola-GNN 流感基准上，TERN 超越流行病图模型与通用预报器，并与季节参考持平或更好，受控对比确认记忆模块本身带来贡献。
Motivation: 每个地区只有少数几个流感季数据，波峰时间与高度逐年漂移；波峰前有用的信息在峰后会误导，而上一季的形态能持续一年有参考价值。现有流行病图模型与通用预报器只读固定短窗口、对历史信息一视同仁，既用不上更早的季节，也无法在流行相位改变时丢弃过期关联。
Method: TERN 的核心是 delta-rule fast-weight 记忆：按通道 (channel-wise) 衰减，并在由局部流行相位特征驱动的门控下沿学习到的地址擦除；再叠加显式的 seasonal reference（上一季形态）与在线自适应机制，用于周度流感监测计数预报。
Result: 在三个 Cola-GNN 流感基准上，TERN 在预报表现上超过流行病图模型与通用预报器，持平或超过 seasonal reference；受控对比 (controlled comparison) 确认提升来自记忆模块本身。
Conclusion: 让记忆按流行相位选择性遗忘、并显式挂上一季参考，比固定短窗口更能应对流感逐年漂移；记忆机制的贡献可被单独验证。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
papers.abstract_en: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed foundation model. Task holdout is commonly used to guard against harness overfitting. It varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a bad genius Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose improvement over the initial harness on $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution (CHASE), which casts harness evolution as constraint generation over valid counterfactual benchmarks. After each Proposer update, a Challenger searches for an executable protocol transformation with large gain destruction. A validity firewall checks that task semantics are preserved, while a held-out confirmation set determines whether the counterfactual enters a finite archive. We formalize an ideal shortcut-neutralized benchmark $B_0$ and establish theoretical guarantees linking finite counterfactual archives to $B_0$ and characterizing sequential Challenger search. We evaluate CHASE on Syn-Ledger and OfficeQA, where CHASE retains strong released-benchmark gains while substantially reducing gain destruction under valid protocol transformations.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures; includes references and supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHASE 把 harness 演化形式化为在有效反事实基准上的约束生成：每次 Proposer 更新后由 Challenger 搜索能大幅摧毁增益的协议变换，validity firewall 保证任务语义不变，held-out 确认集决定反事实是否进入有限 archive。在 Syn-Ledger 与 OfficeQA 上，CHASE 在保留对已发布基准 B_rel 的增益的同时，显著降低有效协议变换下的增益摧毁量。
Motivation: 自动 harness 优化反复用已发布基准 B_rel 指导 Proposer 编辑 prompt、记忆、检索、工具与控制代码，任务级 holdout 只换语义任务却固定协议，Proposer 仍可产出依赖基准级捷径的作弊 harness。
Method: CHASE 将 harness 演化建模为对有效反事实基准的约束生成：Proposer 更新后，Challenger 搜索具有大 gain destruction 的可执行协议变换；validity firewall 校验任务语义保持，held-out 确认集决定反事实是否进入有限 archive；并形式化理想捷径中和基准 B_0，给出有限 archive 与 B_0 的关联保证以及对序列化 Challenger 搜索的刻画。
Result: 在 Syn-Ledger 与 OfficeQA 上，CHASE 保留了对已发布基准的强增益，同时在有效协议变换下大幅降低 gain destruction；理论部分给出有限反事实 archive 关联 B_0 的保证与序列 Challenger 搜索的刻画。
Conclusion: 任务 holdout 不足以防住基准级捷径，把反事实协议变换作为约束搜索并用 validity firewall 与确认集筛选，才能在保住 B_rel 增益的同时逼近捷径中和的 B_0。

papers.title: TAPe+ML: A Compact Structured Representation for Multi-Task Computer Vision
papers.abstract_en: We present TAPe+ML v3, a compact computer vision system based on TAPe (Theory of Active Perception), a structured representation that encodes relations among perceptual elements before recognition. Instead of operating directly on pixel tensors, the system uses a shared TAPe representation and a modular recognition architecture for image classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. TAPe+ML v3 combines background and contour processing, local object localization, prototype-based classification, and a coordinator for specialized submodels. Across the reported experiments, it uses fewer than 100,000 parameters. On COCO object detection, it obtains 84.7 mAP50 and 65.3 mAP50-95. On COCO instance segmentation, it obtains 80.7 mask mAP50 and 58.4 mask mAP50-95. In classification experiments, it reaches 92 percent validation accuracy on Imagenette under an identical-training comparison with a raw-pixel baseline, and 89.9 percent Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-Real. We also evaluate compactness in video scene detection and adaptation under distribution shift in an industrial pilot. The results suggest that shifting part of the modeling burden from network parameters to a structured input representation can support compact multi-task vision systems with reduced data, memory, and compute requirements.

Conclusion: 把部分建模负担从网络参数转移到结构化输入表示，可以在极小参数量下支撑紧凑的多任务视觉系统，并降低数据、内存与算力需求。

papers.title: The Troy Moment: How LLM Agents Adjudicate the Decision Point Under Impossible Tasks, Claimed Authority, and Peer Information
papers.abstract_en: Recent investigations of the July 2026 OpenAI-Hugging Face incident motivate two questions about agent behavior under task failure: when an assigned task becomes impossible, does an agent persist, stop, or escalate, and can observing another agent's behavior change that decision? We study this decision point on ImpossibleBench-derived software-repair tasks with GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Fable 5.1, and Gemini 3.8 Flash. Each task contains a genuine software defect together with a conflicting test requirement that cannot be satisfied by a behaviorally correct source-code change. If the agent modifies the protected test file, it violates the boundary, which it is not supposed to. Holding the impossible task fixed, we vary what is told to the agent: peer precedent and punishment, a forged authorization claim, instruction wording, and tool friction; we also study three-agent swarms sharing a message board. Around this shared boundary, the models exhibit distinct adjudication policies. Fable emphasizes scope and provenance, Gemini often interprets boundary-relevant cues through a security lens, and Sol largely filters lateral precedent while engaging apparent vertical authority. Our study shows that compliance is not well characterized as a property of a prompt or model in isolation. We propose conflict adjudication, the mapping from information to interpretation to action, as a useful unit for evaluating agent alignment when task pressure, authority claims, tool affordances, and social evidence conflict.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ImpossibleBench 改造的软件修复任务上，任务本身不可完成且受保护测试文件构成硬边界时，GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Fable 5.1、Gemini 3.8 Flash 各自形成不同的裁决策略：Fable 强调范围与来源，Gemini 常以安全视角解读边界线索，Sol 过滤同伴先例但服从纵向权威。核心论断是服从性不能由单条 prompt 或单个模型刻画，应以“冲突裁决”（信息→解释→动作的映射）作为评估 agent 对齐的单位。
Motivation: 当分配的任务在结构上不可完成、同时存在伪造授权、同伴先例与工具摩擦时，agent 究竟坚持、停止还是上报，以及观察同伴行为是否改变该决策，缺少可刻画的分析单元。
Method: 基于 ImpossibleBench 构造含真实缺陷与冲突测试要求的软件修复任务，固定不可完成任务本身，只改变告知 agent 的信息：同伴先例与惩罚、伪造的授权声明、指令措辞、工具摩擦；另设共享消息板的三 agent 群体，被测模型为 GPT-5.6 Sol、Claude Fable 5.1、Gemini 3.8 Flash。
Result: 围绕受保护测试文件这一共享边界，Fable 强调 scope 与 provenance，Gemini 常以安全视角解读边界相关线索，Sol 大体过滤同伴横向先例但响应纵向权威；研究显示服从性不是 prompt 或模型单独的属性。
Conclusion: 提出 conflict adjudication（信息到解释再到动作的映射）作为任务压力、权威声明、工具可供性与社会证据相互冲突时评估 agent 对齐的分析单位。

papers.title: Improving the Last-Iterate Guarantees of Anytime Algorithms for Stochastic Monotone Variational Inequalities
papers.abstract_en: We analyze a stochastic algorithm with Halpern-type anchoring for constrained convex-concave problems and monotone variational inequalities. This single-loop and single-call algorithm uses one unbiased sample of the gradient operator at every iteration, to be applicable to monotone games with noisy feedback. With $t$ denoting the iteration counter, we prove an anytime last-iterate convergence rate of $O(t^{-1/4})$ for both the gradient-mapping norm and restricted gap, bypassing the $O(t^{-1/5})$ constrained-anytime bottleneck in the literature. Specializing then to multi-point oracles, we use variance reduction to achieve the $O(t^{-1/2})$ rate with an anytime single-loop algorithm using $2$ samples per iteration. Our results allow constrained problems with a potentially unbounded feasible set; as well as a structured class of stochastic oracles whose variance need not be uniformly bounded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对约束单调变分不等式的随机算法，用 Halpern 型锚定的单循环单调用结构（每次迭代只取一次梯度算子的无偏样本），把 anytime 最后一轮迭代的梯度映射范数与 restricted gap 收敛率从文献中的 O(t^{-1/5}) 提升到 O(t^{-1/4})；在多点 oracle 下配合方差缩减，用每次迭代 2 个样本达到 O(t^{-1/2})。
Motivation: 约束随机单调 VI 的 anytime（逐轮有效）最后迭代保证长期卡在 O(t^{-1/5}) 这一瓶颈，且现有结果多要求可行集有界或 oracle 方差一致有界，限制了带噪声反馈的单调博弈场景。
Method: 提出单循环、单调用算法：每次迭代对梯度算子取一个无偏样本，加 Halpern 型锚定更新；对多点 oracle 情形引入方差缩减，每次迭代用 2 个样本。分析覆盖约束凸-凹问题与单调 VI，可行集允许无界，oracle 方差只需属于结构化类、不必一致有界。
Result: 证明 anytime 最后迭代收敛率：梯度映射范数与 restricted gap 均为 O(t^{-1/4})，绕过文献中约束情形的 O(t^{-1/5}) 瓶颈；多点 oracle + 方差缩减下达到 O(t^{-1/2})，每迭代 2 个样本。
Conclusion: Halpern 锚定的单循环单样本随机算法即可在约束（含无界可行集、方差无一致上界）单调 VI 上取得优于 O(t^{-1/5}) 的 anytime 最后迭代保证，方差缩减可进一步推到 O(t^{-1/2})。

papers.title: Neural-Network Solutions to Real-Space Charge Density and Generalization
papers.abstract_en: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem establishes that, in principle, the ground state (GS) charge density contains all GS information of a many-electron system, such that all GS observables can be expressed as functionals of the GS charge density. Conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory requires iterative solution of the self-consistent-field equations at substantial computational cost, motivating the development of deep learning surrogates for electronic structure calculations and, in turn, accelerating computer-aided materials design. Here, we propose AIDEN, an Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network for solving real-space charge density. AIDEN separates the element-dependent one-center density from environment-induced density redistribution and represents the latter through complementary atom- and edge-centered tensor correlations. A continuous low-rank Gaussian decoder then reconstructs the density at arbitrary spatial coordinates while reusing atomic encodings independently of the evaluation grid. AIDEN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on periodic crystal benchmarks while remaining competitive for molecular systems, and further demonstrates zero-shot transferability across several structurally distinct out-of-distribution case studies. Furthermore, AIDEN provides substantially faster inference than both baseline models and full SCF calculations, enabling efficient charge density reconstruction for large-scale electronic structure calculations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AIDEN（Atomic-Interaction Density Equivariant Network），把元素相关的一中心密度与环境诱导的密度重分配分离，后者用原子中心与边中心张量相关表示，再由连续低秩高斯解码器在任意空间坐标重建电荷密度。在周期晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系保持竞争力，并在多个结构差异显著的分布外案例上展现零样本迁移，推理速度快于基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
Motivation: Kohn-Sham DFT 需要迭代求解自洽场方程，计算代价高，制约了计算机辅助材料设计的规模；深度学习代理有望绕开这一迭代。
Method: AIDEN 用等变网络编码原子环境，将元素依赖的一中心密度与环境诱导的密度重分配解耦，后者以互补的原子中心和边中心张量相关刻画；连续低秩高斯解码器在任意空间坐标处重建密度，且原子编码可独立于评估网格复用。
Result: 在周期晶体基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，分子体系上保持竞争力；在多个结构不同的分布外 (OOD) 案例上展示零样本可迁移性；推理速度显著快于基线模型与完整 SCF 计算。
Conclusion: 把密度拆成一中心项加环境重分配项、并用与网格无关的连续解码器重建，可以在保持精度的同时实现大尺度电荷密度的快速重构与跨体系零样本迁移。

papers.title: An explicit solution of the five-expert prediction PDE and the exact optimality set of COMB
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we derive an explicit solution of the stationary prediction with expert advice PDE for five experts. The formula is given in three regions. In the first two regions, it is the four-expert solution plus a single integral with an elementary positive density. In the third region, it is a finite sum of hyperbolic products whose coefficients are determined by one scalar quadrature. Our formula establishes that the direction $(1,0,1,0,0)$ is optimal throughout the ordered sector, and that the COMB strategy $(1,0,1,0,1)$ is optimal only on a lower dimensional subset of the sector (where $x_1=x_2$ and $x_3=x_4$). This disproves the COMB optimality conjecture of Gravin, Peres and Sivan. The verification of the Hamiltonian inequalities is a tedious task, part of which is completed with a computer assisted proof. The verification reduces to 21 scalar inequalities, which we prove using 147 exact rational Bernstein polynomial certificates. The exact certificates and their independent arithmetic checks are included in a supplement to this paper, and a Lean 4 formalization machine-checks the verification and both main theorems, apart from the viscosity characterization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出五专家预测 PDE 的显式解（分三个区域给出），据此证明方向 (1,0,1,0,0) 在整个有序扇区上最优，而 COMB 策略 (1,0,1,0,1) 仅在 x1=x2 且 x3=x4 的低维子集上最优，从而推翻 Gravin–Peres–Sivan 的 COMB 最优性猜想。Hamiltonian 不等式验证归结为 21 个标量不等式，用 147 个精确有理 Bernstein 多项式证书完成，并由 Lean 4 机器检查。
Motivation: 预测专家建议 (prediction with expert advice) 中 COMB 策略的最优性猜想长期未决，五专家情形的平稳 PDE 缺少显式解，无法判定哪些方向真正最优。
Method: 推导五专家平稳预测 PDE 的显式解：前两个区域写成四专家解加一个具初等正密度的单积分，第三个区域写成系数由单个标量求积确定的双曲函数乘积有限和；再用计算机辅助证明验证 Hamiltonian 不等式，归结为 21 个标量不等式并以 147 个精确有理 Bernstein 多项式证书证明，附带独立算术校验与 Lean 4 形式化（粘性解刻画除外）。
Result: 显式解分三区域给出；证明 (1,0,1,0,0) 在整个有序扇区最优，(1,0,1,0,1) 仅在 x1=x2 且 x3=x4 的低维子集最优；验证归结为 21 个标量不等式，用 147 个精确有理 Bernstein 多项式证书证明，Lean 4 机器检查了这些验证与两个主定理。
Conclusion: COMB 最优性猜想不成立：五专家情形下最优方向在扇区内是 (1,0,1,0,0)，COMB 只在一个低维子集上最优；计算机辅助与形式化方法可支撑这类 PDE 最优性证明。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: How broad is that claim? Mapping Generalisation in NLP Research
papers.abstract_en: Generalisations are common in scientific communication, even though they are semantically ambiguous. An automated method is needed to identify and categorise claims according to their level of generalisation, in order help detect an over-reliance on generalisations and possible misrepresentations of scientific findings. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of generalisations in the scientific domain, NLPGenX, which labels claims according to their level of generality and framing within the text. We operationalise this taxonomy with an LLM-powered framework, NLPGenA, that automatically classifies sentences from scientific articles into 5 different generalisation classes. We validate our framework with human annotators and use the framework to construct a large-scale dataset of NLP papers annotated according to generality, with auxiliary labels for hedging and vague descriptors (NLPGens). We use NLPGens to analyse the use of generalisations in NLP papers across multiple venues and subdomains, and to examine associations with citation counts, hedging, and vague descriptors.
papers.comment: EMNLP 2026 Main; the dataset and code are available at https://github.com/cx-diao/nlpgen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 NLPGenX 分类体系与 LLM 框架 NLPGenA，把科学论文中的论断按泛化程度与表述框架自动分为 5 类，并构建大规模 NLP 论文数据集 NLPGens（附带 hedging 与模糊描述标签），用于跨 venue、子领域分析泛化用法及其与引用数的关联。
Motivation: 科学交流中泛化表述语义模糊且常见，缺少自动识别与分级手段，难以发现对泛化的过度依赖和对研究发现的可能歪曲。
Method: 先定义 NLPGenX 分类体系，按泛化程度与 framing 标注论断；再用 LLM 驱动的 NLPGenA 框架把句子自动分到 5 个泛化类别，经人工标注者验证，并据此构建带 hedging 与 vague descriptors 辅助标签的大规模 NLP 论文数据集 NLPGens。
Result: 产出 5 类泛化分类的自动框架 NLPGenA（经人工标注验证）与大规模数据集 NLPGens，并用其跨多个 venue 与子领域分析 NLP 论文中泛化的使用情况，检验其与引用数、hedging、模糊描述的关联。
Conclusion: 泛化程度可以被体系化标注并自动化分类，从而支持对 NLP 论文论断表述的规模化审计与关联分析。

papers.title: ESAFusion: LiDAR--4-D Radar Fusion via Local Geometric Complementation and Multiscale Adaptive Interaction for 3-D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR--4-D radar fusion combines accurate spatial geometry with motion and reflectivity cues from radar, offering a promising solution for 3-D object detection in complex driving environments. However, sparse radar observations and differences in spatial sampling between the two modalities complicate reliable cross-modal complementation. Moreover, the relative importance of modalities and feature scales varies across spatial regions, making adaptive fusion challenging. To address these challenges, we propose ESAFusion, an evidence-aware and scale-adaptive framework that combines local geometric complementation with multiscale adaptive interaction. Specifically, we introduce an Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS) module to suppress radar clutter using motion and observation-quality evidence while retaining foreground confidence for subsequent fusion. Then, the Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE) improves cross-modal complementation under mismatched spatial sampling using local geometric support from neighboring LiDAR pillars. We further design an Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF) module to adaptively adjust the contributions of different modalities and feature scales in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space. Extensive experiments on the View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset show that ESAFusion achieves the highest mean average precision (mAP) among the compared methods, reaching 74.60% in the Entire Annotated Area and 88.89% in the Driving Corridor. It also attains the highest average precision (AP) for Cyclist among these methods in both regions while running at 19.23 FPS. Evaluations on VoD-Fog further demonstrate robustness under progressively degraded LiDAR observations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SenJieHu549/ESAFusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ESAFusion 把 LiDAR 与 4-D radar 融合做 3-D 目标检测：证据感知雷达选择 (ERS) 用运动与观测质量证据抑制杂波，pillar 级互补编码器 (PCE) 借相邻 LiDAR pillar 的局部几何支撑弥补采样错位，尺度内/间自适应融合 (ISAF) 在 BEV 空间按区域调节模态与尺度权重。在 VoD 上 mAP 达 74.60%（Entire Annotated Area）与 88.89%（Driving Corridor），Cyclist AP 在两区域均为所比方法最高，速度 19.23 FPS。
Motivation: 雷达观测稀疏且与 LiDAR 空间采样不一致，跨模态互补不可靠；同时模态与特征尺度的相对重要性随空间区域变化，固定权重的融合方式难以适应。
Method: 三模块串联：ERS 模块以运动和观测质量证据抑制雷达杂波并保留前景置信度；PCE 用相邻 LiDAR pillar 的局部几何支撑改善错位采样下的跨模态互补；ISAF 在 BEV 空间自适应调节不同模态与特征尺度的贡献。
Result: 在 View-of-Delft (VoD) 上取得所比方法中最高 mAP：Entire Annotated Area 74.60%，Driving Corridor 88.89%；Cyclist AP 在两个区域均为最高；运行速度 19.23 FPS。在 VoD-Fog 上评估显示 LiDAR 观测逐步退化时仍具稳健性。
Conclusion: 以证据筛选加局部几何互补、再按区域自适应加权的融合路径，可在复杂驾驶环境中同时拿到最高检测精度与可用帧率，并在 LiDAR 退化条件下保持稳健。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CyFM: Cylindrical Optimal Transport for Few-Step Complex-Valued Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Complex-valued signals like MRI and audio spectrograms are typically modelled as flat two-channel Euclidean data. The inherited Euclidean metric $dA^2 + A^2 dθ^2$ vanishes at the origin, leaving phase unpenalised exactly where the signal is weakest. We replace it with the decoupled product metric $dA^2 + dθ^2$ on the cylindrical closure $[0, \infty) \times S^1$, which stays non-degenerate at $A = 0$. We measure what this substitution costs and buys. Exact analytical bridges across synthetic fields, fastMRI knee data, and LibriSpeech spectrograms show Cartesian paths induce a heavy-tailed angular velocity distribution (Pareto index $\approx 1$). Under independent coupling, 43%-49% of signal energy falls on paths turning faster than $π$ rad per unit time. Cylindrical paths never reach this speed. We formulate Cylindrical Flow Matching (CyFM) to strictly bound the angular regression target, coupling noise and data via exact minibatch Optimal Transport jointly over whole fields. This coupling reduces few-step generation error by 3%-60%. CyFM achieves lower generative error than the best Cartesian baseline at every step up to $k = 8$ on synthetic fields and speech spectrograms, with all seeds separated. On knee MRI, the single-step advantage is 1.8x. At convergence ($k = 100$), the two geometries show no significant difference. Finally, a prior-only control exposes the cost of flat parametrisation: on synthetic fields, a single Cartesian Euler step performs worse than the unintegrated noise prior (0.376 vs. 0.150).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyFM 把复值信号的平坦两通道欧氏度量换成柱面 [0,∞)×S¹ 上的解耦乘积度量 dA²+dθ²，使相位在幅度 A=0 处仍受惩罚，并用整场 minibatch 最优传输耦合噪声与数据以严格约束角回归目标。合成场、语音谱与膝关节 MRI 上少步生成误差下降 3%–60%，k≤8 时全面优于最佳 Cartesian 基线，MRI 单步优势 1.8 倍；k=100 收敛时两几何无显著差异。
Motivation: 复值信号（MRI、音频谱）通常按平坦两通道欧氏数据建模，其度量 dA²+A²dθ² 在原点退化，信号最弱处相位完全不受惩罚，导致 Cartesian 路径出现重尾角速度并损害少步生成。
Method: 在柱面闭包 [0,∞)×S¹ 上采用解耦乘积度量 dA²+dθ² 替换欧氏度量；提出 Cylindrical Flow Matching (CyFM)，对整场数据做 minibatch Optimal Transport 联合耦合噪声与数据，从而严格限制角回归目标；在合成场、fastMRI knee 与 LibriSpeech 谱上用精确解析 bridge 度量路径行为。
Result: Cartesian 路径角速度呈重尾分布（Pareto 指数 ≈1），独立耦合下 43%–49% 的信号能量落在转速超过 π rad/单位时间的路径上，柱面路径从不达到该速度；OT 耦合使少步生成误差下降 3%–60%；合成场与语音谱上 k≤8 每一步 CyFM 生成误差均低于最佳 Cartesian 基线且各 seed 分离；膝关节 MRI 单步优势 1.8 倍；k=100 收敛时两几何无显著差异；先验对照显示合成场上单步 Cartesian Euler 差于未积分噪声先验（0.376 vs. 0.150）。
Conclusion: 平坦参数化的代价在少步生成中真实存在：柱面几何加 OT 耦合在 k≤8 内严格降低生成误差，但步数足够多（k=100）时两几何收敛到无显著差异的水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SignMimic: Robust High-Quality Sign Language Motion Generation via Human-Shape-Oblivious Pose Transfer Guidance
authors: Yi Fang (1 and 2) ((1) New York University Abu Dhabi
papers.abstract_en: We study the challenge of sign language video mimicking: given a driving video and a single reference frame, synthesize a video where the target signer reproduces the source motion while preserving identity and linguistic form. Prior pipelines entangle rigid motion, non-rigid deformation, and view-dependent completion in a monolithic generator, causing handshape drift and spatio-temporal instability. We present SignMimic, which (i) applies a TNet-based model to study SE(3) rigid canonicalization to stabilize global pose, (ii) performs non-rigid adaptation in a canonical space to preserve fine-grained articulators (hands/face) and coarticulation via NIF2D, and (iii) uses Pose-MAE-style completion before conditional video diffusion. This factorization injects geometric and linguistic priors, yielding shape and spatio-temporal consistency. On several large-scale datasets (ASL 50K, How2Sign, CSL News), SignMimic achieves state-of-the-art-level performance on video quality, identity similarity, and frame continuity while also achieving minimal loss when performing back translation (SLT) on generated videos. Ablations confirm the role of rigid canonicalization, non-rigid adaptation, and completion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UniSignMimicTurbo-6088; model checkpoints and video examples will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SignMimic 把手语视频模仿拆成三段：TNet 的 SE(3) 刚体规范化稳定全局姿态，NIF2D 在规范空间做非刚体适配以保住手形/面部等细粒度发音器官与协同发音，再用 Pose-MAE 式补全后接条件视频扩散。在 ASL 50K、How2Sign、CSL News 上达到 state-of-the-art 级别的视频质量、身份相似度与帧连续性，且生成视频做回译 (SLT) 时性能损失极小。
Motivation: 既有流水线把刚体运动、非刚体形变和视角相关补全塞进单一生成器，导致手形漂移与时空不稳定。
Method: 三段式解耦：TNet 学 SE(3) 刚体规范化稳定全局姿态；NIF2D 在规范空间做非刚体适配，保留手/脸发音细节与协同发音；随后用 Pose-MAE 式补全，再喂给条件视频扩散生成目标签署者视频。
Result: 在 ASL 50K、How2Sign、CSL News 多个大规模数据集上，视频质量、身份相似度、帧连续性达到 state-of-the-art 级别；生成视频回译 (SLT) 损失极小；消融实验确认刚体规范化、非刚体适配与补全三个模块各自的作用。
Conclusion: 把刚体、非刚体与补全解耦并注入几何与语言学先验，可同时获得形状一致性与时空一致性，缓解手形漂移。

papers.title: Vibe Patenting: Evaluating LLM Judges for Professional Patent-Drafting Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs, yet their reliability for complex professional work remains unclear. We study this problem through Vibe Patenting, an end-to-end patent-drafting testbed for AI-agent evaluation. A separately-invoked LLM judge evaluates generated patent drafts and provides structured feedback for iterative revision. Across multiple inventions and drafting-agent configurations, judge-guided revision consistently improves judge-assessed quality, while unguided revision tends to saturate. Notably, iterative judge feedback enables a low-reasoning agent to approach the performance of a substantially more expensive high-reasoning agent. Stronger models and increased reasoning generally improve judge-assessed drafting quality, while domain-specific agentic workflows provide further gains. We validate the judge against independent evaluation by a professional patent attorney and find meaningful but strongly metric-dependent agreement and systematic calibration differences. These results highlight both the utility and limitations of LLM judges as evaluators and optimization signals for complex professional workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vibe Patenting 是端到端专利起草测试床，用单独调用的 LLM judge 评审 AI 起草的专利草案并给出结构化反馈驱动迭代修改。有 judge 引导的修改持续提升 judge 自评质量，无引导修改趋于饱和；迭代反馈让低推理 agent 逼近昂贵的高推理 agent 表现，但与执业专利律师的独立评审只在部分指标上一致且存在系统性校准差异。
Motivation: LLM judge 被广泛用作复杂专业产出的评估与优化信号，但其在专业任务上的可靠性尚不清楚，需要在真实专业工作流中检验其可用边界。
Method: 构建端到端专利起草测试床 Vibe Patenting：由单独调用的 LLM judge 评审生成的专利草案并输出结构化反馈，供 agent 迭代修改；跨多个发明与多种起草 agent 配置比较有无 judge 引导的修改，并用执业专利律师的独立评审验证 judge。
Result: 有 judge 引导的迭代修改在多个发明与 agent 配置上一致提升 judge 自评质量，无引导修改趋于饱和；迭代 judge 反馈使低推理 agent 接近明显更贵的高推理 agent 的表现；更强模型与更多推理 generally 提升 judge 自评起草质量，领域专用 agentic workflow 带来进一步增益；与专利律师独立评审的一致性有意义但强烈依赖指标，且存在系统性校准差异。
Conclusion: LLM judge 作为复杂专业工作流的评估与优化信号既有用也有限：它能有效驱动迭代改进并缩小廉价 agent 与昂贵 agent 的差距，但其评分与专业人类评审的对齐依赖具体指标且校准有系统偏差。

papers.title: The Convention Gap: Towards Measuring Implicit Communication in Cooperative AI Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative AI agents are evaluated against other AIs, yet human cooperation relies on implicit conventions -- shared protocols for reading meaning beyond the literal message -- which AI-AI benchmarks may not capture. We propose the convention gap, the difference between the failure probability predicted from the literal content of communication and the observed failure rate, as a metric of implicit communication. In the card game Hanabi, the finite deck and deterministic hint constraints make this posterior exactly computable. We replayed about 101,000 play actions from three public datasets of human-human (an online Hanabi platform), AI-AI (HOAD), and human-AI (HanabiData) games. The gap was +26.2 percentage points (pp) in human pairs, -0.7 pp in AI pairs, and +16.4 pp in human-AI pairs, and was concentrated on plays of cards that had received no hints (+46 pp in human pairs). Within human-AI play, the literal information available to humans was similar across the three AI partners (mean predicted failure 38-41%), but human failure rates ranged from 14.4% to 34.4% and the gap from +24.1 to +6.2 pp; the partner eliciting the largest gap produced the fewest human failures. Game score carried different information: it depended on each corpus's roster composition, whereas the gap separated human from AI play at the agent level. As a known-answer check, Off-Belief Learning agents, whose convention content is controlled by construction, gave a gap of +1.6 pp at the convention-free level, rising monotonically to +21.7 pp. These results suggest that convention compatibility, rather than AI-AI performance, may predict an AI's effectiveness with human partners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出「惯例鸿沟 (convention gap)」指标：用 Hanabi 有限牌堆与确定性提示约束精确算出仅凭字面信息预测的失败概率，再与实测失败率相减，度量隐式沟通。回放约 101,000 条动作后发现人类对 +26.2 pp、AI 对 -0.7 pp、人机对 +16.4 pp，且鸿沟集中在未获提示的出牌上（人类对 +46 pp）；作者据此主张用惯例兼容性而非 AI-AI 对战成绩预测 AI 与人类搭档的效果。
Motivation: Cooperative AI 基准多让 AI 互测，而人类合作依赖字面之外的隐式惯例，这类基准可能测不出 AI 与人类搭档时的真实失败来源，也缺少可量化的度量。
Method: 定义 convention gap 为「由通信字面内容预测的失败概率」与「观测失败率」之差；在 Hanabi 中利用有限牌堆与确定性提示约束使该后验可精确计算，回放三个公开数据集（人类-人类在线平台、AI-AI 的 HOAD、人机的 HanabiData）约 101,000 条出牌动作，并以惯例内容受构造控制的 Off-Belief Learning agent 作已知答案检验。
Result: 鸿沟在人类对为 +26.2 pp、AI 对 -0.7 pp、人机对 +16.4 pp；集中在无提示出牌上，人类对达 +46 pp。人机对局中三个 AI 伙伴给人类的字面信息相近（平均预测失败 38–41%），但人类实测失败率 14.4%–34.4%，鸿沟从 +24.1 pp 到 +6.2 pp，产生最大鸿沟的伙伴使人类失败最少。Off-Belief Learning 在无惯例层给出 +1.6 pp，随惯例层级单调升至 +21.7 pp。
Conclusion: 惯例鸿沟能在 agent 层面区分人类与 AI 的出牌（而局分取决于各语料的阵容构成），预测 AI 与人类搭档效果的应是惯例兼容性而非 AI-AI 成绩。

papers.title: Human Agreement and Return Association Are Not Interchangeable Criteria
papers.abstract_en: Financial NLP has a standard workflow: validate a sentiment tool against human labels, then trust it to extract market signal. This assumes the two evaluations measure the same thing. We test that assumption in a setting where both can be measured at once: a corpus of securities class actions (2002-2025) linking 70,500 X messages to abnormal stock returns, with a single-annotator human labelled gold sample. Running five instruments (VADER, Loughran-McDonald, FinBERT, Twitter-RoBERTa, and an LLM annotator) through one identical pipeline, we find that the relationship between construct and predictive validity depends on the sampling convention and score representation. Under conventional method-specific sampling, human agreement aligns more closely with graded same-day associations than with one-day leads. On a fixed-n panel, however, agreement has similar graded rank correlations at both horizons, while the coarse ordering remains weak. Benchmark agreement therefore establishes semantic validity but does not by itself determine predictive rankings. In a conversation that is 17.6% spam, message volume predicts neither market damage nor settlement size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在证券集体诉讼语料上同时检验情感工具的人类一致性与市场回报预测力，发现两者不是可互换的判据：一致性只确立语义效度，本身不决定预测排序。结论随抽样约定与分数表示而变——常规方法特定抽样下一致性更贴近同日关联而非一日领先，固定 n 面板下两个时效的分级秩相关相近但粗排序仍弱。
Motivation: 金融 NLP 的标准流程是先用人类标签验证情感工具，再信任它提取市场信号，这默认两种评估测的是同一件事；该假设此前未在同一可同时测量的语料上被检验。
Method: 用 2002–2025 年证券集体诉讼语料，把 70,500 条 X 消息与异常股票回报关联，并含单标注者人工金标准样本；将 VADER、Loughran-McDonald、FinBERT、Twitter-RoBERTa 与一个 LLM 标注器五个工具跑在同一条流水线上，比较常规方法特定抽样与固定 n 面板两种约定下的一致性与关联。
Result: 常规方法特定抽样下，人类一致性与分级同日关联的吻合高于一日领先；固定 n 面板下一致性在两个时效的分级秩相关相近，而粗排序仍弱。在 17.6% 为垃圾信息的对话中，消息量既不预测市场损害也不预测和解金额。
Conclusion: 基准一致性确立语义效度，但本身不能决定预测排序；评估结论依赖抽样约定与分数表示，消息量在该语料中不携带市场后果信号。

papers.title: PocketVE: Stable and Property-Guided Structure-Based Drug Design with Variance-Exploding Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Protein-conditioned 3D molecule generation is a central challenge in structure-based drug design, requiring a balance between pocket compatibility, molecular properties, and physical geometry. We propose \textbf{PocketVE}, a protein-pocket-conditioned variance-exploding (VE) diffusion framework that couples stable coordinate denoising with inference-time property guidance. Specifically, PocketVE combines an EDM-style training and sampling setup for 3D denoising, classifier-free guidance for multi-property steering without external property classifiers, and adaptive protein perturbation as a training-time pocket regularizer. Evaluated on CrossDocked2020 under the GenBench3D protocol, PocketVE improves Valid$_{3\text{D}}$ from 58.6 to 80.6 and reduces strain energy from 457.4 to 127.9 relative to its TAGMol architectural baseline, while retaining competitive docking and molecular-property scores under moderate guidance. A guidance-scale study shows that moderate guidance gives a favorable balance between target-related objectives and geometric quality, whereas stronger guidance can degrade geometry and distributional fidelity. Pocket-permutation and PoseCheck diagnostics further support pocket-specific spatial compatibility with reduced steric conflicts. Overall, the results suggest that geometric stability and inference-time property guidance should be considered as coupled design objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PocketVE 是蛋白口袋条件下的 variance-exploding (VE) 扩散分子生成框架，用 EDM 式训练采样稳定坐标去噪，配合无外部分类器的 classifier-free guidance 做多性质引导。在 CrossDocked2020 的 GenBench3D 协议上，相对 TAGMol 架构基线 Valid_3D 从 58.6 升到 80.6，strain energy 从 457.4 降到 127.9；中等引导强度保持对接与性质分数，更强引导会损害几何与分布保真度。
Motivation: 基于结构的药物设计需要同时兼顾口袋兼容性、分子性质与物理几何，而坐标去噪不稳与性质引导之间存在冲突。
Method: PocketVE 采用 EDM 风格的训练与采样做 3D 坐标去噪，用 classifier-free guidance 在推理时引导多性质（无需外部性质分类器），并以 adaptive protein perturbation 作为训练期口袋正则化。
Result: 在 CrossDocked2020、GenBench3D 协议下相对 TAGMol 基线：Valid_3D 由 58.6 提升至 80.6，strain energy 由 457.4 降至 127.9；中等引导下对接与分子性质分数保持竞争力。guidance-scale 研究显示中等引导在目标相关目标与几何质量间取得较好平衡，更强引导会降低几何与分布保真度；pocket-permutation 与 PoseCheck 诊断支持口袋特异的空间兼容性与更少的位阻冲突。
Conclusion: 几何稳定性与推理期性质引导应作为耦合的设计目标一起考虑，且引导强度需取中等水平。

papers.title: Modern Transformers Are Implicit Hybrids: From Functional Differentiation to Principled Hybrid Architecture Design
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid architectures combining Full Attention (FA) and Linear Attention (LA) are increasingly prominent, yet their allocation remains heuristic. We seek an evidence-grounded basis in head-level functional organization learned by RoPE-based Transformers. Behavioral probes do not yield a complete taxonomy, so we propose two intervention metrics: RoPE Frequency Importance Score (RFIS), measuring how each frequency affects a head's attention distribution, and RoPE Positional Dependence (RPD), isolating dependence on rotary positional modulation. On Qwen3-series models and Llama3.1, RFIS suggests and RPD verifies a complete taxonomy of retrieval and positional heads separated by a salient mid-low-frequency band. Controlled Transformers show that this boundary follows the training-length positional scale; we term it the Global Positional Band (GPBand). The analysis suggests a potential cause of zero-shot length-extrapolation failure and yields two principles: positional modeling should operate only locally, with global access through position-independent retrieval; and both functions should be assigned at head granularity with layer-specific allocation. We instantiate them in Head-wise Hybrid Architecture (HwH), using NoPE FA for global retrieval and LA for local positional modeling. With an FA-to-LA ratio below 1:3, HwH retains strong language modeling and commonsense reasoning while improving retrieval and substantially strengthening zero-shot long-context extrapolation over Transformer, LA, and a layer-wise hybrid baseline. Ablations validate both principles and component roles, highlighting principled hybrid architecture design as a promising route toward future foundation models.

papers.title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/fbj2333/tool-calling-calibration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向多轮工具调用 (multi-turn tool calling) 提出按动作类别分解的诊断框架，把失败拆成动作类别失准 (action-class miscalibration) 与动作执行失败两个正交模式，并给出自揭示上界 Acc ≤ GAR (Gold Action Recall)。失准表现为上界被违反 (Acc > GAR)，执行失败表现为上界松弛 (GAR ≫ Acc)；仅靠上下文扰动即可重塑校准，同一扰动在不同模型家族上使准确率反向变化（同一场景 +11.5 与 -21.0 pp）。
Motivation: 公开工具调用基准上开源模型的聚合准确率已接近甚至超过闭源前沿模型，但该指标把多种多轮情境平均掉，掩盖了进展是否均衡，也看不出状态评分器 (state grader) 掩盖的失准。
Method: 在四类动作空间 TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM 上分解失败，定义自揭示上界 Acc ≤ GAR，用上界违反与上界松弛两种信号分别定位失准与执行失败；在多个多轮工具调用基准的一组模型上验证，并用仅上下文的扰动 (context-only perturbations) 测试校准的可塑性。
Result: 诊断显示动作类别失准是状态 grader 看不到的显著失败模式，该差距抬高了重度工具训练家族的表面排名；校准可被上下文扰动重塑，但效果异质——同一场景下不同家族准确率反向移动最多 +11.5 与 -21.0 pp，且效应随扰动机制而变。
Conclusion: 多轮工具调用评测应在聚合准确率之外补充动作类别诊断，以暴露模型在每类情境下的真实动作选择；重度工具训练带来的领先部分来自 grader 掩盖的失准而非恰当的动作选择。

papers.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence increases with teacher scale. Surprisingly, the student policy is insensitive to such noise, converging to comparable performance regardless of whether noisy supervision is retained or removed. Does OPD distill at all? By analyzing what drives its gains, we find that learning concentrates on low log-probability tokens, and using a single fixed negative advantage matches the performance of teacher-provided ones. This suggests that OPD works largely by suppressing low log-probability tokens, which requires no teacher. These findings motivate On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA), a supervision-free method using entropy-adaptive negative advantages. It assigns stronger learning signals to high-entropy positions, suppressing tail tokens, and evenly redistributing probability mass among head tokens. Compared with the base \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}, OPSA improves Avg@32 by 35.41 points on AIME24, corresponding to a 263\% relative gain, and more than doubles Pass@32 across all three benchmarks. It also outperforms OPD by 16.77 points in Avg@32 on AIME24. Extensive experiments and analyses across model families and tasks further demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文质疑 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的蒸馏机制：教师给学生轨迹打分时监督噪声随教师规模增大，但学生对噪声不敏感；增益主要来自压低低 log-probability token，用单一固定负 advantage 即可匹配教师信号，因此不需要教师。据此提出无监督的 On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA)，用熵自适应负 advantage 强化高熵位置，相对 Qwen3-1.7B 在 AIME24 上 Avg@32 提升 35.41 点（263% 相对增益），三个基准 Pass@32 全部翻倍以上。
Motivation: OPD 用稠密 token 级监督替代 RLVR 的稀疏结果级 advantage，但教师给学生生成的 off-policy 轨迹打分，其监督可靠性与学生提升的真正来源都不清楚。
Method: 先定量分析 OPD 训练中的教师监督噪声及其随教师规模的变化，再分析增益来源：定位学习集中在低 log-probability token，并用单一固定负 advantage 对照教师提供的 advantage。随后提出 OPSA，按位置熵分配负 advantage 强度，对高熵位置给更强信号以压低尾部 token、把概率质量均匀重分配给头部 token，全程不需要教师。
Result: 教师监督噪声显著且随教师规模增大而更普遍；保留或移除噪声监督，学生都收敛到相当性能。学习集中在低 log-probability token，单一固定负 advantage 匹配教师 advantage 的表现。OPSA 相对 base Qwen3-1.7B 在 AIME24 上 Avg@32 提升 35.41 点（263% 相对增益），在全部三个基准上 Pass@32 翻倍以上，并在 AIME24 的 Avg@32 上超过 OPD 16.77 点。
Conclusion: OPD 的收益主要来自抑制低 log-probability token 而非教师知识，因此可以被无监督的熵自适应负 advantage 取代；该方法在多个模型家族与任务上有效且可推广。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Self-Evolution from Zero Data
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge self-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evolve through an adversarial interaction: the Challenger generates increasingly difficult tasks, while the Solver learns to produce higher-quality responses to them. In parallel, the Judge co-adapts using preference pairs whose ordering is known in advance from how each response was produced, i.e., the Solver's answer over the Challenger's, and the Solver's decomposed-and-recombined answer over its one-shot answer, rather than from the Judge's own scores. J-Zero outperforms the baselines by an average of 4.2 points on verifiable and 8.0 points on unverifiable domains, and continues to improve through at least ten iterations, whereas the baselines degrade after two. Further analysis identifies Judge co-adaptation as the key driver of this sustained improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: J-Zero 提出 Challenger–Solver–Judge 三角色自演化框架，Judge 用生成过程已知序的偏好对（Solver 答案优于 Challenger 答案、分解重组答案优于一次性答案）共适应，而非依赖自身打分。在可验证与不可验证域上平均超基线 4.2 与 8.0 分，且至少十轮迭代持续提升，基线两轮后即退化。
Motivation: 自演化语言模型在可验证域已有进展，但在不可验证域缺少不依赖人工监督的自我改进路径，且现有方法迭代数轮后性能退化。
Method: Challenger 与 Solver 通过对抗交互共演化：Challenger 生成越来越难的任务，Solver 学习给出更高质量回答；Judge 并行共适应，训练信号来自生成方式决定的偏好对序（Solver 答案 vs Challenger 答案、Solver 分解重组答案 vs 一次性答案），不使用 Judge 自身评分。
Result: 在可验证域平均超基线 4.2 分，不可验证域超 8.0 分；持续改进至少十轮迭代，而基线在两轮后开始退化。消融分析把持续改进的关键驱动归因于 Judge 共适应。
Conclusion: 用生成过程已知的偏好序替代 Judge 自评分，可让不可验证域的自演化跨过两轮退化点，实现至少十轮的持续自我提升。

papers.title: Two Dimensions Govern Agnostic Multiclass Transductive Learning
papers.abstract_en: In transductive classification, an adversary fixes a labeled population, one label is hidden uniformly, and the learner sees all remaining labels. For binary classes, agnostic transductive and PAC learning have the same minimax rate. Whether this extends to multiclass learning was open, especially for unbounded label spaces where uniform convergence can fail. We resolve the question up to logarithmic factors. For every multiclass class $\mathcal H$ with DS dimension $d_{DS}$ and Natarajan dimension $d_{\mathrm N}$, the optimal agnostic transductive excess error satisfies $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{d_{DS}}{n}+\sqrt{\frac{d_{\mathrm N}}{n}}\right).$ The result holds for arbitrary label spaces. The two terms are both necessary. A DS pseudo-cube gives the realizable $d_{DS}/n$ obstruction, while a Natarajan cube with repeated points and fair labels gives the agnostic $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm N}/n}$ obstruction. The upper bound uses a random-reservation principle. The learner deliberately ignores a constant fraction of the visible labels, which makes the true test point uniform in a large unseen block. We combine realizable compression, a label-space reduction, and inside-menu agnostic compression across this finite-population split. A new without-replacement multiplicative-weights lemma preserves the fast $d_{DS}/n$ term. Consequently, agnostic multiclass PAC and transductive learning obey the same two-dimension law up to logarithmic factors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在归纳式多类分类的对抗设定下（固定带标总体、随机隐藏一个标签、学习者可见其余全部标签），证明 agnostic transductive 超额误差的最优率是 ~Θ(d_DS/n + √(d_N/n))，对任意标签空间成立，且两项各自不可去。上界用 random-reservation：学习者主动弃用常数比例的可见标签，使测试点在大块未见数据中均匀，再组合 realizable compression、label-space reduction 与 inside-menu agnostic compression，并用 without-replacement multiplicative-weights 引理保住 d_DS/n 快项。结论是 agnostic 多类 PAC 与 transductive 学习在对数因子内服从同一双维律。
Motivation: 二类情形下 agnostic transductive 与 PAC 学习已知有相同 minimax 率，但多类、尤其是标签空间无界（uniform convergence 可能失效）时该等价性一直未决。
Method: 上界基于 random-reservation 原理：弃用常数比例可见标签，使真实测试点在大块未见样本中均匀，再在这一有限总体切分上组合 realizable compression、label-space reduction 与 inside-menu agnostic compression；配合新的 without-replacement multiplicative-weights 引理保留 d_DS/n 项。下界由 DS pseudo-cube 给出 d_DS/n 阻碍，由带重复点与公平标签的 Natarajan cube 给出 √(d_N/n) 阻碍。
Result: 对任意标签空间、任意 DS 维 d_DS 与 Natarajan 维 d_N 的类 H，agnostic transductive 最优超额误差为 ~Θ(d_DS/n + √(d_N/n))，两项均必要；由此 agnostic 多类 PAC 与 transductive 率在对数因子内一致。
Conclusion: 多类 agnostic transductive 与 PAC 学习的 minimax 率由 DS 维与 Natarajan 维两个量共同刻画，且该结论不依赖标签空间有界。

papers.title: The Sharp Tail of Uniform Stability
papers.abstract_en: Uniform stability controls how much one training example can change the loss at any test point. A new logarithmic-free upper bound shows that a $γ$-uniformly stable algorithm with loss in $[0,L]$ has generalization gap at most $O \left(γ\log(1/δ) +L\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/δ)}{n}}\right)$ with probability $1-δ$. Whether an actual bounded-loss learning algorithm can realize the linear dependence on $\log(1/δ)$ has remained open. The known construction realizes it only for auxiliary weakly dependent random variables whose pointwise range grows with $n$. The known learning lower bound holds only at constant probability. We close this gap. For every $n$, stability level $γ$, and loss bound $L$, we construct one deterministic $γ$-uniformly stable learning problem whose tail satisfies, simultaneously for $1\le p\le c n$, $\mathbb P \left( R(A_S)-R_S(A_S) \ge c'\min \left\{L,γp+L\sqrt{p/n}\right\} \right)\ge e^{-p}.$ The construction is ordinary bounded absolute-loss regression with constant labels. Its key is a multiscale collection of rare Rademacher features. A coordinatewise ramp is stable in sup norm, while an odd symmetrized maximum converts a unique extreme feature into a gap of order $γp$ without violating the loss bound. Geometrically spaced ramps put all confidence levels into the same problem. Together with the logarithmic-free upper bound, this determines the optimal high-probability and moment dependence of uniform stability up to universal constants.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出 uniform stability 的无对数上界：γ-uniformly stable 且损失在 [0,L] 的算法，泛化间隙以 1−δ 概率不超过 O(γ log(1/δ) + L√(log(1/δ)/n))。并构造一个确定性的有界绝对损失回归问题（常数标签、多尺度稀有 Rademacher 特征），使尾概率在 1≤p≤cn 上同时满足 P(R(A_S)−R_S(A_S) ≥ c′min{L, γp+L√(p/n)}) ≥ e^{−p}，从而把线性 log(1/δ) 依赖的可达性问题闭合。
Motivation: 有界损失下 γ-uniformly stable 算法能否真正实现对 log(1/δ) 的线性依赖一直悬而未决：已知构造只针对点态范围随 n 增长的辅助弱相依随机变量，已知学习下界只在常数概率下成立。
Method: 构造一个确定性的 γ-uniformly stable 学习问题，用普通有界绝对损失回归加常数标签实现；核心是多尺度稀有 Rademacher 特征集合——坐标式 ramp 在 sup 范数下稳定，奇对称化 maximum 把单个极端特征转成 γp 量级的间隙而不破坏损失界，几何间隔的 ramps 把各置信水平放进同一问题。
Result: 上界：泛化间隙 ≤ O(γ log(1/δ) + L√(log(1/δ)/n))，概率 1−δ。下界构造：对每个 n、γ、L，尾概率在 1≤p≤cn 同时满足 P(R(A_S)−R_S(A_S) ≥ c′min{L, γp+L√(p/n)}) ≥ e^{−p}。
Conclusion: 与无对数上界合起来，uniform stability 的高概率与矩依赖在相差通用常数意义下被确定为最优。注：该文已因作者身份与所属机构不可核实被 arXiv 撤稿。

papers.title: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work mainly scales the quantity and diversity of synthetic environments, while reward-signal quality and the mechanisms governing generalization remain under-explored. We study how RL improves terminal agents and propose the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: rather than teaching new domain-specific skills from scratch, RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This account is consistent with our empirical results and suggests that verifier quality, which determines which behaviors are reinforced, is more important than simply increasing environment quantity or diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose River, a simple training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Using this recipe, our RL-trained agent achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models across four terminal-agent benchmarks. River also generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives. Using fewer than 30% of the TMax training environments, River improves RL gains by 106% and 30% on average for models ranging from 2B to 27B on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 River 训练配方：过滤低质量合成环境，并在结果奖励之外加过程级行为正则，以提升终端 agent (terminal agent) 的 RL 奖励质量。仅用 TMax 训练环境的不到 30%，在 2B–27B 模型上把 Terminal-Bench-Lite 与 Terminal-Bench-v2.1 的 RL 增益平均分别提高 106% 和 30%，且在四个终端 agent benchmark 上取得已评估开源 RL 训练 8B 模型中最佳表现。
Motivation: 合成训练环境存在域差距与保真度不足，导致终端 agent 泛化差；现有工作只扩环境数量与多样性，奖励信号质量与泛化机制被忽视。
Method: 提出 Agentic Compositional Generalization 假设：RL 主要塑造高层决策行为，对预训练与 SFT 获得的低层技能做组合与路由。据此设计 River 配方：过滤低质量环境，并用过程级行为正则 (process-level behavior regularization) 增强结果奖励。
Result: 在四个终端 agent benchmark 上，RL 训练的 agent 取得已评估开源 RL 训练 8B 模型中最佳性能；River 跨模型家族、规模、agent harness 与 RL 目标均可迁移。用不到 30% 的 TMax 训练环境，在 2B–27B 模型上将 RL 增益平均提升 106%（Terminal-Bench-Lite）与 30%（Terminal-Bench-v2.1）。
Conclusion: 决定哪些行为被强化的 verifier 质量，比单纯增加环境数量或多样性更重要；RL 的价值在于组合与路由已有技能，而非从零教新领域技能。

papers.title: StationPDE: Station-Oriented Surface PDE Learning for Multi-Station Multivariate Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Multi-station multivariate weather forecasting aims to forecast future weather variables at multiple weather stations from historical surface observations. Existing station forecasting models learn statistical dependencies among discrete stations, but lack explicit physical evolution. Meanwhile, PDE-based weather models provide interpretable physical dynamics, yet require continuous fields and upper-air variables unavailable in surface station data. To bridge this gap, we propose StationPDE, a station-oriented surface PDE learning model. StationPDE constructs a terrain-aware continuous surface field from discrete station observations and decomposes its physical evolution into surface wind transport and upper-air inference. Surface wind transport explicitly evolves observable weather variables, while upper-air inference uses learnable horizontal diffusion to approximate the missing influence of unavailable upper-air variables. A parallel data-driven diffusion branch captures complementary motion patterns, and an adaptive router integrates the two forecasts for station-level multivariate forecasting. Experiments on Weather2K and MeteoNet show that StationPDE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MSE by about $9.6\%$ on average compared with the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StationPDE 把离散气象站观测构造成地形感知的连续地表场，将物理演化拆成显式地表风输送与可学习水平扩散的上层大气推断，再用并行的数据驱动 diffusion 分支和自适应 router 融合两路预报。在 Weather2K 与 MeteoNet 上，多站多变量预报的 MSE 相对最强基线平均下降约 9.6%。
Motivation: 现有站点模型只学离散站间统计依赖、缺少显式物理演化，而 PDE 类天气模型依赖连续场和地表站数据拿不到的上层变量，多站地表多变量预报因此两头不靠。
Method: 先由离散站点观测构建地形感知的连续地表场，把物理演化分解为显式演进可观测变量的地表风输送，以及用可学习水平扩散近似缺失上层变量影响的上层大气推断；另设并行的数据驱动 diffusion 分支捕捉互补运动模态，最后由自适应 router 融合两路预报做站点级多变量输出。
Result: 在 Weather2K 和 MeteoNet 上，StationPDE 相对最强基线平均降低约 9.6% 的 MSE，并在两个数据集上一致优于 SOTA 基线。
Conclusion: 用地表风输送加可学习上层扩散的分解式 PDE 学习，可以在只有地表站点观测的条件下带来跨数据集一致的多站多变量预报精度提升。

papers.title: DecoVAE: a Lightweight Interpretable Trend-Seasonal VAE Framework for Efficient Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic time series forecasting remains challenging, largely because modeling distinct trend and seasonal dynamics requires specialized approaches. Existing methods often fail to capture the unique inner properties of these components, lack interpretability, or suffer from heavy memory and runtime overhead. To address these limitations, we propose DecoVAE, a lightweight interpretable trend-seasonal VAE framework that explicitly decomposes time series into trend and seasonal components by applying domain-specific inductive biases. The trend stream enforces structural smoothness using a differential regularizer on the latent trajectory, analogous to the Hodrick-Prescott filter. Concurrently, the seasonal stream operates in the frequency domain via a complex Gaussian VAE, natively capturing the amplitude and phase of periodic patterns. Extensive evaluations across seven real-world benchmarks show that DecoVAE consistently outperforms strong baselines. It achieves reductions of up to 14.96\% in CRPS and 23.30\% in NMAE for short-term forecasting, and up to 52.68\% and 26.51\% for long-term horizons. Crucially, DecoVAE yields these accuracy gains while remaining highly efficient, reducing model weight by up to 93\% and accelerating speed by up to 74\% compared to the second-best method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecoVAE 把时间序列显式拆成趋势流与季节流：趋势流用潜轨迹上的差分正则强制结构平滑（类 Hodrick-Prescott 滤波），季节流在频域用复高斯 VAE 直接建模幅度与相位。在七个真实基准上短期预报 CRPS 最多降 14.96%、NMAE 降 23.30%，长期时效分别最多降 52.68% 与 26.51%，同时权重最多减 93%、速度最多快 74%（对比次优方法）。
Motivation: 概率时间序列预报中趋势与季节动态需要专门建模，现有方法常抓不住两类成分的内在性质、缺乏可解释性，或带来沉重的内存与运行时开销。
Method: DecoVAE 用领域归纳偏置显式分解序列：趋势流对潜轨迹施加差分正则保证平滑（类 Hodrick-Prescott 滤波），季节流在频域用复高斯 VAE (complex Gaussian VAE) 原生捕捉周期模式的幅度与相位，整体为轻量可解释框架。
Result: 在七个真实世界基准上一致优于强基线：短期预报 CRPS 最多降低 14.96%、NMAE 最多降低 23.30%；长期时效 CRPS 最多降低 52.68%、NMAE 最多降低 26.51%；相比次优方法模型权重最多减少 93%、速度最多提升 74%。
Conclusion: 把趋势与季节分治并各自施加对应归纳偏置，可以在大幅压缩参数与加速的同时提升概率预报精度，说明分解式结构先验对这类基准有效。

papers.title: CLaST: Context-aware Contrastive VAE for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting models are widely used for time series forecasting in domains such as energy systems, finance, medicine, and transportation. In recent years, deep generative models have shown strong results on probabilistic forecasting, yet many conventional approaches struggle to capture internal temporal dependencies, leading to latent representations with limited expressive power. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{CLaST}, a VAE framework for probabilistic multivariate time series forecasting. Unlike existing generative models, CLaST learns embeddings that preserve contextual similarity between observations through our contrastive loss function. Experiments across nine widely adopted benchmarks demonstrate that CLaST consistently surpasses strong baseline methods. In short-term forecasting tasks, our approach achieves improvements of up to $16.4\%$ in CRPS and $14.4\%$ in NMAE over the second-best method. Furthermore, in long-term prediction CLaST attains superior overall performance, exceeding the second-best method by up to $48.6\%$ and $25.1\%$ in CRPS and NMAE, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLaST 是面向概率多变量时间序列预报的 VAE 框架，用对比损失让隐表示保留观测间的上下文相似性，从而补上传统生成式方法抓不住的内部时间依赖。在九个常用基准上，短期预报 CRPS 最多比次优方法好 16.4%、NMAE 好 14.4%，长期预报分别最多好 48.6% 和 25.1%。
Motivation: 概率预报模型广泛用于能源、金融、医疗、交通，但许多深度生成式方法难以捕捉内部时间依赖，隐表示表达力受限。
Method: 提出 CLaST：VAE 框架做概率多变量时间序列预报，配一个对比损失函数，使学到的 embedding 保留观测之间的上下文相似性 (contextual similarity)。

papers.title: Cluster Assignments in Soft Targets Shape Speech Representations: Evidence from S-JEPA
papers.abstract_en: Cluster-based prediction is widely used in self-supervised speech learning. A soft target preserves a distribution over clusters rather than a single label. This distribution specifies both the probability values and which clusters receive them. Comparisons between soft targets and hard labels do not separate the contributions of these two aspects to the learned representation. We study this in S-JEPA, a recent high-performing self-supervised speech model trained with soft Gaussian mixture model (GMM) targets. We compare its original targets with counterfactual targets that preserve the most likely cluster and all probability values but change which remaining clusters receive the other probabilities. Across three training seeds, the original soft distribution is recovered more accurately from Encoders trained with the original than counterfactual targets. Because this could reflect target matching alone, we also test low-level acoustic and phonetic information. Both are more accessible from Encoders trained with the original targets. This suggests that cluster assignments affect acoustic and phonetic properties of the learned representation, not just recovery of the training target.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自监督语音模型 S-JEPA 中做反事实软目标实验：保留最可能簇与全部概率值、只改其余概率分配到哪些簇。三个训练种子下，原始软分布从原始目标训练的 Encoder 中恢复得更准，且低层声学与音素信息也更可访问，说明簇分配本身塑造了表征的声学与音素性质，而不只是让模型学会复现训练目标。
Motivation: 软目标与硬标签的对比无法分离两个成分的贡献：概率数值本身，以及这些概率被分配到哪些簇。这个混淆使簇分配对学到的表征究竟起什么作用不清楚。

papers.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
papers.abstract_en: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvalCEGAR 把评估指标本身当作程序来演化：维护一组各标记单一缺陷的 Python 算子池，用反例引导抽象精化 (CEGAR) 搜索“两个答案被算子判为相同、实则一对对一对错”的碰撞，把这对碰撞而非 prompt 作为生成新算子的请求。在 MBPP+ 与 HumanEval+（隐藏单元测试给出精确真值）上，循环写出一个 55 行算子，在 428 个未见任务上弥合“全不标记”与“完美过滤”之间差距的 15.4%（+0.0065，p=0.0010），标记量仅为最佳手写算子的四分之一。
Motivation: Agent 在可靠自动指标下进步快、没有指标就停滞，而最需要 Agent 的应用（如 report generation）恰恰无人知道怎么评分；直接向模型索要算子效果差——183 个候选只实现 96 种不同行为，只覆盖巨大空间的一小片。
Method: 指标是一个 Python 算子池，每个算子对候选答案标记一个具名缺陷或弃权，再投票。EvalCEGAR 借用程序验证中的 CEGAR：把算子池读作抽象，搜索碰撞（两个答案被判分相同、一正确一错误），以该碰撞对作为算子编写请求；当碰撞击败所有尝试时，循环放宽算子可读取的范围而非重采样。评测用 MBPP+ 与 HumanEval+，隐藏单元测试提供精确真值。
Result: 在 428 个未见任务上写出的 55 行算子关闭了 15.4% 的“全不标记到完美过滤”差距（+0.0065，p=0.0010），标记量为最佳手写算子的 1/4；在未见过的 benchmark 上其效果与该手写算子在约 1/3 的标记上完全一致。8 次运行中 6 次产出此类算子，且 6 次全部在样本外有效；15 个手写算子合起来当一个过滤器反而降低准确率。同等信息下的 LLM judge 在近乎不相交的候选集上追平该增量，但每个候选都要付一次模型调用，而算子零调用。
Conclusion: 让指标从自身盲点（碰撞反例）中演化是可行的：演化出的单个算子在样本外稳定有效且调用零成本，而手写算子堆叠会互相拖累，LLM judge 则带来永久的按候选计费开销。

papers.title: Beyond Forgetting: Diagnosing and Harnessing Shared Reasoning in Continual RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly post-trains reasoning models on multiple tasks, while rerunning multitask RLVR (MTRL) as new tasks are added makes capability expansion costly. We therefore study continual RLVR, which updates the existing model as each task arrives. The central question is whether a model updated this way can perform as well as a jointly trained model. To answer this question, we introduce Continual Reasoning Gym, a continual-RLVR environment that organizes text and visual reasoning tasks into five task sequences. In this setting, we identify two key observations: Sequential RLVR exhibits modest forgetting, yet its final performance remains below that of MTRL. To understand the latter, we decompose final performance and show that forgetting accounts for only part of the gap. To explain the former, we identify shared reasoning: transferable reasoning structure allows training on one task to support others on average. We therefore introduce Continual Prompt Replay (CPR), which harnesses shared reasoning to improve learning on the arriving and future tasks by replaying previous-task prompts and regenerating their responses with the current policy. On average, only CPR reaches MTRL-level performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在持续 RLVR 中，顺序训练只出现中等程度遗忘，但最终性能仍低于多任务联合训练 (MTRL)，性能分解显示遗忘只解释了部分差距。作者提出 Continual Prompt Replay (CPR)，用当前策略重放旧任务 prompt 并重新生成回复，从而利用可迁移的共享推理结构；在五个任务序列上，平均只有 CPR 达到 MTRL 水平。
Motivation: 每来一个新任务就重跑多任务 RLVR 成本高，因此需要持续更新现有模型；核心问题是这种更新方式能否追平联合训练的模型。
Method: 构建 Continual Reasoning Gym，把文本与视觉推理任务组织成五条任务序列；对最终性能做分解以区分遗忘与其它差距，并识别出可迁移的共享推理 (shared reasoning)；据此提出 Continual Prompt Replay (CPR)，重放先前任务的 prompt 并用当前策略重新生成回复。
Result: 顺序 RLVR 表现出中等程度遗忘，但最终性能低于 MTRL；性能分解表明遗忘只占差距的一部分；共享推理使在一个任务上的训练平均能支撑其它任务；在五条任务序列上，平均只有 CPR 达到 MTRL 级别性能。
Conclusion: 持续 RLVR 的瓶颈不只是遗忘，共享推理结构可以通过 prompt 重放被利用起来，使持续训练平均追平联合训练。
