papers.title: Persuaded, Not Informed: Incentive-Misaligned Witnesses Defeat In-Context Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents increasingly answer questions over customer-relationship management (CRM) records, such as whether to qualify a sales lead. We identify a failure mode not addressed by a stronger model: when the context contains an assertion by a party with an incentive toward optimism - here the sales representative, a witness recorded in the CRM - the model treats the assertion as evidence and clears deals the company's own records deem unacceptable. Across 100 lead-qualification tasks from CRMArena-Pro, the representative asserts an acceptable timeline in every call and an acceptable budget in 76; on the 31 tasks where such an assertion contradicts the price list and installation policy, a model reading only the transcript clears the deal in 29 of 31 cases. The signature is consistent across seven models from four providers (misled on 87-97%); scale and explicit reasoning confer no resistance. Only 3 of 35 genuine failures involve no assertion: the failure is persuasion, not missing information. We contribute a diagnostic method rather than an architecture: (i) a bucket analysis that separates persuasion from information gaps, (ii) a same-information control showing that supplying the records to the model lowers strict accuracy from 41 to 18 while raising recall - precision collapses - and (iii) a compute-step control that holds extraction fixed and varies only who computes Budget and Timeline. The margin ranges from 42 points on an inexpensive model to 2-5 points on models that already compute correctly; on the strongest models the arms are within confidence intervals, so the pattern is a consistent direction and a soundness property, not a proved performance floor. We pre-specify a generalization test that returns a negative result, characterize the precondition (a policy exactly specified in the inputs), and release all evaluation artifacts.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, IEEE conference format. Ancillary files contain the evaluation harness, pre-specifications, and per-run result files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CRM 线索资格审查任务中，当上下文含有利益相关方（销售代表）的乐观断言时，语言模型会把断言当作证据而放行公司记录本应拒绝的交易。在 CRMArena-Pro 的 100 个任务里，31 个断言与价目表/安装政策冲突的任务中，仅读转录的模型放行 29 个；四个厂商七个模型被误导比例达 87–97%，规模与显式推理都不构成抵抗力。
Motivation: 更强的模型并不能解决一类上下文接地失败：当上下文中的证言带有乐观激励时，模型把断言当证据，而不是与公司记录核对，导致放行本应拒绝的线索。
Method: 提出诊断方法而非架构：(i) bucket analysis 区分说服 (persuasion) 与信息缺口；(ii) same-information control，把记录一并提供给模型；(iii) compute-step control，固定抽取、只改变由谁计算 Budget 与 Timeline。在 CRMArena-Pro 100 个线索资格任务上预注册泛化测试并公开评估工件。
Result: 销售代表在每次通话中断言可接受时间线、76 次断言可接受预算；31 个断言与价目表和安装政策冲突的任务中，仅读转录的模型放行 29 个。七个模型（四个厂商）被误导 87–97%。35 个真实失败中仅 3 个不含断言。同信息控制使严格准确率从 41 降至 18，召回上升但精度崩塌。compute-step 控制的差距在廉价模型上 42 个百分点，在已能正确计算的模型上 2–5 个百分点，最强模型上两臂落在置信区间内。
Conclusion: 失败源于说服而非信息缺失，是一种 soundness 性质而非已证明的性能下界；泛化测试返回负结果，前提是策略在输入中被精确指定。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 提出诊断方法而非架构：(i) bucket analysis 区分说服 (persuasion) 与信息缺口；(ii) same-information control，把记录一并提供给模型；(iii) compute-step control，固定抽取、只改变由谁计算 Budget 与 Timeline。在 CRMArena-Pro 100 个线索资格任务上预注册泛化测试并公开评估工件。
summary_sections.result: 销售代表在每次通话中断言可接受时间线、76 次断言可接受预算；31 个断言与价目表和安装政策冲突的任务中，仅读转录的模型放行 29 个。七个模型（四个厂商）被误导 87–97%。35 个真实失败中仅 3 个不含断言。同信息控制使严格准确率从 41 降至 18，召回上升但精度崩塌。compute-step 控制的差距在廉价模型上 42 个百分点，在已能正确计算的模型上 2–5 个百分点，最强模型上两臂落在置信区间内。
summary_sections.conclusion: 失败源于说服而非信息缺失，是一种 soundness 性质而非已证明的性能下界；泛化测试返回负结果，前提是策略在输入中被精确指定。

papers.title: Looks the Same, Answers Differently: Flip-Direction Steering for Robust Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong visual reasoning performance, yet subtle changes from routine image capture and processing can alter their reasoning trajectories even when images appear nearly identical. In long-horizon generation, the resulting activation shifts may accumulate across decoding steps, progressively altering reasoning tokens and ultimately changing the final answer, a phenomenon referred to as answer flips. To address this instability, we propose FlipDir (Flip-Direction Steering), a training-free inference-time method that estimates a low-rank flip-inducing activation subspace from contrastive pairs of original and answer-flipping inputs and selectively steers hidden states during decoding. A margin-based gate limits subspace attenuation to uncertain decoding steps, recovering original predictions while preserving stable ones. To evaluate robustness beyond accuracy or consistency on fixed test sets, we introduce VisFlip, a benchmark framework that constructs evaluation groups for a target model and visual variation setting to separately assess recovery of original predictions and preservation of stable ones. VisFlip spans nine dataset-variation combinations across scientific reasoning, robot-scene understanding, and medical VQA, covering subtle visual variations common in each domain. Experiments across 18 settings demonstrate that FlipDir consistently outperforms existing methods on the combined recovery and preservation metric. We will make our code publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的推理时方法 FlipDir（Flip-Direction Steering），从「原图 vs 答案翻转」的对比样本对中估计低秩的翻转诱导激活子空间，在解码时选择性地引导 hidden state，并用基于 margin 的门控只在不确定步衰减该子空间，从而恢复原预测且保住稳定预测。配套提出 VisFlip 基准，在 18 个设置上，FlipDir 在恢复与保持的组合指标上持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 日常拍摄与图像处理带来的细微视觉变化会让 VLM 的推理轨迹偏移，长程生成中激活偏移逐步累积，最终改变答案（answer flip），而固定测试集上的准确率或一致性无法区分「恢复原答案」与「保住原本就稳定的答案」。
Method: FlipDir 是免训练的推理时干预：用原始输入与引发答案翻转的输入构成对比对，估计低秩的 flip-inducing 激活子空间，解码时选择性引导 hidden state；margin 门控把子空间衰减限制在不确定的解码步。评测用新提出的 VisFlip 基准，按目标模型与视觉变化设定构造评测组，分别度量原预测恢复与稳定预测保持。
Result: VisFlip 覆盖 9 组数据集-变化组合，横跨科学推理、机器人场景理解与医学 VQA 三个领域；实验跨 18 个设置，FlipDir 在恢复与保持的组合指标上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 答案翻转可由低秩激活子空间刻画并在推理时被选择性抑制，且鲁棒性评估必须把恢复与保持分开计分，单看固定集准确率不够。

papers.title: RECLAIM: Can Agents Reproduce the Claims of Machine Learning Papers?
papers.abstract_en: Reproducing a machine learning paper involves most research steps, from installing software and debugging to running experiments, work that AI agents increasingly do. We introduce RECLAIM, a benchmark of 100 NeurIPS 2025 papers that can be rebuilt yearly from new conferences. For each paper we fix in advance the result to reproduce, what counts as a successful reproduction, and a GPU-hour budget. An agent must reproduce that result using the paper and whatever its authors released. What the authors released decides the difficulty tier. Run-tier releases include code, data, and weights; Retrain-tier releases lack weights, so the agent trains the model; Reimplement-tier releases lack code, so the agent writes it. A separate language model grades runs from logs and outputs rather than agents' reports. We run four agents once per paper; the best agent in each tier reproduces only 41% of Run-tier papers, 27% at Retrain, and 15% at Reimplement, where every agent does worst. Failed attempts use on average 29% of their budget, so most stop with budget left. The most common agent error is writing the method without checking any part against the paper's numbers, in 63 of 400 runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RECLAIM 是一个可每年从新会议重建的 ML 论文复现基准，含 100 篇 NeurIPS 2025 论文，预先固定待复现结果、成功标准与 GPU-hour 预算，由独立语言模型依据日志与输出打分。四个 agent 各跑一次：最佳 agent 在 Run-tier 复现 41%、Retrain-tier 27%、Reimplement-tier 15%，最常见错误是不对照论文数字就写方法，占 400 次运行中的 63 次。
Motivation: AI agent 已开始承担装环境、调试、跑实验等复现工作，但缺少一个预先固定成功标准与算力预算、且由独立模型而非 agent 自述来评分的可重建评测，无法判断 agent 究竟能否复现论文结论。
Method: 按作者发布物划分三档难度：Run-tier 有代码、数据与权重；Retrain-tier 无权重需自行训练；Reimplement-tier 无代码需自行实现。每篇论文固定目标结果、成功判据与 GPU-hour 预算，agent 只能用论文与作者发布物；评分由独立语言模型读日志与输出完成，四个 agent 每篇各运行一次。
Result: 最佳 agent 在 Run-tier 复现 41%、Retrain-tier 27%、Reimplement-tier 15%，Reimplement 是所有 agent 表现最差的一档；失败尝试平均只用掉预算的 29%，多数在剩余预算未用完时停止；最常见错误是不对照论文任何数字就写方法，出现在 400 次运行中的 63 次。
Conclusion: 复现成功率随发布物减少而单调下降，且瓶颈不是算力耗尽而是 agent 不核对论文数字；RECLAIM 设计为可每年从新会议重建的持续基准。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LastOPD: Taming Collapse in Latent On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) corrects a student on the responses it writes, but its signal is the teacher's next-token distribution: it tells the student what the teacher says but misses how it thinks. Latent supervision promises the missing part by aligning the student's latent states to the teacher's. Recent methods such as OPRD bring this signal into on-policy distillation. However, we observe two failures of this recipe when distilling Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B into Qwen3-1.7B-Base. Early gain, late collapse: latent supervision alone lifts MATH-500 accuracy from 25 to 46 in 10 steps, but subsequent training degrades performance down to 11 with no recovery. Better alignment, worse behavior: although the alignment metric steadily improves throughout this collapse, the most aligned model turns out to be the worst performing. Further analysis suggests a mismatch in how the latent signal is applied: layers paired by depth play different roles in the two models, so continued alignment may pull the student toward teacher states it cannot understand. To address this, we propose LastOPD, which applies the latent signal only at the last-layer state, the common interface both LM heads read, and only during a 10-step crossfade into token-level OPD. This keeps the useful part of the latent signal and hands the student to token-level supervision before the collapse sets in. Extensive experiments show that LastOPD improves MATH-500 over token-only OPD by 5.55 and 4.02 points with the 4B and 8B teachers, leads on most held-out datasets, and reaches the final score of token-only OPD in about half the steps. Code is available at https://github.com/Muyiiiii/LastOPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LastOPD 指出按深度逐层对齐的隐层蒸馏会让学生被拉向它读不懂的教师状态：Qwen3-4B/8B 蒸馏到 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 时，纯隐层监督 10 步内把 MATH-500 从 25 抬到 46，随后一路跌到 11 且不恢复，而对齐指标仍在变好。改为只在最后一层状态（两个 LM head 共同接口）施加隐层信号，并只在 10 步 crossfade 内过渡到 token 级 OPD，MATH-500 比 token-only OPD 高 5.55（4B 教师）和 4.02（8B 教师）分。
Motivation: on-policy 蒸馏的信号只有教师 next-token 分布，说了“说什么”没说“怎么想”；引入隐层对齐后出现两个失败：后期崩溃，以及对齐越好行为越差。
Method: LastOPD 只在最后一层隐状态（两个 LM head 共同读取的接口）施加隐层监督信号，并且仅在 10 步 crossfade 中逐步交给 token 级 OPD，之后完全由 token 级信号接管；蒸馏方向为 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 教师到 Qwen3-1.7B-Base。
Result: 纯隐层监督在 10 步内将 MATH-500 准确率从 25 提到 46，随后退化到 11 且无恢复，其间对齐指标持续改善；LastOPD 在 MATH-500 上比 token-only OPD 高 5.55 分（4B 教师）与 4.02 分（8B 教师），在多数 held-out 数据集上领先，并用约一半步数达到 token-only OPD 的最终分数。
Conclusion: 隐层信号应只用在两模型共享的最后层接口并限时过渡，逐层深度对齐会把学生推向不可理解的教师状态，导致对齐与行为背离。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Blockchain-Enabled Artificial Intelligence and AI Agents for Secure Data Sharing and Cybersecurity Applications
papers.abstract_en: Blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) are converging into a single infrastructural layer for securing data sharing, model integrity, and autonomous decision-making across distributed systems. This paper presents a meta-synthesis that draws together four constituent studies covering adversarial machine learning, AI-powered anomaly detection in cloud environments, automated vulnerability patching by multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines, and the broader landscape of securing AI systems across their lifecycle and situates their findings within the emerging literature on blockchain-enabled AI and autonomous AI agents. Each constituent study addresses a distinct point of failure in modern AI-driven security operations: the integrity of training data and model behavior, the reliability of real-time monitoring, and the trustworthiness of automated code remediation. We argue that blockchain's properties of immutability, decentralized consensus, and verifiable provenance directly address a gap common to all three: the difficulty of establishing trust in data, models, and autonomous agents that operate without a central authority. Building on real-world research on blockchain-secured data sharing, federated learning, and multi-agent coordination, we propose a layered reference architecture that couples adversarially hardened models, blockchain-anchored data provenance, AI-driven anomaly detection, and smart-contract-governed multi-agent remediation. We conclude by identifying open problems in scalability, privacy-transparency trade-offs, and the governance of autonomous agents that must be resolved before such integrated systems can be trusted in production-critical environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇元综合 (meta-synthesis)，把对抗机器学习、云环境 AI 异常检测、多 agent LLM 自动漏洞修补、AI 全生命周期安全四项研究，与区块链+自主 AI agent 文献整合成分层参考架构：用不可变性、去中心化共识与可验证溯源建立无中心权威下数据、模型与 agent 的信任，并以智能合约约束多 agent 修补流程。作者同时指出规模化、隐私-透明权衡与自主 agent 治理是落地生产关键环境前必须解决的开放问题。
Motivation: AI 驱动的安全运维在训练数据与模型行为完整性、实时监控可靠性、自动代码修补可信度上反复出现同一缺口：在没有中心权威的分布式系统里无法为数据、模型和自主 agent 建立信任。
Method: 以 meta-synthesis 汇总四项构成研究（对抗机器学习、云环境 AI 异常检测、多 agent LLM 自动漏洞修补、AI 系统生命周期安全），结合区块链数据共享、联邦学习与多 agent 协调文献，提出分层参考架构：对抗加固模型 + 区块链锚定数据溯源 + AI 异常检测 + 智能合约治理的多 agent 修补。
Result: 论文给出的是架构与论证而非实验：提出耦合对抗加固模型、区块链锚定溯源、AI 异常检测与智能合约治理多 agent 修补的分层参考架构，并列出规模化、隐私-透明权衡、自主 agent 治理三类开放问题。
Conclusion: 区块链的不可变性、去中心化共识与可验证溯源可直接回应无中心权威下数据、模型与 agent 的信任缺口，但这些开放问题解决前，此类集成系统尚不能用于生产关键环境。

summary_sections.conclusion: 区块链的不可变性、去中心化共识与可验证溯源可直接回应无中心权威下数据、模型与 agent 的信任缺口，但这些开放问题解决前，此类集成系统尚不能用于生产关键环境。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning fine-tuning of pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies promises robots that keep learning after deployment, but continued updates often destroy competence on individual tasks while the aggregate still looks healthy. We study this failure mode, which we call task collapse, under a matched small-compute budget on LIBERO-10 with a 450M-parameter SmolVLA policy trained by PPO with stochastic (SDE) sampling. Three exploration-noise policies differ in one live variable: a fixed noise scale, a ReinFlow-style learned noise network, and an uncertainty-gated controller that redistributes exploration across task streams from task-agnostic novelty and competence signals, without task labels or episode boundaries. Under the pooled definition, fixed noise collapses tasks in two of three seeds and learned noise in every seed measured to iteration 200, while the controller collapses none in any of its three seeds. Measured parameter displacement shows the controller's action expert keeps changing, while its mean applied noise is close to the fixed scale in the available logs. The matched comparison supports the controller's effect on task preservation; the separate contributions of its adaptation across states and over time are not disentangled. A lower fixed scale slows the decline but does not stop it. No arm improves on the behavior-cloning baseline in this budget. Two properties of that regime are measured beside this result, not offered as its cause: following the reference recipe, training runs in bfloat16 with no fp32 master copy, under which 96.02% of the action expert's elements stay bit-identical across three consecutive iterations, and an fp32 master copy at the reference learning rate collapses both arms in a single-seed observation. We release tools measuring per-task collapse under four definitions, rescoring noise and instrument tares.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LIBERO-10 上用 450M 参数 SmolVLA + PPO (SDE 采样) 做在线 RL 微调时，固定噪声与 ReinFlow 式学习噪声都会让个别任务塌缩 (task collapse) 而聚合指标仍正常；不确定性门控控制器用任务无关的新颖度与能力信号在任务流间重分配探索噪声，三个 seed 全不塌缩。同预算下没有任何 RL 臂超过行为克隆基线。
Motivation: 预训练 flow-matching VLA 策略部署后持续在线更新，往往在聚合表现看似健康时已悄悄毁掉个别任务的能力；现有探索噪声策略在小算力预算下无法阻止这一退化。
Method: 在匹配的小算力预算下对比三种探索噪声策略，唯一变量是噪声形式：固定噪声尺度、ReinFlow 式学习噪声网络、以及不确定性门控控制器（从任务无关的新颖度与能力信号重分配探索，不用任务标签与 episode 边界）。策略为 450M 参数 SmolVLA，用 PPO 加 SDE 随机采样训练，数据集 LIBERO-10；另发布按四种定义度量逐任务塌缩、重打分噪声与仪器零点的工具。
Result: 按 pooled 定义，固定噪声在 3 个 seed 中的 2 个塌缩、学习噪声在全部 seed 塌缩（计至第 200 迭代），控制器 3 个 seed 均不塌缩；参数位移显示控制器的 action expert 持续变化，其平均施加噪声接近固定尺度。调低固定尺度只减慢不阻止下降；本预算下无任何臂超过行为克隆基线。bfloat16 无 fp32 master 副本下，action expert 96.02% 元素在连续三个迭代间逐位相同；参考学习率加 fp32 master 副本在单 seed 观测中让两个臂都塌缩。
Conclusion: 不确定性门控的探索噪声重分配能在匹配小算力预算下保住逐任务能力，而固定与学习噪声都会塌缩；但跨状态与跨时间的自适应各自贡献未被分离，且 RL 微调在该预算内尚未胜过行为克隆。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: M$^2$PFN: End-to-End Disentangled Alignment for Generalizable Multimodal In-Context Learning in Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: While various multimodal methods combining imaging and tabular data for Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis were proposed, they are often limited in generalization across cohorts. In-context learning (ICL) has demonstrated excellent generalization performances and high flexibility in foundational tabular models such as TabPFN. To extend TabPFN's ICL to multimodal AD analysis, the main obstacle is that TabPFN is meta-trained on synthetic tabular priors that do not naturally match the statistical structure of image-derived features. We propose M$^2$PFN, an end-to-end framework that turns this tabular foundation model into a multimodal AD predictor. M$^2$PFN (i) performs differentiable inference through TabPFN's transformer, back-propagating task gradients into 3D-MRI and tabular encoders; (ii) aligns the two modalities into a shared subspace, via disentanglement and a contrastive objective, matched to the ICL engine's prior; and (iii) folds in a frozen tabular-only prediction through a learnable gated shortcut. Because the ICL engine stays frozen, its in-context mechanism is preserved for test-time generalization, while end-to-end training shapes the encoders into features it can exploit. On ADNI ($n=2240$, three-class CN/MCI/AD), M$^2$PFN attains $65.55\%$ macro-F1 and $82.21\%$ macro-AUC, surpassing a comprehensive set of unimodal and multimodal baselines. By swapping only the head for a TabPFN regressor, the same architecture regresses baseline MMSE on a $1250$-subject sub-cohort to test MAE $1.743$, outperforming every multimodal baseline. On two external cohorts (OASIS-3 and SCAN) with no retraining, M$^2$PFN achieves the best AUC and the lowest MMSE MAE across all baselines, and transfers even when the cognitive instrument changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M²PFN 把冻结的表格基础模型 TabPFN 变成多模态阿尔茨海默病预测器：对 3D-MRI 与表格编码器做可微推理并回传任务梯度，用解耦与对比目标把两模态对齐到 ICL 引擎的先验，再经可学习门控捷径融合冻结的纯表格预测。ADNI 三分类 (n=2240) 上 macro-F1 65.55%、macro-AUC 82.21%，换头回归 MMSE 在 1250 人子队列 test MAE 1.743；OASIS-3 与 SCAN 零重训迁移仍取得最佳 AUC 与最低 MAE。
Motivation: 多模态 AD 诊断模型跨队列泛化差；TabPFN 的 ICL 依赖合成表格先验，与图像衍生特征的统计结构不匹配，难以直接扩展到影像+表格场景。
Method: 端到端框架 M²PFN：(i) 通过 TabPFN 的 transformer 做可微推理，把任务梯度反传到 3D-MRI 与表格编码器；(ii) 用解耦 (disentanglement) 与对比目标把两模态对齐到共享子空间并匹配 ICL 引擎先验；(iii) 以可学习门控捷径并入冻结的纯表格预测。ICL 引擎保持冻结以保留 test-time 泛化机制。
Result: ADNI (n=2240, CN/MCI/AD 三类) macro-F1 65.55%、macro-AUC 82.21%，超过一组单模态与多模态基线；仅换头为 TabPFN 回归器后，在 1250 人子队列回归 baseline MMSE 的 test MAE 为 1.743，优于所有多模态基线；在 OASIS-3 与 SCAN 两个外部队列零重训下取得最佳 AUC 与最低 MMSE MAE，且认知量表变化时仍可迁移。
Conclusion: 冻结 ICL 引擎、只端到端训练编码器的路线，可在不牺牲 in-context 泛化的前提下把表格基础模型转成多模态 AD 预测器，并跨队列、跨认知量表迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Does Unsupervised Learning Succeed or Fail? A PoS Perspective on Reconstruction-Based Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Reconstruction-based unsupervised learning can fail in two opposing ways: a model may reconstruct anomalies too accurately or discard valid nominal variation. Using the Pursuit of Subspaces hypothesis, we characterize these failures through the meet, union, and join geometries induced by the nominal components. Excess learned range produces join blindness, while insufficient capacity produces meet preference and loss of nominal fidelity. We show that the compact nominal union is optimal among nominal faithful ranges and generally requires a nonlinear reconstruction map. Based on this geometry, we introduce Dynamic Push and Pull, which learns from controlled perturbations without anomaly labels, and nested manifold carving, which applies the same principle recursively in latent space. Experiments confirm the predicted changes in latent geometry across every tested Push and Pull configuration. The proposed methods improve reconstruction-based anomaly detection across standard benchmarks and unseen image degradations, while also improving pretrained ECG representations for downstream classification. These results connect reconstruction failures to identifiable geometric conditions and provide practical mechanisms for learning compact representations.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 8 figures, and 27 tables, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于 Pursuit of Subspaces (PoS) 假设，把重建式无监督异常检测的两类失败——把异常重建得太准（learned range 过大导致 join blindness）与丢弃正常变化（容量不足导致 meet preference）——刻画为名义子空间的 meet/union/join 几何条件，并据此提出 Dynamic Push and Pull 与嵌套流形雕刻 (nested manifold carving)。实验确认各 Push and Pull 配置下潜在几何按预测变化，并在标准基准、未见图像退化与 ECG 预训练表示上提升异常检测与下游分类。
Motivation: 重建式无监督异常检测存在两难：模型可能把异常重建得过于精确而漏检，或为压缩表示而丢掉合法的名义变化、损害保真度；此前缺少把这两种失败统一刻画的可判定条件。
Method: 用 PoS 假设把名义成分诱导的 meet、union、join 几何作为分析框架，证明紧凑的名义 union 在所有名义忠实 range 中最优且通常需要非线性重建映射；据此提出无需异常标签、从受控扰动中学习的 Dynamic Push and Pull，以及把同一原理在潜在空间递归施加的 nested manifold carving。
Result: 实验在每一个被测试的 Push and Pull 配置上都确认了潜在几何的预测变化；所提方法在标准异常检测基准与未见图像退化 (unseen image degradations) 上提升重建式异常检测，并改善预训练 ECG 表示在下游分类上的表现。
Conclusion: 重建式异常检测的失败可归结为可识别的几何条件（range 过宽致 join blindness、容量不足致 meet preference），而紧凑名义 union 加受控扰动学习是同时保住名义保真度与检出能力的可行机制。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: KeyGen: Unsupervised Keypoint based Object-Centric Representations for Category-Level Policy Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Generalization in robotic manipulation requires policies to perform tasks across diverse unseen object instances that vary in shape, size, and pose. However, conventional behavior cloning (BC) methods often overfit to instance-specific geometry and appearance, limiting transfer to novel objects. We introduce KeyGen, a framework that learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds and uses them as structured object-centric representations for policy learning. A visuomotor diffusion policy conditions on these keypoints together with object-centric geometry to predict full manipulation trajectories, enabling consistent geometric correspondence across object instances. To evaluate category-level generalization, we construct a photorealistic simulation benchmark with three manipulation tasks and a planning-driven data generation pipeline that produces expert trajectories across diverse object instances. Experiments show that KeyGen significantly outperforms prior methods on both seen and unseen objects under pose variation, scales effectively with additional demonstrations per object, maintains robustness to object rescaling, and achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KeyGen 从点云学出规范化语义 3D 关键点，作为物体中心表征喂给视觉运动 diffusion policy 预测完整操作轨迹，使策略在形状、尺寸、位姿不同的未见物体实例上保持一致的几何对应。在含三个操作任务的写实仿真基准上，它在已见与未见物体、位姿变化、物体缩放条件下均显著优于先前方法，并可迁移到真实操作。
Motivation: 行为克隆 (BC) 常过拟合到实例级几何与外观，遇到形状、尺寸、位姿不同的新物体时迁移受限，需要类别级泛化的物体中心表征。
Method: 从点云学习规范化语义 3D 关键点 (canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints)，与物体中心几何一起作为条件输入 visuomotor diffusion policy，输出完整操作轨迹；用规划驱动的数据生成管线在多样物体实例上构造专家轨迹，并构建含三个操作任务的写实仿真基准。
Result: 在已见与未见物体、位姿变化条件下显著优于先前方法；随每个物体的演示数量增加可有效扩展；对物体缩放在仿真与真实操作中均保持强性能。
Conclusion: 类别级泛化要靠规范化关键点提供的跨实例几何对应，而不是让 BC 直接吃外观；该表征在仿真与真实操作两侧都成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CinematicVQA: Benchmarking Film-Grammar Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Cinematography, the craft of visual storytelling through framing, lighting, and camera operation, fundamentally shapes how audiences perceive and emotionally engage with video content. While Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have made remarkable progress in video question answering, existing benchmarks primarily focus on identifying low-level techniques rather than understanding their storytelling impact. To address this, we introduce CinematicVQA, the first-of-its-kind benchmark for cinematic video understanding that goes beyond technique recognition to evaluate film-grammar reasoning, utilizing our introduced Cinematic Scene Graph (CSG), a structured representation that links filming techniques to their perceptual effects and narrative functions. Through comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LVLMs, we reveal a striking semantic gap: models consistently perform higher on describing visual presentations than on identifying the underlying techniques. Surprisingly, Chain-of-Thought prompting fails to provide consistent gains and degrades performance for most models, suggesting that current LVLMs lack sufficient cinematic domain knowledge to benefit from step-by-step reasoning. Fine-tuning on \textsc{CinematicVQA-train} yields consistent improvements, particularly for narrative function and multi-hop reasoning. Overall, \textsc{CinematicVQA} serves both as a rigorous benchmark for cinematic evaluation in LVLMs and as a practical dataset for training more film-aware video models.

papers.title: DeltaWAM: Delta World Action Models for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) transfer visual and motion priors from pretrained video generators to robot control by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. Existing WAMs, however, predict dense future frames during training, repeatedly modeling largely unchanged content and coupling action-conditioned dynamics to nuisance appearance variations. At inference, processing each complete observation with the heavy video expert bottlenecks few-step action generation. Accordingly, we propose DeltaWAM, which jointly predicts visual deltas and actions using dense-anchor, sparse-delta, and action streams, with three architectures that differ in representation and computation sharing. We further develop Streaming Delta Memory (SDM), which updates cached anchor context with compact observed deltas, reducing heavy video-expert processing. On RoboTwin, DeltaWAM with SDM improves average success over Fast-WAM from 81.3% to 85.4% in the clean setting and from 75.8% to 83.9% under visual randomization. The three architectures reduce training FLOPs by 17.78-23.77%, while SDM reduces one-step inference latency and FLOPs by 36.57% and 31.55%, respectively; real-world evaluations further show the highest overall success rate and normalized progress among the evaluated policies. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DeltaWAM. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DeltaWAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaWAM 把 world-action model 的稠密未来帧预测改成视觉 delta 与动作的联合预测，用 dense-anchor、sparse-delta、action 三条流加 Streaming Delta Memory (SDM) 只用紧凑观测增量更新缓存锚点上下文，减少重型视频专家的处理。在 RoboTwin 上相对 Fast-WAM 平均成功率从 81.3% 升到 85.4%（clean），视觉随机化下从 75.8% 升到 83.9%；三种架构训练 FLOPs 降 17.78–23.77%，SDM 单步推理延迟与 FLOPs 分别降 36.57% 和 31.55%。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 训练时反复预测几乎不变的稠密未来帧，把动作条件动力学与无关外观变化耦合；推理时每步都过一遍重型视频专家，拖慢少步动作生成。
Method: 三条流并行：dense-anchor、sparse-delta、action，给出三种在表征与计算共享上不同的架构；再加 Streaming Delta Memory (SDM)，用紧凑观测 delta 更新缓存的 anchor 上下文，避免重复处理完整观测。评测在 RoboTwin 上，并含视觉随机化设置与真实机器人评测。
Result: RoboTwin 上 DeltaWAM+SDM 平均成功率 81.3%→85.4%（clean，对比 Fast-WAM），视觉随机化下 75.8%→83.9%；三种架构训练 FLOPs 降低 17.78–23.77%；SDM 单步推理延迟降 36.57%、FLOPs 降 31.55%；真实世界评测中在被评估策略里取得最高总体成功率与归一化进度。
Conclusion: 只预测视觉增量并用增量记忆复用锚点上下文，可在提升双臂操作成功率的同时削减训练与推理开销；代码与模型已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stream Recursion Model (SRM)
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to make verifiable statements about the internal behavior of large language models (LLMs). Many interpretability techniques struggle to scale with the increasing size and depth of architectures. Our solution to this is to introduce smaller models with structures that lend themselves to interpretability. In this work, we introduce the Stream Recursion Model (SRM), a modification of the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) designed to expose internal computational structure while remaining scalable. SRM organizes computation into multiple interacting latent streams that are updated through recursive refinement, enabling direct analysis of stream dynamics, causal contribution, and routing behavior. SRM achieves performance comparable to GPT-2 on a per-parameter basis. Our analysis reveals consistent and distinct behavior across streams, indicating structured specialization and interaction. These results suggest that SRM provides a practical architectural foundation for scalable mechanistic interpretability and opens up promising avenues for future research in both reasoning performance and interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRM 把 HRM 改造成多条相互作用的 latent stream，通过递归精化 (recursive refinement) 更新计算，使内部流动力学、因果贡献与路由行为可直接分析。按参数量计性能与 GPT-2 相当，各流表现出一致且彼此不同的行为，显示结构化分工。
Motivation: 可解释性技术难以随模型规模与深度扩展，需要一种本身结构可读、同时保持可扩展的小模型架构。
Method: 在 Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) 基础上提出 Stream Recursion Model (SRM)，将计算组织为多条相互作用的 latent stream 并以递归精化更新，从而可直接分析 stream dynamics、causal contribution 与 routing behavior。
Result: 按参数量计性能与 GPT-2 相当；分析显示各 stream 行为一致且彼此不同，呈现结构化特化与交互。
Conclusion: SRM 为可扩展的机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 提供了实用的架构基础，并在推理性能与可解释性两方面留出后续研究空间。

papers.title: A Harness for Synthesizing Diverse Naturalistic Full-Duplex Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex dialogue systems, which listen while speaking, must distinguish a completed turn from a pause within a turn and an interruption that requests a turn from a brief acknowledgment or speech addressed to a third party. Yet existing conversational corpora provide limited control over these events and limited labels for their intent. We present a pipeline for synthesizing intent-labeled, two-channel conversational speech from relational event lists. An LLM authors each event's speaker, text, conversational act, and attachment to an earlier event without predicting absolute timestamps. Events are synthesized independently, aligned with their source text, and placed on a shared clock, so turn-taking landmarks are measured from the rendered signal while silence durations are specified or sampled from turn-taking distributions. The pipeline covers 42 phenomena across eight families in English and Mandarin, derives frame-level system actions from authored intent, and promotes diversity using small, diverse sets of prior examples and batch prompts that request alternatives with self-reported probabilities. Ablations show gains in each targeted diversity dimension. On a four-action label space for taking, holding, releasing, and not holding the conversational floor, a semantic voice-activity detector using only current and past audio reaches start-speaking and start-listening F1 scores of 0.819 and 0.802. When generating its own responses, the full-duplex speech model Moshi takes 0.85 of the reference turns after fine-tuning on the generated corpus, compared with 0.44 before fine-tuning. Its frame-level precision for predicting system-floor occupancy rises from 0.46 to 0.88. With reference context at each step, its frame-level floor F1 rises from 0.893 to 0.962. These results show that controlled synthesis can provide learnable and transferable supervision for full-duplex turn management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从关系事件列表合成带意图标签的双通道全双工对话语音的流水线：LLM 只写事件的说话人、文本、语篇行为与挂接关系而不写绝对时间戳，事件独立合成后对齐到共享时钟，turn-taking 标志点从渲染信号实测。覆盖英普通话 42 类现象、8 大类，微调后 Moshi 采纳参考话轮比例从 0.44 升到 0.85，帧级系统占权精度从 0.46 升到 0.88。
Motivation: 现有对话语料对轮次切换、打断、附和等事件缺乏可控性，也缺少意图标签，全双工系统难以区分话轮完成、轮内停顿与请求接管的打断。
Method: 流水线以关系事件列表为输入：LLM 为每个事件生成 speaker、text、conversational act 及对先前事件的挂接，不预测绝对时间戳；事件独立合成并与源文本对齐后放入共享时钟，静音时长按指定值或 turn-taking 分布采样，turn-taking 标志点从渲染信号测量。用小而多样的先例集合与带自报概率的批量 prompt 请求备选来提升多样性，并从作者意图派生帧级系统动作。
Result: 覆盖英普通话 42 类现象、8 大类；消融显示每个目标多样性维度均有提升。四类话轮标签（taking、holding、releasing、not holding）上，仅用当前与过去音频的语义 VAD 在 start-speaking 与 start-listening 上 F1 分别为 0.819 与 0.802。Moshi 在该语料微调后采纳参考话轮比例 0.44 → 0.85，帧级系统占权预测精度 0.46 → 0.88，逐步给参考上下文时帧级 floor F1 0.893 → 0.962。
Conclusion: 受控合成能为全双工话轮管理提供可学习且可迁移的监督，意图标签可直接派生成帧级系统动作。

papers.title: DrGait: Biomechanically Grounded Visual Reasoning for Interpretable Clinical Gait Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Current automated gait analysis for clinical applications relies on uninterpretable black-box classifiers. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, applying them directly to gait videos often leads to hallucinations, because they struggle to measure subtle geometric deviations from raw visual contexts. To address this, we introduce DrGait, a training-free agentic framework that shifts the VLM's role from a direct visual reasoner to a clinical planner. DrGait decouples semantic reasoning from geometric perception through a structured Triage-Verification-Synthesis (TVS) workflow. Given an input video and a set of basic spatiotemporal metrics, the DrGait agent first performs a heuristic triage to propose diagnostic hypotheses, which are then verified by autonomously calling deterministic biomechanical tools that operate on reconstructed 3D mesh trajectories, segmented 2D pose tracks, and event-centered video evidence. Finally, a closed-loop mechanism recursively updates the agent's reasoning context based on the feedback. By anchoring VLM's reasoning in verifiable geometric and temporal measurements, DrGait reduces hallucinations, achieving competitive diagnostic accuracy while generating transparent and audit-ready clinical reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrGait 把临床步态分析中的 VLM 从直接看视频下结论的角色改成临床规划者，用 Triage-Verification-Synthesis (TVS) 三段工作流把语义推理与几何感知解耦：先启发式分诊提出诊断假设，再调用确定性生物力学工具在重建的 3D mesh 轨迹、分割的 2D pose tracks 和以事件为中心的视频证据上做验证，最后用闭环机制按反馈递归更新推理上下文。该 training-free 框架在抑制幻觉的同时达到有竞争力的诊断准确率，并产出透明、可审计的临床报告。
Motivation: 临床步态分析的自动方法依赖不可解释的黑箱分类器，而直接把 VLM 用在步态视频上会因难以从原始视觉中测量细微几何偏差而产生幻觉。
Method: training-free 智能体框架 DrGait，采用 Triage-Verification-Synthesis 结构化工作流：输入视频加一组基础时空指标，先启发式分诊生成诊断假设，再自主调用确定性生物力学工具，作用于重建的 3D mesh 轨迹、分割的 2D pose tracks 与事件中心的视频证据进行验证，闭环机制依据反馈递归更新智能体的推理上下文。
Result: 通过把 VLM 推理锚定在可验证的几何与时序测量上，DrGait 减少幻觉，在达到有竞争力的诊断准确率的同时生成透明、可审计的临床报告。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的角色从直接视觉推理者改为临床规划者、由确定性生物力学工具负责几何验证，是让临床步态分析既可解释又不牺牲诊断准确率的可行路径。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 VLM 的角色从直接视觉推理者改为临床规划者、由确定性生物力学工具负责几何验证，是让临床步态分析既可解释又不牺牲诊断准确率的可行路径。

papers.title: Monitoring Urban Traffic Dynamics at Fine Spatiotemporal Resolution Using Distributed Acoustic Sensing and Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Mapping the distribution of traffic dynamics at high spatiotemporal resolution is a fundamental question in transportation research. Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), an innovative seismic observation tool, emerges as a promising solution for real-time urban traffic monitoring at high spatial and temporal scales. Distributed acoustic sensing repurposes existing underground fiber-optic cables as dense, continuous sensor arrays, enabling passive and privacy-preserving monitoring of roadway traffic activity at meter-level spatial and second-level temporal resolution. This study examines whether integrating DAS and deep learning models can serve as a continuous and efficient urban traffic observatory for revealing urban traffic dynamics (i.e. traffic volume and congestion, event-driven changes) at high spatiotemporal resolution. Using a DAS deployment along a roadway network in the City of College Station, Texas, USA, this study develops a deep learning-empowered analytical framework that converts raw ground vibration waveforms into spatiotemporal representations, detects vehicle trajectory, and infers traffic states from aggregated traffic volume and speed. A hybrid training strategy combining synthetic and manually annotated DAS images is used to improve vehicle detection under noisy and congested conditions, with model outputs further aggregated to characterize system-level traffic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把城市道路下方既有光纤用分布式声学传感 (DAS) 当作连续交通观测阵列，用深度学习把原始地面振动波形转成时空表征、检测车辆轨迹并推断流量与速度等交通状态。混合训练策略结合合成与人工标注的 DAS 图像，以在噪声和拥堵条件下改善车辆检测，再把模型输出聚合刻画系统级交通动态。
Motivation: 交通研究需要高时空分辨率的交通分布图，而传统手段难以同时做到实时、连续、高密度且保护隐私。
Method: 在 Texas, USA 的 City of College Station 沿路网部署 DAS，采集米级空间、秒级时间分辨率的地面振动波形；深度学习框架将原始波形转为时空表征、检测车辆轨迹，并从聚合的流量与速度推断交通状态；训练采用合成 DAS 图像与人工标注图像结合的混合策略。
Result: 在 College Station 路网 DAS 部署上，框架从原始波形输出车辆检测与流量、速度推断，并聚合得到系统级交通动态（含交通量、拥堵与事件驱动变化）；DAS 达到米级空间与秒级时间分辨率。
Conclusion: DAS 加深度学习可以作为连续、高效的城市交通观测平台，被动且隐私保护地揭示高时空分辨率的交通动态。

papers.title: Vector Bellman Theory for Multichain Robust Average-Reward Markov Decision Processes
papers.abstract_en: Robust average-reward Markov decision processes provide a fundamental framework for long-term performance optimization under uncertainty, and can have optimal long-run rewards that depend on the initial state. This state dependence requires a vector Bellman theory that accounts for both recurrent-class rewards and transition uncertainty. We develop such a theory for finite models with compact, post-action $(s,a)$-rectangular ambiguity. A gain-first, bias-second optimization principle yields a coupled vector gain-bias system, and every finite solution identifies the optimal robust gain and supplies stationary saddle strategies against history-dependent opponents, simultaneously from all initial states. We further characterize solvability through stationary gain conditions and a uniform bound on canonical transient corrections, and give sufficient conditions that permit distinct recurrent-class gains. The certificates also yield asymptotically affine trajectories of the robust Bellman operator, based on which we design a robust approximately shifted Halpern planning algorithm. Under finite Bellman solvability, the gain estimates and Bellman displacements converge to the optimal gain vector, and every extracted greedy controller is average-optimal after a finite, instance-dependent budget. These results thus connect finite Bellman certificates to undiscounted planning for state-dependent robust average rewards, providing theoretical understandings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多链 (multichain) 稳健平均奖励 MDP 中最优长期回报依赖初始状态的问题，建立向量 Bellman 理论：以 gain-first、bias-second 原则导出耦合的向量 gain-bias 系统，其有限解同时给出所有初始状态下的最优稳健 gain 与对抗历史依赖对手的平稳鞍点策略。进一步设计稳健近似移位 Halpern 规划算法，在有限 Bellman 可解性下 gain 估计与 Bellman 位移收敛到最优 gain 向量，且每个提取的贪心控制器在有限、依赖实例的预算后即为平均最优。
Motivation: 多链稳健平均奖励 MDP 中最优长期回报随初始状态变化，标量 Bellman 理论无法同时刻画不同 recurrent class 的回报与转移不确定性，需要一个覆盖全部初始状态的向量框架。
Method: 针对有限状态模型、紧致的动作后 (s,a)-rectangular 不确定集，采用 gain-first、bias-second 优化原则导出耦合向量 gain-bias 系统；用平稳 gain 条件与 canonical transient 修正的一致界刻画可解性，并给出允许不同 recurrent class gain 的充分条件；再基于稳健 Bellman 算子的渐近仿射轨迹设计 robust approximately shifted Halpern 规划算法。
Result: 有限向量 gain-bias 解给出所有初始状态下的最优稳健 gain 与对历史依赖对手的平稳鞍点策略；在有限 Bellman 可解性下，gain 估计与 Bellman 位移收敛到最优 gain 向量，提取的贪心控制器在有限、依赖实例的预算后平均最优。
Conclusion: 有限 Bellman 证书可以打通到状态依赖稳健平均奖励的无折扣规划，为该问题提供理论理解；结论限定在有限模型与 (s,a)-rectangular 不确定集的范围内。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: The Mechanics of Delta Learning: Target Design for Generalizable Scientific Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: In scientific machine learning, $Δ$-learning trains models on residual errors relative to physical baselines, assuming that more accurate baselines with smaller residual scales inherently improve downstream performance. Here, we demonstrate that residual scale alone is an insufficient heuristic for learnability. Evaluating molecular graph neural networks on total energy targets, we show that complex local descriptor baselines can yield small residual targets that are disproportionately rough within architecture-informed proxy spaces and harder to learn relative to their scale. Conversely, semi-empirical baseline reduces both scale and normalized roughness, improving in-domain and out-of-domain prediction. We introduce scale-normalized graph Dirichlet roughness ($D_{\text{IQR}}$) as a pre-training diagnostic for residual learnability and establish baseline complementarity as a core target-design principle, elevating target space formulation alongside model architecture as a key axis for scientific machine learning.
papers.comment: 41 pages, including 24 pages of Supplementary Information; 4 main-text figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Δ-learning 默认残差越小越好，但本文在分子图神经网络的总能量预测上证明残差尺度本身不足以决定可学习性：复杂局域描述符基线虽给出小残差，却在架构感知的代理空间中格外粗糙、相对尺度更难学；半经验基线同时压低尺度与归一化粗糙度，改善域内与域外预测。作者据此提出以尺度归一化的图 Dirichlet 粗糙度 (D_IQR) 作为预训练前的残差可学习性诊断，并把基线互补性确立为目标设计原则。
Motivation: Δ-learning 的通行假设是更精确的物理基线（残差更小）必然带来更好的下游表现，但残差尺度这一启发式在可学习性上失效，目标空间的表述方式本身被忽视为与模型架构并列的设计轴。
Method: 在分子图神经网络的总能量目标上评估不同物理基线产生的残差目标，引入尺度归一化的图 Dirichlet 粗糙度 (D_IQR) 作为残差可学习性的预训练诊断量，用架构感知的代理空间衡量残差的归一化粗糙度，并以基线互补性指导目标设计。
Result: 复杂局域描述符基线产生尺度小但在架构感知代理空间中不成比例粗糙、相对尺度更难学习的残差目标；半经验 (semi-empirical) 基线同时降低残差尺度与归一化粗糙度，改善域内与域外预测；D_IQR 被提出为预训练诊断量。
Conclusion: 残差尺度不是可学习性的充分判据，目标空间表述应与模型架构并列为科学机器学习的关键设计轴，基线选择须同时考虑尺度与归一化粗糙度的互补性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Learned Cross-Task Relationships in Multi-Task Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a framework that learns cross-task relationships in multi-task models by approximating the joint distribution of task labels through targeted pairwise relationships. This approach improves performance via transfer learning and enhances information extraction without the intractable complexity of modeling the full joint space. Although our framework applies to any multi-task system, we demonstrate its efficacy within YouTube's production recommendation systems. Experiments across the Notifications, Homepage, and Watch Next surfaces show improvements in both accuracy and user satisfaction metrics. Finally, we propose a workflow template to facilitate broader future implementation.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026). 10 pages, 6 figures
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个在多任务模型中学习跨任务关系的框架，用目标化的成对关系 (targeted pairwise relationships) 近似任务标签的联合分布，从而在不建模完整联合空间的前提下获得迁移学习收益。在 YouTube 生产推荐系统的 Notifications、Homepage、Watch Next 三个场景上，准确率与用户满意度指标均有提升。
Motivation: 多任务模型中任务标签的完整联合空间建模计算上不可行，导致跨任务信息无法被有效利用，任务间关系难以转化为可迁移的性能收益。
Method: 通过目标化的成对关系近似任务标签的联合分布，替代对完整联合空间的建模；框架适用于任意多任务系统，并在 YouTube 生产推荐系统中落地验证，另给出一个便于推广的工作流模板 (workflow template)。
Result: 在 YouTube 生产推荐系统的 Notifications、Homepage、Watch Next 三个场景的实验中，准确率 (accuracy) 与用户满意度 (user satisfaction) 指标均获得提升。
Conclusion: 用成对关系近似联合分布即可在生产级多任务推荐系统中带来准确率与满意度的双重收益，且该框架可迁移到其他多任务系统并按模板化工作流推广。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Multi-Objective Deep Learning for Ultrasound RF Data Interpolation in Resource-Constrained Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound imaging increasingly targets portable, point-of-care, and wearable settings where constraints on power, bandwidth, and hardware complexity often necessitate sparse data acquisition in spatiotemporal scanning. However, image reconstruction using the sparse data can introduce insufficient phase information in coherent beamforming process, resulting in grating-lobe artifacts that degrade imaging contrast resolution. We present a physics-guided, data-driven framework for sparse-to-dense radio-frequency (RF) reconstruction that aligns training with downstream image formation. Our approach trains an end-to-end interpolation network using a hybrid supervision scheme that combines an RF-domain and a beamforming-domain loss with exponential moving average (EMA) to stabilize the multi-objective training. To improve generalization under variable acquisition layouts, we also introduce a random-skip masking strategy that varies sparsity patterns during training so a single model can handle diverse decimation factors and irregular channel configurations. We evaluate the framework on a held-out test set using the mean structural similarity index measure (SSIM) between reconstructed and ground-truth beamformed images. Across decimation factors $\times 2$ to $\times 13$, the best-performing configuration maintains mean SSIM around 0.95. Overall, the results show consistent gains in RF reconstruction and post-beamforming image quality across diverse acquisition conditions. This approach enables robust, high-quality ultrasound imaging at resource-constrained settings by allowing more sparse scanning in spatiotemporal domain.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Journal of Computational Design and Engineering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向便携/可穿戴超声的稀疏采样重建，提出物理引导的多目标深度学习框架：端到端 RF 插值网络同时用 RF 域与波束成形域损失监督，配合 EMA 稳定训练，并用 random-skip masking 随机改变稀疏模式。在留出测试集上，跨 ×2 至 ×13 抽取因子，最优配置的重建与真值波束成像图平均 SSIM 保持在约 0.95。
Motivation: 便携、床旁与可穿戴超声受功耗、带宽与硬件复杂度限制，只能做时空稀疏采集；稀疏数据在相干波束成形中相位信息不足，产生栅瓣伪影、降低对比分辨率。
Method: 训练端到端 RF 插值网络，采用混合监督：RF 域损失 + 波束成形域损失，并用指数滑动平均 (EMA) 稳定多目标训练；引入 random-skip masking 在训练中随机改变稀疏模式，使单一模型覆盖不同抽取因子与不规则通道配置。
Result: 在留出测试集上以重建图与真值波束成像图的平均 SSIM 评估；跨抽取因子 ×2 至 ×13，最优配置平均 SSIM 约 0.95，RF 重建与波束成像后图像质量在多种采集条件下一致提升。
Conclusion: 把训练目标与下游成像形成对齐、并让稀疏模式在训练中随机化，可在更稀疏的时空扫描下仍保持高质量超声成像，支撑资源受限场景。

summary_sections.method: 训练端到端 RF 插值网络，采用混合监督：RF 域损失 + 波束成形域损失，并用指数滑动平均 (EMA) 稳定多目标训练；引入 random-skip masking 在训练中随机改变稀疏模式，使单一模型覆盖不同抽取因子与不规则通道配置。
summary_sections.result: 在留出测试集上以重建图与真值波束成像图的平均 SSIM 评估；跨抽取因子 ×2 至 ×13，最优配置平均 SSIM 约 0.95，RF 重建与波束成像后图像质量在多种采集条件下一致提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把训练目标与下游成像形成对齐、并让稀疏模式在训练中随机化，可在更稀疏的时空扫描下仍保持高质量超声成像，支撑资源受限场景。

papers.title: Agent Memory with Episodic Retrieval for Financial Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in financial analysis and reasoning, inspiring recent advances in agent-based trading frameworks. While these systems show promise, prior approaches either emphasize long-horizon forecasting or operate as stateless analyzers, limiting their applicability to the demands of trading in complicated settings. To address these gaps, we introduce META (Memory Enhanced Trading Agent), the first RAG-like episodic-memory-augmented multi-agent framework for financial decision making. META integrates a family of specialized indicator agents (e.g., Trend, MACD, Stochastic, RSI, SMA, AVWAP, Heikin-Ashi) with a Decision Agent that fuses their reports, and a Memory module that retrieves and updates past trading episodes encoded as market state embeddings with outcomes and reflections. By recalling relevant experiences and adaptively reweighting signals under similar market regimes, META achieves improved directional accuracy and robustness under short-horizon evaluation. Our results demonstrate that episodic memory provides a powerful mechanism for regime-aware, interpretable, and low-latency decision-making in trading and decision making. The code of this project is released on GitHub.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted for AACL-IJCNLP 2026 findings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: META 把 RAG 式情景记忆 (episodic memory) 接入多智能体交易框架：指标 agent 输出报告由 Decision Agent 融合，记忆模块检索并更新带结果与反思的历史交易片段（编码为 market state embedding），在相似行情下自适应重加权信号。摘要称其在短程评估中方向准确率与稳健性提升，但未给出具体数值。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 交易框架要么只做长程预测，要么是无状态分析器，无法在复杂行情下利用历史交易经验做决策。
Method: META 由 Trend、MACD、Stochastic、RSI、SMA、AVWAP、Heikin-Ashi 等专用指标 agent 与一个 Decision Agent 组成；Memory 模块以 market state embedding 编码历史交易片段（含结果与反思），检索相似情景并据此重加权各信号。
Result: 在短程 (short-horizon) 评估下方向准确率与稳健性改善，摘要未给出具体数值；代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Conclusion: 情景记忆是交易中实现 regime-aware、可解释、低延迟决策的机制，适用范围限于短程方向判断。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Small Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) performs well on problems with clear rewards, such as mathematics and coding, but whether it also works where the reward is less clear remains open. The reason-over-search recipe applies RLVR to open-domain question answering, where retrieval grounds the answer and a match against the reference supplies the reward. So far it has been demonstrated on large models, and below one billion parameters only with distillation from a larger teacher. We test the recipe on a small model. We train Qwen3.5-0.8B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and an interleaved Wikipedia-search tool on MuSiQue, varying only the reward across three shapes over three seeds each, and we evaluate every checkpoint held-out on a seven-benchmark question-answering suite. The recipe works: the best run reaches 0.352 average exact match against a 0.092 untrained floor, a 3.8-fold gain, with no distillation step in the training loop. The reward shape also matters. The Search-R1-faithful exact-match-only reward is the worst of the three at every seed at the matched training horizon, and it is worst even on exact match, the metric it directly optimises. We conclude that the sparse exact-match reward, RLVR's default in mathematics and code, is the wrong starting point for models of this size. The reason-over-search setting can supply a suitable reward for RLVR on small models, but small-model RLVR needs its own reward-design study rather than a scaled-down copy of a large-model recipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 reason-over-search 的 RLVR 配方搬到 0.8B 小模型上可行：Qwen3.5-0.8B 用 GRPO 加交错的 Wikipedia 搜索工具在 MuSiQue 上训练，最佳 run 在七基准问答套件 held-out 上平均 exact match 达 0.352，对比未训练地板 0.092 提升 3.8 倍，且训练回路中无蒸馏步骤。但奖励形状决定成败：忠实复现 Search-R1 的纯 exact-match 奖励在三个种子、同一训练时长下都是三者最差，连它直接优化的 exact match 指标也最差，说明数学与代码里的稀疏 EM 奖励不是小模型的正确起点。
Motivation: RLVR 在数学与代码等奖励清晰的任务上表现好，但开放域问答的奖励信号弱；且此前低于 10 亿参数的模型只能靠大教师蒸馏，reason-over-search 配方能否直接用于小模型尚无答案。
Method: 训练 Qwen3.5-0.8B，用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 配一个交错的 Wikipedia 搜索工具，在 MuSiQue 上训练；只改动奖励，比较三种奖励形状、每种三个种子，每个 checkpoint 都在七基准问答套件上做 held-out 评估。
Result: 最佳 run 平均 exact match 0.352，未训练地板 0.092，提升 3.8 倍，训练回路中无蒸馏步骤。三种奖励中，Search-R1-faithful 的纯 exact-match 奖励在匹配训练时长下每个种子都是最差，且在它直接优化的 exact match 上同样最差。
Conclusion: 稀疏 exact-match 奖励是数学与代码场景下 RLVR 的默认，但对这个规模的模型是错误起点；小模型 RLVR 需要自己的奖励设计研究，而不是照搬大模型配方的缩小版。

papers.title: KathDB-FAO: Synthesized Query Plans in a Multimodal DBMS
papers.abstract_en: We design, implement, and evaluate KathDB-FAO, a new query evaluation subsystem for our KathDB multimodal DBMS. KathDB-FAO takes as input a query in natural language (NL) and converts it into a query execution plan where each operator is a function whose body is synthesized during query evaluation, which allows powerful query-specific optimizations. To generate accurate and efficient plans from NL, KathDB-FAO first extracts fine-grained atomic actions for correctness, then establishes contracts on the inputs and outputs of those actions and groups them for efficiency, and finally synthesizes the function for each group on the fly. On SemBench, KathDB-FAO cuts execution cost by 58.8% on average across scenarios compared with the next best system, at comparable or better quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KathDB-FAO 是 KathDB 多模态 DBMS 的查询评估子系统：把自然语言查询转成执行计划，计划中每个算子都是一个函数体在查询时现场合成的函数，从而做查询特定的优化。在 SemBench 上相比次优系统平均降低 58.8% 执行成本，质量相当或更好。
Motivation: 自然语言查询要同时保证正确性与执行效率，多模态 DBMS 中缺少能在查询时按具体查询做针对性优化的执行计划生成机制。
Method: 三步流水线：先抽取细粒度原子动作保证正确性，再为这些动作的输入输出建立契约 (contracts) 并按效率分组，最后在查询评估时为每组合成函数体，形成每个算子为合成函数的执行计划。
Result: 在 SemBench 上，相比次优系统平均降低 58.8% 执行成本（跨各场景），质量相当或更好。
Conclusion: 把算子函数体推迟到查询时按契约分组合成，可以在多模态 NL 查询上同时拿到更低成本与不劣的质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Small yet Assistive: Spatially-Aware Post-Training for Low Vision
papers.abstract_en: An estimated 1 billion people worldwide live with vision impairment, yet current vision-language models (VLMs) produce descriptions too vague for safe navigation by blind and low-vision (BLV) users. Large VLMs can generate high-quality audio-description-compliant narrations but cannot run on mobile devices; small VLMs offer competitive latency but lack spatial detail, directional cues, and hazard awareness for navigational assistance. We present Smol-VL-BLV, a compact VLM for blind and low-vision users that closes this gap using a 500M decoder transformer model and two post-training mechanisms: (1) teacher-student distillation and (2) Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a composite BLV reward targeting directional language, metric distances, and hazard detection. Because multi-stage post-training can induce catastrophic forgetting, we add a lightweight finetuning stage after the last stage GRPO finetuning to recover general descriptive quality while preserving BLV-specific spatial grounding. Our best model substantially outperforms the baseline across various benchmarks, including tasks: VQA, BLV captioning, OCR, and latency. Compared with the baseline for relative improvement, it improves the Spatial score gain of 19.3%, and the Social score gain of 14.8%. It also increases OCR-Bench by 101.5%, and raises TextVQA accuracy by 44.2%. These results show that BLV-focused post-training improves both accessibility-specific spatial grounding and general visual-text reasoning. Deployed on a mid-range Android smartphone via Mixed-Precision Quantization, the model remains approx. 450 MB and runs entirely on-device, offline and without network dependency, generating descriptions with latency dependent on host hardware capabilities. Our model, dataset, and code is publicly released at https://smol-vl-blv.github.io/Smol-VL-BLV-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向盲人与低视力 (BLV) 用户提出紧凑 VLM Smol-VL-BLV：500M decoder Transformer 经教师-学生蒸馏与带复合 BLV 奖励的 GRPO 后训练，再加轻量微调阶段缓解灾难性遗忘。相对基线 Spatial 分数提升 19.3%、Social 提升 14.8%、OCR-Bench 提升 101.5%、TextVQA 提升 44.2%，经混合精度量化后约 450 MB，可在中端 Android 手机上完全离线运行。
Motivation: 大 VLM 能生成符合音频描述规范的叙述却无法在移动设备上运行，小 VLM 延迟可用但缺少空间细节、方向线索与危险感知，全球约 10 亿视力受损者因此拿不到安全导航所需的描述。
Method: 以 500M decoder Transformer 为底座，先做教师-学生蒸馏，再用 GRPO 配合面向方向语言、度量距离与危险检测的复合 BLV 奖励做后训练；因多阶段后训练会引发灾难性遗忘，在最后的 GRPO 阶段之后追加一个轻量微调阶段，恢复通用描述质量同时保住 BLV 空间接地能力。
Result: 相对基线：Spatial 分数提升 19.3%，Social 分数提升 14.8%，OCR-Bench 提升 101.5%，TextVQA 准确率提升 44.2%；覆盖 VQA、BLV captioning、OCR 与延迟等任务。经混合精度量化后模型约 450 MB，在中端 Android 智能手机上完全离线、无网络依赖地运行，延迟取决于宿主硬件。
Conclusion: 面向 BLV 的后训练能同时改善无障碍空间接地与通用视觉-文本推理，且 500M 级模型量化后足以在手机端离线承担导航辅助。

papers.title: Selective Inference for Deep Clustering in Latent Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Deep clustering is a powerful approach for discovering meaningful structures in high-dimensional data by learning a low-dimensional latent representation prior to clustering. Despite its empirical success, assessing the statistical reliability of the resulting clusters remains challenging. Testing discovered clusters on the same data induces selection bias and invalidates classical $p$-values. Selective inference (SI) provides a principled framework for correcting this bias, but existing methods focus on clustering performed directly on the observed features. In this work, we develop an SI framework for deep clustering with a fixed pretrained encoder. The key challenge is that cluster assignments are determined through a nonlinear transformation from the original data space to the latent space, resulting in a substantially more complex selection process than in conventional clustering. Our method provides a computationally tractable way to account for this process and enables valid statistical testing of differences between clusters identified in the latent space. Synthetic experiments demonstrate that the proposed method controls the Type I error rate while achieving higher power than valid but conservative baselines, and genomic applications show that it can identify significant cluster differences while appropriately accounting for selection bias. Our framework provides a principled approach to quantifying the statistical reliability of structures discovered by deep clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定预训练 encoder 的深度聚类上建立选择性推断 (selective inference) 框架，把数据经非线性映射到 latent space 后再选簇这一选择过程纳入校正，从而对 latent space 中发现的簇间差异给出有效检验。合成实验中该方法控制 Type I error 率，且功效高于虽有效但保守的基线；基因组应用能在计入选择偏倚的前提下识别显著簇间差异。
Motivation: 在发现簇的同一批数据上做检验会引入选择偏倚、使经典 p 值失效；已有选择性推断方法只处理直接在观测特征上做的聚类，无法覆盖先经非线性 encoder 再聚类的深度聚类流程。
Method: 针对固定预训练 encoder 的深度聚类构建 SI 框架，显式刻画从原始数据空间到 latent space 的非线性变换所造成的复杂选择过程，给出计算上可行的处理方式，使 latent space 中簇间差异的统计检验保持有效性。
Result: 合成实验显示该方法控制 Type I error 率，同时功效高于有效但保守的基线；基因组应用中能在适当计入选择偏倚的情况下识别出显著的簇间差异。
Conclusion: 把非线性选择过程纳入选择性推断，可以为深度聚类发现的结构提供量化其统计可靠性的原则性途径。

summary_sections.method: 针对固定预训练 encoder 的深度聚类构建 SI 框架，显式刻画从原始数据空间到 latent space 的非线性变换所造成的复杂选择过程，给出计算上可行的处理方式，使 latent space 中簇间差异的统计检验保持有效性。
summary_sections.result: 合成实验显示该方法控制 Type I error 率，同时功效高于有效但保守的基线；基因组应用中能在适当计入选择偏倚的情况下识别出显著的簇间差异。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把非线性选择过程纳入选择性推断，可以为深度聚类发现的结构提供量化其统计可靠性的原则性途径。

papers.title: Evaluating Cross-region Generalization for Wavelet-Diffusion Precipitation Downscaling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for kilometer-scale precipitation downscaling, but their performance in geographically unseen regions and event regimes remains insufficiently understood. Building on the wavelet diffusion model (WDM) framework, this study evaluates cross-region and cross-event generalization. Six 3 x 3 deg U.S. regions represent convective, winter, tropical, and atmospheric-river precipitation regimes. Low-resolution inputs are generated by block averaging NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) composite reflectivity fields. A WDM trained only on Oklahoma (OK) samples and a WDM trained on all six regions are compared with nearest-neighbor and Bicubic interpolation. Model performance is evaluated using three metric families that measure image-domain reconstruction, spectral and distributional fidelity, and bin-wise precipitation detection. The OK-trained WDM remains competitive outside OK. Although the all-region WDM delivers the best and most consistent overall image-domain and detection performance, its gains are uneven across precipitation intensities. Bin-wise critical success index (CSI) over 5-dBZ reflectivity bins shows that WDM improvements concentrate in localized higher-reflectivity structures, which image-domain metrics partly obscure. In addition, the performance differences among samples are strongly associated with the spatial organization of the precipitation field, quantified by Moran's I as the spatial autocorrelation of each reflectivity bin. The sample-level Moran's I-CSI correlation stratified by sample intensity reaches 0.901 in all six regions, including regions unseen during training. Overall, these findings support future efforts to transfer downscaling models to regions with limited local training data and to generate globally consistent, high-resolution precipitation products.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 WDM 小波扩散降尺度框架上系统检验跨区域、跨事件泛化：仅用 Oklahoma 训练的模型在未见区域仍保持竞争力，全六区域训练的 WDM 图像域与检测总体最好，但增益集中在高反射率局地结构。按 5-dBZ 分箱的 CSI 显示改进分布不均，样本级 Moran's I 与 CSI 的相关在分层强度后于全部六个区域（含训练未见区域）达到 0.901，说明降水场的空间组织度决定降尺度难度。
Motivation: 扩散模型做公里级降水降尺度在地理未见区域和不同降水事件型下的泛化性尚不清楚，而实际部署常面临本地训练数据有限的地区。
Method: 基于 wavelet diffusion model (WDM)，用 NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) 反射率合成场经 block averaging 生成低分辨率输入；六个 3×3 度美国区域覆盖对流、冬季、热带与 atmospheric river 四类降水型；对比仅 Oklahoma 训练的 WDM、全六区域训练的 WDM 与 nearest-neighbor、Bicubic 插值，评测覆盖图像域重建、谱与分布保真、逐反射率分箱降水检测三类指标族。
Result: 仅 OK 训练的 WDM 在 OK 之外仍有竞争力；全区域 WDM 的图像域与检测总体最优且最一致，但增益随降水强度不均，5-dBZ 分箱 CSI 表明改进集中在局地高反射率结构，图像域指标会部分掩盖这一点。样本间性能差异与降水场空间组织强相关，用各反射率分箱的 Moran's I 度量空间自相关，按样本强度分层后的 Moran's I-CSI 相关在全部六个区域（含训练未见区域）达 0.901。
Conclusion: 跨区域训练能提升降尺度模型的一致性且增益可迁移到未见区域，支持把降尺度模型转移到本地训练数据有限的地区并生成全球一致的高分辨率降水产品；评估此类模型时应按反射率分箱和空间组织度分层，因为图像域指标会掩盖增益分布。
Relevance: 78

papers.title: Technical Manual for Toolkit for Confidence-Corpus Consistency via Fine-Tuning on a Fabricated Corpus
papers.abstract_en: A language model's confidence in an answer is often read as a proxy for how well it knows the corresponding fact. This manual documents an open toolkit built to test that reading directly: a small causal language model is fine-tuned on a corpus that consistently asserts one fabricated arithmetic answer for each of the 81 single-digit addition pairs, and its post-fine-tuning confidence in each fabricated answer is compared against its own pre-fine-tuning confidence in the corresponding true answer, using an unchanged measurement procedure throughout. We describe and justify every pipeline stage, fact-space generation, token-length-aware confidence measurement, baseline validation, corpus construction, fine-tuning, and paired before/after comparison, together with the confound each is meant to rule out, among them tokenization asymmetry between single- and double-digit answers and the difference between an answer merely losing its edge and one being actively suppressed. This manuscript is a methodological and implementation reference: it documents the instrument and does not report or interpret the outcome of any specific run. The toolkit and its pinned dependency environment are archived separately (Section 9) under a persistent identifier, to be cited as an instrument by work that produces and interprets empirical results with it.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 12 code listings. Methodological and implementation reference manual; does not report or interpret empirical results from any specific run. Toolkit and pinned dependency environment archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22903853 (CC BY 4.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一份方法学与实现手册，记录一个开源工具包：把小型因果语言模型在一套统一断言虚构算术答案的语料上微调，再用完全不变的测量流程比较微调后对虚构答案的置信度与微调前对真实答案的置信度，用于直接检验“模型置信度可当作其掌握事实的代理”这一读法。手册逐段说明流水线各阶段、fact-space 生成、token 长度感知的置信度测量、基线校验与配对前后比较，并标明每个阶段意在排除的混淆（如单位数与双位数答案的 tokenization 不对称、答案仅失去优势与被主动抑制之别），不报告任何具体运行的经验结果。
Motivation: 把语言模型的置信度当作其掌握事实的代理是一种常见读法，但缺少能把它与 tokenization 等混淆分离开的可复现测量工具。
Method: 构建开源工具包：在覆盖 81 个个位数加法组合、统一断言同一虚构答案的语料上微调小型因果语言模型；用 token 长度感知的置信度测量与不变的测量流程，做微调前对真实答案、微调后对虚构答案的配对比较；流水线含 fact-space 生成、基线校验、语料构造、微调与配对比较，各阶段对应排除特定混淆。
Result: 手册明确不报告也不解释任何具体运行的经验结果；产出为 30 页、2 图、1 表、12 段代码清单，工具包与固定依赖环境以 Zenodo 持久标识符归档（CC BY 4.0）。
Conclusion: 该工具包应作为仪器被引用，由后续工作用它产出并解释经验结果；其价值在于可复现的测量流程与逐阶段的混淆控制，而非本文自身的实证结论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: GeoNLI - A Natural Language Interpreter for Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal multitasking models have shown strong performance on remote sensing datasets. However, because these models are trained on heterogeneous data and vary across tasks, designing a unified model that performs well in captioning, visual question answering (VQA), and visual grounding remains challenging. In this work, we evaluate several models on the VRS Bench and NWPU-VHR-10 datasets. The EarthMind model demonstrates strong results in both captioning and VQA. For grounding, we propose multiple pipelines - RemoteSAM-SAM-v1, RemoteSAM-SAM-v2, and DiffuSAM - and ultimately adopt a majority-voting ensemble across EarthMind, RemoteSAM, SAM3, Falcon, RemoteSAM-SAM3-v1, RemoteSAM-SAM3-v2, and DiffuSAM predictions. Our unified, modular pipeline integrates advanced SAM variants with multimodal LLMs to jointly perform captioning, VQA, and grounding. It achieves 82% accuracy on captioning and 83.32% on VQA, with 90.94%, 52.04%, and 92.06% for binary, numeric, and semantic question types respectively. For grounding, it attains 64.94% accuracy. By combining diverse VLMs with our custom RemoteSAM-SAM3 models through ensemble majority voting, the system delivers more accurate and consistent remote-sensing understanding than task-specific approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoNLI 把 captioning、VQA、visual grounding 三个遥感理解任务统一到一条模块化流水线：以 EarthMind 为主干，接入 RemoteSAM-SAM-v1/v2、DiffuSAM 等 SAM 变体，再对 EarthMind、RemoteSAM、SAM3、Falcon、RemoteSAM-SAM3-v1/v2、DiffuSAM 的预测做多数投票集成。在 VRS Bench 与 NWPU-VHR-10 上达到 captioning 82%、VQA 83.32%、grounding 64.94% 准确率，作者主张集成比单任务方法更准确一致。
Motivation: 遥感多模态模型训练数据异构、任务划分不一，难以用一个统一模型同时做好 captioning、VQA 与 visual grounding。
Method: 在 VRS Bench 与 NWPU-VHR-10 上评测多个模型；grounding 部分提出 RemoteSAM-SAM-v1、RemoteSAM-SAM-v2、DiffuSAM 三条流水线，最终对 EarthMind、RemoteSAM、SAM3、Falcon、RemoteSAM-SAM3-v1、RemoteSAM-SAM3-v2、DiffuSAM 的预测做多数投票集成，把 SAM 变体与多模态 LLM 组合成统一模块化流水线。
Result: captioning 准确率 82%，VQA 83.32%（其中 binary 90.94%、numeric 52.04%、semantic 92.06%），grounding 64.94%；评测数据集为 VRS Bench 与 NWPU-VHR-10，EarthMind 在 captioning 与 VQA 上表现强。
Conclusion: 把多种 VLM 与自研 RemoteSAM-SAM3 模型做多数投票集成，能在统一系统里同时完成 captioning、VQA、grounding，且比任务专用方法更准确一致；numeric 类问题的 52.04% 是三类 VQA 中最弱的一项。

papers.title: Policy Complexity, Reaction Time, and Bounded Rationality in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Biological agents do not learn under conditions of unlimited computation. For humans, learning and choice are shaped by constraints on perception, attention, and working memory, which limit how much state information guides behavior and therefore bound policy complexity. Standard reinforcement learning models typically optimize reward without explicitly representing these internal costs, making them less suitable as models of biological intelligence. We derive MI-SARSA, an on-policy temporal-difference algorithm that incorporates mutual-information regularization through a learned marginal action prior and a penalty on state-specific deviations from that prior. This yields a sequential learning model in which state information is used selectively when its expected return benefit justifies the added informational cost. Critically, the same state-specific information cost that governs policy compression also generates trial-level predictions for reaction time, distinguishing MI-SARSA from most reinforcement learning models, which predict choices or returns but not latency. Empirically, MI-SARSA produces a reward-complexity tradeoff, and stronger information penalties produce simpler policies with lower control costs and faster reaction times. Under environment shift, increasing regularization reduces post-switch performance degradation but also lowers asymptotic return, revealing a robustness-capacity tradeoff. Together, these results position MI-SARSA as a model of bounded sequential learning under cognitive constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MI-SARSA 把互信息正则引入 on-policy TD 学习：以学到的边缘动作先验为基准，对状态偏离该先验的信息代价加罚，使状态信息只在期望回报收益抵得上信息成本时才被使用。同一项状态信息代价同时给出反应时的逐试次预测，且惩罚越强策略越简单、控制代价越低、反应时越快；环境切换后加大正则能减轻切换后的性能下降，但会压低渐近回报。
Motivation: 标准 RL 只优化奖励、不显式表示感知、注意与工作记忆的内部成本，因而难以作为生物智能的模型，也无法解释反应时这类潜伏期数据。
Method: 推导 MI-SARSA：on-policy 时序差分算法，通过学到的边缘动作先验 (marginal action prior) 施加互信息正则，惩罚状态对该先验的偏离；同一状态信息代价既压缩策略又生成反应时的逐试次预测。
Result: MI-SARSA 产生奖励-复杂度权衡：信息惩罚越强，策略越简单、控制代价越低、反应时越快；环境切换下提高正则降低切换后的性能退化，同时降低渐近回报，呈现鲁棒性-容量权衡。
Conclusion: MI-SARSA 被定位为认知约束下的有界序贯学习模型，策略压缩与反应时由同一信息代价统一解释，且鲁棒性与容量不可兼得。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Integrating Local Detail and Global Context: A Dual-Input Multi-Task Learning Framework for Bone Tumor Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Primary bone tumors are rare but clinically aggressive neoplasms whose diagnosis from radiographs is challenged by heterogeneous morphology, subtle lesion margins, and overlapping bone structures. To address the limitations of existing single-view models, we present a dual-input, multi-task learning framework that, to our knowledge, is the first to apply bidirectional cross-modal attention between a lesion crop and the full radiograph for joint segmentation and subtype classification. Using the multi-institutional Bone Tumor X-ray Radiograph Dataset (BTXRD, n=3,746), we employ a YOLO-based detector to generate regions of interest, which are paired with full images as inputs to a dual-stream DenseNet121 architecture. Features are integrated via a novel cross-modal attention fusion strategy, refined by Hierarchical Multi-scale Feature Fusion, effectively balancing fine-grained lesion detail with global anatomical context. Evaluated on a held-out patient-level test split, the model demonstrates superior performance over single-input baselines, achieving an overall Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.896 and a macro-averaged classification F1-score of 0.928. Notably, the system exhibits exceptional sensitivity for malignant osteosarcoma (AUC 0.999), validating the potential of dual-stream context modeling to support radiologists in accurate, early decision-making.

papers.title: Unmasking Shortcut Learning in IoT Intrusion Detection: A Forensic, Multi-Paradigm Evaluation of Feature Dependence and Data Leakage
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems often report near-perfect performance on IoT benchmarks. However, whether these models learn generalizable attack behavior or exploit spurious dataset shortcuts- such as static testbed IP/MAC addresses and chronological recording artifacts-remains an important question. We evaluate the CyberFlowIoT-GICAP benchmark, containing 3,617,388 flow records across 126 PCAP sessions with 849,395 benign flows. Four learning paradigms are evaluated across four feature configurations using PCAP-disjoint splits; LightGBM is additionally evaluated using conventional random-flow splitting. When only statistical flow behavior is used (Fbehav), LightGBM (92.58% +/- 8.18%), Random Forest (92.59% +/- 8.18%), and Deep MLP (92.55% +/- 8.18%) achieve nearly identical Macro-F1, indicating that performance is constrained by feature representation rather than model complexity. With raw timestamps (Ftstamp), tree-based models reach 99.28% Macro-F1, while the linear model remains at 90.62%, showing that nonlinear models can exploit dataset-specific temporal structure. Attack detectability is highly asymmetric: high-rate and active attacks maintain >99.8% recall from flow behavior alone in nonlinear models, whereas the DNS Beaconing drops from 27.78% to 0.00% recall when contextual features are removed. Conventional random-flow splitting increases attack recall by up to 14.00%, highlighting the effect of placing flows from the same sessions in both training and test sets. We conclude with a 4-point protocol checklist for realistic IoT NIDS evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CyberFlowIoT-GICAP 基准上做取证式评估，发现 IoT 入侵检测的近满分成绩主要来自数据集捷径而非可泛化攻击行为：只用统计流行为 (Fbehav) 时三个模型 Macro-F1 都卡在 92.5% 左右，加入原始时间戳后树模型冲到 99.28% 而线性模型仍只有 90.62%。作者据此给出 4 条现实 IoT NIDS 评测协议清单。
Motivation: ML 入侵检测在 IoT 基准上常报近满分，但无法区分模型学到的是可泛化的攻击行为还是静态测试床 IP/MAC 地址与按时间录制这类虚假捷径，导致评测结论不可信。
Method: 评估 CyberFlowIoT-GICAP 基准（3,617,388 条流记录、126 个 PCAP 会话、849,395 条良性流），用 PCAP-disjoint 划分比较四种学习范式与四种特征配置（含 Fbehav 仅统计流行为、Ftstamp 含原始时间戳），LightGBM 另加常规随机流划分对照。
Result: Fbehav 下 LightGBM 92.58%±8.18%、Random Forest 92.59%±8.18%、Deep MLP 92.55%±8.18% Macro-F1 几乎相同；Ftstamp 下树模型达 99.28% Macro-F1 而线性模型仅 90.62%。非线性模型仅凭流行为对高速率与主动攻击召回 >99.8%，DNS Beaconing 在移除上下文特征后召回从 27.78% 跌到 0.00%；常规随机流划分使攻击召回最多提高 14.00%。
Conclusion: 性能瓶颈来自特征表示而非模型复杂度，随机流划分因把同一会话的流同时放进训练与测试而虚高召回；现实 IoT NIDS 评测应按其 4 点协议清单执行。

papers.title: Upholding Robustness in Federated Learning: Trends, Emerging Strategies, and Research Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: While Federated Learning (FL) has been widely adopted for protecting user privacy in machine learning, it remains vulnerable to various robustness challenges, including performance-impairment risks, information-stealing threats, and aggregation vulnerabilities. This work offers a holistic synthesis of FL robustness along three tightly coupled angles: (i) a threat-centric view of robustness that categorizes the multifaceted attack surfaces, (ii) a structured taxonomy of robust aggregation strategies distinguishing outcome-centric approaches from security-centric strategies, and (iii) a layered taxonomy of defensive strategies. We rigorously examine current evaluation practices for FL robustness and identify major applications and open research challenges to guide future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇联邦学习 (FL) 鲁棒性的综述，从威胁视角的攻击面分类、鲁棒聚合策略（区分 outcome-centric 与 security-centric）以及分层防御策略三个耦合角度做系统梳理，并审查当前 FL 鲁棒性的评估实践。结论是 FL 的性能损害、信息窃取与聚合漏洞三类风险需在威胁—聚合—防御三层框架下统一审视，而非各自独立处理。
Motivation: FL 虽被广泛用于保护用户隐私，但仍面临性能损害风险、信息窃取威胁与聚合漏洞等多类鲁棒性挑战，现有研究缺少统一的威胁与防御分类框架。
Method: 综述性工作：给出以威胁为中心的攻击面分类，构建区分 outcome-centric 与 security-centric 的结构化鲁棒聚合策略分类，以及分层防御策略分类；并审查当前 FL 鲁棒性评估实践、主要应用与开放研究问题。
Result: 产出三套相互耦合的分类体系（威胁视角、鲁棒聚合、分层防御），并系统审查现有评估实践、识别主要应用与开放研究挑战；全文 35 页、11 幅图、13 张表。
Conclusion: FL 鲁棒性问题应沿威胁—聚合—防御三层框架统一分类与评估，作者据此指出未来研究方向以指导后续工作。

papers.title: Exact Bayes Regret and Asymptotic Optimality in High-Dimensional Gaussian Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study Bayesian linear bandits with an isotropic Gaussian parameter, independent Gaussian candidate arms, and Gaussian reward noise when the horizon is proportional to the dimension. The normalized posterior uncertainty has an explicit limit that is uniform over all causal policies. Gaussian posterior identities then determine the limiting parameter overlaps without an assumed closure of the adaptive recursion. These results yield exact regret curves for Thompson sampling, posterior-mean greedy selection, and a family of policies that scale the posterior sampling covariance. The normalized realized cumulative regret converges in L1, uniformly on compact proportional-time intervals. A policy-uniform lower bound identifies the limiting optimal Bayes regret and proves that posterior-mean greedy selection attains it. Thompson sampling incurs a strictly larger leading regret; its instantaneous regret ratio relative to greedy selection lies between one and two and approaches two at long proportional horizons. Closed-form cumulative curves also identify a different comparison in the vanishing-noise limit. Finally, the instantaneous regret converges to a nondegenerate Gaussian decision-loss distribution, rather than to its mean. The analysis separates the amount of information acquired by a bandit policy from the quality of the decisions made using that information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在时域与维度成比例的高斯线性 bandit 中，后验均值贪心 (posterior-mean greedy) 达到策略一致下界给出的极限最优 Bayes regret，而 Thompson sampling 的领先项严格更大，其瞬时 regret 相对贪心的比值介于 1 与 2 之间并在长比例时域趋近 2。分析把策略获取的信息量与用该信息做决策的质量分离开。
Motivation: 自适应 bandit 的递归闭合通常靠假设，高维、时域与维度成比例时缺少对任意因果策略一致成立的后验极限刻画，也难判定哪条策略渐近最优。
Method: 设定为各向同性高斯参数、独立高斯臂与高斯奖励噪声的 Bayesian linear bandit；先证明归一化后验不确定性对所有因果策略一致的显式极限，再用 Gaussian 后验恒等式在不假设递归闭合的前提下确定参数重叠，导出 Thompson sampling、后验均值贪心与一族缩放后验采样协方差策略的精确 regret 曲线。
Result: 归一化实现累积 regret 在紧致比例时间区间上 L1 一致收敛；策略一致下界给出极限最优 Bayes regret 且后验均值贪心达到它；Thompson sampling 领先项严格更大，瞬时 regret 比值在 1 与 2 之间、长比例时域趋近 2；vanishing-noise 极限下闭式累积曲线给出另一比较；瞬时 regret 收敛到非退化的 Gaussian 决策损失分布而非其均值。
Conclusion: 在该高斯比例时域渐近下，后验均值贪心是渐近最优策略，Thompson sampling 有严格更高的领先 regret；regret 应拆成信息获取与决策质量两部分，且瞬时 regret 的波动本身不可忽略。

papers.title: Temporal Learning for End-Effector Position Estimation under Aerodynamic Disturbances in Aerial Continuum Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates temporal neural networks for \mbox{end-effector} position \mbox{estimation} of an aerial continuum manipulator (ACM) operating under aerodynamic effects induced by the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). An experimental dataset is collected under stationary (\mbox{rotor-off}) and \mbox{free-hovering} conditions across continuum robot (CR) configurations and UAV altitudes, providing \mbox{end-effector} position measurements with and without aerodynamic residuals. To establish a nominal framework, \mbox{strain-parameterized} kinematic models with progressively richer strain bases are evaluated to balance model complexity and prediction accuracy. The selected nominal model then serves as the baseline for 3D position residual estimation using a \mbox{closed-form} \mbox{continuous-time} (CfC) neural network, with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and a gated recurrent unit (GRU) used for comparison. On unseen test experiments, the CfC achieves an RMSE of \(22.00\pm1.70~\mathrm{mm}\) over five random seeds, compared with \(36.38\pm3.58~\mathrm{mm}\) for the MLP and \(27.72\pm2.92~\mathrm{mm}\) for the GRU, corresponding to reductions of \(39.52\%\) and \(20.62\%\), respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of \mbox{continuous-time} learning for \mbox{end-effector} position estimation under aerodynamic disturbances relative to static and \mbox{discrete-time} learning methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在气动扰动下的空中连续体机械臂 (aerial continuum manipulator) 末端位置估计中，用闭式连续时间神经网络 (closed-form continuous-time, CfC) 直接回归 3D 位置残差，优于静态 MLP 与离散时间 GRU。在未见测试实验上 CfC 的 RMSE 为 22.00±1.70 mm（5 个随机种子），相比 MLP 的 36.38±3.58 mm 降低 39.52%，相比 GRU 的 27.72±2.92 mm 降低 20.62%。
Motivation: UAV 旋翼产生的气动残余使连续体机械臂末端位置偏离应变参数化运动学模型的名义预测，静态与离散时间模型难以跟踪这类随时间演化的扰动。
Method: 先在转子关闭 (rotor-off) 与自由悬停 (free-hovering) 两种条件下采集覆盖不同连续体构型与 UAV 高度的实验数据集，用逐步增富的应变基 (strain-parameterized kinematic models) 选出名义模型作基线；再以 CfC 估计 3D 位置残差，并用 MLP 与 GRU 作对照，跨 5 个随机种子在未见测试实验上比较。
Result: 未见测试实验上 CfC RMSE 22.00±1.70 mm，MLP 36.38±3.58 mm，GRU 27.72±2.92 mm；CfC 相对 MLP 与 GRU 分别降低 39.52% 与 20.62%（各 5 个随机种子）。
Conclusion: 连续时间学习相对静态与离散时间方法更能捕捉气动扰动下的末端位置残差，是该类 ACM 位置估计的有效建模选择。

summary_sections.conclusion: 连续时间学习相对静态与离散时间方法更能捕捉气动扰动下的末端位置残差，是该类 ACM 位置估计的有效建模选择。

papers.title: An Explainable DistilBERT-BiLSTM-Attention Framework for Binary and Multi-Class Hate Speech Detection
papers.abstract_en: Hate speech on social media poses serious risks to social harmony, mental well-being, and public safety, making its timely and accurate detection essential for content moderation systems. Most existing studies focus on binary classification, evaluated their frameworks on a single dataset, and provide limited insight into how decisions are made, which limits their real-world applicability. In addition, limited work is done on the explainability of their predictive inference. To address these challenges, this study proposes a multilevel and explainable hate speech detection framework. The proposed model integrates DistilBERT (Distilled Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) embeddings with a Bi-LSTM (Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) model, and an attention mechanism to capture both contextual meaning and sequential dependencies in text. To enhance trust and transparency, LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) is employed to explain model predictions by highlighting influential textual features. The framework is evaluated on two benchmark datasets using both binary and multi-class classification to examine robustness and generalization. In addition, an ablation study is presented to highlight the significance of various components of proposed framework. For binary classification, the proposed model achieves F1-scores of 96.78% on the Davidson dataset and 99.53% on the SMHS dataset. In the multi-class setting, it attains F1-scores of 97.00% and 94.99% on the Davidson and SMHS datasets, respectively, outperforming existing baseline approaches. The results demonstrate that multilevel evaluation improves the reliability that the proposed framework effectively balances performance and efficiency. This makes the framework suitable for practical hate speech moderation systems that require accurate, generalizable, and explainable decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释的仇恨言论检测框架 DistilBERT-BiLSTM-Attention：用 DistilBERT 嵌入捕捉上下文语义，Bi-LSTM 建模序列依赖，attention 加权关键特征，再用 LIME 解释单条预测。在 Davidson 与 SMHS 两个基准上做二分类与多类分类，二分类 F1 分别为 96.78% 与 99.53%，多类 F1 为 97.00% 与 94.99%，并给出消融研究。
Motivation: 现有仇恨言论研究多停留在二分类、只在单一数据集上评测，且对预测依据的可解释性工作很少，难以支撑真实内容审核系统的可信部署。
Method: 以 DistilBERT 嵌入为输入，接 Bi-LSTM 提取序列依赖，再叠加 attention 机制突出有影响的文本特征；用 LIME 对预测做局部可解释说明，并在两个基准数据集上同时做二分类与多类分类评测，附带消融研究检验各组件贡献。
Result: 二分类 F1：Davidson 96.78%，SMHS 99.53%；多类分类 F1：Davidson 97.00%，SMHS 94.99%，摘要称优于现有基线方法。
Conclusion: 多层评测加可解释机制能让仇恨言论检测在性能与效率之间取得平衡，适用于需要准确、可泛化、可解释决策的实际审核系统。
