papers.title: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a categorical policy's expected score-gradient norm vanishes as its distribution sharpens, so the predictions that most need correction receive the weakest updates. We propose Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization (DEEPO), a dual-stage enhancement combining signal variance regularization with gradient preconditioning: semantic-entropy-triggered expert prefixes inject grounded continuations on high-uncertainty queries, providing direct supervision and restoring advantage variance, while advantage-sign-aware Renyi preconditioning counteracts logit-level saturation so correction reaches confident errors in the operational confidence regime. Both branches improve over GRPO individually; their interaction is statistically significant on VideoMMMU---the most complex long-horizon task in our evaluation suite (+4.0$, 95\% CI [1.1, 6.9])---and additive elsewhere. DEEPO reduces hallucination while preserving accuracy and training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEEPO 针对 RL 强化 MLLM 推理时幻觉改善不均的问题，定位到奖励到参数更新的两处断点：高语义熵的难题常整组答错使组相对优势归零，以及自信但错误的 token 因策略分布变尖而梯度不可见。它用语义熵触发的专家前缀注入接地续写恢复优势方差，用优势符号感知的 Renyi 预条件化打破 logit 饱和；两支单独均优于 GRPO，在 VideoMMMU 上交互效应显著（+4.0，95% CI [1.1, 6.9]），其余任务为可加。
Motivation: RL 提升 MLLM 推理的效果在幻觉上不一致：难题整组答错使组相对优势塌到零，自信错误 token 的期望分数梯度范数随分布变尖而消失，最该被纠正的预测反而得到最弱更新。
Method: DEEPO 是双阶段增强：语义熵触发的专家前缀 (expert prefixes) 在高不确定性查询上注入接地续写，提供直接监督并恢复优势方差；优势符号感知的 Renyi 预条件化 (advantage-sign-aware Renyi preconditioning) 对抗 logit 级饱和，使纠正能到达自信错误。
Result: 两支相对 GRPO 单独均有提升；在评估套件中最复杂的长程任务 VideoMMMU 上交互效应统计显著，+4.0，95% CI [1.1, 6.9]，其余任务为可加。DEEPO 降低幻觉，同时保持准确率与训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 幻觉改善不均源于修正链上优势方差塌缩与梯度不可见这两处信号断裂，同时修复两者可在降低幻觉的同时不牺牲准确率与训练稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leakage-Safe Machine Learning for Hydrogen Embrittlement Detection in 316L Stainless Steel: A Region-Held-Out Evaluation of Texture and Deep Features in SEM Micrographs
papers.abstract_en: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is routinely used to characterize the microstructural changes caused by hydrogen embrittlement (HE) in structural steels. Machine learning can automate this characterization, but models are often evaluated using image-level splits. When several images come from the same specimen region, such splits leak information between the training and test sets. Here, we propose a region-held-out protocol for classifying as-received (AR) and hydrogen-charged (H2) SEM micrographs of 316L stainless steel, based on Leave-One-Region-Out (LORO) cross-validation over 14 spatial regions (8 AR, 6 H2; 31 images). We compared six feature-classifier combinations built on local binary patterns (LBP), grey-level co-occurrence matrices (GLCM), self-supervised convolutional embeddings pretrained on 143 unlabeled SEM images, and a convolutional neural network (CNN). The simplest texture approach, LBP with a support vector machine (LBP+SVM), performed best, achieving a balanced accuracy of 0.79, H2 recall of 0.69, and H2 precision of 0.82, outperforming every deep-learning and combined-feature model. A group-level permutation test (500 permutations sampled from the 3,003 possible region-to-label assignments) yielded p = 0.008, indicating that the result cannot be explained by a chance alignment of the region structure. Grad-CAM maps from a CNN trained on the full dataset tended to concentrate on localized surface and grain-boundary features, where hydrogen-induced morphological changes are known to occur. Under a leakage-safe, statistically validated protocol, texture descriptors recover a hydrogen-charging signature from SEM micrographs even with few samples, and the same protocol can be extended to larger HE detection studies in other alloy systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 SEM 氢脆 (HE) 检测中图像级划分导致的训练/测试信息泄漏，提出 Leave-One-Region-Out (LORO) 区域留出协议，在 316L 不锈钢 14 个空间区域上评测六种特征-分类器组合。最简单的 LBP+SVM 取得最佳：balanced accuracy 0.79、H2 recall 0.69、H2 precision 0.82，胜过全部深度学习与混合特征模型；500 次置换检验 p = 0.008。
Motivation: 同一试样区域的多张图像被随机分到训练与测试集会造成信息泄漏，使氢脆 SEM 分类的评估结果虚高，小样本下尤其严重。
Method: 在 14 个空间区域（8 AR、6 H2，共 31 张图像）上做 Leave-One-Region-Out 交叉验证；比较六种组合：LBP、GLCM、基于 143 张无标注 SEM 自监督预训练的卷积 embedding，以及 CNN；用 group-level permutation test（500 次置换，取自 3,003 种区域-标签分配）检验显著性，并用 Grad-CAM 查看 CNN 关注区域。
Result: LBP+SVM balanced accuracy 0.79、H2 recall 0.69、H2 precision 0.82，优于其余五种深度学习与组合特征模型；置换检验 p = 0.008；Grad-CAM 显示 CNN 倾向聚焦表面与晶界处的局部特征。
Conclusion: 在泄漏安全且经统计检验的协议下，纹理描述子即便样本很少也能从 SEM 图像中恢复氢充注特征；该协议可推广到其他合金体系的更大规模 HE 检测研究。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对 SEM 氢脆 (HE) 检测中图像级划分导致的训练/测试信息泄漏，提出 Leave-One-Region-Out (LORO) 区域留出协议，在 316L 不锈钢 14 个空间区域上评测六种特征-分类器组合。最简单的 LBP+SVM 取得最佳：balanced accuracy 0.79、H2 recall 0.69、H2 precision 0.82，胜过全部深度学习与混合特征模型；500 次置换检验 p = 0.008。
summary_sections.motivation: 同一试样区域的多张图像被随机分到训练与测试集会造成信息泄漏，使氢脆 SEM 分类的评估结果虚高，小样本下尤其严重。
summary_sections.method: 在 14 个空间区域（8 AR、6 H2，共 31 张图像）上做 Leave-One-Region-Out 交叉验证；比较六种组合：LBP、GLCM、基于 143 张无标注 SEM 自监督预训练的卷积 embedding，以及 CNN；用 group-level permutation test（500 次置换，取自 3,003 种区域-标签分配）检验显著性，并用 Grad-CAM 查看 CNN 关注区域。

papers.title: When Explanations Cannot Be Read: Measuring and Correcting SHAP and LIME Rendering for Right-to-Left Languages
papers.abstract_en: Post hoc explanation methods such as SHAP and LIME are widely used to interpret text classifiers, but their visualizations are mainly designed for left-to-right languages. When applied to right-to-left (RTL) languages such as Urdu, Arabic, Persian, and Hebrew, the attribution values remain mathematically valid, while their visual presentation fails. Tokens appear out of sequence, connected letterforms break apart, and plot layouts do not follow the natural reading direction. This study addresses this gap as a visualization problem rather than a limitation of the explanation methods themselves. We present SHAP-RTL, a rendering layer that corrects reading direction and script shaping in SHAP and LIME visualizations, with per-language font selection, while preserving the original attribution values, feature ordering, and model outputs. The approach is evaluated on Urdu, Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian hate and offensive-language datasets using TF-IDF and logistic regression classifiers. Rendering correctness is measured by an OCR round trip over 200 feature words per language. Default rendering yields character error rates of 0.820 to 0.979, meaning the label no longer carries its token; the common reshape-and-reorder workaround fails for Urdu at 0.998, worse than no correction; and the Matplotlib 3.11.0 text rewrite inverts that workaround, while SHAP-RTL remains correct under both versions. The framework also verbalizes the same attributions as short contextual explanations in the reader's language, constrained to the identified features. Evaluation in this paper concerns rendering correctness; assessment of the generated explanations is left to future work. The study highlights the importance of language-aware visualization in making post hoc explainability more accessible across different writing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHAP-RTL 是一个渲染层，修正 SHAP/LIME 在阿拉伯语、乌尔都语、希伯来语、波斯语等 RTL 语言可视化中的阅读方向与连写字形 (script shaping)，并按语言选字体，同时保持原始归因值、特征排序与模型输出不变。OCR 往返测试显示默认渲染的字符错误率 (CER) 达 0.820–0.979，常见 reshape-and-reorder 变通在乌尔都语上为 0.998（比不修正还差），而 SHAP-RTL 在 Matplotlib 3.11.0 文本重写前后都保持正确。
Motivation: SHAP 与 LIME 的可视化按从左到右书写设计，套用到 RTL 语言时归因值在数学上仍有效，但 token 顺序错乱、连写字母断裂、版面方向不符，标签不再对应其 token，可解释性对这些语言的读者失效。
Method: 提出 SHAP-RTL 渲染层，修正阅读方向与 script shaping，含按语言的字体选择，不改动归因值、特征排序与模型输出；在 Urdu、Arabic、Hebrew、Persian 的仇恨与冒犯语言数据集上用 TF-IDF 加 logistic regression 分类器，渲染正确性用 OCR 往返测试衡量，每种语言 200 个特征词；另把同一批归因转写为读者语言的短上下文解释，约束在已识别特征上。
Result: 默认渲染的 CER 为 0.820 到 0.979；reshape-and-reorder 变通在 Urdu 上 CER 0.998，比完全不修正更差；Matplotlib 3.11.0 的文本重写使该变通结果反转，而 SHAP-RTL 在两个 Matplotlib 版本下都保持正确。评测范围是渲染正确性，生成式解释的评估留待后续工作。
Conclusion: RTL 语言下 SHAP/LIME 的问题出在可视化渲染而非解释方法本身，语言感知的渲染层即可修复，且需跨 Matplotlib 版本稳定；生成解释的质量尚未评估。

papers.title: Don't Read the Log: Execution Traces Contaminate Verifiers in Video-Generation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic video-generation systems close a loop between a generator and a verifier: an LLM plans shots, calls a text-to-video model, and a multimodal judge decides whether the result satisfies the request. To diagnose where a long workflow fails, recent harnesses deliberately show the judge more than the video-the agent's execution trace, its plan, the narration it synthesized. We ask whether this auxiliary text moves the judge's verdict on purely \emph{visual} requirements, holding the frames fixed. On a benchmark of 109 generated two-event clips with manual labels, in which the requested event is either visibly completed or visibly missing, a trace that reports a successful tool call makes three open-weight Qwen-VL judges (7B, 8B, 32B) accept $78$--$90\%$ of the failures, up from $7$--$19\%$ without text, and a contradicting trace makes them reject up to $100\%$ of correct clips; an instruction to ``use only the frames'' does not remove the effect. Frontier closed judges are essentially unmoved on the same clips, showing that the vulnerability is a property of the judge's learned trust in tool logs rather than of the task. Plan-derived text carries no clip-specific information, so it can only shift a judge's operating point, and in a repair loop that shift becomes a cap on the true pass rate that no repair policy can exceed; the cap matches simulation to two decimals. In the loop, contamination is exploited without any adversarial agent: an honest LLM planner that always regenerates ends with a judge pass rate of $1.00$ and a human-labelled pass rate of $0.28$, and a pipeline in which a cheap checker writes its verdict into the trace launders that checker's errors into a stronger final judge ($0.69$ false accepts).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在视频生成 agent 的生成器-验证器闭环里，把执行轨迹、计划、旁白等辅助文本喂给多模态 judge，会系统性地把 judge 的判定从画面本身挪开：在 109 条人工标注的双事件片段上，报告工具调用成功的轨迹让 Qwen-VL 7B/8B/32B 接受 78–90% 的失败片段（无文本时仅 7–19%），矛盾轨迹让它们拒绝多达 100% 的正确片段，而“只看帧”的指令无法消除该效应。作者据此给出结论：计划派生文本不含片段信息，只能平移 judge 的工作点，在修复循环里构成任何修复策略都无法突破的真实通过率上限。
Motivation: 近期 harness 为诊断长流程失败，刻意把执行轨迹等辅助文本展示给 judge，但这些文本是否会在帧固定的情况下改变 judge 对纯视觉要求的判定尚不清楚；若会，闭环中的判定偏移会直接污染视频生成的自动验证。
Method: 构造 109 条含两个事件、人工标注“请求事件可见完成或可见缺失”的生成片段基准，固定画面帧，只操纵喂给 judge 的文本（成功工具调用轨迹、矛盾轨迹、“只用帧”指令），对比三个开源 Qwen-VL judge（7B、8B、32B）与前沿闭源 judge；再用仿真与修复循环实验刻画偏移的后果。
Result: 成功轨迹使 Qwen-VL 三档 judge 接受 78–90% 的失败片段，无文本时为 7–19%；矛盾轨迹使其拒绝多达 100% 的正确片段；“只用帧”指令不消除效应，前沿闭源 judge 基本不受影响。仿真给出的通过率上限与实测吻合到小数点后两位；诚实的 LLM planner 总是重生成时，judge 通过率 1.00 而人工标注通过率仅 0.28；廉价 checker 把判定写进轨迹时，最终强 judge 的误接受率为 0.69。
Conclusion: 轨迹污染是 judge 对工具日志的习得信任所致而非任务属性，计划派生文本只能平移判定工作点，因而在修复循环中形成真实通过率的硬上限；把判定写回轨迹会把廉价 checker 的错误洗成更强 judge 的误接受。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SpaFactor: Lightweight Spatial Context-Aware Gene Program Modeling for Histology-to-Transcriptomics Inference
papers.abstract_en: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) profiles gene expression within tissue architecture, but its cost and experimental complexity limit routine use. Predicting spatial expression from routinely available hematoxylin and eosin (HE) images therefore offers a scalable alternative. However, conventional methods often fit high-dimensional gene outputs as independent targets, overlooking the biological coordination among genes while remaining vulnerable to high-dimensional noise and overfitting. Existing attempts to address this limitation often rely on computationally heavy graph networks or complex auxiliary supervision. We therefore introduce SpaFactor, a lightweight and efficient low-rank morphology-program-gene factorization framework. At the input, SpaFactor efficiently fuses the visual representation of the central spot with multiscale local and regional neighborhood context, yielding a histologic representation that captures cellular morphology and microenvironmental heterogeneity. For modeling, a residual MLP stably learns a nonlinear mapping from the tissue microenvironment to low-dimensional latent gene programs. These activities are decoded through shared gene loadings into coordinated multi-gene expression predictions. Across five public cohorts, SpaFactor achieves the best aggregate performance, with particularly clear improvements for spatially variable genes, and more faithfully recovers biologically organized spatial patterns. These results demonstrate that lightweight joint modeling of tissue context and gene programs can improve both predictive accuracy and biological fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpaFactor 用低秩形态-程序-基因分解把 HE 图像到空间转录组的预测从逐基因独立回归改成共享基因载荷的联合建模：输入端融合中心 spot 的视觉表征与多尺度局部/区域邻域上下文，残差 MLP 映射到低维 latent gene programs，再经共享载荷解码成协调的多基因表达。在五个公开队列上取得最佳综合表现，对空间可变基因 (spatially variable genes) 的提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 常规方法把高维基因输出当作独立目标拟合，忽略基因间的生物学协同，且易受高维噪声影响而过拟合；已有补救依赖计算量大的图网络或复杂的辅助监督。
Method: 低秩形态-程序-基因分解框架：输入端融合中心 spot 视觉表征与多尺度局部及区域邻域上下文得到组织学表征；残差 MLP 学习组织微环境到低维 latent gene programs 的非线性映射；程序活性经共享基因载荷解码为多基因表达预测。
Result: 在五个公开队列上取得最佳综合性能 (best aggregate performance)，对空间可变基因的改进尤其清晰，并更忠实地恢复生物学上有组织的空间模式。
Conclusion: 轻量级地联合建模组织上下文与基因程序，可以在不引入重型图网络的前提下同时提升预测精度与生物学保真度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Matrix Aggregation Operators
authors: Humberto Bustince (3 and 4) ((1) Faculty of Statistical Studies
Complutense University of Madrid (2) Instituto Universitario de Estadística y Ciencia de Datos
Complutense University of Madrid (3) Department of Statistics
Universidad Pública de Navarra (4) Institute of Smart Cities (ISC)
Universidad Pública de Navarra (5) Faculty of Mathematics
Complutense University of Madrid (6) Instituto de Matemática Interdisciplinar
papers.abstract_en: Aggregation theory has traditionally focused on operators defined over vectors. However, many applications-including Multi-Criteria Decision Making, Group Decision Making, Fuzzy Rule-Based Classification Systems, and overlap/grouping indices-require aggregating information naturally structured as a matrix of membership degrees (e.g., where a set of objects interacts with a family of fuzzy sets). Despite this, no formal framework has been proposed for this class of operators, partly due to the common practice of flattening matrices into vectors (which discards structural information) and partly due to a reliance on decomposable operators that aggregate rows and columns sequentially. This paper addresses this gap by formalizing the notion of a matrix aggregation operator (MAO). We analyze the decomposability and symmetry properties of MAOs, showing that certain operators cannot be expressed in decomposable form and examining several notions of symmetry. Finally, we introduce a family of MAOs termed maximum entropy global coverage indices (MEGCIs), provide a construction method for them based on combining grouping functions and MEOWA operators, and illustrate their usefulness in cluster quality assessment through an extensive computational study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为矩阵结构的隶属度聚合给出首个形式化框架：定义 matrix aggregation operator (MAO)，分析其可分解性与对称性，证明某些算子无法写成分解形式，并提出基于 grouping functions 与 MEOWA 组合构造的 maximum entropy global coverage indices (MEGCIs)。MEGCI 通过计算研究被用于聚类质量评估。
Motivation: 多准则决策、群体决策、模糊规则分类与 overlap/grouping 指数需要聚合天然呈矩阵的隶属度，但既有理论只覆盖向量，实践中靠把矩阵拉平成向量（丢失结构信息）或按行列顺序分解聚合来绕过。
Method: 形式化定义 MAO，分析其可分解性与多种对称性概念；再提出一族 MEGCI，构造方式为组合 grouping functions 与 MEOWA (maximum entropy ordered weighted averaging) 算子，并在聚类质量评估场景中做计算研究。
Result: 证明存在无法表示为可分解形式的矩阵聚合算子，并考察了若干对称性概念；给出 MEGCI 一族及其基于 grouping functions 与 MEOWA 的构造方法，通过一项扩展计算研究说明其在聚类质量评估中的用处。
Conclusion: 矩阵聚合需要独立于向量聚合的正式理论，可分解性并非普遍成立；MEGCI 这类基于最大熵全局覆盖的指标可直接用于聚类质量评估。

summary_sections.result: 证明存在无法表示为可分解形式的矩阵聚合算子，并考察了若干对称性概念；给出 MEGCI 一族及其基于 grouping functions 与 MEOWA 的构造方法，通过一项扩展计算研究说明其在聚类质量评估中的用处。
summary_sections.conclusion: 矩阵聚合需要独立于向量聚合的正式理论，可分解性并非普遍成立；MEGCI 这类基于最大熵全局覆盖的指标可直接用于聚类质量评估。

papers.title: CARE: Condition-Aware Representation Regularization for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models highlight the importance of representation regularization for improving sample quality and training efficiency. However, commonly used regularization methods often overlook the built-in conditions (such as labels or texts) which directly determine the generation target. In this work, we demonstrate how conditioning signals affect the feature distribution and introduce the CARE (Condition-Aware REpresentation regularization). CARE is a lightweight plug-and-play regularization framework that dynamically modulates feature distribution based on condition similarity. CARE leverages built-in conditioning signals to judiciously guide the representation space, promoting tighter feature clusters for similar conditions without relying on explicit alignment losses or external supervision. Empirically, CARE consistently improves both visual fidelity and convergence stability across both class-to-image and text-to-image tasks. On ImageNet, CARE achieves a 19.08\% reduction in FID in 400k training steps, leading to a 3.5$\times$ speed-up. When applied to text-to-image generation, CARE lowers FID by 16.61\% in 200k iterations and improves semantic alignment between generated samples and text prompts. Moreover, CARE can be seamlessly integrated with existing regularization methods, yielding additional performance gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE 是面向扩散模型的轻量即插即用正则框架：按条件相似度动态调制特征分布，让相似条件的特征簇更紧，且不引入显式对齐损失或外部监督。在 ImageNet 类生成上 400k 步内 FID 降低 19.08%，带来 3.5 倍训练加速；文本到图像 200k 迭代 FID 降低 16.61% 并改善文本-图像语义对齐。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的表示正则方法忽略了标签、文本这类直接决定生成目标的内置条件，无法按条件关系塑造特征空间。
Method: CARE 利用内置条件信号计算条件相似度，据此动态调制特征分布，促进相似条件的特征簇收紧；不依赖显式对齐损失或外部监督，可作为即插即用模块与已有正则方法叠加。
Result: ImageNet 类到图像任务在 400k 训练步内 FID 降低 19.08%，对应 3.5 倍训练加速；文本到图像生成在 200k 迭代内 FID 降低 16.61%，并提升生成样本与文本提示的语义对齐；与已有正则方法结合可获得额外增益。
Conclusion: 把内置条件信号纳入表示正则，可以在不加外部监督的前提下同时改善扩散模型的视觉保真度、收敛稳定性与训练效率，且与既有正则方法兼容。

papers.title: Speculative Evaluation of Stochastic LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating a stochastic large language model is costly: benchmark scores estimate expected performance from randomized rollouts, yet uniform repetition ignores sharp differences in task-level rollout variance. We ask how to minimize the variance of a fixed-benchmark mean under an exact rollout budget. We develop Speculative Evaluation with a Hierarchical Bayesian Neyman (HBN) policy with pilot size and stage weight jointly chosen ex ante. It runs a short uniform pilot, pools per-task success counts with a hierarchical Bayesian model, and uses posterior expectations of task-level sampling variances for exact positive-integer Neyman allocation. To mitigate the pilot synchronization barrier, HBN-async speculatively executes continuations from partial pilot feedback and retains those selected by the final allocation. Across six checkpoints and 18 benchmark groups, we evaluate 107 nondegenerate benchmark-checkpoint profiles. For rollout budgets of 8-64 per task, Speculative Evaluation reduces variance relative to Uniform by 12.8%-33.6% on average across profiles, outperforming hindsight-tuned empirical and independent Bayesian baselines. Real-generation experiments that account for the pilot synchronization barrier show that HBN-async mitigates its overhead, helping translate statistical efficiency into practical evaluation benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对随机 LLM 基准评测中均匀重复采样浪费预算，提出分层贝叶斯 Neyman 分配 (HBN)：先跑短 pilot，用分层贝叶斯模型汇总各任务成功次数，按后验期望的任务级方差做正整数 Neyman 分配；HBN-async 用部分 pilot 反馈提前执行续跑以绕开同步等待。在 6 个 checkpoint、18 个 benchmark 组的 107 个非退化 profile 上，每任务 rollout 预算 8–64 时相对 Uniform 平均降方差 12.8%–33.6%，并优于事后调优的经验与独立贝叶斯基线。
Motivation: 随机 LLM 的基准分数靠重复 rollout 估计期望性能，均匀重复忽略任务间 rollout 方差的巨大差异，在固定 rollout 预算下评测均值方差偏高且成本昂贵。
Method: Speculative Evaluation with a Hierarchical Bayesian Neyman (HBN) policy：pilot 规模与阶段权重事前联合选定；跑短的均匀 pilot，用分层贝叶斯模型汇总各任务成功计数，取任务级采样方差的后验期望做精确正整数 Neyman 分配。HBN-async 从部分 pilot 反馈投机执行续跑，只保留最终分配选中的那些。
Result: 在 6 个 checkpoint、18 个 benchmark 组共 107 个非退化 benchmark-checkpoint profile 上，每任务 rollout 预算 8–64 时相对 Uniform 平均降方差 12.8%–33.6%，优于事后调优的经验基线与独立贝叶斯基线；真实生成实验表明 HBN-async 缓解了 pilot 同步开销。
Conclusion: 按任务级方差做分层贝叶斯 Neyman 分配能在固定评测预算下系统性降低随机 LLM 基准均值的方差，而异步投机执行是把统计效率转成实际评测收益的必要环节。

papers.title: Who Is Behind the Harness? Fingerprinting LLMs through Agentic Behavior
papers.abstract_en: LLMs increasingly operate through coding-agent harnesses that inspect repositories, invoke tools, and modify files. Substituting the model behind such an agent can therefore change security-relevant decisions, including whether it verifies changes or recovers safely from failures. Existing LLM fingerprints largely infer identity from direct text or token distributions. In coding agents, these signals are mediated by system instructions, controller logic, tools, and execution feedback, limiting their transfer. We present LIDAR (LLM Identification from Decisions and Actions at Runtime), an active black-box fingerprinting method for coding-agent execution. Three coding probe pairs expose post-edit verification, transient-failure recovery, and specification--test conflict resolution under controlled changes. LIDAR represents the resulting trajectories with complementary instance-level and distribution-level features and compares them with clean references using a lightweight probabilistic identifier. It requires no access to model weights, logits, or provider internals. Across 36 models from seven families and two agent harnesses, LIDAR achieves high Top-1 accuracy and MRR and outperforms four existing fingerprinting and API-auditing baselines. Ablations confirm that the two feature levels, all probe pairs, and their controlled variants contribute. These results show that agent execution behavior provides model-identity evidence beyond final outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LIDAR 是面向 coding-agent 执行过程的主动黑盒指纹方法：用三组 coding probe 诱发编辑后验证、瞬时故障恢复、规格-测试冲突解决三类轨迹，再以实例级与分布级特征对照干净参考做轻量概率识别。在 7 个模型家族共 36 个模型、两种 agent harness 上取得高 Top-1 准确率与 MRR，超过四个已有指纹与 API 审计基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 指纹依赖直接文本或 token 分布，但在 coding agent 中这些信号被系统指令、控制器逻辑、工具与执行反馈中介，跨 harness 迁移受限；而替换模型会改变安全相关决策。
Method: LIDAR (LLM Identification from Decisions and Actions at Runtime) 是主动黑盒方法：三组 coding probe 在受控改动下暴露 post-edit verification、transient-failure recovery、specification-test conflict resolution；轨迹用实例级与分布级互补特征表示，再与 clean reference 用轻量概率识别器比对，不需要权重、logits 或厂商内部信息。
Result: 在 36 个模型、7 个家族、两种 agent harness 上取得高 Top-1 accuracy 与 MRR，优于四个已有指纹与 API 审计基线；消融显示两个特征层级、全部 probe 及其受控变体均有贡献。
Conclusion: agent 执行行为本身携带超出最终输出的模型身份证据，可在不接触权重与 logits 的黑盒条件下做模型替换审计。

papers.title: CFD Correction of Open Tip Clearance Flow in a Compressor Cascade Using VAE Latent Space Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: CFD predictions of open tip clearance flow in compressor cascades are subject to discrepancies relative to experiments, while experimental observations are sparse and high-resolution experimental ground truth is unavailable. This study proposes a non-intrusive correction method based on a variational autoencoder (VAE) and latent-space adaptation. A VAE is first trained using a dataset of 166 parametrically sampled CFD total pressure loss fields to learn a low-dimensional statistical representation of these fields. The VAE is then frozen, and a low-rank latent-space adapter is trained using only 12 paired CFD--experiment operating conditions. An observation operator maps the corrected high-resolution fields to the experimental observation space, allowing supervision to be applied only at the available measurement locations and within the measured pitchwise windows. In the current 12-fold cross-validation, the mean absolute error decreases from 0.1335 to 0.0473, the root mean square error from 0.1717 to 0.0621, and the relative $L_2$ error from 0.5108 to 0.1871. These results indicate that the method improves agreement between CFD predictions and sparse experimental observations of open tip clearance flow without modifying the RANS solver or constructing artificial high-resolution experimental labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对压气机叶栅端部间隙流 CFD 与稀疏实验观测的偏差，提出基于 VAE 与低秩 latent-space adapter 的非侵入式修正：冻结在 166 个参数化 CFD 总压损失场上训练的 VAE，仅用 12 组 CFD–实验配对工况训练适配器，经观测算子在测量位置施加监督。12 折交叉验证下 MAE 从 0.1335 降到 0.0473，RMSE 从 0.1717 降到 0.0621，相对 L2 误差从 0.5108 降到 0.1871。
Motivation: 压气机叶栅端部间隙流的 CFD 预测与实验存在偏差，而实验观测稀疏、缺乏高分辨率实验真值，传统修正难以在不改动 RANS 求解器的前提下利用这些稀疏数据。
Method: 先用 166 个参数化采样的 CFD 总压损失场训练 VAE 学习低维统计表示，再冻结 VAE，仅用 12 组 CFD–实验配对工况训练低秩 latent-space adapter；观测算子把修正后的高分辨率场映射到实验观测空间，监督只施加在可用测量位置与实测 pitchwise 窗口内。
Result: 12 折交叉验证中，MAE 从 0.1335 降至 0.0473，RMSE 从 0.1717 降至 0.0621，相对 L2 误差从 0.5108 降至 0.1871。
Conclusion: 冻结生成模型低维表示、只在 latent 空间做低秩适配并按稀疏观测位置监督，可在不修改 RANS 求解器、不构造人工高分辨率实验标签的情况下，提高 CFD 与稀疏实验观测的一致性。

papers.title: BaseCamp --- An Agentic AI Framework for Automating DNA Sequencing Data Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: DNA sequencing pipelines, spanning quality control, alignment, variant calling, and annotation, are now reliably executed by workflow management systems that orchestrate established bioinformatics tools at scale. What remains manual is the decision layer surrounding that execution: selecting quality thresholds appropriate to a sample and platform, adjudicating borderline variant calls, diagnosing anomalies, and determining which findings warrant expert review. These decisions are repetitive, judgment-intensive, inconsistent across operators, and frequently undocumented. This paper introduces BaseCamp, a novel agentic AI framework for automating the decision layer of DNA sequencing pipelines. The framework decomposes the pipeline into six specialized AI agents, covering sample intake and quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, cross-stage monitoring, and reporting. Critically, BaseCamp agents do not perform sequence analysis: established tools execute alignment, calling, and annotation, while the agents select among them, configure them, interpret their output, and decide what follows. This confines language model reasoning to the judgment layer where it is reliable and preserves the reproducibility existing tooling guarantees. Agent reasoning is powered by a consortium of fine-tuned, domain-specialized large language models coordinated by a central reasoning LLM, executing locally so no sequencing data leaves the operating environment, under human-in-the-loop orchestration. Evaluation shows agent-generated configurations are concordant with expert practice, that an explicit filtering ledger renders inspectable what filtering otherwise removes without trace, and that cross-stage anomaly detection surfaces conditions execution monitoring misses. BaseCamp offers a generalizable blueprint for agentic automation of scientific data pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BaseCamp 把 DNA 测序流程的执行层留给既有生信工具，用六个专职 AI agent 接管判断层：选质控阈值、裁定边界变异、诊断异常、决定哪些结果需专家复核。agent 由微调领域 LLM 加中央推理 LLM 在本地协同驱动，人在回路编排，序列数据不出运行环境。评估显示 agent 生成的配置与专家实践一致，显式过滤台账 (filtering ledger) 让原本无痕的过滤可检查，跨阶段异常检测能发现执行监控漏掉的情况。
Motivation: 测序流程的执行已由工作流管理系统可靠完成，但围绕执行的判断层——按样本和平台选阈值、裁定边界变异调用、诊断异常、决定是否送专家复核——仍靠人工，重复、依赖判断、操作者间不一致且常无记录。
Method: 将流程拆成六个专职 AI agent，覆盖样本接收与质控、比对、变异调用、注释、跨阶段监控与报告；agent 不做序列分析，只负责选择工具、配置参数、解读输出并决定下一步。推理由一组微调的领域专用 LLM 加一个中央推理 LLM 协同完成，全部本地执行，采用 human-in-the-loop 编排。
Result: 评估显示 agent 生成的配置与专家实践一致；显式过滤台账使原本不留痕的过滤变得可检查；跨阶段异常检测能浮现出执行监控遗漏的状况。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 推理限制在判断层而非序列分析本身，可在保留既有工具可复现性的同时自动化科学数据流程的决策环节，该蓝图可推广到其他科学数据管线。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Pistis Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Pistis model family, comprising 27B- and 9B-parameter multimodal large language models built on Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.5, respectively, and developed through a general and scalable post-training framework. The framework first establishes a strong foundation through large-scale multimodal supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Building on this SFT foundation, we propose Interleaved Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (IDRL), a novel post-training paradigm that tightly integrates on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning within a single training loop. By alternating between the two objectives, rather than optimizing either in isolation or combining them in a static joint loss, IDRL enables more effective knowledge transfer, greater optimization stability, and more precise credit assignment for long-horizon agentic trajectories, leading to stronger performance while mitigating common capability trade-offs. At both model scales, the framework produces two specialized variants: Pistis-Thinking, designed to strengthen deep multimodal reasoning, and Pistis-Agentic, which additionally incorporates agentic trajectory data to support long-horizon planning, iterative reasoning, and tool use. Pistis-Agentic is particularly strong in multimodal search. Both scales outperform their corresponding base models. Beyond model-parameter optimization, we further introduce Pistis-Auto-Harnessing (PAH), a system-level method that automatically improves the agent's inference harness through iterative optimization. Experiments demonstrate that PAH enhances the model performance without updating the model parameters or increasing the interaction budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pistis 提出把 on-policy 蒸馏与强化学习交替放进同一训练循环的后训练范式 IDRL，在 Qwen3.6/Qwen3.5 基座上做 27B 与 9B 多模态模型，产出面向深推理的 Pistis-Thinking 与面向长程工具使用的 Pistis-Agentic。两个规模都超过各自基座，Pistis-Agentic 在多模态搜索上尤其强；配套的 Pistis-Auto-Harnessing 在不更新参数、不增加交互预算的前提下进一步提升性能。
Motivation: 多模态大模型后训练中，蒸馏与 RL 常被孤立优化或用静态联合损失拼接，导致长程 agentic 轨迹上的 credit assignment 不准、优化不稳，并伴随能力此消彼长。
Method: 先做大规模多模态 SFT 打底，再提出 Interleaved Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (IDRL)：在同一训练循环内交替优化 on-policy 蒸馏与 RL 目标；每个规模分出 Pistis-Thinking（深多模态推理）与 Pistis-Agentic（加入 agentic 轨迹数据，支持长程规划与工具使用）两个变体；另提出系统级方法 Pistis-Auto-Harnessing (PAH) 迭代优化 agent 的推理 harness。
Result: 模型规模为 27B（基于 Qwen3.6）与 9B（基于 Qwen3.5）；两个规模的框架产物都优于各自 base model；Pistis-Agentic 在多模态搜索上表现尤强；PAH 在不更新模型参数、不增加交互预算的条件下提升模型性能。
Conclusion: 蒸馏与 RL 交替而非静态联合，是多模态后训练中更有效的知识迁移与 credit assignment 路径；性能还能通过优化推理 harness 而非模型参数继续获得。

papers.title: SMILESGNN: Interpretable Clinical Toxicity Prediction via SMILES-Graph Cross-Attention Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Drug toxicity prediction is critical for reducing late-stage attrition in drug discovery, yet remains challenging due to severe class imbalance, scaffold-based generalization, and the clinical need for interpretable predictions. Single-modality approaches-SMILES Transformers or graph neural networks capture complementary aspects of molecular structure, while sequence-only models cannot directly provide graph-attributed explanations. We present SMILESGNN, a multimodal architecture that fuses a SMILES Transformer encoder and a GATv2 graph encoder via cross-attention, and SMILESGNN-PT, a variant using a ChemBERTa-2 pretrained backbone. The design retains an explicit graph branch within the predictive pipeline, supporting GNNExplainer-based analysis of substructures associated with toxic predictions. On ClinTox, SMILESGNN achieves AUC-ROC 0.987 and F1 0.906 with only 0.4M parameters, performing competitively with a strong SMILESTransformer and a larger ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 concat-fusion baseline. On Tox21 (12 tasks), SMILESGNN-PT obtains mean AUC-ROC 0.750, comparable to ChemBERTa-2 alone and the same-backbone concat-fusion baseline. Overall, the results suggest that cross-attention is a practical fusion alternative that preserves competitive predictive performance while enabling graph-based interpretability support.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMILESGNN 用交叉注意力把 SMILES Transformer 编码器与 GATv2 图编码器融合，并保留显式图分支以支持 GNNExplainer 解释。在 ClinTox 上以 0.4M 参数取得 AUC-ROC 0.987、F1 0.906，与更强的 SMILES Transformer 及更大的 ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 拼接融合基线相当；Tox21 12 任务上 SMILESGNN-PT 平均 AUC-ROC 0.750，与 ChemBERTa-2 单模态及同骨干拼接基线相当。
Motivation: 药物毒性预测受严重类别不平衡、基于骨架的泛化与临床可解释性需求制约；单模态方法（SMILES Transformer 或 GNN）各捕获分子结构的不同侧面，纯序列模型无法给出图归因解释。
Method: SMILESGNN 以交叉注意力融合 SMILES Transformer 编码器与 GATv2 图编码器；SMILESGNN-PT 用 ChemBERTa-2 预训练骨干。预测管线中保留显式图分支，用 GNNExplainer 分析与毒性预测相关的子结构。
Result: ClinTox 上 SMILESGNN AUC-ROC 0.987、F1 0.906，参数量仅 0.4M，与强 SMILES Transformer 及更大的 ChemBERTa-2/GATv2 concat-fusion 基线表现相当。Tox21（12 任务）上 SMILESGNN-PT 平均 AUC-ROC 0.750，与 ChemBERTa-2 单独使用及同骨干 concat-fusion 基线相当。
Conclusion: 交叉注意力是一种实用的融合替代方案，在保持竞争力的预测性能的同时支持基于图的可解释性。

papers.title: An Order-Theoretic Characterization of Consistent Inductive Inference
papers.abstract_en: When can a learner make only finitely many prediction errors along every infinite sequence labeled by a fixed, unknown hypothesis? We characterize this form of consistency for arbitrary binary hypothesis classes in ZFC, without requiring a uniform mistake bound. The characterization uses a single linear order on finite realizable traces. Each trace selects its least subtrace, and the order must satisfy two conditions: conflicting traces select different subtraces, and the order is well-founded on the traces of each fixed target. These conditions induce a learner whose selected evidence decreases on every mistake. Conversely, a consistent learner yields such an order through canonical mistake transcripts and the Kleene--Brouwer ordering. The result provides a representation of consistent prediction by finite evidence, answering a question of Lu (2024).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ZFC 中给出二值假设类上「沿任意由固定未知目标标注的无限序列只犯有限次错误」这一一致性形式的序论刻画：在可实现有限轨迹上定义一个线性序，每个轨迹取其最小子轨迹，且该序满足冲突轨迹取不同子轨迹、对每个固定目标的轨迹良基两个条件。这两个条件足以诱导出一个每次犯错时所选证据递减的学习器，反之由一致学习器经规范错误转录与 Kleene–Brouwer 序可反构出这样的序，无需一致错误界 (uniform mistake bound)。
Motivation: 一致归纳推理何时只产生有限次预测错误，此前缺少对任意二值假设类的内在刻画，且通常要借助一致错误界这类外加条件。
Method: 在可实现有限轨迹 (finite realizable traces) 上构造单一线性序，每个轨迹选取其最小子轨迹；要求冲突轨迹选取不同子轨迹、且该序在每个固定目标的轨迹上良基。正向由条件构造学习器，使其所选证据在每次犯错时递减；反向用规范错误转录 (canonical mistake transcripts) 与 Kleene–Brouwer 序从一致学习器恢复该序。
Result: 在 ZFC 中对任意二值假设类给出该一致性的等价刻画，无需一致错误界；所得结果是对 Lu (2024) 所提问题的回答，构成用有限证据表示一致预测的表示定理。
Conclusion: 有限次错误的一致预测等价于可实现轨迹上满足冲突分离与逐目标良基的线性序，即一致性可完全由有限证据上的序结构刻画。

papers.title: PAWS: Policy-driven Agentic World Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Policy interventions propagate through public communication, institutional decisions, and stakeholder responses, yet datasets for financial multi-agent simulation rarely connect these processes to temporally aligned historical evidence. We introduce PAWS, a Policy-driven Agentic World Simulation dataset covering 36 verified U.S. financial and economic policy episodes, 12,727 policy-linked news records, and 65,291 source-grounded stakeholder actions. Each action is linked to its supporting news and represented by a multi-layer event frame capturing its interaction mode, financial-action family and subtype, semantic attributes, and conditional mappings to external taxonomies. Entities are resolved to normalized organizations, and actions are aligned with daily market-return context to support policy-agent simulation replay. On 2,522 stratified action samples, independent AI and human reviewers achieved 89.4% initial agreement on interaction mode, with disagreements subsequently adjudicated. Case studies of the 2008 short-selling ban and 2001 decimalization recover documented policy timelines and associated market patterns across both dense and sparse news settings. A replay study further shows that high accuracy can mask failure to detect rare stakeholder actions, identifying action timing and calibration as central challenges. PAWS provides an auditable substrate for evaluating agent influence, policy-response cascades, and action-outcome alignment in historically grounded financial simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAWS 构建了一个策略驱动的多智能体世界模拟数据集，把 36 个美国金融与经济政策事件、12,727 条政策相关新闻和 65,291 条有据可依的利益相关者行动按日对齐到市场收益，用于策略-智能体模拟回放。在 2,522 条分层抽样行动上，独立 AI 与人工评审对交互模式的初始一致率为 89.4%；回放研究显示高准确率会掩盖对罕见行动的漏检，行动时序与校准是核心难点。
Motivation: 金融多智能体模拟的数据集很少把公共沟通、机构决策与利益相关者反应同时间对齐的历史证据连起来，导致策略干预的传播过程难以在历史可信的设定下回放与评估。
Method: PAWS 为每条行动建立多层事件框架（交互模式、金融行动家族与子类型、语义属性、到外部分类体系的条件映射），将实体归一化到组织，并把行动与日度市场收益上下文对齐；用独立 AI 与人工评审在 2,522 条分层样本上标注交互模式并对分歧做仲裁。
Result: 数据集覆盖 36 个已核实的美国金融与经济政策事件、12,727 条政策相关新闻记录、65,291 条利益相关者行动；2,522 条分层行动样本上交互模式初始一致率 89.4%。2008 年卖空禁令与 2001 年十进制化两个案例研究在新闻密集与稀疏设定下均复原有记录的政策时间线与相应市场形态；回放研究显示高准确率可能掩盖对罕见利益相关者行动的检测失败。
Conclusion: PAWS 提供可审计的基底，用于在历史可信的金融模拟中评估智能体影响力、策略响应级联与行动-结果对齐，而行动时序与校准是回放中的关键挑战。

papers.title: Type-Safe Is Not Error-Free: A Constrained Decision Head Follows the Option Name, Not the Rubric Bound to It
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models are built for settings where model outputs are consumed directly by software. Instead of generating free-form text, they return a decision over a predefined set of options. By construction, every output conforms to the required schema. Yet this guarantee does not tell us whether the model interprets the options as intended. We study Jev and two Jev-like models with open weights by changing how option names are assigned to rubrics. Each option consists of an option name and a textual rubric that defines what the option means. We change only which option name is assigned to each rubric; the question, state, rubric wording, and set of option names remain exactly the same. On 1200 workflow decisions with task-specific rubrics, renaming the two options from 0/1 to no/yes changes 70.4 more answers per hundred (95% CI: [67.6, 73.1]) and shifts AUC from .94 to .23, revealing a systematic reversal in the decision ranking rather than simple uncertainty. The same operation has little effect with neutral option names. This pattern holds across all 4 predicates, where the effect is at least 7.4x larger than under the neutral control, and becomes stronger as the number of options increases. The effect also depends on the read-out geometry: a second model family that mean-pools over the full option span flips 4.1x less often. The hosted model exhibits the same behavior: the swap changes AUC from .8146 to .5806 and produces 24x as many answer flips as its test-retest floor. In contrast, replacing the option names with random character strings returns all model families to the neutral-control regime without reducing accuracy. The failure therefore depends on the semantic polarity of the option names rather than on the renaming operation itself. Across all conditions, the type-error rate remains 0%, even when decision accuracy degrades substantially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 类型安全的决策头只保证输出符合 schema，不保证模型按 rubric 理解选项：把两个选项名从 0/1 改成 no/yes（rubric、问题、状态、选项名集合全不变），1200 个 workflow 决策上每百题多翻 70.4 个答案（95% CI [67.6, 73.1]），AUC 从 .94 掉到 .23，出现系统性排序反转而非不确定；换成随机字符串则回到中性对照水平且精度不降，说明失败源于选项名的语义极性而非改名操作本身，而全程类型错误率保持 0%。
Motivation: 类型化决策模型被用于输出直接进软件的场景，schema 合规被当作可靠性保证，但合规并不说明模型按 rubric 解释了每个选项的含义。
Method: 在 Jev 及两个开放权重的 Jev-like 模型上做受控改名实验：只交换 option name 与 rubric 的绑定，问题、状态、rubric 措辞与选项名集合完全不变；对照条件为中性选项名与随机字符串，并比较 mean-pooling 全选项跨度的另一模型族与 hosted 模型，读出指标为 AUC、每百题翻转数与类型错误率。
Result: 1200 个 workflow 决策、任务特定 rubric 下，0/1 改为 no/yes 使每百题多 70.4 个不同答案（95% CI [67.6, 73.1]），AUC 从 .94 降至 .23；该效应在全部 4 个 predicate 上至少是中性对照的 7.4 倍，且随选项数增加而增强；mean-pooling 模型族翻转频率低 4.1 倍；hosted 模型 AUC 从 .8146 降至 .5806，翻转数为其重测底线的 24 倍；随机字符串选项名让所有模型族回到中性对照区间且精度不降；所有条件下类型错误率均为 0%。

papers.title: PARTE: Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation for Point Cloud Registration
papers.abstract_en: Global point-cloud registration remains challenging when limited overlap, repetitive geometry, and sensor noise produce correspondence sets dominated by outliers. Planar regions are particularly difficult for conventional point descriptors and are therefore often suppressed or discarded before matching. We present PARTE (Plane-Assisted Robust Transformation Estimation), a global registration method that instead treats planar structure as complementary registration evidence. PARTE extracts planar patches and represents them using our novel Plane Context Histogram (PCH), a descriptor that encodes the geometry surrounding each patch, while a two-level matching procedure identifies reliable plane correspondences. Candidate point and plane correspondences are combined in a confidence-weighted compatibility graph for joint outlier rejection, followed by rigid transformation estimation. When no usable plane correspondences are available, PARTE naturally reduces to point-only registration. We evaluate PARTE on 8,097 registration pairs across six indoor and outdoor benchmarks spanning dense RGB-D and sparse LiDAR measurements. Evaluations show PARTE achieves the highest overall success rate against 13 standard and state-of-the-art methods while maintaining low runtime. An open-source C++ implementation with Python bindings is provided at https://ariarobotics.github.io/parte/.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 14 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://ariarobotics.github.io/parte/. Updated project website URL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PARTE 把平面结构当作配准证据而非噪声：提取平面块并用 Plane Context Histogram (PCH) 描述其周边几何，两级匹配得到平面对应，再与点对应放进置信度加权的兼容性图做联合外点剔除，最后估计刚体变换；无可用平面对应时自动退化为纯点配准。在 6 个室内外基准共 8,097 对配准上，对 13 个标准与 SOTA 方法取得最高总体成功率且运行时间低。
Motivation: 有限重叠、重复几何与传感器噪声使全局点云配准的对应集被外点主导，而平面区域对常规点描述子尤其困难，常被直接抑制或丢弃，损失了可用的几何证据。
Method: 提取平面块并用新提出的 Plane Context Histogram (PCH) 编码其周边几何，两级匹配过程筛选可靠平面对应；点与平面候选对应合并进置信度加权的 compatibility graph 联合剔除外点，再做刚体变换估计；无平面对应时退化为纯点配准。提供开源 C++ 实现与 Python 绑定。
Result: 在 6 个室内外基准（覆盖稠密 RGB-D 与稀疏 LiDAR）共 8,097 个配准对上评测，PARTE 对 13 个标准与最先进方法取得最高总体成功率，同时保持较低运行时间。
Conclusion: 平面结构可作为点云全局配准的互补证据，在点描述子失效的平面场景下提升成功率而不牺牲运行时间；无平面对应时方法可自然退化为纯点配准。

papers.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract_en: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RRSI 给 agent harness 的递归自改进 (RSI) 加正则：proposer 用退火预算限制单次编辑数量并鼓励探索未走过的轨迹，selector 用 critic 筛掉只针对特定 benchmark 的提案、用 pruner 删掉过小/过贵/不再有用的改动。在覆盖 coding、agentic workspace、工程设计的八个 benchmark 上，进化侧 split 最多涨 14.1 点，五个 out-of-distribution benchmark 最多涨 4.7 点，产出的 harness 比无正则进化少用 30% policy token。
Motivation: 自动迭代改写 agent harness 的 RSI 容易靠记住训练任务过拟合：in-distribution 涨幅大，换到 out-of-distribution benchmark 就缩水甚至消失。
Method: 在 harness 进化的候选提议与选择两端加约束：proposer 带时间退火的编辑预算（限制一个候选能打包多少改动）并依据进化历史鼓励未探索轨迹；selector 含 critic（筛掉 benchmark 特定提案）与 pruner（删除过小、过贵或失效的改动），使选择偏向可复用机制。
Result: 在八个 benchmark（coding、agentic workspace、工程设计）上，RRSI 在其进化的 split 上最多提升 14.1 点，在五个 out-of-distribution benchmark 上最多提升 4.7 点；所得 harness 的 policy token 消耗比无正则进化少 30%。
Conclusion: 对候选提议与选择施加正则，可让 harness 进化从记忆训练任务转向产出可复用机制，同时把 OOD 增益和 token 开销一起压下来。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing
papers.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is increasingly being incorporated into learning-based robotic manipulation, yet many existing approaches rely on spatially distributed sensors. Here we introduce {SpectRobot}, a framework that transforms single-point tactile signals into compact time-frequency spectrograms. These spectrograms encode high-bandwidth tactile histories as fixed-size image-like representations. They can be processed by standard vision encoders and integrated into learning pipelines originally developed for vision, while preserving temporal and frequency information unavailable to conventional cameras. Rather than increasing spatial density through arrays of tactile elements, SpectRobot exploits the rich dynamics contained in sparse, high-bandwidth single-point measurements. In our implementation, the sensors are mounted away from the contact surface while remaining mechanically coupled to it, reducing direct exposure to wear and potentially improving robustness in harsh environments and for long-term deployment on dexterous robots. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) a robot can exploit single-point vibration signals to solve a visually occluded manipulation task; (2) temporal history strongly influences policy performance, while sensing bandwidth controls the spectral information available, with measurements extending to 100~kHz; and (3) the same representation can be used across different tactile sensing technologies mediated by acceleration, force, or strain. We further show that capabilities previously associated with research-grade instrumentation can be accessed using readily available, off-the-shelf hardware. We believe that broader access to high-bandwidth tactile sensing could facilitate the integration of contact dynamics into embodied learning systems and, for some tasks, offer an alternative or complement to increasing the spatial density of tactile sensing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpectRobot 把单点高带宽触觉振动信号转成定尺寸时频谱图，交给现成视觉编码器接入既有视觉学习管线，用时间-频率信息替代密集触觉阵列。实验显示机器人可用单点振动信号完成视觉被遮挡的操作任务，策略性能强烈依赖时间历史、传感带宽最高到 100 kHz，且同一表示可跨加速度、力、应变三类触觉技术复用。
Motivation: 触觉学习多依赖空间分布式传感器阵列，增加阵列密度成本高且传感元件直接暴露磨损；高带宽单点测量的动态信息此前多绑定研究级仪器。
Method: SpectRobot 将单点触觉信号转为紧凑时频谱图，编码高带宽触觉历史为定尺寸类图像表示，送入标准视觉编码器并接入原有视觉学习管线；传感器安装在接触面之外但保持机械耦合，以降低磨损。
Result: 三项实验发现：机器人可用单点振动信号解决视觉遮挡的操作任务；时间历史强烈影响策略性能，传感带宽决定可用谱信息，测量延伸至 100 kHz；同一表示可跨加速度、力、应变三种传感技术复用。研究级仪器的能力可用现成商用硬件获得。
Conclusion: 高带宽单点触觉可作为增加触觉空间密度的替代或补充，把接触动力学带入具身学习系统，并因传感器远离接触面而利于恶劣环境与长期部署。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CoaG: Cylinders on a Grid for Coarse 3D Layout Control in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: We ask how little geometry a person has to draw to control both where people stand and where the camera moves in a generated video. Our answer is a ground plane and one cylinder per person. A user draws a grid on the ground, places one cylinder where each person should stand, moves the cylinders and the camera over 81 frames, and the model renders a photoreal video in which the people occupy the cylinders' positions, move as the cylinders move, and are seen from the drawn camera. Appearance comes from a text prompt and a background reference image; layout and motion come from the geometry. Because no dataset pairs such a signal with video, we build the pairs ourselves: an automatic engine writes 2000 captions from a combinatorial seed, generates a clip for each with a text-to-video model, and lifts every clip back to its geometry with person tracking, background inpainting, an agentic ground-mask loop, feed-forward multi-view reconstruction and a plane fit, with no real footage and no manual labels. A LoRA on Wan2.2-Fun-Control trained on 1935 such tuples follows drawn layouts and camera paths on hold-out clips: the generated people match the cylinders' count, order, position and height, the text changes who they are, the reference image changes where they are, and dolly-in, orbit, pan and crane paths are followed, dolly-out only weakly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoaG 用「地面网格 + 每人一个圆柱」作为视频生成的 3D 布局控制信号：用户画网格、摆圆柱并移动圆柱与相机，模型渲染出人物占位、随圆柱移动、按所画相机视角观看的写实视频。自动引擎造出 2000 条几何-视频配对，在 Wan2.2-Fun-Control 上训 LoRA（1935 条），hold-out 上人物的计数、顺序、位置、高度与圆柱一致，dolly-in/orbit/pan/crane 相机路径被跟随，dolly-out 仅弱跟随。
Motivation: 视频生成中同时控制人物站位与相机运动所需的最小几何输入尚不明确，且不存在把这种布局信号与视频配对的数据集。
Method: 控制信号为地面平面加每人一个圆柱，外观来自文本提示与背景参考图，布局与运动来自几何。自动流水线从组合种子写 2000 条 caption、用 text-to-video 模型逐条生成片段，再经人物跟踪、背景 inpainting、agentic ground-mask 循环、前馈多视角重建与平面拟合把片段反 lift 回几何，全程无真实素材与人工标注；随后在 Wan2.2-Fun-Control 上训练 LoRA。
Result: 自动引擎产出 2000 条几何-视频元组，LoRA 用其中 1935 条训练，视频长 81 帧；hold-out 片段上生成人物与圆柱的 count、order、position、height 匹配，文本决定人物身份、参考图决定其所处位置，dolly-in、orbit、pan、crane 路径被跟随，dolly-out 仅弱跟随。
Conclusion: 地面网格加单圆柱这一极简几何足以同时约束人物布局与相机路径，配对数据可完全由合成流水线自造；但 dolly-out 方向的相机控制仍然偏弱。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: VISTA: Video-Injected Stylized Text-to-Animation
papers.abstract_en: We present VISTA, a two-stage framework for generating stylized 3D human motion by fusing structural content from text prompts with expressive style from reference videos, without requiring jointly paired (text, video, stylized motion) triplets. A Dual-channel Autoencoder first maps motion sequences and video clips into a shared latent manifold. A masked autoregressive diffusion backbone then operates within this manifold, injecting video-derived style through a dedicated late-fusion Dual-AdaLN pathway while preserving text-conditioned content structure. A cross-batch unpaired training protocol with latent cycle consistency enables joint learning across separate semantically rich and stylistically diverse datasets. As a proof-of-concept for controllable animation synthesis, we validate VISTA on rendered motion-capture references: it achieves the highest style recognition accuracy among video-conditioned methods while preserving competitive content alignment, and its decomposed 3-way classifier-free guidance provides independent, user-controllable calibration of the content-style balance at inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VISTA 用两阶段框架从文本提示取结构内容、从参考视频取风格，生成风格化 3D 人体动作，且不需要 (text, video, stylized motion) 三元组配对数据。Dual-channel Autoencoder 把动作序列与视频片段映射到共享隐空间，masked autoregressive diffusion 在其中经 Dual-AdaLN 晚期融合注入视频风格，同时保留文本条件的内容结构。在渲染的动作捕捉参考上，它在视频条件方法中取得最高风格识别准确率，并保持有竞争力的内容对齐。
Motivation: 风格化动作生成通常依赖文本、参考视频与风格化动作严格配对的三元组数据，这类数据难以获取，限制了可控动画合成的训练规模。
Method: 两阶段：Dual-channel Autoencoder 将动作序列与视频片段编码到共享隐流形；masked autoregressive diffusion 在该流形内运行，通过专门的晚期融合 Dual-AdaLN 通路注入视频风格，同时保持文本条件的内容结构。训练采用 cross-batch unpaired 协议加 latent cycle consistency，使语义丰富与风格多样的分离数据集可联合学习；推理时用分解的 3-way classifier-free guidance 独立校准内容-风格平衡。
Result: 在渲染的动作捕捉参考上验证：VISTA 在视频条件方法中取得最高风格识别准确率，同时保持有竞争力的内容对齐；其 3-way classifier-free guidance 提供推理时可独立调节的内容-风格配比。
Conclusion: 无需配对三元组即可把内容与风格解耦并联合训练，且分解式 guidance 让用户在推理时独立控制内容与风格的权衡，可作为可控动画合成的概念验证。

papers.title: GraphSkillAA: Attribution-Guided Skill-Graph Updating with Targeted Validation and Rollback
papers.abstract_en: External skills provide domain knowledge and procedures without updating model parameters, but flat collections obscure skill applicability, dependencies, and composition. Graphs organize skills into addressable nodes and explicit relations, supporting selection and composition. Yet existing skill-graph methods use this structure mainly for retrieval, rather than to localize updates, scope retesting, or precisely roll back rejected changes. We introduce GRAPHSKILLAA (GraphSkill Abductive Attribution), which uses one addressable graph for skill selection, execution, failure attribution, targeted updating, validation, and rollback. Nodes separate applicability, execution, and exclusion conditions; typed edges encode prerequisite and enhancement relations. The frozen student records used nodes and edges, while the teacher contrasts related successes and failures to route each supported repair to the smallest relevant field or relation; execution lapses or insufficient evidence leave the graph unchanged. A Local Gate retests affected examples, while a Big Gate evaluates the merged graph on the complete update pool; rejected changes are rolled back. With GPT-5.6-sol, GRAPHSKILLAA reaches 81.5%, 66.7%, and 91.2% on SearchQA, LiveMath, and DocVQA, respectively, and attains the highest observed mean in every main setting. These results show that object-level attribution and graph-scoped validation make a skill graph a locally optimizable, testable, and reversible external state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphSkillAA 把外部技能组织成带类型边的可寻址技能图，用归因引导的定向更新、局部与全局两级验证以及回滚，把技能图变成可局部优化、可测试、可回退的外部状态。在 GPT-5.6-sol 上，SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA 分别达到 81.5%、66.7%、91.2%，并在每个主设置中取得最高观测均值。
Motivation: 现有技能图主要被用于检索，而非定位更新范围、限定复测范围或精确回滚被拒绝的改动；扁平技能集合则掩盖了适用性、依赖与组合关系。
Method: 单一可寻址技能图承担选择、执行、失败归因、定向更新、验证与回滚：节点区分适用、执行与排除条件，类型边编码前置与增强关系；冻结的 student 记录所用节点与边，teacher 对比相关成功与失败，把修复路由到最小相关字段或关系，执行失误或证据不足则不改图；Local Gate 复测受影响样例，Big Gate 在完整更新池上评估合并后的图，被拒绝的改动回滚。
Result: 在 GPT-5.6-sol 上，GraphSkillAA 在 SearchQA 达 81.5%、LiveMath 达 66.7%、DocVQA 达 91.2%，并在每个主设置中取得最高观测均值。
Conclusion: 对象级归因加上图范围的验证，能让技能图成为可局部优化、可测试、可逆的外部状态。

papers.title: Supervising the Chain Ladder
papers.abstract_en: The chain ladder's volume-weighted pattern minimises an explicit loss function, yet is rarely booked as such. Practitioners adjust the pattern and record the final adjusted ratios. This paper treats the chain ladder's pattern selection as a supervised-learning problem. Judgement on pattern adjustments becomes a framework of defined penalties and hyperparameters on the chain ladder's loss function, treated here as an objective function in machine learning. Data weights are generalised with a decay and a power parameter for recency and volume weighting. Benchmark shaping and smoothness enter through a reference penalty and Whittaker-Henderson smoothing. The assembled objective is strictly convex and minimised by a single linear system. Each hyperparameter becomes an interpretable adjustment in its own right, declarable by judgement and categorised as an experience or a prospective adjustment. Experience adjustments can be set more objectively by a proposed training loop and a reserve validation score on held-out calendar diagonals. Further hyperparameter-based adjustments are written as almost-everywhere differentiable penalties that re-time or reshape the pattern. A worked example carries one real Schedule P triangle through an incurred and then a paid training stage, demonstrating the workflow.
papers.comment: v2: fixes missing reference Balona and Richman (2020) cited for the rolling hold-out mechanism; clearly contrasts the validation score with theirs; adds references on backtesting and decay weighting; expands the training-loop discussion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把链梯法 (chain ladder) 的模式选择改写成监督学习问题：把从业者对模式的人工调整显式化为链梯损失函数上的惩罚项与超参数，目标函数严格凸且可由单一线性系统求解。经验型调整可用训练循环加留出日历对角线上的准备金验证分数来设定，并在真实 Schedule P 三角形上按已发生赔款、再按已付赔款两个阶段走通流程。
Motivation: 链梯法的体量加权模式实际上在最小化一个显式损失，但实务中从业者直接手工调整模式并记录最终调整比率，判断过程没有统一框架，也缺少可复现的验证机制。
Method: 把链梯损失当作机器学习目标函数：数据权重推广为带衰减与幂参数的近期性/体量加权；基准形态与平滑度通过参考惩罚和 Whittaker-Henderson 平滑进入；其余超参数写成几乎处处可微的惩罚项以重定时或重塑模式。每个超参数被归类为经验型或前瞻性调整，经验型调整由提出的训练循环和留出日历对角线上的 reserve validation score 设定。
Result: 组装后的目标函数严格凸，由单一线性系统最小化；每个超参数本身成为可解释的调整量。在一个真实 Schedule P 三角形上依次走通已发生赔款 (incurred) 与已付赔款 (paid) 两个训练阶段，演示完整工作流。
Conclusion: 链梯法的人工模式判断可以被形式化为带惩罚与超参数的监督学习目标，并用留出对角线的验证分数把经验型调整设得更客观。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving global precipitation forecasts with an AI weather model trained on satellite observations
papers.abstract_en: Precipitation forecasts shape decision-making across the global economy, particularly in sectors such as agriculture. However, unlike variables such as temperature, precipitation is highly intermittent and localized, making it difficult to forecast. While recent advances in AI weather prediction systems have enabled them to surpass physical models on globally averaged metrics, improvements in mean error rarely translate to actionable forecasts of severe flooding or dry crop fields. Furthermore, most of these models are trained and evaluated against a reanalysis data product, ERA5, which has well-known biases. Here we retrain AIFS, ECMWF's widely-used, open-source operational 0.25° probabilistic graph-transformer weather model, on satellite-based precipitation observations. Our model, Laxmi, improves global probabilistic accuracy by 19% and resolves systematic distributional biases in ERA5. Specifically, Laxmi reduces drizzle overprediction by 33% for amounts less than 3 mm per day. It also mitigates extreme rainfall underprediction, improving the global 95th percentile Brier skill score by 57%. Across a case study of 10 Indian tropical storms, Laxmi delivered the most accurate forecast of 150 mm event-total precipitation in 7 events, compared to 1 for AIFS and 2 for the leading physical model, IFS. Our results demonstrate that incorporating observation-based precipitation data directly into training can substantially improve forecasts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ECMWF 的 AIFS（0.25° 概率图 Transformer）改用卫星降水观测重训为 Laxmi，全球概率预报技巧提升 19%，并纠正 ERA5 的系统性分布偏差：小于 3 mm/日的毛毛雨高估减少 33%，全球 95 分位 Brier skill score 提升 57%。在 10 个印度热带风暴个例中，Laxmi 有 7 次给出最准的 150 mm 事件总量预报，AIFS 仅 1 次、物理模式 IFS 2 次。
Motivation: 降水间歇性强、局地性大，AI 天气模式在全局平均指标上超过物理模式，但均值误差改善难以转化为洪涝或干旱的可用预报；且多数模型以有已知偏差的 ERA5 为训练与评估目标。
Method: 以卫星降水观测为训练目标，重训 ECMWF 开源的 0.25° 概率图神经网络天气模式 AIFS，得到 Laxmi；直接把基于观测的降水数据纳入训练，以纠正 ERA5 的分布偏差。
Result: 全球概率预报准确率提升 19%；小于 3 mm/日的降水毛毛雨高估减少 33%；全球 95 分位 Brier skill score 提升 57%。在 10 个印度热带风暴个例的 150 mm 事件总量预报中，Laxmi 在 7 个事件最准，AIFS 1 个，物理模式 IFS 2 个。
Conclusion: 把基于观测的降水数据直接纳入训练，能实质改善全球概率降水预报并修正 ERA5 的系统性分布偏差，包括毛毛雨高估与极端降水低估。

papers.title: A Human-AI Theorem Connecting Spontaneous and Field-Induced Mechanisms of Collective Behavior in One Dimension
papers.abstract_en: Can an artificial intelligence (AI) generate a scientific hypothesis outside a human collaborator's active hypothesis space (AHS), and can human-AI research be organized to make such breakthroughs more likely? We document such a case while proving a theorem that connects two basic organizing mechanisms of statistical physics: collective behavior arising in zero field from competing interactions and that induced or controlled by an external field. A zero-field $O(n)$-vector open chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interaction functions $U_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+1})$ and $V_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+2})$ is microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level, equivalent to a simpler $O(n)$ open chain with nearest-neighbor interaction $V_i(\boldsymbolσ_i\cdot\boldsymbolσ_{i+1})$ and axial single-spin potential $U_i(σ_i^z)$ for every integer $n\ge1$ and every system size $L\ge1$. The homogeneous linear specialization maps the foundational frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ model onto the canonical $J$-$h$ field model---with $n=1,2,3$ being the Ising, XY, and Heisenberg classical spin models, respectively; the theorem resolved a longstanding challenge for $n=3$ published in 1990. Its proof was done with an AI-synthesized recursive Householder moving frame and understood via a human-recognized hidden reciprocity. An analogous theorem holds when the continuous $O(n)$ spins are replaced by the $q$-state Potts spins, implying a closed-form exact solution of the $J_1$-$J_2$ standard Potts open chain for every $q\ge2$ and every $L\ge1$. The emergence of these theorems from a human-AI co-development framework suggests that sustained AI involvement throughout a systematic research program may incubate autonomous scientific breakthroughs and make aspects of the discovery process experimentally testable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明一条统计力学定理：零场下带任意非均匀近邻与次近邻相互作用的 O(n) 向量开链，经温度无关的哈密顿量映射，等价于只有近邻耦合加轴向单自势的更简单 O(n) 链，对任意整数 n≥1、任意 L≥1 成立。齐次线性特化把受挫 J1-J2 模型映到经典 J-h 场模型，解决了 1990 年提出的 n=3（Heisenberg）难题；Potts 情形给出 q≥2、L≥1 的 J1-J2 标准 Potts 开链闭式精确解。
Motivation: 受挫自旋系统的零场集体行为与外场诱导机制长期被视为两类问题，J1-J2 模型到 J-h 场模型的等价性自 1990 年起对 n=3 一直未解；同时学界缺少可检验的案例来回答 AI 能否提出人类假设空间之外的科学假设。
Method: 在哈密顿量层面构造温度无关映射，把含 U_i(S_i·S_{i+1}) 与 V_i(S_i·S_{i+2}) 的 O(n) 开链化为只有近邻 V_i 与轴向单自势 U_i(σ_i^z) 的链；证明用 AI 合成的递归 Householder moving frame 完成，并由人类识别出的 hidden reciprocity 加以理解，n=1,2,3 分别对应 Ising、XY、Heisenberg 经典自旋模型。
Result: 定理对每个整数 n≥1 与每个系统尺寸 L≥1 成立；齐次线性特化将受挫 J1-J2 模型映到规范的 J-h 场模型，解决了 1990 年发表的 n=3 长期难题；Potts 推广对每个 q≥2、L≥1 给出 J1-J2 标准 Potts 开链的闭式精确解。
Conclusion: 零场竞争相互作用与外场诱导/控制这两类集体行为机制可在哈密顿量层面统一，且作者认为贯穿系统研究计划的持续 AI 参与可能孵化自主科学突破，并让发现过程的某些方面变得可实验检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Effective Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings for Textual and Multimedia Data
papers.abstract_en: In a data-driven world, efficiently organizing and mapping relationships between objects is crucial. Graphs are powerful tools for modeling these connections, being widely used in social networks, telecommunications, and biology. However, graph-based methods often face high computational costs, particularly in memory and space usage. To address this, graph embedding techniques, also referred to as Network Representation Learning, encode graph information into lower-dimensional representations while preserving structural aspects. Traditional methods, however, lack interpretable dimensions. RaDE (Rank Diffusion Embedding) introduces a new approach using rank-based information, with a key step being the selection of a representative subset of nodes to provide interpretability for its dimensions and improve retrieval tasks. Despite its potential, RaDE's original proposal did not fully explore the effectiveness of representative subset selection across different classes or evaluate embeddings in tasks like classification and clustering. Inspired by RaDE, this work introduces GRaCE (Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings), a fully unsupervised framework that generates interpretable embeddings by leveraging robust rank-based measures for representative subset selection and node embedding. GRaCE surpasses RaDE and Original Features across diverse datasets, including textual and image collections, excelling in retrieval, classification, and clustering tasks, considering state-of-the-art Transformer models as feature descriptors and Graph Convolutional Networks models in classification tasks.
papers.comment: Published in International Joint Conference on Neural Networks, 2025 (IJCNN 2025). Code available in: https://github.com/thcastilho/interpretable-embeddings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRaCE（Graph and Rank-based Contextual Embeddings）在 RaDE 的 rank diffusion 基础上，用稳健的 rank 度量做代表性节点子集选择，生成可解释的图嵌入，覆盖检索、分类与聚类三类任务。在文本与图像集合上，以 Transformer 特征为描述子、GCN 做分类时，GRaCE 在检索、分类、聚类上均超过 RaDE 与 Original Features。
Motivation: 图嵌入方法计算开销大且维度缺乏可解释性；RaDE 虽引入 rank 信息与代表性子集，但原方案未系统考察跨类别的子集选择效果，也未在分类、聚类任务上评估。
Method: 全无监督框架 GRaCE：用稳健的 rank-based 度量做代表性节点子集选择，再据此生成节点嵌入；以 Transformer 模型输出作为特征描述子构建图，分类任务上使用 Graph Convolutional Networks。
Result: 在多样化的文本与图像集合上，GRaCE 在检索、分类、聚类任务中均超过 RaDE 与 Original Features；评估同时采用 Transformer 特征描述子与 GCN 分类模型。
Conclusion: 把 rank 度量用于代表性子集选择，可以在保持维度可解释性的同时提升图嵌入在检索、分类、聚类上的表现，是对 RaDE 的直接改进。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Aero Hand Open: A Simulation-Ready Tendon-Driven Hand for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Tendon-driven hands are anthropomorphic, and moving the actuators off the joints is what makes a hand of this capability affordable to build. Two effects produce that saving. Routing force through a cable removes the requirement that a motor fit inside the joint it drives, so smaller and cheaper motors suffice, and one motor can drive several joints through a single cable, so fewer motors are needed. They are also harder to learn on than a direct-drive hand. The underactuated transmission that produces the saving is itself difficult to represent in a simulator, and the joints one cable drives are not independently commandable. We present Aero Hand Open, a tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand that is released simulation-ready. Three things ship with it. A simulation model reproduces the cable transmission itself. An identified actuation map connects that model to the motor commands in both directions, including the three-way coupling of the thumb. A reinforcement learning package trains policies for the hand. Together they let a policy be trained entirely in simulation and run on the hand with no fine-tuning and no state estimation. We release the mechanical design, the simulation model, the identified mapping, the training environment and the deployment stack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Aero Hand Open 把腱驱动拟人手做成仿真就绪并开源：随附复现线缆传动的仿真模型、含拇指三向耦合的双向辨识驱动映射，以及强化学习训练包，使策略可完全在仿真中训练后直接上实机，无需微调与状态估计。
Motivation: 腱驱动把电机移出关节、一根线缆带动多关节，造价低，但欠驱动传动难以在仿真中表示，且同一根线缆驱动的关节不能独立指令，强化学习难以训练。
Method: 发布三件套：复现线缆传动本身的仿真模型；连接仿真与电机指令的双向辨识驱动映射（含拇指三向耦合）；为该手训练策略的强化学习包。同时开源机械设计、训练环境与部署栈。
Result: 策略可完全在仿真中训练，部署到实体手时无需微调、无需状态估计；开源内容包括机械设计、仿真模型、辨识映射、训练环境与部署栈。
Conclusion: 把线缆传动与耦合驱动映射一起放进仿真，腱驱动手就能走仿真到实机零微调的技能学习路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each projection. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on using an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a reusable prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems. We evaluate the proposed method using the same diffusion visual transformer model and normalized denoising strength on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning additively manufactured metal parts and concrete microstructure imaged with cone-bean X-ray CT and parallel-beam neutron CT respectively. The proposed method improves upon analytic reconstructions in all three cases, demonstrating transferability across the evaluated problems and providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction.
papers.comment: To appear in SC26 Workshops proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练一个跨多个成像域共享的 diffusion visual transformer，配合统一的归一化去噪强度，作为异构 CT 重建的即插即用先验，替代每换模态/几何/材料就要重训的专用网络。在增材制造金属件 cone-beam X-ray CT 与混凝土微结构 parallel-beam neutron CT 三个数据集上，该先验在全部三种情形中均改进了解析重建结果。
Motivation: CT 吞吐受限于扫描时间，稀疏视角或低剂量重建依赖信息量充分的先验，而现有神经先验绑定单一扫描设置，模态、几何或材料一变就得重训。
Method: 用同一个 diffusion visual transformer 跨多个成像域训练，推理时以归一化去噪强度 (normalized denoising strength) 作为统一控制，在三个在模态、束几何、材料与退化类型上均不同的数据集上作为可复用先验做 CT 重建。
Result: 在三个数据集上均改进了解析重建 (analytic reconstructions)：增材制造金属件 cone-beam X-ray CT、混凝土微结构 parallel-beam neutron CT 等三种情形全部为正向提升，体现跨问题可迁移性。
Conclusion: 单一跨域 diffusion 先验可以在所评估的异构 CT 重建问题间复用，是通向 foundation plug-and-Play prior 的一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Weight Encoding Affects Language Model Placement and Performance on the Apple Neural Engine
papers.abstract_en: Weight compression can alter accelerator placement as well as memory traffic, complicating the interpretation of inference speedups. We investigate this interaction on the Apple Neural Engine through the public Core ML deployment path. Five independently trained language-model checkpoints span two architectures and dense fp16, int8, and ternary weights encoded with two-bit lookup tables. We combine compiler device plans, synchronized memory-controller measurements, and compute-unit exclusion controls for a fixed single-token forward workload. On an M1, the smaller fp16 export executes on the CPU despite permitting ANE execution, whereas its compressed counterparts exhibit ANE activity. The int8 export reduces warm forward latency by a factor of 1.9. The larger fp16 export also uses the ANE, indicating that dense encoding alone does not determine placement. Separate M3 energy measurements support the same direction of change. These results establish encoding-dependent placement in the measured deployment stack and show that compression comparisons require joint measurement of backend selection, latency, and traffic.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. v2: corrected byte-traffic accounting, withdrew the 0.77 nominal-byte factor, and attributed normalization eligibility to dtype rather than formulation; title and abstract revised accordingly. See Section 8
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Apple Neural Engine 的 Core ML 部署路径上，权重编码方式会改变编译器的后端选择，从而与内存流量一起影响推理速度的解读。小模型的 fp16 导出落在 CPU 上（虽允许 ANE 执行），其 int8/三值压缩版本则出现 ANE 活动，int8 使单 token 前向热延迟降低 1.9 倍；大模型 fp16 同样使用 ANE，说明稠密编码本身不决定放置。作者主张压缩对比必须同时测量后端选择、延迟与流量。
Motivation: 权重压缩既改内存流量也可能改加速器放置，把速度提升单独归因于压缩本身会误读；该交互在 Apple Neural Engine 公开部署栈上缺少实测证据。
Method: 在 Core ML 公开部署路径上，用五个独立训练的语言模型 checkpoint（两种架构，dense fp16、int8、以及用 two-bit lookup table 编码的三值权重），结合编译器 device plan、同步的 memory-controller 测量与 compute-unit exclusion 控制，固定单 token 前向负载；另在 M3 上做能耗测量。
Result: M1 上小模型 fp16 导出落到 CPU，其压缩版本出现 ANE 活动；int8 导出使 warm 前向延迟降低 1.9 倍。大模型 fp16 也使用 ANE，表明稠密编码不单独决定放置。M3 能耗测量方向一致。v2 修正了字节流量核算，撤回 0.77 nominal-byte factor，并把归一化资格归因于 dtype 而非 formulation。
Conclusion: 在所测部署栈中存在编码依赖的放置（encoding-dependent placement），因此压缩收益必须联合测量后端选择、延迟与流量才能成立。

papers.title: From Detection to Understanding: TAR and TAR-Bench for Multi-Task Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Detecting a traffic anomaly does not establish whether a video-language model can explain what happened, localize it in time, or identify its causes. We introduce TAR (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning) and TAR-Bench, paired resources for training and evaluating these complementary capabilities across 10 tasks spanning question answering, temporal reasoning, and scene understanding. TAR contains 44,040 automatically generated annotations with chain-of-thought traces for 3,670 CCTV videos from eight public datasets. TAR-Bench provides 960 human-curated annotations for 80 held-out clips from 17 public YouTube videos. Evaluation of eleven vision-language models reveals a gap between question-answering performance and temporal or scene reasoning. Progressively adding task groups during supervised fine-tuning improves aggregate performance on both Cosmos-Reason2-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Training on all 10 tasks raises their mean benchmark scores from 34.3 to 55.7 and from 30.9 to 53.9, respectively. These results support joint training across complementary tasks as a promising approach to traffic anomaly understanding, while highlighting persistent limitations in temporal precision and causal attribution. TAR and TAR-Bench serve as the official training and in-domain evaluation resources for AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3.The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-Traffic-Anomaly-Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TAR 训练集与 TAR-Bench 评测集，覆盖 10 项交通异常推理任务（问答、时序推理、场景理解），用带 chain-of-thought 的自动标注训练视频语言模型。在 10 任务上联合监督微调后，Cosmos-Reason2-8B 平均分从 34.3 升到 55.7，Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 从 30.9 升到 53.9；但时序精度与因果归因仍是短板。
Motivation: 检测出交通异常并不等于视频语言模型能解释发生了什么、在时间上定位它或找出成因；现有模型在问答与时间/场景推理之间存在明显能力缺口。
Method: TAR 提供 44,040 条自动生成、含 chain-of-thought 的标注，覆盖 8 个公开数据集的 3,670 段 CCTV 视频；TAR-Bench 提供 80 段留出片段（来自 17 段公开 YouTube 视频）的 960 条人工整理标注。评测 11 个 vision-language model，并在 Cosmos-Reason2-8B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上逐步加入任务组做监督微调。
Result: 11 个 VLM 的问答表现与时间/场景推理之间存在差距；逐步加入任务组可提升两项模型的总体成绩，全部 10 个任务训练后平均分 Cosmos-Reason2-8B 34.3 → 55.7，Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 30.9 → 53.9；时序精度与因果归因仍持续受限。
Conclusion: 跨互补任务的联合训练是提升交通异常理解的有效路径，但时序精度与因果归因尚未解决；TAR 与 TAR-Bench 是 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3 的官方训练与域内评测资源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Hardware Keystores for AI Agent Signing Workflows: A Zero-Trust MCP Enforcement Architecture
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly sign Git commits, certify documents, and attest release artifacts on behalf of their operators, using private keys that live in software-accessible locations (plaintext files, environment variables, container memory) readable by any process the agent can reach. A widely deployed agent framework recently leaked its keys this way to a single email injection. Hardware keystores (HSM, TPM, smart card) keep the key on-device, but exposing the keystore as a tool an LLM agent can call moves the problem rather than removing it: once a signing session exists, the hardware cannot tell a request reflecting the operator's intent from one injected into content the agent read. We characterize this confused-deputy problem and build the five-layer Zero-Trust enforcement stack it requires, so that only requests consistent with the operator's committed intent reach the hardware. We evaluate on two attack planes. Prompt injection in content the agent reads (AgentDojo, three injection-following models, n=144) falls from an 18.1% baseline attack success rate to 0% under the full stack. Tool poisoning by a compromised MCP server (MCPTox) is contained identically: a hash comparison protects a pre-committed payload, and human-in-the-loop escalation contains autonomous requests with nothing pre-committed. A further probe delineates how far the semantic filter's protection extends: it detects a substitute document under an unrelated name, but an adversarially plausible substitute name defeats it in every trial we ran. We report this as a central finding: the architecture's guarantee never rests on the filter being right, only on a human being asked whenever nothing was committed in advance. The trade-off we characterize across both planes is that the less an operator can commit to in advance, the less deterministic the resulting guarantee, down to asking a human.
papers.comment: v2: substantially revised. Adds metadata-plane tool-poisoning evaluation (MCPTox), an adaptive substitution probe of the semantic filter, TPM 2.0 latency measurements, and per-layer ablations. Artifact link in the paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI agent 代签名时私钥可被任意进程读取、以及把硬件 keystore 暴露为 LLM 可调用工具后无法区分操作者意图与注入请求的 confused-deputy 问题，提出五层 Zero-Trust 执行栈，只让与操作者预先提交意图一致的请求到达硬件。在 AgentDojo 上三种跟随注入的模型（n=144）中，提示注入攻击成功率从 18.1% 降到 0%；MCPTox 工具投毒同样被遏制，但语义过滤器在对抗性合理的替代命名下每次都被绕过，保证最终落在“未预先提交就问人”。
Motivation: agent 代签名所用私钥存放在软件可读位置，一次邮件注入即可泄露；把 HSM/TPM 变成 agent 可调工具只是转移问题，硬件无法区分操作者意图与内容注入。
Method: 构建五层 Zero-Trust 执行栈，使只有与操作者已提交意图一致的请求才触达硬件 keystore；用哈希比对保护预先提交的 payload，对无预提交的自主请求走 human-in-the-loop 升级，并加入语义过滤器。评测覆盖两个攻击面：AgentDojo 提示注入（三种注入跟随模型，n=144）与自建 MCPTox 工具投毒，另有替代命名探针和逐层消融。
Result: AgentDojo 提示注入攻击成功率由 18.1% 基线降至 0%（三种注入跟随模型，n=144）；MCPTox 工具投毒被同样遏制，哈希比对保护预提交 payload，human-in-the-loop 包住无预提交的自主请求。语义过滤器能识别换名的替代文档，但在对抗性合理的替代命名下每次试验都被击败。
Conclusion: 架构的保证从不依赖语义过滤器判断正确，只依赖“无预提交时问人”；操作者能预先承诺的越少，保证越不确定，最终退化为人工确认。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trident : How to Break Deep Reinforcement Learning Cyber Defenses (Agentic)
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous cyber defense systems based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) have attracted significant research attention, yet remain evaluated almost exclusively against static, heuristic red agents, leaving their robustness against adaptive threats critically understudied. Meanwhile, recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have improved LLM reasoning, but their integration into cybersecurity remains elusive due to the absence of suitable benchmark environments and interaction datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trident, an agentic LLM red teaming framework comprising three components: a dynamic benchmark with isolated sandbox servers spanning CybORG CAGE 4 and CyberWheel, a dataset comprises over 13,000 high-fidelity red-blue interaction trajectories for RLVR, and a ``Code-as-Policy'' RLVR agentic architecture Trident Agentic). The latter reformulates red agent training as a contextual bandit via a tripartite Log Summarizer--Planner--Coder design, where a trainable Planner generates complete attack strategies from compressed execution logs, which a frozen Coder translates into executable Python policies deployed against live DRL defenders. Empirical evaluations reveal a fundamental brittleness in existing defenses: with a single trainable 7B planner, Trident reduces blue agent defensive performance by an average of 522% compared to static red agent baselines while autonomously discovering emergent behaviors such as decoy avoidance and adaptive state prioritization that static heuristics entirely fail to uncover.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trident 是面向 DRL 网络防御的 agentic LLM 红队框架：用隔离沙箱基准（CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel）、13,000+ 条红蓝交互轨迹做 RLVR 训练，并以 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 三段式 Code-as-Policy 架构把红方训练重构成 contextual bandit。仅用单个可训练 7B Planner，蓝方防御性能相对静态红方基线平均下降 522%，并自主发现诱饵规避、自适应状态优先级等静态启发式完全暴露不了的行为。
Motivation: 基于 DRL 的自主网络防御几乎只在静态启发式红方下评测，对自适应威胁的鲁棒性严重欠缺研究；而 RLVR 在网络安全中难以落地，原因是缺少合适的基准环境与交互数据集。
Method: Trident 由三部分组成：跨 CybORG CAGE 4 与 CyberWheel 的动态隔离沙箱基准；含 13,000 余条高保真红蓝交互轨迹、供 RLVR 使用的数据集；以及 Code-as-Policy 的 Trident Agentic 架构——把红方训练重构为 contextual bandit，三段式 Log Summarizer–Planner–Coder 中，可训练 Planner 从压缩执行日志生成完整攻击策略，冻结的 Coder 将其翻译为可执行 Python 策略并部署到实况 DRL 防御者上。
Result: 实证评测中，单个可训练 7B Planner 使蓝方防御性能相对静态红方基线平均降低 522%；同时自主发现诱饵规避 (decoy avoidance) 与自适应状态优先级 (adaptive state prioritization) 等涌现行为，静态启发式完全无法暴露这些行为。
Conclusion: 现有 DRL 网络防御存在根本性脆弱：在自适应 LLM 红方压力下防御性能大幅下滑，因此只用静态红方评测会系统性高估防御鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Confidence Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Anytime-valid inference enables analysts to continuously monitor their data and stop experiments early. However, the majority of these methods incur a certain conservativeness by remaining valid on infinite time horizons. In practice, a bound on the horizon may be imposed due to budgetary, practical, or ethical constraints. In this paper, we ask the question: "Is it possible to obtain sharper large-sample anytime-valid inference by forgoing validity beyond some finite time horizon?". We provide a positive answer to this question by proposing a family of statistical objects that we call "confidence horizons". These objects can be viewed as large-sample confidence sequences on bounded time horizons, or alternatively as group sequential repeated confidence intervals with a maximal number of interim peeking times. We make explicit connections to the group sequential boundaries of Pocock [1977], O'Brien--Fleming [1979], and Wang--Tsiatis [1987]. We derive closed-form distribution functions of certain statistics which can be used to calculate the asymptotic quantiles of confidence horizons exactly, sidestepping the repeated integration typically employed in group sequential methods. We illustrate the use of confidence horizons for treatment effect estimation in sequentially randomized experiments under adaptive Neyman allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 confidence horizons：放弃无限时间轴上的 anytime-valid 性，只在有限时间窗内保持有效，从而在大样本下得到更锐的置信序列。推导了若干统计量的闭式分布函数以精确计算渐近分位数，避开 group sequential 方法常用的重复积分，并在自适应 Neyman 分配的序贯随机实验中演示处理效应估计。
Motivation: 多数 anytime-valid 方法为在无限时间轴上保持有效而付出保守性代价，但预算、实践或伦理约束下分析者本就只关心有限的监测窗口，这部分保守性是白付的。
Method: 定义 confidence horizons 这一统计对象，视作有界时间窗上的大样本置信序列 (confidence sequence)，或带最大中期查看次数的 group sequential 重复置信区间；与 Pocock (1977)、O'Brien--Fleming (1979)、Wang--Tsiatis (1987) 的 group sequential boundary 建立明确联系，并推导若干统计量的闭式分布函数。
Result: 闭式分布函数可精确计算 confidence horizon 的渐近分位数，绕开 group sequential 方法典型的重复积分；在自适应 Neyman 分配下的序贯随机实验中用于处理效应估计。
Conclusion: 在预先给定的有限时间窗内放弃窗外有效性，是换取更锐大样本 anytime-valid 推断的可行交换，且分位数可闭式求得。
