papers.title: Who Owns the AI Recommendation? A Multi-Industry Empirical Map of Brand Category Ownership Across Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This exploratory study measures brand inclusion across five industries, 50 brands and 250 queries, each put five times to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash and Perplexity sonar-pro in February and September 2026 (3,614 and 3,750 scored answers). Category Inclusion Rate, Recommendation Share, Competitive Vacuum Index and Co-Mention Asymmetry have stated denominators. February inclusion rates sit close together across an industry's sampled brands (mean Gini 0.30), while at least one brand is named in 80% or more of answers to 204 of 250 queries. Vacuums occur in 7.6% of queries; provisional open-vocabulary model readings suggest most reflect the sampled brand list. The partially pre-specified September replication shows strong cross-date Recommendation Share correlation (Spearman 0.994), unchanged vacuum prevalence and agreement of 60.8% against February's 57.2%. The descriptive size association persists. Fixed margins do not account for all co-mention structure: 31 ordered pairs depart from the September null. Agreement exceeds the query-independent null, and both parametric-pair advantage intervals are positive. All ten clustering seeds yield zero emergent clusters. Matcher validation remains provisional pending author checks. The statistics describe system output and identify no causal mechanism.
papers.comment: Corrected February analysis and September 2026 replication; 30-page main paper and 31-page supplement. Matcher validation and open-vocabulary readings remain provisional pending human checks. Published data/code release: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22693819; September derived outputs are not yet deposited
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 5 个行业、50 个品牌、250 条查询在 GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Perplexity sonar-pro 上各问 5 次，用 Category Inclusion Rate、Recommendation Share、Competitive Vacuum Index、Co-Mention Asymmetry 度量品牌被 LLM 推荐的分布。2 月纳入率在行业内品牌间接近（mean Gini 0.30），真空占 7.6% 查询；9 月复现 Recommendation Share Spearman 0.994、真空比例不变，31 个有序对偏离零模型，10 个聚类种子均无涌现聚类。
Motivation: LLM 已成为品牌推荐入口，但跨行业、跨模型、跨时间的品牌纳入结构缺少带明确分母的量化刻画，也难判断共现结构是否超出固定边际所能解释。
Method: 探索性实证设计：5 行业 × 50 品牌 × 250 查询，每条查询对 GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash、Perplexity sonar-pro 各问 5 次，2026 年 2 月与 9 月两轮（分别 3,614 与 3,750 条计分回答）；提出四个带分母的指标（Category Inclusion Rate、Recommendation Share、Competitive Vacuum Index、Co-Mention Asymmetry），9 月为部分预注册复现，并做开放词表读取与 matcher 验证。
Result: 2 月行业内品牌纳入率接近，mean Gini 0.30；250 条查询中 204 条至少有一个品牌在 80% 及以上回答中被点名；真空出现在 7.6% 查询。9 月复现 Recommendation Share 跨日期 Spearman 0.994，真空比例不变，与 2 月一致率 60.8%（2 月为 57.2%）；描述性规模关联持续；31 个有序对偏离 9 月零模型；一致率高于查询无关零模型，两个参数化配对优势区间均为正；10 个聚类种子全部零涌现聚类。
Conclusion: 品牌在 LLM 推荐中的分布跨时间稳定且可复现，但固定边际无法解释全部共现结构；结论仅描述系统输出，不识别因果机制，matcher 验证与开放词表读取仍待人工核查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiffUNet^2: Bidirectional Conditional Diffusion for Probabilistic Scientific Spatiotemporal Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Studying the spatiotemporal evolution of scientific phenomena often relies on costly simulations and experiments. Machine learning-based surrogate models reduce this cost, but most are limited to deterministic forward prediction. Scientific temporal analysis often requires both forward prediction and backward inference, while temporal evolution is not always uniquely determined, especially for the inverse problem. We introduce DiffUNet^2, a bidirectional conditional diffusion model for probabilistic scientific temporal prediction. It supports both forward and backward prediction within a shared model. We evaluate DiffUNet^2 on four scientific temporal datasets spanning fluid dynamics, chemical reaction dynamics, and material deformation, against deterministic and probabilistic baselines. Results show that DiffUNet^2 achieves strong predictive performance in both temporal directions and high probabilistic ensemble quality compared with existing baselines. To support practical scientific exploration beyond prediction, we further extend DiffUNet^2's generation ability with target-guided state editing, allowing states of interest to be specified and explored in both temporal directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffUNet^2 用一个共享的双向条件扩散模型同时做科学时空过程的前向预测与后向推断，并输出概率集合而非单一确定解。在流体动力学、化学反应动力学与材料变形四组数据集上，它相对确定性与概率基线在两个时间方向都取得强预测表现与高质量概率集合，并支持目标引导的状态编辑 (target-guided state editing) 沿双向时间轴探索感兴趣状态。
Motivation: 科学时空模拟与实验成本高，现有 ML 代理模型多为确定性单向预测；而实际时间分析既需要前向预报也需要后向反演，且逆问题下演化往往不唯一，确定性输出无法表达这种不确定性。
Method: 提出双向条件扩散模型 DiffUNet^2，在同一模型内以前向与后向两种条件生成实现双向预测；在四个覆盖流体动力学、化学反应动力学、材料变形的科学时序数据集上，与确定性基线和概率基线对比；再扩展其生成能力，加入目标引导的状态编辑，允许指定感兴趣状态并在两个时间方向上探索。
Result: 在四个科学时序数据集（流体动力学、化学反应动力学、材料变形）上，DiffUNet^2 相对现有确定性与概率基线，在前向与后向两个时间方向均取得强预测性能，并获得更高的概率集合质量 (probabilistic ensemble quality)；目标引导状态编辑可在双向时间轴上按指定状态进行探索。
Conclusion: 前向预测与后向推断可以由一个共享的条件扩散模型统一承担，且概率集合质量足以支撑预测之外的交互式状态探索；作者据此把双向生成能力延伸到目标引导编辑。

papers.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. By leveraging the rich visual priors of Cosmos and mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios, OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors. Crucially, it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions. Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment, providing a scalable and comprehensive solution for training and evaluating next-generation autonomous driving policies. We additionally show preliminary results indicating that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters. These results highlight the potential for a real-time world model like OmniDreams to also serve as a backbone for policy architectures.
papers.comment: Research blog: https://research.nvidia.com/labs/sil/projects/omnidreams-blog/, GitHub: https://github.com/nv-tlabs/omni-dreams, Model weights: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/omni-dreams-models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniDreams 是从 Cosmos diffusion 模型中训与后训得到的实时生成式世界模型，自回归地按过去帧、当前仿真器状态和即时驾驶动作生成动作条件视频，作为闭环自动驾驶仿真中的响应式环境。在 21k 小时驾驶场景上训练后可合成极端天气等未观测现象；后训出的 world-action model (WAM) 在 Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec 数据集上超过 VLA 策略 Alpamayo 1.5，参数量仅为其 1/5。
Motivation: 长尾场景下驾驶策略的安全评估是瓶颈：基于重建的神经仿真器受限于初始采集数据，难以泛化到高度动态或全新场景，而闭环中策略动作会实时改变仿真器状态并影响下一帧观测。
Method: 以 Cosmos diffusion 模型为基座做 mid- and post-training，得到自回归、动作条件的实时视频生成器；条件输入为过去帧、当前仿真器状态与即时驾驶动作。部署上与 Alpamayo 1 策略模型和 AlpaSim orchestrator 组成闭环系统，并在其上后训出 world-action model (WAM)。
Result: 在 21k 小时驾驶场景上训练，可合成传统仿真器难以捕捉的极端天气与不可预测动态 agent 行为；WAM 在 Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec 数据集上超过 VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model，且总参数量仅为后者的 1/5（摘要称此为 preliminary results）。
Conclusion: 实时生成式世界模型既能作为闭环驾驶策略评估的响应式环境，也能充当策略架构的 backbone；重建式仿真器的先验数据约束可由视觉先验丰富的 diffusion 基座绕开。

papers.title: When Search Becomes Memory: Accelerating Robot Design Discovery with Self-Evolving Skills
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proposal generators for evolutionary robot design, yet most loops remain memoryless: simulator results shape the next population but are not preserved as reusable design knowledge. We present Auto-Robotist, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library. Each skill stores a structural archetype, evidence-grounded positive and negative rules, and the evaluated designs that support them, making design memory inspectable rather than implicit in a population. During search, the agent retrieves skills to condition LLM edits of elite bodies while retaining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) mutation path for exploration; after evaluation, it updates the library through Add, Diagnose, and Merge. Across seven EvoGym tasks spanning locomotion, traversal, and object interaction, Auto-Robotist improves cold-start 5x5 search and transfers learned skills to 10x10 design spaces, where reference-conditioned transfer outperforms GA on every task. These results suggest that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/wangyf9/Auto-Robotist .
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Accepted by EMNLP26 main
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Auto-Robotist 把进化机器人设计搜索中的仿真评估轨迹蒸馏成显式自然语言技能库（结构原型 + 有证据支撑的正负规则 + 支撑设计），检索技能来约束 LLM 对精英个体的编辑，同时保留 GA 变异路径做探索，并通过 Add、Diagnose、Merge 更新库。在七个 EvoGym 任务上改善冷启动 5x5 搜索，学到的技能迁移到 10x10 设计空间后，reference-conditioned transfer 在每个任务上都优于 GA。

Method: Auto-Robotist 将形态搜索轨迹蒸馏为显式自然语言技能库，每条技能存结构原型、有证据支撑的正负规则及其支撑的已评估设计；搜索时检索技能来条件化 LLM 对精英个体的编辑，同时保留 Genetic Algorithm (GA) 变异路径做探索，评估后通过 Add、Diagnose、Merge 三步更新库。
Result: 在七个 EvoGym 任务（涵盖 locomotion、traversal、object interaction）上改善冷启动 5x5 搜索；技能迁移到 10x10 设计空间后，reference-conditioned transfer 在全部任务上优于 GA。
Conclusion: LLM 智能体可以把昂贵的物理评估转化为可复用、可审计的设计原则，且这种设计记忆能跨设计空间规模迁移。

papers.title: BEHAVE: Real-Time Modeling of Human Systems as Observable Complex Dynamical Systems and Operational Objects for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: A robot can track every person and still fail to see the system those people form. BEHAVE treats an interacting human group as a complex dynamical system: a HumanSystem, an observable, persistent, relational object whose state is carried partly by interaction structure. It is therefore neither explicit in independent individual-track representations nor reducible to simple aggregates. We call this operational emergence. On public pedestrian data, interaction evidence improves group discrimination beyond proximity (AUC 0.896->0.933). On 24 bottleneck runs, future-calm and future-breakdown moments matched on density, mean speed, flow and speed dispersion differ in neighbour-level organization under run-level inference (p=0.028). From interaction evidence K, BEHAVE constructs conservative routing P and local dynamics J=-D+GP, separating routing from gain and relaxation. Stability, critical modes and response become explicit model quantities. We derive exact bounds on what topology can change in collective stability, and conditions under which an observable is blind to the mode becoming unstable. In a causal real-data stress test, the coupled operator improves held-out local dynamics over self-only relaxation by 4.5%. The fitted stability margin St is prospectively associated with future throughput loss but overlaps with lag-1 autocorrelation and self-only relaxation; we read it as a model-based early-warning quantity, not a superior scalar alarm. For Physical AI, the HumanSystem provides a real-time human-side object between perception and action. A robot or scheduler can query group state, structure, critical modes and forced response. Action-conditioned stability changes are reported only when supported by identified changes in human dynamics or signed human-machine coupling. Mixed human-machine systems are represented through a joint Jacobian.
papers.comment: 51 pages, 3 figures. Theorem verification, figure and analysis code included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEHAVE 把相互作用的人群当作可观测的持久关系对象 HumanSystem，用交互证据 K 构造保守路由 P 与局部动力学 J=-D+GP，把路由与增益/松弛分离，使稳定性、临界模态与响应成为显式模型量。在公开行人数据上交互证据把群体判别 AUC 从 0.896 提到 0.933；24 次瓶颈运行中密度、均速、流量与速度离散度匹配的 future-calm 与 future-breakdown 时刻在邻居级组织上仍显著不同（p=0.028）。
Motivation: 机器人能跟踪每个行人却看不到这些人构成的系统：独立个体轨迹表示里群体既不显式存在，也无法化约为简单聚合，感知与行动之间缺少可查询的群体状态对象。
Method: 由交互证据 K 构造保守路由 P 与局部动力学 J=-D+GP，分离路由与增益、松弛；推导拓扑能改变集体稳定性的精确界与可观测量对失稳模态盲的条件；在因果真实数据压力测试中用耦合算子对比 self-only relaxation，并以 run-level inference 检验瓶颈运行的邻居级组织差异。
Result: 公开行人数据上群体判别 AUC 0.896→0.933（交互证据相对仅用邻近度）；24 次瓶颈运行中，密度、均速、流量与速度离散度匹配的 future-calm 与 future-breakdown 时刻在邻居级组织上存在差异，run-level inference p=0.028；因果真实数据压力测试中耦合算子把 held-out 局部动力学相对 self-only relaxation 改善 4.5%；拟合的稳定裕度 St 与未来吞吐量损失前瞻性相关，但与 lag-1 自相关和 self-only relaxation 重叠。
Conclusion: 群体作为关系对象可被实时建模并供机器人或调度器查询，但 St 应读作基于模型的早期预警量而非更优的单一报警标量；仅在人类动力学或带符号的人机耦合被辨识出变化时才报告作用条件下的稳定性改变。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 公开行人数据上群体判别 AUC 0.896→0.933（交互证据相对仅用邻近度）；24 次瓶颈运行中，密度、均速、流量与速度离散度匹配的 future-calm 与 future-breakdown 时刻在邻居级组织上存在差异，run-level inference p=0.028；因果真实数据压力测试中耦合算子把 held-out 局部动力学相对 self-only relaxation 改善 4.5%；拟合的稳定裕度 St 与未来吞吐量损失前瞻性相关，但与 lag-1 自相关和 self-only relaxation 重叠。
summary_sections.conclusion: 群体作为关系对象可被实时建模并供机器人或调度器查询，但 St 应读作基于模型的早期预警量而非更优的单一报警标量；仅在人类动力学或带符号的人机耦合被辨识出变化时才报告作用条件下的稳定性改变。

papers.title: Structured 3D Latents Are Surprisingly Powerful: Unleashing Generalizable Style with 2D Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: 3D asset generation plays a pivotal role in fields such as gaming and virtual reality, enabling the rapid synthesis of high-fidelity 3D objects from a single or multiple images. Building on this capability, enabling style-controllable generation naturally emerges as an important and desirable direction. However, existing approaches typically rely on style images that lie within or are similar to the training distribution of 3D generation models. When presented with out-of-distribution (OOD) styles, their performance degrades significantly or even fails. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{DiLAST}: 2D Diffusion-based Latent Awakening for 3D Style Transfer. Specifically, we leverage a pretrained 2D diffusion model as a teacher to provide rich and generalizable style priors. By aligning rendered views with the target style under diffusion-based guidance, our method optimizes the structured 3D latent representations for stylization. We observe that this limitation stems not from insufficient model capacity, but from the underutilization of structured 3D latents, which are inherently expressive. Despite being trained on comparatively limited data, 3D generation models can leverage 2D diffusion guidance to steer denoising toward specific directions in latent space, thereby producing diverse, OOD styles. Extensive experiments across diverse data and multiple 3D generation backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and plug-and-play nature of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiLAST 用预训练 2D diffusion 当 teacher，通过 diffusion guidance 对齐渲染视图与目标风格，优化结构化 3D latent 做风格迁移，使 3D 生成模型在分布外 (OOD) 风格上也能产出多样结果。作者认为瓶颈不是模型容量，而是结构化 3D latent 未被充分利用；方法可即插即用地接到多个 3D 生成 backbone 上。
Motivation: 现有 3D 风格可控生成依赖落在训练分布内或相近的风格图，遇到 OOD 风格时性能显著下降甚至失败。
Method: 以预训练 2D diffusion 模型为 teacher 提供可泛化的风格先验，在 diffusion-based guidance 下把渲染视图与目标风格对齐，据此优化结构化 3D latent 表示；2D diffusion 引导去噪朝 latent 空间特定方向进行，从而产生分布外的多样风格。
Result: 在多样数据与多个 3D 生成 backbone 上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性与即插即用特性；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: OOD 风格失败的根源是结构化 3D latent 被低度利用而非容量不足，用 2D diffusion 引导即可释放其表达力并实现可泛化的风格控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgileLog: A Forkable Shared Log for Agents on Data Streams
papers.abstract_en: In modern data-streaming systems, alongside traditional programs, a new type of entity has emerged that can interact with streaming data: AI agents. Unlike traditional programs, AI agents use LLM reasoning to accomplish high-level tasks specified in natural language over streaming data. Unfortunately, current streaming systems cannot fully support agents: they lack the fundamental mechanisms to avoid the performance interference caused by agentic tasks and to safely handle agentic writes. We argue that the shared log, the core abstraction underlying streaming data, must support creating forks of itself, and that such a forkable shared log serves as a great substrate for agents acting on streaming data. We propose AgileLog, a new shared log abstraction that provides novel forking primitives for agentic use cases. We design Bolt, a system that implements the AgileLog abstraction. Bolt uses many novel techniques to make forks cheap and to provide logical and performance isolation.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 17 figures. Accepted at SOSP 2026. Updated to the final version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgileLog 把共享日志本身做成可 fork 的抽象，让 LLM agent 在流数据上执行自然语言任务时能廉价创建日志分叉，并由实现系统 Bolt 提供逻辑隔离与性能隔离，从而避免 agentic 任务对传统流处理的干扰并安全处理 agent 写入。
Motivation: 流式系统缺少阻止 agentic 任务造成性能干扰、以及安全处理 agent 写入的基础机制，传统共享日志无法支撑 LLM agent 在流数据上的高层任务。
Method: 提出新的共享日志抽象 AgileLog，提供面向 agentic 用例的 fork 原语；设计实现系统 Bolt，用多项技术让 fork 便宜并提供逻辑隔离与性能隔离。
Result: 论文提出 AgileLog 抽象与 Bolt 系统，使 fork 成本降低并提供逻辑与性能隔离；该工作被 SOSP 2026 接收，18 页 17 图。
Conclusion: 可 fork 的共享日志是支撑 agent 操作流数据的合适底层抽象，能同时解决干扰规避与安全写入问题。

papers.title: Novelty Adaptation Through Hybrid Large Language Model (LLM)-Symbolic Planning and LLM-guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In dynamic open-world environments, autonomous agents often encounter novelties that hinder their ability to find plans to achieve their goals. Specifically, traditional symbolic planners fail to generate plans when the robot's planning domain lacks the operators that enable it to interact appropriately with novel objects in the environment. We propose a neuro-symbolic architecture that integrates symbolic planning, reinforcement learning, and a large language model (LLM) to learn how to handle novel objects. In particular, we leverage the common sense reasoning capability of the LLM to identify missing operators, generate plans with the symbolic AI planner, and write reward functions to guide the reinforcement learning agent in learning control policies for newly identified operators. Our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in operator discovery as well as operator learning in continuous robotic domains.Our webpage and code can be access here: helenlu66.github.io/hybridLLMguided/
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robotos & Systems (IROS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向开放世界机器人新颖性适应，提出 LLM-符号规划与 LLM 引导强化学习的混合架构：LLM 识别缺失算子并调用符号规划器生成计划，同时写出奖励函数供 RL 学习新算子的连续控制策略。在算子发现与连续机器人域的算子学习上均优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 当规划域缺少与新颖对象交互所需的算子时，传统符号规划器无法生成计划，机器人在开放世界中遇到新对象即失效。
Method: 神经-符号架构结合三部分：LLM 用常识推理识别缺失算子，符号 AI 规划器据此生成计划，LLM 为新算子编写奖励函数引导强化学习智能体学习连续域控制策略。
Result: 在算子发现 (operator discovery) 与连续机器人域的算子学习 (operator learning) 两项任务上均优于 state-of-the-art 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: LLM 的常识推理可同时充当算子发现器与奖励函数编写者，使符号规划与 RL 协同处理开放世界中的新颖对象。

papers.title: MOOSEnger: A Simulation-Aware AI Agent Framework for the MOOSE Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: MOOSEnger is a modeling and simulation AI agent framework for the Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) ecosystem, built around a simulation-aware harness that combines an interchangeable reasoning model with grounded domain knowledge, revised simulation artifacts, MOOSE-specific validation, and executable solver feedback. This surrounding system addresses a central limitation of one-shot large language model generation: small syntax, schema, reference, or solver-configuration errors can prevent a plausible input from executing, while successful execution alone does not establish scientific correctness. MOOSEnger's simulation-aware harness integrates MOOSE knowledge retrieval, Hierarchical Input Text (HIT)-aware parsing, syntax metadata, language-server diagnostics, revision-controlled authoring, and local or MCP-backed validation and execution in a generate-check-repair-run workflow that binds evidence to each input revision and guides bounded repair before acceptance. Across 200 prompts spanning eight simulation families, the MOOSEnger harness increases executable success from 10/200 (5%) to 179/200 (89.5%) with GPT 5.2 API and from 0/200 to 153/200 (76.5%) with Gemma 4 31B. A complementary ten-case Method of Manufactured Solutions benchmark moves beyond executability: all ten generated inputs satisfy the semantic-alignment criterion, and eight execute successfully while meeting the prescribed single-mesh numerical-accuracy criterion. These results show that executable reliability depends on the complete agent system rather than on the reasoning model alone, and that simulation-aware harnessing provides a path toward physics-informed verification and future full application-level and engineering verification and validation implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOOSEnger 为 MOOSE 多物理仿真生态构建 simulation-aware AI agent 框架，用 generate-check-repair-run 工作流把知识检索、HIT 解析、语言服务器诊断、修订控制与本地/MCP 校验执行绑到每个输入修订上。200 条 prompt、8 类仿真族上，可执行率从 10/200（5%）升到 179/200（89.5%）（GPT 5.2 API），从 0/200 升到 153/200（76.5%）（Gemma 4 31B）。
Motivation: 一次性 LLM 生成的输入常因语法、schema、引用或求解器配置的小错误无法执行，而能执行也不等于科学正确；可执行可靠性取决于整套 agent 系统而非推理模型本身。
Method: simulation-aware harness 集成 MOOSE 知识检索、Hierarchical Input Text (HIT)-aware 解析、语法元数据、language-server 诊断、revision-controlled authoring，以及本地或 MCP 支持的校验与执行，形成 generate-check-repair-run 工作流，把证据绑定到每个输入修订并在接受前做有界修复；推理模型可替换。
Result: 200 条 prompt、8 个仿真族上，可执行成功率由 10/200（5%）提升至 179/200（89.5%）（GPT 5.2 API），由 0/200 提升至 153/200（76.5%）（Gemma 4 31B）；十例 Method of Manufactured Solutions 基准中全部 10 例满足语义对齐标准，8 例执行成功并满足规定的单网格数值精度标准。
Conclusion: 可执行可靠性来自完整的 simulation-aware agent 系统而非推理模型本身，该 harness 为物理信息验证以及后续应用级与工程级 V&V 提供路径。

papers.title: Near-Oracle KV Selection via Pre-hoc Sparsity for Long-Context Inference
papers.abstract_en: A core bottleneck in large language model (LLM) inference is the cost of attending over the ever-growing key-value (KV) cache. Although near-oracle top-k KV selection can preserve the quality of dense attention while sharply reducing computation and bandwidth, existing sparse methods generally rely on posterior heuristics, i.e., selectors conditioned on observed attention or proxy scores. Such conditioning introduces posterior bias: it tends to distort true token importance and miss salient tokens, thereby impairing long-range reasoning. To tackle this problem, we propose Pre-hoc Sparsity (PrHS), which selects KV entries before attention scoring and provides explicit accuracy control. Let the attention mass of discarded entries be delta (the dropped mass). Through a marginal-to-mutual-information analysis, we derive an upper bound on the mutual-information loss that depends only on the dropped mass. This relation explains failure modes of posterior heuristics and enables verifiable guarantees by controlling the dropped mass in advance. Within PrHS, we instantiate three orthogonal pre-hoc selectors along the axes of time, depth, and layer. Extensive experiments on LLaMA and Mistral families validate PrHS. Across GSM8K and CoQA, PrHS reduces retrieval overhead by over 90%, achieving 3x higher retrieval sparsity than HShare at matched or better accuracy. It incurs under 1% average degradation on LongBench, lowers attention FLOPs by about 15% versus prior sparse baselines, and yields a 9.9x speedup in attention-operator latency and 2.8x higher throughput on NVIDIA A100-80GB GPUs than the dense baseline.
papers.comment: An effective method for accelerating LLM's inference via selective KV processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Pre-hoc Sparsity (PrHS)，在注意力打分之前选择 KV 条目并显式控制被丢弃的注意力质量 δ，通过边际到互信息分析给出只依赖 δ 的互信息损失上界，从而避免后验启发式选择的后验偏差。在 LLaMA 与 Mistral 系列上，PrHS 检索开销降低超过 90%，在匹配或更高精度下达到 HShare 的 3 倍检索稀疏度，LongBench 平均精度下降不到 1%，注意力 FLOPs 较先前稀疏基线降约 15%，A100-80GB 上注意力算子延迟加速 9.9 倍、吞吐提升 2.8 倍。
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理的瓶颈是 KV cache 注意力开销；现有稀疏方法依赖基于已观测注意力或代理分数的后验启发式选择，产生后验偏差、扭曲真实 token 重要性并漏掉显著 token，损害长程推理。
Method: PrHS 在注意力打分前选择 KV 条目：以被丢弃注意力质量 δ 为控制量，经 marginal-to-mutual-information 分析推导只依赖 δ 的互信息损失上界，实现可验证的精度控制；框架内沿时间、深度、层三个轴实例化三个正交的 pre-hoc 选择器。
Result: 在 LLaMA 与 Mistral 系列、GSM8K 与 CoQA 上，检索开销降低超过 90%，在匹配或更优精度下达到 HShare 的 3 倍检索稀疏度；LongBench 平均精度下降不到 1%；注意力 FLOPs 较先前稀疏基线降低约 15%；在 NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU 上注意力算子延迟加速 9.9 倍、吞吐较 dense 基线提升 2.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把 KV 选择从后验启发式改为打分前的显式丢弃质量控制，可以在保持长上下文任务精度的同时大幅削减注意力开销，且精度保证可由 δ 上界事先验证。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 把 KV 选择从后验启发式改为打分前的显式丢弃质量控制，可以在保持长上下文任务精度的同时大幅削减注意力开销，且精度保证可由 δ 上界事先验证。

papers.title: IDRBench: Benchmarking the Interactive Capabilities of Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based deep research agents perform multi-step reasoning, web exploration, and long-form report generation. In these long-horizon workflows, early deviations from user intent can misdirect research and propagate through planning, search, and synthesis, making timely interaction essential. However, existing benchmarks primarily treat deep research as a static input-output task, overlooking agents' ability to elicit and use user feedback. We introduce IDRBench, a benchmark for evaluating interactive deep research with controlled opportunities for clarification. Within a common workflow and stage-wise interaction budget, IDRBench compares autonomous and interactive trajectories, measuring interaction benefit through changes in task-specific report alignment and interaction cost through turns and tokens. Comprehensive experiments on 100 tasks with seven proprietary and open-weight LLMs show that interaction improves all five alignment measures for every model, yielding an average gain of 6.39 points, while revealing distinct trade-offs among autonomous performance, alignment gain, and communication cost. At the task level, interaction improves performance in 74.4% of cases but degrades it in 19.9%, demonstrating that access to clarification alone does not guarantee better outcomes: success depends on what agents ask and how effectively they incorporate the resulting feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IDRBench 把深度研究智能体从静态输入-输出评测改为带澄清机会的交互评测：在统一工作流与分阶段交互预算下对比自主与交互轨迹，用报告对齐度衡量收益、用轮数与 token 衡量成本。100 个任务、七个专有与开放权重 LLM 上，交互使全部五个对齐指标对每个模型都提升，平均增益 6.39 分；任务层面 74.4% 变好、19.9% 变差，说明仅有澄清机会并不保证更好结果，成败取决于问什么以及如何吸收反馈。
Motivation: 深度研究智能体的长程工作流中，早期偏离用户意图会沿规划、搜索、合成一路传播，而现有基准把该任务当作静态输入-输出，忽略智能体主动获取并利用用户反馈的能力。
Method: 在统一工作流与分阶段交互预算 (stage-wise interaction budget) 下生成自主与交互两类轨迹，以任务特定的报告对齐度变化衡量交互收益、以轮数和 token 衡量交互成本；实验覆盖 100 个任务与七个专有和开放权重 LLM。
Result: 交互对每个模型都改善全部五个对齐指标，平均增益 6.39 分；任务层面 74.4% 的案例性能提升、19.9% 下降；同时呈现自主性能、对齐增益与通信开销之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 获得澄清机会本身不保证更好产出，结果取决于智能体提出的问题以及吸收反馈的有效程度。

papers.title: SPARQL-LLM: Real-Time SPARQL Query Generation from Natural Language Questions
papers.abstract_en: The advent of large language models is contributing to the emergence of novel approaches that promise to better tackle the challenge of generating structured queries, such as SPARQL queries, from natural language. However, these new approaches mostly focus on response accuracy while ignoring other evaluation criteria, such as runtime and cost to generate SPARQL queries. Consequently, they are often not production-ready or easy to deploy over real-world knowledge graphs with good accuracy. To mitigate these issues, in this paper, we describe and systematically evaluate SPARQL-LLM, an open-source and triplestore-agnostic approach, powered by lightweight metadata, that generates SPARQL queries from natural language text. First, we describe its architecture, which consists of dedicated components for metadata indexing, prompt building, and query generation and execution. Then, we evaluate it based on a state-of-the-art challenge with multilingual questions, and a collection of questions from three of the most prevalent knowledge graphs within the field of bioinformatics. Our results demonstrate a substantial improvement of up to 59% in F1 score over the second-best system participating in the challenge, adaptability to high-resource languages such as English, Spanish, and German, as well as ability to form complex bioinformatics queries. Furthermore, our results show that our system is up to 27x faster than the second-best system participating in the challenge, while costing a maximum of $0.01 per question, making it suitable for real-time, low-cost text-to-SPARQL applications. SPARQL-LLM is publicly released as an open-source project at https://github.com/sib-swiss/sparql-llm and is currently deployed over real-world decentralized knowledge graphs at https://www.expasy.org/chat.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 ACM Transactions on the Web (TWEB)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARQL-LLM 是一个开源、与 triplestore 无关的 text-to-SPARQL 系统，用轻量 metadata 索引、prompt 构建与查询生成/执行三个组件从自然语言直接产出 SPARQL。在多语言挑战赛上 F1 较第二名最高提升 59%，速度最高快 27 倍，每问成本不超过 $0.01，适合实时低成本部署。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 结构化查询生成方法只优化回答准确率，忽略运行时与成本，导致难以在真实知识图谱上以良好精度生产部署。
Method: SPARQL-LLM 架构含三个专用组件：metadata indexing、prompt building、query generation and execution，由轻量 metadata 驱动且不绑定特定 triplestore；在含多语言问题的 state-of-the-art challenge 与三个主流生物信息学知识图谱的问题集上系统评估。
Result: 在挑战赛上 F1 较第二名系统最高提升 59%；适配英语、西班牙语、德语等高资源语言并能构造复杂生物信息学查询；速度较第二名最高快 27 倍，每问成本最高 $0.01。
Conclusion: 兼顾准确率、运行时与成本的轻量 metadata 方案可让 text-to-SPARQL 达到实时、低成本的生产可用水平，系统已开源并部署在 expasy.org/chat。

papers.title: A Fast and Effective Solution to the Problem of Look-ahead Bias in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Applying LLMs to predictive tasks in finance is challenging due to look-ahead bias resulting from their training on long time-series data. This precludes the backtests typically employed in finance since retraining frontier models from scratch with a specific knowledge cutoff is prohibitive. In this paper, we introduce a fast, effective, and low-cost alternative. Our method guides generation at inference time by adjusting the logits of a large base model using a pair of smaller, specialized models -- one fine-tuned on information to be forgotten and another on information to be retained. We demonstrate that our method effectively removes both verbatim and semantic knowledge, corrects biases, and outperforms prior methods.
papers.comment: See frontiertopit.com for a production ready system, based off of this paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对金融预测任务中 LLM 因训练数据含未来信息而产生的 look-ahead bias，提出推理时 logit 调整方法：用一对小模型分别在“待遗忘信息”和“保留信息”上微调，引导大基座模型生成，从而免去按知识截止点重训前沿模型的昂贵回测流程。该方法能同时去除逐字 (verbatim) 与语义 (semantic) 层面的未来知识、纠正偏差，并优于既有方法。
Motivation: LLM 在长时间序列上训练导致 look-ahead bias，使金融回测失效；而为设定知识截止点从头重训前沿模型成本过高，需要低成本替代方案。
Method: 推理时对大基座模型的 logits 做调整：一对小的专用模型分别在待遗忘信息与待保留信息上微调，用其输出引导生成，无需重训大模型。
Result: 方法有效去除逐字与语义两类知识，纠正偏差，并在对比中优于先前方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 推理时 logit 调整可作为重训前沿模型的低成本替代来消除 look-ahead bias，使金融预测任务的回测重新可行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MLPerf Automotive
papers.abstract_en: We present MLPerf Automotive, the first standardized public performance benchmark for evaluating Machine Learning systems that are deployed for AI acceleration in automotive systems. Developed through a collaborative partnership within MLCommons, this benchmark addresses the need for standardized performance evaluation methodologies in automotive machine learning systems. Existing benchmark suites cannot be utilized for these systems since automotive workloads have unique constraints including sensor suites, safety, and real-time processing that distinguish them from the domains that previously introduced benchmarks target. Our implemented and adopted MLPerf Automotive benchmark is a framework for evaluation and methodology for benchmarking automotive systems with reproducible performance metrics. The benchmark consists of automotive perception tasks in 2D object detection, 2D semantic segmentation, 3D object detection, end-to-end driving, and an infotainment system application. We carefully curated and customized models for automotive use cases. We describe the methodology behind the benchmark design including the task selection, reference models, and submission rules. We also discuss the challenges involved in acquiring the datasets and the engineering efforts to develop the reference implementations. Our benchmark code is available at https://github.com/mlcommons/mlperf_automotive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MLPerf Automotive 是 MLCommons 推出的首个面向车载 AI 加速的标准化公开性能基准，覆盖 2D 目标检测、2D 语义分割、3D 目标检测、端到端驾驶与车载信息娱乐五类任务，并配套定制参考模型、数据集与提交规则。它把传感器套件、安全与实时处理这类车载特有约束纳入可复现的性能度量方法，代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Motivation: 现有基准套件面向的领域与车载负载不同，无法直接用于具有传感器套件、安全与实时处理约束的汽车机器学习系统，缺少统一可复现的性能评测方法。
Method: 在 MLCommons 框架下设计任务选择、参考模型与提交规则的评测方法学，为汽车用例定制并挑选模型，覆盖 2D/3D 目标检测、2D 语义分割、端到端驾驶和信息娱乐应用，并解决数据集获取与参考实现的工程问题。
Result: 提出并落地了 MLPerf Automotive 基准框架与方法学，包含五类汽车感知任务、定制参考模型和可复现性能度量，配套数据集与参考实现，代码发布于 github.com/mlcommons/mlperf_automotive。
Conclusion: 汽车 ML 系统需要独立于既有基准的专用评测体系，因为其实时、安全与传感器约束无法由先前领域的基准直接覆盖。

papers.title: Unraveling the cognitive patterns of Large Language Models through module communities
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have reshaped our world with significant advancements in science, engineering, and society through applications ranging from scientific discoveries and medical diagnostics to Chatbots. Despite their ubiquity and utility, the underlying mechanisms of LLM remain concealed within billions of parameters and complex structures, making their inner architecture and cognitive processes challenging to comprehend. We address this gap by adopting approaches to understanding emerging cognition in biology and developing a network-based framework that links cognitive skills, LLM architectures, and datasets, ushering in a paradigm shift in foundation model analysis. The skill distribution in the module communities demonstrates that while LLMs do not strictly parallel the focalized specialization observed in specific biological systems, they exhibit unique communities of modules whose emergent skill patterns partially mirror the distributed yet interconnected cognitive organization seen in avian and small mammalian brains. Our numerical results highlight a key divergence from biological systems to LLMs, where skill acquisition benefits substantially from dynamic, cross-regional interactions and neural plasticity. By integrating cognitive science principles with machine learning, our framework provides new insights into LLM interpretability and suggests that effective fine-tuning strategies should leverage distributed learning dynamics rather than rigid modular interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把生物学中涌现认知的分析思路搬到 LLM，构建连接认知技能、模型架构与数据集的网络框架，按模块社群 (module communities) 统计技能分布。结果显示 LLM 不具备生物系统那种严格局域化分工，其社群化技能模式更接近鸟类与小型哺乳动物脑的分布式互联组织，且技能习得明显受益于跨区域动态交互与神经可塑性；据此作者主张微调应利用分布式学习动力学而非刚性模块干预。
Motivation: LLM 的认知过程埋在数十亿参数与复杂结构里，缺少把认知技能、架构模块与数据集对应起来的分析框架，可解释性与微调策略设计都缺乏依据。
Method: 借鉴生物学中涌现认知 (emerging cognition) 的研究方法，建立一个把认知技能、LLM 架构与数据集三者关联的网络框架，按模块社群分析技能分布，并与生物系统的技能组织做对照；摘要未给出具体网络构建或训练细节。
Result: 数值结果表明 LLM 的技能分布不严格对应生物系统中的局域化专门化 (focalized specialization)，其模块社群的涌现技能模式部分镜像鸟类与小型哺乳动物脑的分布式互联认知组织；关键分歧在于 LLM 的技能习得大幅受益于动态跨区域交互与神经可塑性。
Conclusion: LLM 的认知组织是分布式而非刚性模块化的，因此有效的微调策略应利用分布式学习动力学，而不是做刚性的模块化干预。

papers.title: Stacked SVD or SVD stacked? A Random Matrix Theory perspective on data integration
papers.abstract_en: Modern data analysis increasingly requires identifying shared latent structure across multiple high-dimensional datasets. A commonly used model assumes that the data matrices are noisy observations of low-rank matrices with a shared singular subspace. In this case, two primary methods have emerged for estimating this shared structure, which vary in how they integrate information across datasets. The first approach, termed Stack-SVD, concatenates all the datasets, and then performs a singular value decomposition (SVD). The second approach, termed SVD-Stack, first performs an SVD separately for each dataset, then aggregates the top singular vectors across these datasets, and finally computes a consensus amongst them. While these methods are widely used, they have not been rigorously studied in the proportional asymptotic regime, which is of great practical relevance in today's world of increasing data size and dimensionality. Consequently, it remains unclear when one method should be preferred over another. In this work, we derive exact expressions for the asymptotic performance and phase transitions of these two methods and develop optimal weighting schemes to further improve both methods. Our analysis reveals that while neither method uniformly dominates the other in the unweighted case, optimally weighted Stack-SVD dominates optimally weighted SVD-Stack when the low rank signal is fully shared across the datasets. We then analyze multiple, partially shared components per dataset and demonstrate that SVD-Stack can yield improved performance without requiring estimation of subspace alignment. Finally, we provide practical algorithms for estimating optimal weights from data, offering theoretical guidance for method selection in practical data integration problems. Extensive numerical simulations and semi-synthetic experiments on genomic data corroborate our theoretical findings.
papers.comment: 61 pages. Analysis extended to handle multiple, partially shared components per dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在比例渐近 (proportional asymptotic) 区间下推导 Stack-SVD（拼接后做一次 SVD）与 SVD-Stack（各数据集分别 SVD 再聚合 top 奇异向量求共识）的精确渐近性能与相变，并给出最优加权方案。结论是：未加权时两者互有胜负；当低秩信号在各数据集间完全共享时，最优加权 Stack-SVD 压过最优加权 SVD-Stack；而当每个数据集含多个部分共享成分时，SVD-Stack 无需估计子空间对齐即可更优。
Motivation: 多份高维数据共享低秩奇异子空间时，Stack-SVD 与 SVD-Stack 两种整合方式被广泛使用，但在与当今数据规模匹配的比例渐近区间下缺乏严格分析，何时该选哪一种一直不清楚。
Method: 在比例渐近区间下推导两种方法的精确渐近表达式与相变边界；基于此构造最优加权方案并给出从数据中估计权重的实用算法；分析从完全共享信号扩展到每个数据集含多个部分共享成分的情形。
Result: 得到两种方法的精确渐近性能与相变表达式；未加权情形下无一致占优者；最优加权 Stack-SVD 在信号完全共享时占优于最优加权 SVD-Stack；部分共享成分情形下 SVD-Stack 无需估计子空间对齐即可提升性能。大量数值模拟与基因组数据上的半合成实验 (semi-synthetic experiments) 佐证理论结论。
Conclusion: 方法选择取决于共享结构：信号完全共享时选最优加权 Stack-SVD，存在多个部分共享成分时 SVD-Stack 更划算；最优权重可从数据估计，为实际数据整合提供可操作的选型依据。

papers.title: CatSIM: A Categorical Image Similarity Metric
papers.abstract_en: We introduce CatSIM, a new similarity metric for binary and multinary two- and three-dimensional images and volumes. CatSIM uses a structural similarity image quality paradigm and is robust to small perturbations in location so that structures in similar, but not entirely overlapping, image or volumetric regions are rated higher than by simple matching. The metric can also compare arbitrary regions inside images and volumes. CatSIM is evaluated on artificial data sets, validated by comparing with human perception in two separate image quality assessment surveys, and illustrated on two datasets. The publicly available R package \texttt{catsim} implements the methodology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CatSIM 是面向二值与多值二维图像及三维体数据的结构相似度度量，基于 SSIM 范式并对位置小扰动鲁棒，使相似但不完全重叠的结构获得高于简单匹配的评分，还可比较图像内部任意区域。它在人工数据集上评估、经两项图像质量主观调查与人类感知比对验证，并以 R 包 catsim 开源实现。
Motivation: 二值/多值图像与体数据的相似度比较中，简单匹配对位置小扰动过于敏感，完全重叠假设会低估结构相似但略有错位的区域。
Method: CatSIM 沿用结构相似度 (SSIM) 图像质量范式构造度量，对位置小扰动鲁棒，并支持在图像或体数据内比较任意指定区域；在人工数据集上评估，用两项图像质量评估调查与人类感知比对做验证，实现为公开 R 包 catsim。
Result: 在人工数据集上评估，并通过两项独立的图像质量评估调查与人类感知比对完成验证；在两个数据集上演示应用；对相似但不完全重叠的结构，评分高于简单匹配。
Conclusion: CatSIM 提供了一个对错位鲁棒、可比较任意区域的分类图像相似度度量，并以开源 R 包形式可复现。

papers.title: Stochastic Inertial Krasnosel'skii-Mann Iteration Achieves Near-Optimal Sample Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We analyze a simple stochastic inertial Krasnosel'skii--Mann (iKM) method for finding a fixed point of a nonexpansive operator in a real Hilbert space. Our method is obtained simply by adding two inertial extrapolations to stochastic KM [Bravo and Cominetti, 2024], and it retains one call to a possibly biased stochastic oracle per update and achieves sharp rates in both the stochastic and deterministic regimes. Specifically, with our proposed parameter schedule, we prove the following last-iterate fixed-point residual bound: \[ {O}\!\left(\frac{1}{K} +\frac{σ\log K}{\sqrt K} +\frac{B_K\log K}{K}\right), \] where $K$ is the horizon, $σ$ is the noise level and $B_K$ is the accumulated root-mean-square bias. When $B_K=O(\sqrt K)$, this yields $\widetilde O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity that matches, up to a logarithmic factor, the stochastic-oracle lower bound given under the unbiased subclass of our model [Foster et al., 2019, Theorem 2]. It also improves the best-known $O(ε^{-4})$ random-iterate guarantee for stochastic KM [Bravo and Cominetti, 2024, Corollary 5.4]. To our knowledge, this is the first single-loop method for general nonexpansive fixed-point problems to attain this near-optimal sample complexity without variance reduction or batching. When the oracle is exact, the same method attains the worst-case-optimal $O(K^{-1})$ last-iterate residual rate [Park and Ryu, 2022, Theorem 4.6], improving the $O(K^{-1/2})$ rate of classical KM [Cominetti et al., 2014; Bravo and Cominetti, 2018].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在实 Hilbert 空间上给随机惯性 Krasnosel'skii-Mann (iKM) 方法配上参数调度，单循环、每次更新只调用一次可能有偏的随机 oracle，证明 last-iterate 不动点残差界 O(1/K + σlogK/√K + B_K logK/K)。当累积 RMS 偏差 B_K=O(√K) 时得到 Õ(ε^{-2}) 样本复杂度，仅差对数因子即达随机 oracle 下界；oracle 精确时达到最坏情形最优 O(K^{-1}) 残差率。
Motivation: 一般非扩张算子不动点问题的随机单循环方法此前最好只有 O(ε^{-4}) 的随机迭代保证，且常需方差缩减或 batching 才能逼近随机 oracle 下界。
Method: 在 Bravo 与 Cominetti (2024) 的随机 KM 上加两处惯性外推 (inertial extrapolation)，配一个新参数调度；分析对象是带可能有偏随机 oracle 的非扩张算子不动点问题，给出 last-iterate 残差界而非随机迭代点界。
Result: last-iterate 残差界 O(1/K + σlogK/√K + B_K logK/K)；B_K=O(√K) 时样本复杂度 Õ(ε^{-2})，对齐 Foster et al. (2019, Theorem 2) 在无偏子类下的下界（仅差对数因子），并把随机 KM 的 O(ε^{-4}) 保证 (Bravo and Cominetti 2024, Corollary 5.4) 改进；oracle 精确时达到 Park and Ryu (2022, Theorem 4.6) 的最坏情形最优 O(K^{-1})，优于经典 KM 的 O(K^{-1/2})。
Conclusion: 两处惯性外推加合适参数调度，就能让一般非扩张不动点问题的单循环随机方法在不使用方差缩减或 batching 的前提下拿到近最优样本复杂度，同时在确定性情形保持最优 last-iterate 率。

papers.title: Adaptive Tiling for Least-Squares Phase Unwrapping: Runtime and Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Phase unwrapping estimates the missing multiples of $2π$ in measured phase images. For large images, tiling limits the size of local reconstruction problems and enables parallel processing. Adaptive tiling could further reduce the number of local problems and boundaries by retaining large tiles where little refinement is needed. We investigate whether this reduction makes reconstruction faster. We compare complete reconstruction time and accuracy for a regular grid, quadtree, and kd-tree partitions. We also evaluate nine criteria for deciding where quadtree tiles should be subdivided, including residue count, fringe density, and measures of phase variation, at different tile sizes and budgets. In single-threaded experiments on a heterogeneous image dataset, optimized adaptive partitions use fewer tiles but remain slower than the optimized grid, and some reconstructions lose substantial accuracy. Stage measurements explain why: constructing the partition and solving larger retained tiles outweigh the savings at tile boundaries. The criterion comparison also shows that more refinement does not consistently improve accuracy. These results motivate evaluating adaptive partitions by the complete time needed to reach a chosen reconstruction accuracy, including whether limited refinement can provide a faster approximate result.
papers.comment: Technical report. 15 pages of main text and references, followed by 8 pages of supplementary material. 6 figures, 8 tables and 2 algorithms in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在相位解缠 (phase unwrapping) 的分块重建中，自适应分块（quadtree、kd-tree）用更少的 tile 却比优化过的规则网格更慢，且部分重建精度明显下降。原因是构造分块与求解更大保留 tile 的开销超过了边界处节省；细化越多也不必然越准。作者主张按达到指定精度所需的完整耗时来评估自适应分块。
Motivation: 大尺寸相位图的局部重建问题规模受限，自适应分块本希望减少局部问题数与边界以加速，但这一加速假设未经完整重建时间与精度的对照检验。
Method: 对比规则网格 (regular grid)、quadtree、kd-tree 三种分块；评估九种 quadtree 细分判据（含 residue count、fringe density 与相位变化度量），在不同 tile 尺寸与预算下做单线程实验，用分阶段计时拆解构造分块与求解的耗时。
Result: 在异构图像数据集的单线程实验中，优化后的自适应分块用更少 tile 但仍慢于优化网格，部分重建精度大幅下降；阶段计时显示构造分块与求解更大保留 tile 的开销超过边界节省；判据对比显示更多细化并不一致提升精度。
Conclusion: 自适应分块的收益必须按达到目标重建精度所需的完整时间来衡量，而非只看 tile 数或边界数；有限细化能否给出更快的近似结果是后续应评估的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $\unicode{x1F493}$Heartian: Physiology-Aware Relightable Gaussian Head Avatar
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian head avatars typically model intrinsic facial appearance as temporally static, omitting subtle cardiac-induced skin-color variation. We propose $\unicode{x1F493}$Heartian, a physiology-aware modulation framework that learns cardiac-cycle-dependent per-frame albedo modulation of facial skin-region Gaussians within a relightable head avatar to encode remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals. Using synchronized contact PPG supervision, $\unicode{x1F493}$Heartian models the prescribed cardiac waveform as the sum of two Gaussian functions and learns per-frame spatial residuals via a lightweight MLP. Across 152 stationary recordings from UBFC-rPPG, PURE, and MMPD, attribute-space recovery of the supplied signal achieves a pooled recording-level heart-rate MAE of 0.29 bpm and MAPE of 0.38%. The signals remain detectable after rendering by benchmark rPPG methods, with the best tested configuration - a motion-augmented TS-CAN decoder pretrained on UBFC-rPPG - recovering heart rate from the rendered MMPD avatars at 0.97 bpm MAE and 1.21% MAPE. Meanwhile, $\unicode{x1F493}$Heartian maintains reconstruction quality comparable to the baseline, with negligible average PSNR degradation of 0.005 dB. Overall, our work embeds recoverable rPPG signals as controllable material attributes to subject-specific Gaussian head avatars while retaining the reconstruction quality.
papers.comment: 4 pages of manuscript and 2 pages of supplementary material; SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Heartian 在可重光照 Gaussian 头像中把心脏周期相关的逐帧皮肤反照率调制当作可控材质属性，编码 rPPG 信号：用接触式 PPG 监督，把心波建模为两个高斯函数之和加轻量 MLP 学习的空间残差。152 段静止录制上属性空间恢复的心率 MAE 0.29 bpm、MAPE 0.38%，渲染后由 TS-CAN 从 MMPD 头像恢复心率 MAE 0.97 bpm、MAPE 1.21%，重建 PSNR 平均仅降 0.005 dB。
Motivation: Gaussian 头像把面部固有外观当作时间静态，丢掉心跳引起的细微肤色变化，因而无法在重光照渲染中保留可恢复的生理信号。
Method: 在可重光照头像的皮肤区域 Gaussian 上学习逐帧反照率调制，用心波为两个高斯函数之和的先验加轻量 MLP 输出逐帧空间残差，以同步接触式 PPG 作监督；在 UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD 上训练与检验。
Result: 152 段静止录制（UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD）上，属性空间恢复所给信号的录制级心率 MAE 0.29 bpm、MAPE 0.38%；渲染结果经基准 rPPG 方法仍可检出，最佳配置为在 UBFC-rPPG 预训练的 motion-augmented TS-CAN decoder，从渲染的 MMPD 头像恢复心率 MAE 0.97 bpm、MAPE 1.21%；重建质量与基线相当，PSNR 平均下降仅 0.005 dB。
Conclusion: 把可恢复的 rPPG 信号嵌入个体化 Gaussian 头像的可控材质属性是可行的，且重建质量基本不受损。

summary_sections.result: 152 段静止录制（UBFC-rPPG、PURE、MMPD）上，属性空间恢复所给信号的录制级心率 MAE 0.29 bpm、MAPE 0.38%；渲染结果经基准 rPPG 方法仍可检出，最佳配置为在 UBFC-rPPG 预训练的 motion-augmented TS-CAN decoder，从渲染的 MMPD 头像恢复心率 MAE 0.97 bpm、MAPE 1.21%；重建质量与基线相当，PSNR 平均下降仅 0.005 dB。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把可恢复的 rPPG 信号嵌入个体化 Gaussian 头像的可控材质属性是可行的，且重建质量基本不受损。

papers.title: An Exposition of GPT Astra's Proof of Lower Bound on DP Continual Counting
papers.abstract_en: The goal of this note is to give a detailed proof, to the best of our understanding, of the recent presentation by Harrison and Leeman (arXiv:2609.17650v01 and arXiv:2609.17650v02) of the proof by Astra on the lower bound for differentially private continual counting. We believe a more natural and easy proof is possible and hope that this note will help in that effort. Prior to the initial preprint by Harrison and Leeman (arXiv:2609.17650v01), Bairaktari and Larsen (arXiv:2607.00876) gave an elegant proof to show a lower bound of $Ω(\log^{3/2}(n))$ for both pure and approximate-DP continual counting, and in personal communication had informed us that they have a proof of optimal $Ω(\log^{2}(n))$ for pure-differential private continual counting as well. They have subsequently published their $Ω(\log^{2}(n))$ bound, which is now a joint work of Bairaktari, Dahl, and Larsen (arXiv:2607.00876v3). Their new result is an elegant extension of their technique for approximate-differential privacy. Although the two proofs are technically different, the Astra argument uses related tree geometry introduced in Bairaktari and Larsen.
papers.comment: This is full proof of GPT generated proof for DP continual counting written in preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.17650v2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于差分隐私 (DP) 连续计数 (continual counting) 下界的证明笔记，给出 GPT Astra 所提证明的详细版本，并对照 Bairaktari–Larsen 及 Bairaktari–Dahl–Larsen 的 Ω(log^{3/2}(n)) 与最优 Ω(log^2(n)) 下界讨论其树几何 (tree geometry) 论证。作者认为存在更自然、更简洁的证明路径。
Motivation: Harrison 与 Leeman 转述的 Astra 证明较为晦涩，而 DP 连续计数的紧下界（纯 DP 的 Ω(log^2(n))）刚由 Bairaktari–Dahl–Larsen 给出，需要一份可读的完整证明来核对并推动更自然的证明。
Method: 逐条重写 Astra 的下界证明，采用 Bairaktari 与 Larsen 引入的相关树几何结构；与 Bairaktari–Larsen 的 Ω(log^{3/2}(n))（纯 DP 与近似 DP）及后续 Ω(log^2(n))（纯 DP）技术做对照说明。
Result: 笔记所针对的已知下界为：Ω(log^{3/2}(n))（纯 DP 与近似 DP 连续计数，Bairaktari–Larsen，arXiv:2607.00876）与最优 Ω(log^2(n))（纯 DP，Bairaktari–Dahl–Larsen，arXiv:2607.00876v3）；Astra 论证与之使用相关的树几何但技术上不同。
Conclusion: Astra 的下界论证可被完整、可读地重述，且与 Bairaktari–Larsen 系的树几何方法同源；作者主张还存在更自然易懂的证明。

papers.title: Sequential Confidence Sets for Coverage-Constrained Conformal Model Selection
papers.abstract_en: Modern conformal forecasting systems often maintain several adaptive pipelines that differ in base forecasters, conformity scores, calibration windows, and update rules. Comparing them is difficult because coverage is a hard constraint, whereas efficiency should be optimized only among feasible pipelines. We formulate this problem as sequential inference for a stochastic constrained argmin. At each time, the target is the set of minimum-cost pipelines satisfying multiple prefix-average conditional miscoverage constraints. We introduce Coverage-Constrained Sequential Model Confidence Sets (CC-SMCS), which separate certifiably feasible, possibly feasible, and possibly constrained-optimal pipelines. Using simultaneous martingale confidence sequences, CC-SMCS projects a rectangular confidence region onto the constrained argmin and admits an exact closed-form rule. With probability at least $1-δ$, it contains every constrained-optimal pipeline simultaneously over all times. This finite-sample guarantee requires no stationarity or mixing assumptions and remains valid under data-dependent stopping. We also establish an impossibility result for safe certification at the coverage boundary and extend the construction to delayed multi-horizon feedback and outcome-dependent efficiency objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 conformal 预报系统中多条自适应流水线的比较写成随机约束 argmin 的序贯推断：CC-SMCS 用同时 martingale 置信序列把矩形置信域投影到约束 argmin，闭式规则把流水线分为可认证可行、可能可行、可能约束最优三类。以至少 1−δ 的概率在所有时刻同时包含每条约束最优流水线，无需平稳性或混合假设，并在数据依赖停时下仍有效。
Motivation: conformal 预报系统常并存多条在基预报器、conformity 分数、校准窗和更新规则上不同的自适应流水线，而覆盖率是硬约束、效率只能在可行流水线之间优化，逐条比较因此难以给出带保证的结论。
Method: 将选择问题表述为随机约束 argmin 的序贯推断，目标是满足多个前缀平均条件欠覆盖约束的最小代价流水线集合；CC-SMCS 借助同时 martingale 置信序列构造矩形置信域并投影到约束 argmin，得到精确闭式判定规则，另给出覆盖边界处安全认证的不可能性结果，并把构造扩展到延迟多时段反馈与依赖结果的效率目标。
Result: 有限样本保证：以至少 1−δ 的概率，CC-SMCS 在所有时刻同时包含每条约束最优流水线；该保证不依赖平稳性或混合假设，且在数据依赖停时下仍成立。另证明覆盖边界处安全认证的不可能性结果。
Conclusion: 覆盖率硬约束下的流水线选择可以做成带同时有限样本保证的序贯置信集问题，但覆盖边界附近的安全认证存在原理性障碍，需按不可能性结果界定可认证范围。

papers.title: Certified Task-Conditioned Active Observability
papers.abstract_en: Before acting upon an unobservable physical system, an autonomous agent must determine which latent distinctions govern downstream tasks, how many active interventions are necessary to certify them, and when to abstain to prevent catastrophic errors. Classical observability treats state reconstruction as an unconditioned binary predicate, failing when passive observations cannot break latent degeneracies without perturbation, full microscopic inversion is prohibitively costly, and distinguishing task-irrelevant degrees of freedom wastes interaction budgets. We formalize task-conditioned active observability complexity: the minimum worst-case expected interaction cost required to identify task-relevant states under certified error and safe abstention guarantees. We prove that task-predictive equivalence induces the unique minimal sufficient quotient $\mathcal{H}/\!\sim_τ$, leaving active observability complexity strictly invariant while eliminating superfluous distinctions. In deterministic regimes, this complexity is characterized by an optimal adaptive distinguishing tree and Bellman recursion; in noisy regimes, it obeys a stopped-transcript relative-entropy lower bound and adaptive martingale certificates that compose without independence assumptions. We instantiate a prospective certified observer with staged recovery: a nominal verifier defers candidate compilation, triggering active probing only upon evidence, while a history-measurable score shell prunes hypotheses without sacrificing risk bounds. Stress audits across high-dimensional physical systems and thousands of operational trials demonstrate certified state recovery with zero false acceptances and substantial reductions in sensor reads and model steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把可观测性从无条件的二元谓词改写为任务条件的主动可观测性复杂度：在认证错误与安全弃权约束下，识别任务相关状态所需的最小最坏情况期望交互代价。任务预测等价诱导唯一最小充分商 H/~τ，使该复杂度严格不变而剔除多余区分；确定性体制由最优自适应区分树与 Bellman 递归刻画，噪声体制由停止转录相对熵下界与自适应鞅证书刻画。在高维物理系统压力审计与数千次运行试验中实现零误接受，并显著减少传感器读取与模型步数。
Motivation: 经典可观测性把状态重建当作无条件二元判定：被动观测无法打破需要扰动才显形的隐变量简并，完整微观反演代价过高，而区分与任务无关的自由度会白白消耗交互预算。
Method: 形式化任务条件主动可观测性复杂度（认证错误 + 安全弃权下的最小最坏期望交互代价）；证明任务预测等价给出唯一最小充分商 H/~τ；确定性体制用最优自适应区分树与 Bellman 递归，噪声体制用停止转录相对熵下界与无需独立性假设即可复合的自适应鞅证书；实例化带分级恢复的认证观测器：名义验证器延迟候选编译、仅在有证据时触发主动探测，历史可测的 score shell 剪枝假设且不牺牲风险界。
Result: 在高维物理系统压力审计与数千次运行试验中，认证状态恢复达到零误接受 (zero false acceptances)，传感器读取与模型步数均有显著减少。
Conclusion: 任务相关性应通过最小充分商来定义可观测性：只区分下游任务需要的隐状态，就能在保持认证风险界的同时压低交互代价，并在证据出现前保持弃权。

papers.title: When is logistic error growth a spectral reduction?
papers.abstract_en: Forecast-error growth has been studied through complementary approaches: scalar models describe the evolution of bulk error, whereas spectral theories follow decorrelation and error transfer across scales. Their connection matters when a fitted growth curve is used to infer a physical mechanism or a limit of predictability. We establish a conditional link between these approaches. Within a bilinear spectral exchange model, assume a stationary reference spectrum and a remainder that vanishes on the proposed common-shape evolution. For a common initial decorrelation fraction strictly between zero and one, the spectral shape is preserved and its amplitude grows logistically exactly when every participating scale shares one positive growth coefficient. The converse inference fails: a logistic aggregate need not imply proportional decorrelation or a common coefficient. An exact two-shell construction demonstrates this failure with identical aggregate curves and different spectral dynamics. For heterogeneous amplitudes, an exact averaging identity separates the contributions of growth-rate mismatch, shape variance, rate--shape covariance, evolving spectral weights, and residual tendencies. A finite-time bound relates their combined effect to departure from a reference logistic curve. Forced surface-quasigeostrophic simulations illustrate how similar retrospective agreement with a logistic reference can coexist with heterogeneous effective shell rates and substantial instantaneous tendency discrepancies. Thus a scalar growth curve alone cannot identify how uncertainty is distributed across scales or justify interpreting a fitted rate as a common spectral growth coefficient. The framework specifies the additional spectral and budget evidence needed to give scalar predictability models that interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在双线性谱交换模型中，只有当所有参与尺度共享同一个正增长系数时，谱形保持不变且幅度严格按 logistic 增长，这是充分条件；反向推断不成立——一个 logistic 的总量曲线并不蕴含按比例去相关或共同系数。作者用一个精确的双壳 (two-shell) 构造给出总量曲线完全相同而谱动力学不同的反例，并指出标量增长曲线本身无法识别不确定性在各尺度上的分布。
Motivation: 用拟合的 logistic 增长曲线反推物理机制或可预报性极限是常见做法，但标量误差模型与谱理论之间的对应关系此前缺少判定条件，误读会把一个聚合拟合率当成共同的谱增长系数。
Method: 在双线性谱交换模型中假设平稳参考谱、余项在所提共同形状演化上消失，推导谱形保持与 logistic 增长的充要条件；用精确双壳构造证伪逆命题；对非均匀幅度给出一个精确平均恒等式，分离增长率失配、形状方差、率-形状协方差、演化谱权重与残余倾向五项贡献，并给出它们偏离参考 logistic 曲线的有限时间界；最后用强迫的 surface quasi-geostrophic 模拟作说明。
Result: 当初始去相关分数严格介于 0 与 1 时，谱形保持且幅度 logistic 增长当且仅当每个参与尺度共享同一正增长系数；双壳构造给出总量曲线完全相同而谱动力学不同的实例；强迫 SQG 模拟显示对同一 logistic 参考曲线的事后拟合可以很接近，同时各壳有效增长率异质、瞬时倾向差异显著。
Conclusion: 标量 logistic 曲线单独不足以识别不确定性在尺度间的分布，也不能把拟合率解释为共同的谱增长系数；要给出这种解释，必须补充谱形与误差预算方面的证据。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: DCRMTA: Deep Causal Representation Learning for Multi-Touch Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Multi-touch attribution (MTA) is essential for estimating the contribution of individual advertising touchpoints to user conversions. While recent studies incorporate causal inference to mitigate confounding bias from user preferences, existing multi-stage deconfounding pipelines exhibit a critical structural flaw: they indiscriminately filter out user influences, which inadvertently discards the genuine causal signals linking user covariates to conversions. To resolve this trade-off, we propose Deep Causal Representation for MTA (DCRMTA), an end-to-end framework that explicitly quantifies and preserves the causal impact of user features. By leveraging structural causal modeling and adaptive counterfactual attention perturbations, DCRMTA distills invariant user representations while actively decoupling them from latent confounding variables. Extensive experiments on real-world industrial datasets demonstrate the efficacy of our approach. DCRMTA effectively improves predictive accuracy yielding up to a 5.2\% relative improvement in PR-AUC over strong baselines while providing robust, Shapley-based credit allocations across complex marketing channels.

papers.title: Does DCGAN-Based Synthetic Augmentation Improve Brain Tumor MRI Classification? An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) are increasingly used to augment medical imaging datasets, but synthetic images do not necessarily provide downstream classification benefits. This study investigates whether class-specific Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN) augmentation improves brain tumor classification when the classifier and evaluation set are held constant. Experiments were conducted on 7,200 brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans across four classes: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. For each class, 1,400 real images were used for training and 400 were reserved for testing. A baseline Swin Transformer classifier was trained using only the real training images and compared with a second model trained using the same real images augmented with 500 DCGAN-generated images per class. Both conditions were evaluated on the identical held-out test set. The two models achieved the same overall accuracy of 96%, while macro F1 remained effectively unchanged and ROC-AUC decreased slightly from 0.987 to 0.982 after augmentation. Class-level analysis showed small redistributions in errors rather than a consistent performance gain. FID values between real and synthetic images ranged from 209.15 to 314.27, indicating substantial distributional differences under the adopted evaluation setup. These results suggest that synthetic augmentation should not be assumed to improve medical image classification and should instead be evaluated for both distributional fidelity and downstream task utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 7,200 例脑 MRI、四类肿瘤（glioma/meningioma/pituitary/no tumor）上，固定 Swin Transformer 分类器与同一留出测试集，每类加入 500 张 DCGAN 合成图后总体准确率仍为 96%，macro F1 基本不变，ROC-AUC 反而从 0.987 降到 0.982。真实-合成图像 FID 在 209.15–314.27 之间，分布差异明显，误差只在类间小幅重分配。结论是合成增强不能默认提升医学图像分类，须同时核对分布保真度与下游任务效用。
Motivation: GAN 合成图被广泛用于扩充医学影像训练集，但合成样本不必然带来下游分类收益，需要在分类器与评测集固定的前提下分离其真实作用。
Method: 以 7,200 张脑 MRI、每类 1,400 张真实训练图与 400 张测试图为基准，训练 Swin Transformer：一组只用真实图，另一组在相同真实图基础上每类加 500 张 DCGAN 生成图，两组在同一留出测试集上比较，并计算真实与合成图像的 FID。
Result: 两组总体准确率同为 96%，macro F1 基本不变，ROC-AUC 由 0.987 降至 0.982；类级分析显示误差小幅重分配而非一致提升；真实-合成 FID 介于 209.15 与 314.27，表明所用评测设置下分布差异显著。
Conclusion: 类别专属 DCGAN 增强在该设置下不带来下游分类收益，合成增强应先通过分布保真度与下游效用两道检验再采用。

papers.title: Calpric: Inclusive and Fine-grain Labeling of Privacy Policies with Crowdsourcing and Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: A significant challenge to training accurate deep learning models on privacy policies is the cost and difficulty of obtaining a large and comprehensive set of training data. To address these challenges, we present Calpric, which combines automatic text selection and segmentation, active learning and the use of crowdsourced annotators to generate a large, balanced training set for privacy policies at low cost. Automated text selection and segmentation simplify the labeling task, enabling untrained annotators from crowdsourcing platforms, like Amazon's Mechanical Turk, to be competitive with trained annotators, such as law students, and also reduce inter-annotator disagreement, which decreases labeling cost. Having reliable labels for training enables the use of active learning, which uses fewer training samples to efficiently cover the input space, further reducing cost and improving class and data category balance in the data set. The combination of these techniques allows Calpric to produce models that are accurate over a wider range of data categories, and provide more detailed, fine-grain labels than previous work. Our crowdsourcing process enables Calpric to attain reliable labeled data at a cost of roughly $0.92-$1.71 per labeled text segment. Calpric's training process also generates a labeled data set of 16K privacy policy text segments across 9 Data categories with balanced positive and negative samples.
papers.journal_ref: 32nd USENIX Security Symposium, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Calpric 用自动文本选择与分段、主动学习 (active learning) 和众包标注三者组合，把隐私政策的细粒度标注成本压到每段约 $0.92–$1.71，并产出 16K 段、9 个 Data 类别、正负样本平衡的训练集。分段简化任务后，Amazon Mechanical Turk 上未经训练的标注者可与法学生等受训标注者竞争，标注分歧下降进一步降低成本。
Motivation: 训练隐私政策深度模型的瓶颈是获取大规模、全面且类别均衡的标注数据成本高、难度大，传统依赖受训标注者的方式难以扩展。
Method: 先用自动文本选择与分段把长政策切成小任务，再让众包平台 (Amazon Mechanical Turk) 的非受训标注者标注以降低分歧与成本；拿到可靠标签后引入主动学习，用更少样本覆盖输入空间，同时改善类别与数据类别的平衡，最终训练出比先前工作覆盖类别更广、标签更细的模型。
Result: 标注成本约 $0.92–$1.71 每个文本段；生成 16K 条隐私政策文本段、覆盖 9 个 Data 类别、正负样本平衡的标注数据集；未经训练的众包标注者在该流程下可与受训标注者（如法学生）竞争，标注者间分歧降低。
Conclusion: 自动分段加众包加主动学习的组合能以低成本产出可靠、细粒度且类别均衡的隐私政策标注数据，使模型在更广数据类别上准确并给出比先前工作更细的标签。

papers.title: TW3Cast: A Frozen Router of Lightly Fine-Tuned Foundation Models for Time-Series Forecasting on GIFT-Eval, Selected Entirely on the Training Split
papers.abstract_en: TW3Cast is a time-series forecasting system that reaches position 3 of 130 entries on the GIFT-Eval benchmark by mean MASE rank, as of 2026-09-14. The two entries above it belong to the leaderboard's agentic category, multi-step systems that use agents or language models to reason about, generate or select forecasts. TW3Cast runs no agent and no language model. Its selection is a table computed once on the training split and then frozen, and its experts are public foundation models lightly fine-tuned on those training splits. For each of the 97 dataset, frequency and horizon configurations, the table serves one of four modes: a specialist, which is a LoRA or full fine-tune of Chronos-2, TiRex or Toto whose training data was cleaned and enriched by explicit rules; a quantile blend that contains a specialist; a blend of base models; or a selection tournament played on a backtest carved from the training split. Every decision in the table was taken on that backtest. A specialist is admitted the moment it beats the tournament there, so a candidate costs a few megabytes and minutes of GPU time, and a failed candidate changes nothing. Three guarded mechanisms protect the selection from its own biases: a dual accuracy and calibration criterion, an asymmetric margin against candidates that saw the series during training, and conservative per-window gates. The selection rules themselves were chosen inside a temporal meta-backtest. The best base model served alone reaches a mean MASE rank of 33.8, the tournament served on every configuration reaches 38.0, and the full router reaches 19.4. The routing table, the expert index, the pinned base-model revisions, the submitted score file and the dated snapshot of the public scores are released, and every leaderboard number in this paper regenerates from them by one script.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TW3Cast 是一个时间序列预报系统：在训练集上一次性算出路由表并冻结，按 97 个数据集/频率/时长配置在四种模式（微调专家、含专家的分位数混合、基础模型混合、回测选择锦标赛）中择一，全程不用 agent 和语言模型。在 GIFT-Eval 上以 mean MASE rank 排第 3/130（截至 2026-09-14），前两名均为 agentic 类别；完整路由 19.4，优于最佳单基础模型 33.8 与全配置锦标赛 38.0。
Motivation: GIFT-Eval 排行榜前列被需要 agent 或 LLM 多步推理的系统占据，而轻量、可复现、只依赖训练集信息的路由方案能否接近这一水平尚不清楚。
Method: 对每个配置在训练集切分出的回测上做选择锦标赛，四种模式为：LoRA 或全量微调的 Chronos-2、TiRex、Toto 专家（训练数据经显式规则清洗增强）、含专家的 quantile blend、base model blend、锦标赛；专家只需击败锦标赛即可入选，成本为数 MB 与数分钟 GPU。三重防护机制为精度与校准双准则、针对训练期见过该序列候选的非对称 margin、保守的 per-window gate；选择规则本身在 temporal meta-backtest 内选定。
Result: GIFT-Eval 上 mean MASE rank 排名第 3/130（截至 2026-09-14），前两名属 agentic 类别；mean MASE rank：最佳单独 base model 33.8，全配置锦标赛 38.0，完整路由 19.4；覆盖 97 个数据集、频率与时长配置。发布路由表、专家索引、固定 base-model 版本、提交分数文件与公开分数快照，可用一个脚本重新生成论文中全部排行榜数字。
Conclusion: 只在训练集上冻结的轻量路由即可把 mean MASE rank 从 33.8 压到 19.4 并进入前三，说明不依赖 agent 或 LLM 的多步推理也能逼近 agentic 系统的水平。

papers.title: AI in Science: Early Insights
papers.abstract_en: Scientific progress is a key driver of economic growth and prosperity. There is great excitement - but also concerns - about the impacts of AI on science, but so far little data. We provide early insights on this from three data sources: a sample of 15 million Gemini interactions, an inventory of over 2,600 specialized AI models across disciplines, and a survey of over 600 scientists. We map these data to a new taxonomy of scientific tasks to study how scientists are using AI. Four main findings emerge. First, we find broad adoption and coverage: scientists use AI more than most other occupations. Specialized AI models have broad disciplinary coverage and are highly cited. Nearly half of the scientists surveyed report using some form of AI every day. Second, we document evidence that LLMs (proxied through Gemini usage) and specialized models act as complements-- LLMs are used for general analysis, coding, and manuscript preparation, while specialized models provide domain-specific predictions, data generation and classification. Third, scientists report large productivity gains from using AI: a saving of nearly 7 hours per week, time which is primarily re-invested in more research. Finally, we show that AI is already changing the scientific process. As some stages of scientific research become easier, bottlenecks shift downstream. Scientists report an increased backlog of untested hypotheses and substantial demand for output verification. Our findings suggest that AI holds significant potential to increase scientific productivity. However, as with other sectors, its ultimate impact will be governed by complex task interdependencies and investment into the elimination of emerging bottlenecks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于 1500 万次 Gemini 交互、2600 余个学科专用 AI 模型清单和 600 余名科学家调查，用新的科学任务分类法刻画 AI 在科研中的使用。四个发现：科学家 AI 采用率高于多数职业、近半数受访者每天使用；LLM 与专用模型互补（前者做通用分析/编码/写稿，后者做领域预测与数据生成）；每周节省近 7 小时且多投回研究；科研瓶颈随部分环节变易而后移，未检验假设积压与产出核验需求上升。
Motivation: 关于 AI 对科学影响的讨论热烈但缺少数据，需要把真实使用行为、模型供给与科学家自述放到统一任务分类下，才能判断 AI 是否真的提升科研生产率以及瓶颈移到了哪里。
Method: 整合三类数据源：1500 万次 Gemini 交互样本、覆盖各学科的 2600 余个专用 AI 模型清单、600 余名科学家的调查；将三者映射到一套新的科学任务分类法 (taxonomy of scientific tasks)，据此分析使用模式、互补关系与生产率变化。
Result: 科学家 AI 采用率高于多数职业，专用模型学科覆盖广且被高引；近半数受访科学家每天使用某种 AI；LLM 与专用模型呈互补（Gemini 用于通用分析、编码、写稿，专用模型用于领域预测、数据生成与分类）；自述每周节省近 7 小时并主要再投入研究；科研流程已变，未检验假设积压增加、产出核验需求显著。
Conclusion: AI 有显著提升科研生产率的潜力，但最终影响取决于任务间的相互依赖，以及对新出现瓶颈（假设积压、产出核验）的消解投入。

summary_sections.method: 整合三类数据源：1500 万次 Gemini 交互样本、覆盖各学科的 2600 余个专用 AI 模型清单、600 余名科学家的调查；将三者映射到一套新的科学任务分类法 (taxonomy of scientific tasks)，据此分析使用模式、互补关系与生产率变化。
summary_sections.result: 科学家 AI 采用率高于多数职业，专用模型学科覆盖广且被高引；近半数受访科学家每天使用某种 AI；LLM 与专用模型呈互补（Gemini 用于通用分析、编码、写稿，专用模型用于领域预测、数据生成与分类）；自述每周节省近 7 小时并主要再投入研究；科研流程已变，未检验假设积压增加、产出核验需求显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: AI 有显著提升科研生产率的潜力，但最终影响取决于任务间的相互依赖，以及对新出现瓶颈（假设积压、产出核验）的消解投入。

papers.title: Stable and Faithful Explanations for Knowledge Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge tracing (KT) models predict student performance opaquely, limiting pedagogical action. This study contributes a validation protocol testing predictive competitiveness (RQ1), explanation stability (RQ2) and retraining-based faithfulness (RQ3) together. Thirteen behavioral features across five pedagogical themes were engineered from ASSISTments 2009 and 2012, with history features computed from temporally preceding interactions and current response latency retained only for retrospective analysis. ASSISTments 2009 was rebuilt: the uncorrected skill-builder release duplicates each multi-skill interaction across one row per skill, and because those rows share one correctness label, they leak it into preceding-interaction features. Rebuilding lowered model AUC and reordered the explanation results. An Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model explained with Tree SHapley Additive exPlanations (TreeSHAP) was compared against four deep baselines (DKT, SAKT, AKT and SimpleKT) under an information-matched protocol giving the deep models the same behavioral signals and restricting XGBoost to what is derivable from the identifier-and-correctness stream they consume. XGBoost reached an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.777 on 2012 and 0.786 on rebuilt 2009, with prediction-time AUCs of 0.771 and 0.775, respectively, after excluding current response latency; restricted to the baselines' information it performed as they did (0.697 against 0.700, and 0.717 against 0.720), locating the difference in information supplied, not model family. Rankings were consistent across folds, seeds and conditioning schemes (Spearman rho = 0.989-1.000), and removing top-ranked TreeSHAP features harmed AUC more than random removal, though split-gain and permutation rankings performed comparably. Student-level examples are illustrative interpretations, not validated recommendations.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Code is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22715077
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 知识追踪 (KT) 模型的预测与解释需在同一信息条件下联合验证：提出覆盖预测竞争力、解释稳定性与重训练忠实性三项 RQ 的验证协议，在 ASSISTments 2009/2012 上用 XGBoost+TreeSHAP 对比 DKT、SAKT、AKT、SimpleKT。信息对齐后 XGBoost 与深度基线打平（0.697 vs 0.700、0.717 vs 0.720），差异归于所供信息而非模型族；重建 2009 数据后模型 AUC 下降且解释排序被重排。
Motivation: KT 模型预测不透明，难以支撑教学决策；现有解释缺少预测竞争力、稳定性与忠实性的联合检验，且 ASSISTments 2009 未修正版存在多技能交互重复行导致的标签泄漏。
Method: 从 ASSISTments 2009 与 2012 构造覆盖五个教学主题的 13 项行为特征（历史特征仅用时序在前的交互，当前作答延迟仅留作回溯分析）；重建 2009 数据以消除共享正确性标签向先前交互特征的泄漏。用 XGBoost + TreeSHAP，在信息对齐协议下（给深度模型同样的行为信号，把 XGBoost 限制在其可从标识符与正确性流推导的信息）对比 DKT、SAKT、AKT、SimpleKT，并做重训练忠实性检验。
Result: XGBoost 在 2012 上 AUC 0.777、重建 2009 上 0.786；排除当前作答延迟后预测时 AUC 分别为 0.771 与 0.775。限制到基线信息集时与基线持平：0.697 对 0.700、0.717 对 0.720。跨折、跨种子、跨条件化方案的排序一致（Spearman rho 0.989–1.000）；移除 TreeSHAP 高分特征比随机移除更伤 AUC，但 split-gain 与 permutation 排序表现相当。重建 2009 降低了模型 AUC 并重排了解释结果。
Conclusion: XGBoost 与深度 KT 的差距来自所供信息而非模型族；解释排序稳定且具一定忠实性，但 split-gain、permutation 与 TreeSHAP 排序可比，学生级示例仅为说明性解读而非经验证的推荐。

papers.title: Long-Tail Adaptive Flow Matching with Explicit Conditional Consistency Guidance for Precise Multimodal Face Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Although diffusion-based methods have substantially improved the controllability of multimodal face synthesis, their semantic alignment remains suboptimal because most existing approaches rely on implicit latent-space objectives to model the relationship between denoising variables and multimodal conditions. Such implicit modeling is often insufficient to enforce precise correspondence between synthesized faces and conditional inputs, especially under long-tailed semantic mask distributions where rare attributes receive weak optimization signals. To address these limitations, we propose EC\textsuperscript{2}Face, a multimodal face synthesis framework that improves semantic alignment through explicit semantic supervision and distribution-aware optimization. First, we introduce Explicit Conditional Consistency Guidance (ECCG), which imposes direct consistency supervision in pixel space by decoding an approximate reverse estimate of the clean latent and explicitly aligning the synthesized image with textual descriptions and semantic masks. A temporal dynamic modulation function is further designed to adapt the supervision strength according to the timestep-dependent reliability of reverse estimation. Second, we propose Long-Tail Adaptive Flow Matching (LAFM), which reweights spatial optimization signals based on semantic attribute frequency, with normalized weights to maintain numerical stability during training. Importantly, all additional modules are used only during training and introduce no extra inference overhead. Extensive experiments show that EC\textsuperscript{2}Face consistently outperforms competitive baselines in both generation quality and semantic alignment, achieving a 29.38\% improvement in mask accuracy on rare attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EC²Face 用显式条件一致性引导 (ECCG) 在像素空间直接对齐生成人脸与文本/语义掩码，并按属性频率重加权长尾空间优化信号 (LAFM)。在长尾语义掩码分布下，稀有属性的 mask accuracy 提升 29.38%，且附加模块仅训练期使用、不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 多模态人脸合成多依赖隐式 latent 空间目标，难以强制生成结果与条件输入精确对应；长尾掩码分布下稀有属性优化信号弱。
Method: ECCG 解码干净 latent 的近似反向估计，在像素空间对齐文本描述与语义掩码，并用时间动态调制函数按 timestep 调节监督强度；LAFM 按语义属性频率重加权空间优化信号并归一化以保持数值稳定；两模块仅训练期启用。
Result: 在与竞争基线的对比中，生成质量与语义对齐均更优，稀有属性 mask accuracy 提升 29.38%；附加模块不引入额外推理开销。
Conclusion: 显式语义监督加分布感知优化可改善长尾条件下多模态人脸合成的语义对齐，且代价只落在训练期。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Algebraic Expressivity Certificates for Shallow Polynomial Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study exact representability by bias-free shallow polynomial neural networks using algebraic geometry. Over $\mathbb{C}$, a width-$r$ network with activation $z\mapsto z^d$ computes a sum of $r$ $d$-th powers of linear forms, whose Zariski closure is a Veronese secant variety. Ideal elimination therefore yields polynomial certificates of nonrepresentability. We implement this construction as a generic architecture-to-certificate pipeline. For quadratics, we recover the exact symmetric determinantal description and explain its dimension through orthogonal symmetry. In higher degree, the implementation recovers classical catalecticant and secant equations and maps the practical reach of direct elimination across a finite architecture sweep. We also derive the exact population loss floor for a rank-two quadratic network on the sphere, illustrating how an algebraic obstruction induces irreducible approximation error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用代数几何给无偏置浅层多项式神经网络的表达能力下证书：宽度 r、激活 z↦z^d 的网络等价于 d 次幂和，其 Zariski 闭包是 Veronese secant variety，理想消元直接产出“不可表示”的多项式证书。对二次型恢复出精确的对称行列式描述，高次情形复现经典 catalecticant 与 secant 方程，并给出球面上秩二二次网络的精确总体损失下界。
Motivation: 浅层多项式网络何时能精确表示目标多项式缺少可判定的判据，尤其在高次与较大宽度下，无法直接判断表示障碍来自何处。
Method: 把 width-r、激活 z↦z^d 的无偏置网络写成 r 个线性形式的 d 次幂之和，取其 Zariski 闭包为 Veronese secant variety，用理想消元 (ideal elimination) 生成不可表示性证书，并实现为通用的架构到证书 (architecture-to-certificate) 流水线，在有限架构扫描上考察直接消元的可行范围。
Result: 对二次型恢复出精确的对称行列式 (symmetric determinantal) 描述并用正交代对称性解释其维数；高次实现复现经典 catalecticant 与 secant 方程；推导出球面上秩二二次网络的精确总体损失下界 (population loss floor)，说明代数障碍导致不可约的逼近误差。
Conclusion: 表达能力障碍可以写成可计算的代数证书，且这种障碍直接对应不可消除的逼近误差；直接消元的实际可达范围随架构规模受限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Stochastic Semantic Evidence Graphs: Uncertainty Propagation and Governance for Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: AI-agent evaluations usually inspect a final answer, yet error may enter through evidence, retrieval, prompting, generation or decision mapping. We introduce a stochastic semantic evidence graph (SSEG), a hierarchical stochastic DAG whose language node expands into an autoregressive token subgraph and whose observable output may be a law over complete phrases. Semantic reduction and calibration are optional. We define graph-relative local defects and downstream edge influences, derive a pathwise bound on terminal error and use its nodewise terms to diagnose governance triggers. For source provenance, the graph preserves uncertain claim--passage relations and propagates sharp Fréchet bounds rather than assuming independence across sources. Across three open-weight architectures, information-equivalent changes materially alter complete-phrase laws. A controlled experiment yields no certificate violations in 5,000 cases; crossed-RAG and live Brave-retrieval experiments separate retrieval, presentation, source and interaction effects. SSEG therefore turns workflow provenance into a quantitative account of where uncertainty entered, how it propagated and whether an output is qualified for use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机语义证据图 (SSEG)，把 AI agent 的证据、检索、提示、生成与决策映射写成分层随机 DAG，语言节点展开为自回归 token 子图，对来源用 Fréchet 界传播而非假设独立。路径级终端误差界给出逐节点诊断以触发治理；受控实验 5,000 例中零证书违例，跨三个开源模型的信息等价改写显著改变完整短语分布。
Motivation: AI-agent 评测通常只看最终答案，无法定位误差究竟从证据、检索、提示、生成还是决策映射哪一环进入，因而无法对不确定性来源做治理。
Method: 构建分层随机 DAG：语言节点展开为自回归 token 子图，可观测输出可为完整短语上的分布；定义图相对局部缺陷与下游边影响，推导终端误差的路径级界并用其逐节点项触发治理；来源侧保留不确定的 claim–passage 关系并传播 Fréchet 界，语义归约与校准为可选项。
Result: 在三个开源权重架构上，信息等价的改动显著改变完整短语分布；受控实验 5,000 例中零证书违例；crossed-RAG 与 Brave 实时检索实验分离出检索、呈现、来源与交互效应。
Conclusion: SSEG 把工作流来源信息变成对不确定性从何处进入、如何传播、输出是否够格可用的量化说明，可作为 agent 输出的证书式治理机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Modal Emotion Understanding: A Transformer-GAT Approach for Dialogue Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition is a key research area in affective computing, with applications in sentiment analysis, intelligent customer service, and human-computer interaction. However, existing methods often rely on single-modal features or simple multimodal fusion, failing to capture the synergy between global and local contexts, which limits model performance and emotion understanding. To address this challenge, we propose Transformer-GAT, a hybrid framework that combines Transformer and the Graph Attention Network to enable cross-modal emotion understanding. The Transformer is used to capture global semantic information, while the Graph Attention Network is employed to model fine-grained relationships between modalities, thereby enhancing the representation of emotional features. Experiments on the IEMOCAP and MELD datasets show that our model achieves weighted F1 scores of 72.45% and 77.37%, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate that Transformer-GAT effectively integrates multimodal features, balances global and local contexts, and provides deeper emotional insights, offering new directions for multimodal emotion computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Transformer-GAT 混合框架做多模态对话情感识别：Transformer 捕获全局语义，Graph Attention Network 建模模态间细粒度关系，从而平衡全局与局部上下文。在 IEMOCAP 与 MELD 上加权 F1 分别达 72.45% 与 77.37%，超过所对比的 state-of-the-art 方法。
Motivation: 现有方法多依赖单模态特征或简单多模态融合，无法捕捉全局与局部上下文之间的协同，限制了情感理解与模型性能。
Method: Transformer-GAT 混合框架：Transformer 编码器提取全局语义信息，Graph Attention Network 对模态间细粒度关系建图并加权聚合，二者结合增强情感特征表示，在 IEMOCAP 与 MELD 上训练评测。
